tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rting zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btang/dpe thum gsol/dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rting zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang /da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe rting dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang /'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/nang don rig pa dang /gso ba rig pa/tshad ma rig pa/sgra rig pa/bzo rig pa/lo rgyus/rtsis rig ༵//sa bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig —1—

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brdzid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'jug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/—2—

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu spungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / har wid lta bu yo rob dang / a ri sogs su grags wo gyi slob grwa r+sā mo —1 —

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod wo po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi bai ro ska cog zhung / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ shangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen skrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang myongs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ snyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skol ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khru / gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/ —3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhyen mkhyen/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1 —

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras spungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe ceng mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon tan bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag ma rngan yod pa/ da lta 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3—

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i ( kil gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sprungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈dzo 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di( 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus snyen ra phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5—

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin krin sogs kyi rgya'i spyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen pyu pa rta sge 'byung gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang spyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge spyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'khrug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bzhes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gshugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mi tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug smri ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug pū hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhus brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591)la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bzhes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub 4pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags/ can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta pu rte nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni rbu ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang g.yin la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ri ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyi rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635) la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse ngang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon to mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/— 10—

dpal rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs bskyed rim mtha' dag gsal bar byed pa bzhugs/ 1rdo rje 'jigs byed bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs dang slob ma rjes 'dzin bzhugs/ 97dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa byed lugs kyi lag len dngos grub kun stso'i/ zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 105bsnyen pa byed tshul bzhugs/ 112dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed khros pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhu/gas/ 114dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor ma'i cho ga'i dmigs rim gyis gsang ba'i man ngag bzhugs/ 145dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor gyi dbang dang brgyud bshad man ngag dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad bzhugs/ 149dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs/ 152dam can chos kyi rgyal po las kyi gshin rje'i man ngag gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba bzhugs/ 154

las sbyor dang bcas pa'i lag len bzhugs/ 232bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i bdag bskyed sgrub thabs kyi 'bru non brjed tho tsam zhig bzhugs/ 242'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi man ngag rwa lo'i snyan rgyud thun mong ma yin pa bzhugs/ 275dmar nag 'jigs gsum las bzhi'i gtor ma bsdus pa nyin gcig rdzogs pa'i dbu bzhugs/ 340

rim mtha' dag gsal bar byed pa bzhugs/oṃ na mo gu ru gu phya sa ma dzaX tsakra saX bha ra/ mahā ma ya/ badz+ra bhe ra ba/ mahā kā la maṇ+ḍal le khyuXslob dpon ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /'dul dka' 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur bstan pa/ /rnam lnga'i dkyil 'khor mchog la mgos btud nas/ /bla med sgrub thabs gang yin gsal bar bri/ /lam 'dir mkhas grub dam pa mchog brnyes pa'i/ /skyes bu du mas yang yang bshad gyur mod/ /mtshar sdug lang tshos sgeg pa'i gzugs bzang mar/ /rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan na lhag par mdzes/ /de la dgyes pa rdo rje drag po gdan can gyi bskyed pa'i rim pa la gzhi byas nas rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs nyams su len pa'i tshul ni 'di yin te/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas spyi dang 6/thun par byas la/ oX shā n+ya ta dz+nyā badz+ra swā bha wa ut+pa ko3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃX las rdo rje hūṃX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus rang gi snying gar thim nas zhu ba'i thig le las/ bdag nyid dgyes pa rdo rje phyag gnyis pa shes rab ma dang bcas pa tshangs pa dang dbang phyug gi gdan la gnas pa'i snying gar nyi ma la hūṃX de las khro bo bcu spros phyogs bcur 'khod pa ni/ shar du gshin rje gshed nag po tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma'i mthar byed dmar po pad+ma ke 1 — pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed nag po

rdo rje gdengs pa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor gtum po nag po ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal sngo dmar lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ nub byang du be con sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du stobs po che nag po tri shu la 'dzin pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes nag po gshun shing 'dzin pa/ mi g.yo 'dod rgyal gnod mdzes rnams rol pa'i khro bo/ gzhan rnams shin tu khros pa/ thams cad kyang stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang / rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ khro bo'i mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa me dpung dang bcas pa'o /khro bo bcu las khro bo bcu lcags kyu dang zhags pa phyogs bcur spros/phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams kyi yan lag lnga zhags pas bcings/ lcags kyus snying gar btab ste bkug par gyur/ oṃ ya mun+ta krita hūX/ oṃ prarnyo n+ta spo ta hūX/ oX pad+man+ta krita huX/ oṃ ne krita huX/ oX ur+sā tsa la hūX/ oX ṭak+ki rā dza huX/ oX ni la daṇ+ḍa huX/ oX mahā ba la huX/ oX tsakra nywa rti hūX/ oX nga rā dza huX/ oX za ni nga hūX/gro hā gro hā huX/ gro hā pā ya gro hā pā ya huX/ ā na ya ho bha gi wān biṅgā rā dza hūX phaṭa swāhā/ yang huX las phur bu dang tho ba bcu spros/ yang sprul khro bo rnams kyi lag pa g.yas g.yon du gtad/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab cing tho bas brdungs nas/ lus g.yo 'gul med/ ngag rlud rgyu ba med/ sems 'od gsal du thim zhing lhag ma rnams rdo rje'i me 'od dang dang sngags kyi sgras khor yug chen po'i phyi rol tu bskrad par gyur/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba du gu na phaṭa/ gī lā ya gī lwa ya sarba pā paX phaṭa/ huX hūX hūX badz+ra gī la badz+ra dha ro a dz+nyā pa ya ti sarba —2—

bisnrin kā ya nywa ka tsit+ta badz+ra gī ya hūX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra the tha ra badz+ra gī la ā ko ṭa ya huX huX phaṭa/ rang nyid mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas mā ma gī la 'khyud pa/ rlung kha spyor bya/ rtsa gsum gsal btab nas/ a wa ga ti rab tu rgyas pa'i nang gi snying gar huX mthing nag /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūX hūX huX phaṭa swāhā/ snying ga'i hūX las raX chad de 'og tu nyi mar gyur/ yang huX gcig chad de/ de'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rjer gyur pa ni/ shar gyi rā gsum dkar po/ lho'i rwa gsum ser po/nub kyi rwa gsum dmar mo/ byang gi rwa gsum ljang khu/ lte ba mthing nag la hūX gis mtshan pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje de nyid rgya che zhing rngams 'thug par gyur pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug tu 'phros pa dpangs mtho nas rwa ba/ rtse mo rnams steng du 'dus pas gur dang bla bre/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa huX huX hūX phaṭa swā hā/ phyogs bzhir dmigs nas huX bzhi pa lan gcig brjod/ snying ga'i hūX gi 'od zer gyi sna la rdo rje gcig pa nas rtse dgu pa'i bar gyi rdo rje rnams 'phros te go mtshams med pa gtams/ yang rak+ta'i sngags brjod pas/ 'og gi nyi ma las ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi me 'bar bas phyi ngos kyi rdo rje rnams khro chu ltar zhu nas/ me long gi ngos bzhin du gyur pas bskal ba'i rlung gis kyang mi thar zhing bar du gcod pa gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa'i bsrung 'khor ye shes kyi me 'bar bas dpag tshad bye ba tsam du khyab par gyur/ badz+ra rwak+ta'i sngags lan gsum brjod/ gnas bsrungs pa'o/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin phung 'khrigs pa bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ bla ma yi dam —3—

mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / khro bo chos skyong bcas pa la/ /rtag tu gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /lan gsum rnal 'byor bsrung ba'o/ /lus bsrung ba ni/ bla ma yi dam 'khor bcas kyis/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis sems can gyi don du rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs sgrub pa ni shin tu legs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyi bar chad nga yi bsrung zhing byin gyis brlabs par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs nas bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad pa bkrus par gyur/ dngos su khrus spro na bya/ ngag bsrung ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rdo rje la sogs pa byon nas rang dang dbyer med du gyur/ yang sngags rnams bzla zhing kha bkrus la bdud rtsi myang / yid bsrung ba ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bdag gi pha ma yin/ pha ma 'di rnams sdug bsngal ba snying re rje/ da ni bdag gis bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bya/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar bya/ rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis go 'phang la bzhag par bya/ de'i phyir du bdag gis rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /bdag bsrung ba'o/ /de yan chad ni dkyil 'khor re re nyams su len pa dag gis/ dgyes pa rdo rje dang rgyud sde lnga zhes bya ba'i gnas su rang rang gi mtshan bcug pas 'grub cing g.yin rnams la phyag gnyis pa rang gi mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba ltar bsgoms zhing / gsang 'dus la yang rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po yum can bsgom pa yin no/ /de nas rang skad cig gis dgyes mdzad rdo rje phyag gnyis pa shes rab ma dang bcas pas gsal ba'i snying gar raX las nyi ma'i steng —4—

du huX/ de las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros pas/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad sbyangs/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ yang 'phros pas sha khrag la sogs pa bar gyi dngos po rnams kyang sbyangs te ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ yang 'phros pa ba sbu'i bu ga nas phyir song ste rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dkyil 'khor lnga'i lha tshogs bla mas dbu brgyan pa sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs/ /bdag gi gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ bha ga wan mahā kā ru ṇi he badz+ra gu he sa mā dzaX tsakra sa lhar mahā/ mu ha ma yā badz+ra bhi ra ba maṇ+ḍal la sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaX rang gi lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs sho ka gcig /bcom ldan dgyes mdzad dkyil 'khor dang / /gsang 'dus mahā ma ya dang / /bde mchog 'khor lo 'jigs mdzad de/ /yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro dang / /chos skyong tshogs dang bcas pa la/ /bdag sogs gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /oX ni ri ti huX khaX/ ne wi te hūX khaX/ sarba saX shwa dha ni ā huX / dzaXhūX baX hoX khaX raX mahā ar+ghaX pra tismo ye swāhā/ yang na/ ar+ghaX nas/pa tuX ste chu gnyis phul kyang rung / oX badz+ra pukhye āXhuX nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis 'bul/ nam mkhar rje btsun bltas nas ni/ /rdo rje skye ba snying rje can/ /rgyan rnams thams cad 'dzin pa yi/ /lha mo brgyad po rnams kyis mchod/ /dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag —5—

ma/ /lha sma ri ni sman 'dzin cing / /puska sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod mi ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen po rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'byud pa nyid/ /mchod bya yul/ mchod byed bdag /mchod pa'i rdzas thams cad rang bzhin med par rang gis sems nyid do/ /de nas rgyun bshags ni/ thog med dus kyi sdig pa dang / /sems can rnams kyi sdig pa'i tshogs/ /mi dge las rnams ci bgyis pa/ /de kun khyed la bshags par bgyi/ /so sor thar pa'i mi mthun dang / /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /de dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa kun/ /de dag khyed la so sor bshags/ /gsang sngags theg par dbang bskur nas/ /dam tshig nyams chags byung ba kun/ /de dag khyed kyi spyan sngar bshags/ /mi dge slan chad sdom par bgyi/ /so so'i skye bo'i dge ba dang / /nyan thos dgra bcom dge ba dang / /rang sangs rgyas kyi dge ba la/ /bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo / /dang po byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /'gro don 'phrin las rab rgyas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /dge ba kun la yi rang ngo / /bla ma yi dam lha rnams kyi/ /gsang sngags lam mchog mtha' ru phyin/ /'bras bu sku bzhi 'grub pa yi/ /dge ba kun la yi rang ngo / /bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams/ /sems can sangs rgyas thob don du/ /byang chub chen por rab tu bsngo/ /bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas la/ /bdag gis lus ngag yid gsum ni/ /ltos med sems can don du 'bul/ khyed kyi sku gsum 'grub —6—

tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/par shog /bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dang / /'du 'bral med par 'grub gyur nas/ khyed kyi byin rlabs mthu yis ni/ /gang ltar song yang thugs rjes zungs/ /bla ma rgyud sde'i lha rnams kyis/ /sems can rgyud la gang 'tshams pa'i/ /gang 'dul de la der ston pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas kyis/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas sa la ma 'khod bar/ /de srid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bla ma dam pa rnams dang ni/ /yi dam mkha' 'gror bcas pa dang / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /bdag ni skyabs su nye bar mchi/ /bla ma rgyud sde'i lha rnams kyis/ /dang po byang chub thugs bskyed ltar/ /bdag kyang sems can bsgral ba'i blos/ khyed kyi rjes su sems bskyed do/ /yang na mtsho skyes ltar yan lag lnga'am/gur nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa bya'o/ /de nas/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad la sogs pa'i rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung bar bya'o/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang /sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ /oX swa bhā wa 8khyu sarba dharma swā bha wa shu rdzo3haX/ oX shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las raX las nyi ma la huX las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de las rdo rje'i sa gzhir rwa ba drwa bgur bla bre me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ e las chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs shing / rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa'i nang du/ yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gaX yaX dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum raX dang 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baX las chu'i dkyil —7—

'khor dkar po zlum po/ baX dang bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laX las sa'i dkyil snyen ra ser po gru bzhi laX dang rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bhuX las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu drug pa lhe ba la bhāX gyis mtshan pa/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las pad nyi sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa'i steng du/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin du dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu las drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa la sogs pa du ma dpyangs pa/ de'i steng du bya 'dabs las thur du 'phyang ba'i shar bu'i phreng ba dang / steng du mda' yab mchod rten gyi dbyibs can gyis bskor ba'i bar bar na gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pas brgyan pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhi mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mo rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'gram stegs mchod pa'i snam bu dmar po la bud med sgyu ma'i mdzes sdug gis sgeg pa'i gzungs ma rnams kyis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la mchod pa/ zur bzhir zla phyed nor bu dang / sgo khyud kyi mtshams su zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du rgyan dang bcas pa'i ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs mchod rten gyis rnam pa can ngang pa dang rma bya dang nya sbus brgyan pa dang / chu srin dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / spre'u bzung ba'i ba dan la sogs pas brgyan pa/ rta babs kyis rtse mor pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos 'khor/ steng du gdugs dkar po/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas —8—

pa/ gzhan yang rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i gzhal yas khang glang rgyab kyi nang de bzhin gshegs pa lngas mdzes pa/ sgo bzhi'i phyi rol tu rin po che'i them skas dang / de'i phyi rol tu babs bzhon gyi rta babs dang bcas pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar du gtum drag gi dur khrod/lhor 'jigs byed thod pa can/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ byang du tshang tshang 'khrigs pa/ shar lhor dbang phyug nags tshal/ lho nub tu mun pa mi zad pa/nub byang du ca co sgrog pa/ byang shar du ha ha rgod pa'o/ khreng chen po brgyad ni/ha ra tsu ta a sho ka /a shwad tha dang ka ra sgra dza la ti dang par ti pa/ bhe ta dang ni bha ṭa'o/ /rtsa bar phyogs skyong brgyad gnas pa/ khar du brgya byin lhor gshin rje/ /chu lha nub dang gnod sbyin byang / /byang shar 'byung po shar lho me/ /lho nub srin po nub byang rlung / /brgya byin dkar po glang po'i bdag /rdo rje dril bu g.yas dang g.yon/ /gshin rje mthing nag ma he bzhon/ /dbyug pa thod pa de bzhin no/ /chu lha dkar pos chu srin mnan/ /sprul zhag g.yas dang g.yon pad+ma/ /gnod sbyin ser po rta la bzhon/ /dpal 'bras ne'u le g.yas dang g.yon/ /'byung po'i bdag po dkar po ni/ khyu mchog dkar po mdung thung 'dzin/ /me lha dmar po ra la bzhon/ /spyi blugs dbyug gu rtse gsum bsnams/srin po kham nag me ri khrid/ /gri dang thod pa g.yas dang g.yon/ /rlung lha dud kha sha ba bzhon/ /g.yas nas ba dan zhags pa g.yon/ /thams cad rin chen brgyad ldan te/ /srin po rus pas brgyan pa'o/ /chung ma bu 'khor phyogs mdog bcas/ /mdog rnams zhi byed phyogs logs skyong / /steng gi nam mkhar lha chen —9—

brgyad/ khar du brgya byin sngon dang 'dra/ /lho ru tshangs pa gser gyi mdog /spyi blugs dbyug gu rtse gsum 'dzin/ /nub tu khyab 'jug dmar po ste/ /'khor lo g.yas dang g.yon na dung / /byang du lha chen thal ba'i mdog /rtse gsum thod pa g.yas dang g.yon/ /dbang ldan gzhon nu drug gi bu/ /dkar po mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa / shar lho tshogs bdag dkar po ni/ /g.yas g.yon la phug la du 'dzin/ /bden bral ra gi ri ti smug /mdung dang ba dan g.yas dang g.yon//rlung du legs ldan nag po ni/ /ral gri g.yas dang phub ni g.yon/ /thams cad lha rgyan dag dang ldan/ /lha dang gza' skar 'khor gyis bskor/ /bsdu na brgya byin dkar po man chad nas 'di'i bar bor kyang rung ngo / /chu la klu chen brgyad gnas pa/ /'jog po dung skyong rigs ldan dang / /mtha' yas pad chen dga' bo dang / /nor rgyas bu dang pad+ma rnams/ /phyogs skyong mdog can sbrul zhags dang / /pad+ma 'dzin cing gdengs ka ldan/ snyo|nga gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong rnams phyogs skyong so so'i mdog dang mtshungs shing so so'i bzhon pa'i gdong pa can gri gug dang thod pa gtor mas gang ba 'dzin pa'o/ /sprin chen po brgyad ni/ sgrog byed ser po ldog byed sngon po/ 'jigs byed dkar po/ 'khor byed ser po/ 'thug po dkar po/ 'gengs byed dmar po/char 'bebs nag po/ gtum po ljang gu'o/ /gzhan yang ri brgyad mchod rten brgyad/ chu brgyad/ drag tu 'bar ba'i me brgyad dang bcas pa/ bya dang gcan gzan sna tshogs 'thab pa dang 'khrugs pa dang nga ro 'don pa/ grub chen rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i slob dpon rnams dang / 'jigs pa dang 'dzem pa med — —10—

pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma cang te'u dang kha ṭāX thogs te ha ha zhes gar bsgyur ba/ rol mo sna tshogs pa'i sgra dang / 'dod chags kyi rnam par rol ba/mtshan dang ldan pa'i bu mo rnams gcer bu skra grol ba/ rnam par grol ba/ rnam par brgyan pa/ gar gyi rol ba sna tshogs pas thod rnga'i sgra dang / glu dbyangs bro cha dang bcas pas lhang lhang sogs sgrog pa dang / la lar 'byung po/ sgron me 'bar ba'i 'jug ngogs nas/ lce spyang khus 'debs pa dang / phag dang seng ge dang / stag dang khyi dang / wa sna tshogs pas gang zhing / khwa dang / 'ug pa dang / bya rog dang / 'ol ba dang mchu ring la sogs pas lang long du rgyug pa/ seng ge'i gdong can dang / stag gi gdong can dang / sbrul ba glang gi mgo can dang / mgo gnyis pa la sogs pa skyi g.ya' ba/ ro phyed tshig pa dang / dum bu dang / 'thor ba dang / 'gags te shing la dpyangs pa dang / lhu dum dang mgo bo dang / keng rus kyis khyab pas yid 'byung bar byed pa/ ro langs dang mgo med rnams gar byed pa/ gnod sbyin dang srin po dang sha za dang 'byung po dang / mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams g.yo ba dang / 'greng ba dang / sdod pa dang / nyal ba dang /za ba dang / rgyug pa la sogs pa sna tshogs pas ngo mtshar bskyed pa/ grub pa'i rdzas dang mchod rdzas thams cad kyi gang ba'i dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod/de rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lto ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ phyogs bzhi dmar ba/ me dang rlud ser ba/ bden bral ljang ba/dbang ldan sngo ba/ mtha' ma rdo rje nag po'i mu khyud kyis bskor ba/ lte bar nyi —11—

ma'i gdan la bdud bzhi'i ngo bo/ tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang ljang khu/ drag po nag po rnams gan rkyal du bkram pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la/shar du tshangs pa/ lho ru brgya byin/ nub tu nye dbang / byang du drag po/ byang shar du gshin rje sngon po/ shar lhor gnod sbyin ser po/ lho nub tu srin po smug naganub byang du lha min thags bzang ris ljang khu rnams gan rkyal du gnas pa'i/snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ sgo bzhir nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la yi dwags kyi gdan re re'o/ /'di man ngag ste/ gzhung nas gtso bo la 'dud bzhi'i steng du nyi ma'i gdan gsungs pa ltar byas kyang wo ngo / /dbus su rang sems huX dang oṃ nag po/ de'i 'og tu mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo a ā/ i zhi/ u mū/ ṛ grwa/ le lī/ e i/o au/ aX aX phrag rgenyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ ka kha ga gha nga /tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa lha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ḍa dha da dha la ya/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du yi ge gnyis zhugs te/ hūX las rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa dang aX las gri gug aX gis mtshan par gyur pa ni so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes de las 'od 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs chos kyi dbyings kyis ye shes kyi ngo bo/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog mthing nag /zhal brgyad pa/ spyan nyi —12—

shu rtsa bzhi phye ba/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ zhal nas huX spro ba/ lha dang lha min thams cad bsdigs par mdzad pa/ 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs pa/ drag po chen po rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas dkar ba g.yon dmar ba steng zhal du ba'i mdog can/ lhag ma zhal bzhin nag pa/ dbu skra ser po 'bar zhing 'khyil ba/spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ thod skam lnga lnga'i dbu brgyan can smin ma yon po dang bcas shing / khro gnyer ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ brgyu ltar dmar pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag bcu drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing / g.yas kyi gnyis pa na ral gri/gsum pa na mda'/ bzhi pa na 'khor lo/ lnga pa na bshor/ drug pa na dgrag pa/bdun pa na rtse gsum/ brgyad pa na lcags kyu/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na pad+ma/gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pa na kha ṭāX ga /lnga pa na thod pa/ drug pa ni rin po che/bdun pa na sdigs 'dzub/ brgyad pa na zhags pa bsnams pa/ sku la rus pa'i phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang gi stabs dang / rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis tshangs pa dang / dbang po dang / drag po dang / nye dbang rnams mnyam par mnan/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba ste/ /gar dgu ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de la 'khyud pa'i bdag med ma nag po drag mo chen po lha mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa/phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu bsnams pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang mgo bo skam po lnga'i phreng —13—

ba can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis rjes su chags pa/ lhag ma bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa/ gnyis ka'ang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing nam mkha'i mtha' klas par 'od kyis khyab par mdzad pa'o/ /yang na zhabs mdun ma gar stabs/ rgyab ma g.yas brkyang pa'o/ /yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las hūX las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūX gis mtshan pa/ oṃ badz+ra mahā dī ṣa tsa shun ā nan+ta dā ya ka kha kha mu kha e ka ra so na tha huX hūX hūX kwarlaX ku ru ṣa me/ yum gyi mkha' a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa nye ba aX gis mtshan pa/ oṃ pad+ma su kha dha ra mahā rā ga su kha da da tsa tun a nan+ta bhā ga bi shwa huX huX huX kar+shaX ku ru ṣa me/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs yab kyi zhal nas zhugs nas thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma ra babs pas thig le cha bcu gnyis su gyur/ mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/so so'i gdan la 'khod pa nyi zla kha sbyor bcu gnyis su gyur/ de rnams kyi bar du gaX rtsa baX ghaX paX shaX laX ṭaX dzaXhūX baX hoX rnams su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las gri gug dang cang te'u ral gri dang thod pa rin po che dang rdo rje rlung ras dang thod pa lcags kyu dang / zhags pa lcags sgrog dang dril bu rnams sa bon de rnams kyis mtshan pa/ zla nyi so so dang gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/shar du go rī nag mo g.yas gnyis gri gug dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ lhor tso rī dmar mo g.yas gnyis ḍā ma ru dang 'khor lo/g.yon gnyis thod pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ nub tu be+e ta li ser mo g.yas —14—

gnyis ral gri dang chang bu/ g.yon gnyis dung chos dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du lha sma ri ljang gu g.yas gnyis thod zhags dang skyabs spyin/ g.yon gnyis dgra stu dang me thab 'dzin pa/ byang shar du puska sī sngon po g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang mchog sbyan/ /g.yon gnyis dpag bsam shing gi lcug ma dang thod pa 'dzin pa/shar lhor shā bā ri dkar mo g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang kha ṭāX ga /g.yon gnyis thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu tsan+d+ra lī sngon po g.yas gnyis rlung ras dang thod pa/ g.yon gnyis ba dan dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nub byang du toX bi ni sna tshogs mdog g.yas gnyis thod pa dang bshor/ g.yon gnyis mdung rtse gsum dang sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ shar sgor rta gdong ma nag mo zhal bzhi nag ser dmar ba'i steng na rta gdong ljang khu rtsa phyag gnyis kyis gling bu/ tha ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lhor sgor phag gdong ma ser mo zhal bzhi ser sngo dkar ba'i steng na phag gdong dmar mo rtsa phyag gnyis kyis pi wang tha ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang zhags pa 'dzin pa nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo zhal bzhi dmar sngo dkar ba'i steng na khyi gdong ser mo rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rnga bo che/ tha ma gnyis kyis pad+ma dang lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ byang sgor seng gdong ma ljang gu zhal bzhi ljang nag dmar ba'i steng na seng gdong dkar mo rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rdza rnga/ tha ma gnyis kyi ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lha mo thams cad kyang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ thod skam lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng ba dang / rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i —15—

dbus na bzhugs pa/ sgo ma rnams ni stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ rtsa zhal yang steng zhal dang mtshungs pa'o/ /de nas/ gtso bo'i dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ gtsug tor dang lte bar hoX dmar po res mtshan par gyur/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu nas bdud bzhi'i steng du/ de ba chen po'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin thig le gnyis su gyur/ de nas tshad med pa bzhi'i ngo bor gyur pa'i lha mo bzhi'i snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'gro ba'i don la bskul ba ni/ puska sis/ rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhin bzhengs shig /puska sī ni bdag la skyobs/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod/ /sha ba ris/ khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pas/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /ri khrod ma 'bras 'grub par mdzod/ /tsaṇ+ḍa lis/ dga' brtse 'jig rten don gnyer ba/ /stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci/ khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas/ /gdol ba mo bdag zhu ba bgyid/ /rngeX bi nis/ bdag gis nyid kyi thugs 'chal gyi/ /mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag nyid dran nyams pas/ /snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /ces bskul bas/ thig le gnyis po gcig tu 'dres te nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su huX dang aX las rdo rje dang gri gug huX dang aX gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa dgyes mdzad rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag sogs rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yum bcas ltar gsal btab/ mtshon cha can gyi dkyil 'khor kho na bsgom par 'dod na 'og nas 'gyung ba'i ye shes pa sbyan 'dren yan chad bya'o/ /rgyud sde lnga bsgom par 'dod na/ de ltar bdag nyid —16—

dgyes mdzad du gyur pa'i sku la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa/snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i steng du gzhal yas khang pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang bcas pa'i lte ba la nyi ma'i steng du bdud bzhi'i gdan/'dab ma rnams la shar du tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po dkar po/ nub tu nye dbang ljang khu/ byang du drag po nag po/ byang shar du gzhin rje sngon po/ shar lhor nor bdag ser po/ lho nub tu srin po dmar po/ nub byang du thags bzang ris ljang khu/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rdo rje sku mdog nag po/ drag po chen po rtsa ba'i zhal nag po g.yas dkar g.yon dmar steng zhal du ba'i mdog can/ lhag ma bzhi nag po/ dbu skra ser po 'bar zhing 'khyil ba/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ thod skam lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan can smin ma yon po dang bcas shing / khro gnyer ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/brgyu ltar dmar ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas pa brgyad na/ glang po che rta/ bong bu glang / rnga mo/ khyi/mi/ ma he rnams so/ /g.yon pa brgyad na/ sa'i lha mo/ chu lha/ me lha/ rlud lha/ zla ba/ nyi ma/gshin rje/ gnod sbyin rnams so/ /sku la rus pa'i phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang gi stabs dang / rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyi tshangs pa dang / dbang po dang / drag po dang / nye dbang rnams mnyam par mnan pa/ gar dgu'i nyams kyis rol pa/ de la 'byud pa'i bdag med ma nag mo/—17—

drag mo chen po lha mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa/ phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang / mgo bo skam po'i phreng ba can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis rjes su chags pa/ lhag ma bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs shing /gnyis ka'ang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du go rī nag mo g.yas gri gug dang g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ lhor chom rkun ma dmar mo g.yas ḍā ma ru g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu ro langs ma ser mo g.yas rus sbal g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du za nus ma ljang gu g.yas sbrul g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du sbos mo sngon mo g.yas seng ge g.yon dgra sta 'dzin pa/ shar lhor ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas dge slong g.yon gsil byed 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gdol ba mo sngon po g.yas 'khor lo g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du ga yung mo bya ko li'i mgrin pa ltar kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyan dmar po gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga ldan/ g.yon brkyad ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo dkar po 'dab ma so gnyis pa'i steng du gzhal yas khang dbus ling tshe dgu pa snam bu rim pa gnyis dang bcas pa/dbus dang khro bcu'i gnas su nyi gdan/ shar phyogs pa rnams la zla ba/ mā ma ki la rdo rje/ gzhan lho phyogs pa rnams la rin po che/ nub phyogs pa rnams la pad+ma dmar po/ byang phyogs pa rnams la sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan/ de rnams kyi —18—

steng du dgyes mdzad kyi sku'i snang ba las grub pa'i lha sum cu rtsa gnyis ni/dbus su mi bskyod pa sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis 'byud rgyas yum reg bya rdo rje ma rang dang 'dra ba/ pad+ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis 'byud rgyas yum reg bya rdo rje ma rang dang 'dra ba/ pad+ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ re mig rnams su shar du rnam snang dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor lo rdo rje pad dkar/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu nor bu ral gri 'dzin pa/ lhor rin 'byung ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyi nor bu rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu pad ser ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yon gyi dang po dril bu dkur bsten pas pad+ma dmar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa g.yas kyi dang pos kha 'byed pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyi rdo rje dang 'khor lo g.yon gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang du don grub ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu pad ljang nor bu 'dzin pa/ shar lhor spyan ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor lo rdo rje ut+pal dkar po/ g.yon pa —19—

rnams kyis dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu mā ma ki sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i 'al gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje 'khor lo atrul sngo dmar g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub byang du gos dkar mo dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yon gyi dang pos dril bu dkur bsten pas ut+pal dmar sho'i sdong bu 'dzin pa g.yas kyi dang pos kha 'byed pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang 'khor lo/g.yon gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang shar du sgrol ma ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo ut+pal sngon po rdo rjes mtshan pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo sangs rgyas spyan ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis me long dmar po 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo mā ma gī dang 'dra ba las/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis pi wang sngon po 'dzin pa/ nub byang du dri rdo rje ma dmar mo 'od dpag med dang 'dra ba las/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa/ byang shar du rdo rje ma ljang gu sgrol ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis ro drug gis gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa/ rim pa gsum pa'i lha snam la/ shar sgo'i g.yas su byams pa rnam snang dang 'dra ba las/ g.yas kyi dang pos klu shing gi yal ga me tog dang bcas pa 'khor los mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ shar sgo'i g.yon du sa'i snying po rnam snang dang 'dra ba/ lho sgo'i g.yas su phyag na rdo rje dang /g.yon du nam mkha'i snying po gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu/ nub sgo'i —20—

g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / g.yon du 'jam dpal 'od dpag med dang 'dra ba/ byang sgo'i g.yas su sgrib pa rnam sel dang / g.yon du kun tu bzang po don grub lta bu/ lha yab rnams thams cad ral ba'i thor tshugs dang mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs pa/ yum rnams dbu skra phyed bcings su byas pa/ sgeg cing 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ zur gyis lta ba la sogs pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis mdzes pa/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i dga' bas rol ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rdo rje'i skyil krung dang / gzhan rnams sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/thams cad dar gyi na bza' dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /shar sgor gzhan rje mthar byed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/phyag drug gis g.yas pa rnams kyis tho ba 'khor lo rdo rje/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dril bu dgra sta 'dzin pa/ lho sgor shes rab 'thar byed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dbyug pa ral gri/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dril bu dgra sta 'dzin pa/ nub sgor rta mgrin dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis pad+ma ral gri gshun shing / g.yon snyems pa dang bcas pa'i dril bu dgra sta zhags pa 'dzin pa/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed ljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyi sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo gshun shing / g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dril bu dgra sta 'dzin pa/shar lho'i grwar mi g.yo ba nag po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can nag dkar dmar —21—

ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo/ /g.yon sdigs mdzub dgra sta zhags pa/ lho nub kyi grar 'dod rgyal sngon po rin 'byung gi dbu rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis huX mdzad kyi phyag rgya can/ lhag ma g.yas rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon zhags pa dang lcags kyu/ nub byang gi grar dbyug sngon can sngon po 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje'i mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub pad+ma dgra sta/ byang shar gyi grwar stobs po che sngon po don 'grub kyi dbu rgyan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa nag po ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon thugs dkar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa rtse gsum dgra stu/ steng gi ya phugs kyi nang du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba sngon po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya/ lhag ma g.yas rdo rje dang pad+ma/g.yon sdigs mdzub dang ral gri/ 'og tu sa gzhi'i nang du gnod mdzes nag po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub pad+ma ral gri/ khro bo thams cad kyang stobs chen pha rol gnon pa/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gi —22—

stabs kyis pad nyi la bzhugs pa/ dus mtha'i me lta bu'i me stag 'bar ba dang bcas pas gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'o/ /mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo dmar po 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i steng du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa la/dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i gsung gi snang ba las byung ba'i sgyu 'phrul chen mo lhar lngar gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du dpal he ru ka sngon po sngo ser dmar ljang pa'i zhal/ phyag dang po gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭāX ga bsnams pas/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo dmar ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal can la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu/ khro chags sgeg la 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad la/ spyan gsum gsum dmar zhing g.yo ba/ skra ser gyen brdzes thod skam lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga ཿ'i do shal/ phyag rgya lnga dang gar dgus rol ba/ thal chen gyis byugs shing mi lpags kyis stod g.yogs can g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis nyi ma'i steng du mi ro'i snying gar mnan pa me dpung gi dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ sngo ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhis rdo rje dril bu kha ṭāX ga thod pa bsnams pa/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo ser sngo dkar ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhis rin chen ce spyang ba dan mdung rtse gsum pa bsnams pa/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dkar dmar dkar ser ljang sngo ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhis pad+ma thod pa gzhu dang mda' bsnams pa/ byang du sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu/ ljang ser dkar sngo ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhis ral gri zhags pa ka pā la ḍā ma ru bsnams pa/ lha mo lnga ni thal ba dang bral ba —23—

thod skam gyi phreng ba can no/ /yang na/ 'di la gzhal yas khang gi lte bar pad+ma dmar po bsgom kyang wo / lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo ser po rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i steng du rin po che'i sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar / lho ser/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du 'khor lo dkar po 'khor lo'i mu khyud can/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po pad+ma'i mu khyud can/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rdo rje li mu khyud can/ gsum ga'ang rtsibs brgyad dang ldan pa/dbus su bde chen 'khor lo pad+ma 'dab brgyad mu khyud la gri gug gi phreng ba can/sgo mtshams brgyad du ro'i gdan sna tshogs pad+ma'i ste bar nyi ma la 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma'i gdan/ de rnams kyi steng du dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i yon to gyi snang ba las grub pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing nag zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal mthing ga g.yon ljang / rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser ba/zhal re re la dmar zhing g.yo ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i lpags rlon stod g.yogs su gyon pa/ lhag ma g.yas rnams kyis ḍā ma ru dgra sta rtse gsum gri gug /g.yon pa rnams kyis kha ṭāX ga thod pa zhags pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang / g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs la sna tshogs rdo rje dang /—24—

zla ba phyed pa dang / thod skam lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing / mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs grol shing phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/gar gyis nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub g.yon khrag chen gyis gang ba'i thod pa yab la stob pa'i tshul gyis 'khyud pa/ spyan gsum drag mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lnga dang mgo phreng gis brgyan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khrud pa/ khrag la dgyes shing zla mtshan dang bcas pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma rnams la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar po/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i shar sgor khwa gdong ma sngon mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gzhan rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa/ 'og pa gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭāX ga bsnams pa/g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa ste/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni ro'i gdan dang bcas pa/ bde chen 'khor lo'i mtshams kyi 'dab ma la bum pa bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i steng du thod pa bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs pu snyi ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab tu gtum mo/—25—

byang phyogs dza lan+ta rar ma hā kaX ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub phyogs o ṭi ya nā ra kaX ka la 'od ldan ma/ lho phyogs urbu twar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ shar lhor go da bā rir su ra be+e ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ lho nub tu ra smi shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ nub byang de bī ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang la sko'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar ma la bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog nag lo/ /gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs kā ma rū par aX ku ri dang e ra ba ti/byang phyogs o dreng rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub phyogs tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho phyogs ko sa lar rdo rje huX mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ shar lhor ka ling kar rab tu bzang po dang / bye ma de bī/ lho nub lam pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ nub byang ka zhin 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ byang shar hi ma lar mig mi bzang dang 'a gā na ste gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dmar lo /sku'i 'khor lo'i shar phyogs pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang phyogs kṛ ha de bar rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ nub phyogs so swa kha rta mgrin dang ho ni/ lho phyogs su war+ṇa dī par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ shar lhor na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ lho nub si rgyur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ nub byang —26—

ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo'i bsgyur ma/ byang shar ku la tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste sku'i gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dkar po'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams zhal gcig phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang rang gi yum la 'byud pa/ 'og pa gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭāX ga 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa/ rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni rdo rje phag mo'i rigs las byung ste phag mo dang rnam pa mtshungs te/ 'on kyang phyag g.yas pa na gri gug dang g.yon thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lo ljang khu rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi steng du gzhal yas khang dbus kyi lte ba la sna tshogs rdo rje/ steng thog re mig dgur phub pa/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i 'phrin las kyi snang ba las grub pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu phyag sum cu so bzhi/ zhabs bcu drug pa/ rtsa zhal nag po ma ge'i gdong can shin tu khros pa/ pho ka ra'i sgra chen po 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ de'i steng na srin po'i zhal dmar po bzhad cing mche ba gtsigs pa zhal gyi grwa nas khrag 'dzag pa/ de'i steng na 'jam dpal gyi zhal ser po 'dzum zhing cung zad khros pa/ gzhon nu'i rgyan can/ rwa'i g.yas phyogs kyi zhal dang po sngon po/gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa ser po ste mnga' bdag gi zhal gsum shin tu khros pa/ rwa'i g.yon phyogs kyi zhal dang po dkar po gnyis pa dud kha/ gsum po nag po ste zhal gsum ka'ang mche ba gtsigs pa'o/ khro zhal rnams smin ma —27—

dang sma ra dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas pa'i phyag bcu drug gis rim pa bzhin du/ dang po na spi gug /gnyis pa na 'phang mdung / gsum pa na gtun shing / des 'grel/ chu gri/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ dgra sta/ mdung / mda'/lcags kyu/ dbyug pa/ kha ṭāX ga /'khor lo/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ rdo rje tho ba/ ral gri/ rnge'u chung / bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi phyag bcu drug gis rim pa bzhin du/ dang po na thod khrag /gnyis pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo/ gsum pa na phub/ des 'gres/rkang pa/ rdo rje'i zhags pa/ /gzhu rgyu ma/ rdo rje dril bu/ lag pa / ro ras/ skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa/ me thab/ thod tshal/ sdigs mdzub/ 'phan rtse gsum pa/ rlung ras bsnams pa/ phyag tha ma gnyis kyis glang po'i che'i lpags pa rlon pa khrag dang bcas pa brgyangs nas na bza' 'dzin pa/ phyag dang po gnyis phyag mtshan thugs dkar steng 'og tu 'dzin cing / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /zhabs bcu drug gi g.yas brgyad bskums pa rim pa bzhin du mi dang ma he dang glang dang bong bu dang rnga mong dang / khyi dang lug dang wa rnams mnan pa/g.yon brgyad brkyangs pas rim pa bzhin du bya rgod dang lug pa dang khra dang bya rog dang ne tso dang khyung dang ri skeg dang bzhad rnams mnan pa/ de rnams kyis 'og tu tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/ drag po nag po rnams bskyel zhing kha bub tu mnan pa/ dbu re re la thod pa skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang / rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ thal chen gyi tshom bu/ rak+ta'i thig le/ zhag gi zo —28—

ris rnams kyis mtshan pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ rgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba ste/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba/ g.yon khrag chen gyis gang ba'i thod pa yab la stob pa'i tshul gyis 'byud pa/ spyan gsum drag mo bskal ba'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ gcer bu skra ser 'khyil ba/ phyag rgya lnga dang rlon bral gyi mgo 'phreng gis cod pan dang do shal du brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis yab la 'khril ba/ khro mo'i cha lugs rdzogs pa 'od kyis nam mkha'i mthar khyab pa'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa'o/ /shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po dkar nag dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lhor ser sna gzhin rje gshed ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'byud pa/lhag ma g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang 'bor lo —29—

'dzin pa/ byang du phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ shar ltor tsar tsi kā dkar mo gti mug gshin rje gshed lta bu/ lho nub tu phag mo ser mo dbu'i steng du phag zhal gyen du lta ba dang bcas pa ser sna gshin rje gshed lta bu/ nub byang du dbyangs can ma dmar mo 'dod chags gzhin rje gshed lta bu/ byang shar du go ri ljang khu phrag dog gshin rje gshed lta bu/ de ltar lha mo bzhi po rang snang gi thabs la 'phyud pa'o/ /shar sgor thob pa gshin rje gshed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis tho ba dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lho sgor dbyug pa gshin rje gshed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'byud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis pad+ma dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ nub sgor pad+ma gzhin rje gshed dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'phyud pa/lhag ma g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ byang sgor ral gri gzhin rje gshed ljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal —30—

gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa smin ma dang sma ra dang dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ sbrul gyi rgyan dang stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ yab rnams thams cad thod skam lngas dbu brgyan cing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i phreng ba dang rus pa'i phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ yum rnams thod skam lngas bu brgyan cing / skam po lnga bcu'i phreng ba dang rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ phyi'i grwa bzhir ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi dang bcas pa'o/ /rang dgyes mdzad rdo rje mtshon cha can gyi thugs kar pad nyi la hūX/ lha mo bcu gsum gyi thugs kar pad zla la/ aX gaX tsaX baX ghaX paX shaX laX ḍaX dzaXhūX baX hoXrnams 'khod par gyur/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dgyes mdzad mtshon cha can lha bcu gsum rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa oX badz+ra sa ma dzaX shar phyogs kyi dur khrod chen po'i thad kyi steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis yang dag par mchod/ spros na 'og nas 'byung ba ltar nang mchod byin gyis brlabs la 'bul/ bsdu na dgyes mdzad snying po lan gnyis dang / gtso bo gzhan bzhi'i snying po lan re brjod la/ mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ zhes gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ de thams cad kyang sgyu ma lhar rang bzhin med par —31—
