shes par byas nas cung zad mnyam par bldan /oṃ badz+ra go rī a kar+ṣa ya dzaX oṃ badz+ra tso rī pra be sha ya huX/ oṃ badz+ra be tā li ban+ta baX/ oṃ badz+ra lha smi rī wa shaX ku ru hoX dzaXhūX baX hoX lan lnga/ ye shes sems dpa' dang dam tshig sems dpa' ro gcig tu gyur/phyi'i dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i lha rnams kyi mig tu maX dkar po/ rna bar daX sngon po/sna la paX ser po/ lce la raX dmar po/ dpral bar i ljang gu/ lhe bar naX nag po/mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu/ lte bar bdag med rnal 'byor ma nag mo/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rdo rje ma drug gi go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus te skye mched kyi lha rnams la thim pa las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / 'jigs mdzad kyi lha rnams kyi mig tu khriX dkar po sa'i snying po/ rna bar dzaX nag po phyag na rdo rje/ sna la khaX ser po nam mkha'i snying po/ lce la gaX dmar po 'jig rten dbang phyug /dpral bar skaX ljang gu sgrib pa rnam sel/ lte bar saX sngon po kun tu bzang po'i ngo bo/ sgrub chen mo'i lha tshogs rnams la dpral bar rtse ser po/ mig tu oṃ dkar po/ rna bar āX dmar po/kha la khe dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ snying gar ra dmar po/ bde mchog gi lha yab rnams kyi snying khar oṃ oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor oX na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu oṃ swā hā huX dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug /phrag pa gnyis su oṃ bo ṣa ṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka /mig gnyis su oṃ hūX hūX ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭa hi ljang —32—

khu rta mchog gi ngo bo/ yum rnams la lte bar oX baX dmar po rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haX yoX sngon mo gzhin rje ma/ khar oX hru mo dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar oX hri hriX ser mo bskyed byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu oX huX huX ljang khu skrag byed ma/tshigs chen brgyad la oX phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tshwa ka'i ngo bo/ de ltar go cha so sor dgod pa ni bla ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes yin la/ grub chen khyung po nyid kyi dgongs pa ni/ dgyes mdzad lha dgu'i mig tu maX dkar nas/ lte bar naX nag po'i bar gong bzhi no/ /phyi dkyil ma gtogs kyi lus dkyil lnga car skad cig bskyed pa yin pa'i phyir/ skye mched byin gyis rlabs pa dang gnas gsum byin gyis rlabs pa mi bzhed do/ /de phyir sa bon las lus dkyil dkyil 'khor lnga'i lha tshogs bskyed pa yang mi mdzes so/ /lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oX dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi lus kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs bskul zhing bsdus te/ oX la thim pa las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āXdamar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi ngag gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs bskul zhing bsdus te/ āXl thim pa las gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/thugs dkar huX sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi yid kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs bskul zhing bsdus te/ hūX la thim pa las thugs rdo rje ma sngon mo/ gti mug rdo rje ma la sogs pa lha mo drug dang / sku rdo rje ma la sogs pa lha mo drug ni zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭāX ga bsnams pa/ rus pa dang mi mgo'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ /—33—

rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer sna lnga 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad bskul/ dbang gi lha rgyal ba yab yum/ byang chub sems dpa' yab yum/ khro bo rig ma dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaX gong bzhi mchod pa gsum gyis mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje bdag la stsol/ /'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs/ /phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po khyod/ /las rnams thams cad grub byed pa/ /thams cad rdo rje bdag mgur gyur/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis/ khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsole/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi khiñtsa tu maX zhes gsol ba btab pas/sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas byung ba'i spyan ma dang / mā ma ki dang / gos dkar mo dang / sgrol ma rnams kyi byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur/ khro bo rnams kyis bsrung ba'i las mdzad/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blang / rdo rje ma rnams kyis mchod de/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūX/ zhes gsung zhing dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad la dbang bskur/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las gtso bo yab yum dang / go rī dang /puska sī la mi bskyod pa/ tso ri dang / sha wa rī dang sgo ma bzhi rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ bai tā li dang tsan+t+ra lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/ lha sma rī dang rngeX bi ni —34—

la 'od dpag med rnams kyis dbu brgyan/ sgo ma bzhi la don grub kyis dbu rgyan pa yang bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bzhed pa ltar yang rung ngo / /de ltar phyag len la lus kyi lha rnams la yang rig bdag bzhed pa ltar na 'dus pa'i lha tshogs thams cad la rnam snang / sgyu 'phrul chen po'i lha tshogs thams cad la 'od dpag med/ dgyes mdzad kyi lha tshogs thams cad la mi bskyod pa/'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs thams cad la rin po che rgyal po/ 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs thams cad la don grub kyis dbu brgyan/ ces bzhed pa ni/ sku gsang ba 'dus pa zhes gsungs pa sogs la brten pa yang snang mod kyi grub chen khyung pos mi bzhed cing don la yang mi dgos mod/ 'jag bsam kun gyi phyag len la mgrin gcig tu mdzad pa'i phyir bkod pa'o/ /de nas bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ āXdu ta kṛ ta huX gis bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam yaX dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa'i steng du/ raX las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum raX gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaX gsum las mi mgo'i skyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa dkar po stong gsum gyi khyon tsam gyi nang du/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar hūX las snabs dang mchil ma/ khar du bhuX las dri chen/ ltor aX las rak+ta/ nub tu dzī las byang chub kyi sems/ byang du khaX las dri chu/ dbus su na las ma'i sha /byang shar du gaX las ba glang gi sha /sha lhor nāX las glang po che'i sha/lho nub tu haX las rta'i sha /nub byang du ṣaX las ce spyang gi sha rnams kyis gang ba/steng du oX āXhuX thugs ka'i hūX las 'od 'phros/ sna bug nas thon/ rlud gi ba dan la phog /yaX las rlud g.yos/ raX las me sbar/ thod pa'i rdzas rnams bskol/ zhu zhing gyen du lud pa'i mi gtsang ba rnams phyir phyung / steng gi āXzla —35—

ba'i dkyil 'khor hūX rdo rje gyur pa oṃ dang bcas te thod par lhung bas rdzas rnams lan bdun du dkrugs shing sbyangs/ yang rdo rje 'greng bur gnas pa'i lte bar āXlas byung ba'i zla ba las hūX dang rtse mor la oX gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres/ oX āXhūX lan gsum dang / ha ho hiX kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ 'bring du byed na lag pa thal mo kha sbyar ba'i nang du/ skye( āXhuX zhes bsam/ tseX( zhes brjod lag pa g.yon pa bsten pas oX las 'od 'phros bdud rtsi snod bcud dang bcas pa la phog stong par bsam/ g.yas pa bstan pas āXzhes pas āX'i 'od zer gyis rin po che'i thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba stong gsum tsam du bsam pa'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas phyur gyis gang bar bsam/ lag pa gnyis ka bstan pas hūX gis 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres pa'i kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par bsam la/ oX āXhūX lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis rlabs/ shin tu bsdu bar byed na/ thod pa bcud dang bcas pa la dmigs nas/ tso ( āXhuX lan gsum brjod pa la phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dpag tu med par gyur bar bsam mo lha thams cad kyi ljags hūX las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs shing gsol bas tshim zhing mnyes par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a khru ta badz+ra su bha wa ut+pa ko3haX/ de nas yang sngar bzhin/ ar+ghaX la sogs pas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza badz+ra swa bha wa ut+pa ko3haX/ lha mo'i 'khor gyis bcom ldan bskor/ /rgyu dang mi —36—

rgyu khyod kyi thugs/ /sems can kun gyi don mdzad rnams/ /bcom ldan mchog tu dgyes rdo rje/ /zhal mdzes thugs kyi dgongs pa 'grub/ / thugs dgyes mdzod cig dgyes rdo rje/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti ra badz+ra su bha wa at+pa ko3haX/huX mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ / thams cad dngos po rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad rang bzhin gnas/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /kyai rdo rjer bdag phyag 'tshal/ / mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che/ /sngags kyi me tog 'phreng bas brgyan/ sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa/ /he ru ka dpal bdag phyag 'tshal/ /bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ni/ /bskal ba'i me dpung lta bur rab tu 'bar/ /ral pa'i cod pan dbu'i rgyan du bcings/ /mche ba rab gtsigs drag shul 'jigs pa'i zhal/ /sku la gzi brjid phyag stong ldan pa po/ /dgra sta zhags pa kha ṭāX mdung bsnams shing / /rab 'jigs stag gi lpags pa sku la gsol/ /sku chen du kha bgegs mthar mdzad la 'dud/ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /bdud dang mu stegs lha min bcom/ /gzhin rje 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs thams cad snyoms par zhugs te gcig tu 'dus pa byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le dkar po dwangs shing 'od zer 'phro ba ltar mi bzod pa zhig tu gyur nas bde chen 'khor lo'i lte ba la gnas par bsam/ de'i 'od zer gyis spyi bo'i 'khor lo dang lus kyi nang dang snang ba thams ba cad khyab pas thams cad kyang 'od dkar po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ slar 'dus te —37—

thig le la thim/ de ltar sems dang thig le dbyer med pa de la ma bcos pa'i tshul gyi mnyam par bzhag /de bzhin du mgrin pa'i lha tshogs rnams zhu bas thig le dmar po dang / snying kha'i lha rnams zhu bas thig le sngon po/ lte ba'i lha rnams zhu bas thig le ser po dang / gsang gnas kyi lha tshogs rnams zhu bas thig le ljang khur gyur/ lhag ma'i dmigs pa spyi bo'i thig le bzhin bskyang / mthar lnga char las 'od zer 'phros/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs zhing yongs su dag par byas/thams cad kyang rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de rnams kyang 'od zer gyis rnam par zhu/rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ dkyil 'khor lha dang bcas pa yang 'od zer rnam pa lngar zhu ste bdag nyid la thim/ bdag nyid thig le bzhi dang bcas pa yang snying kha'i thig le la thim/ de nyid kyang 'ja' tshon yal ba ltar bsam la cung zad mnyam par bzhag /slar yang de nyid kyi ngang las rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyud sde lnga'i lus dkyil dang bcas pa skad cig tsam gyis grub par gyur/ de ltar bsgoms pas lo zla tsam gyis lam lnga'i rim pa lnga phyag rgya bzhi'i rtags rnams rdzogs par 'gyur zhes grub chen khyung pos gsungs so/ /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la sngags 'di rnams bzla bar bya ste/ oX a zhu na nā ya/ skra bo rte ke sha wartu ne/ tsa turbi sha ti ne tru ya/ kho ṭa sha bhu dzā ya/ kriṣ+ṭha dzi mū ta wa pu ṣe ka pā la mā la a ne kar+sā ri ṇi/ ar rmi ta kru ra tsit+ta ya/ a rje nu daX spyi ṇi/ oṃ mā ra ya/ mā ra ya/ ka rā ya ka rā ya/ ga rdzu ya ga rdzu ya/ ta rdzu ya ta rdzu ya/ sho khyi ya sho khyi ya/ sa bha swā ga rā na ban dha ban dha/ nā ga aṣ+ṭa kwan/ gro hā grihā/ sha truX/ ha hā/ hi hi/ hu hū/ he hai/ho ho/ ha haX/ phaṭa swāhā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /oX de wa pi tsu badz+ra huX huX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oX badz+ra ka rta ri he badz+ra ya huX hūX huX phaṭa swāhā/ glu( aX swāhā/ tseX( maX swāhā/ glu( aX swāhā/ tseX( aX swāhā/ skye rna mūX swāhā/ tseX( daX swā—38—

gri so su na si ma ku/ huX huX huX huX huX hūX hūX hūX/ zhes bde mchog gi sngags phreng bsdus pa'o/ /rgyas par ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /oX ā dhi swāhā/ oṃ ya mun+ta ka huX phaṭa/ oX hiXnyu ༄ ༷bi kri tā na nā hūX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye huX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ ā dzi na dzika hūX/ oX āXrat+na dhika huX/ oṃ āX.ā ro lika hūX/ oX āXpradz+nyā dhika hūX/ oX āXmo ha rā ti hūX/ oX āXdī ṣa ra ti huX/ oṃ āXrā ga rā ti hūX/ oṃ āXbadz+ra ra ti hūX/ oṃ āXmud ga ra dhika huX/ oX āX dan+t+ra dhika hūX/ oX āXpad+ma dhika huX/ oX āXkha rga dha ka hūX/ oX āXṇa huX/ oX āXyo hūX/ lkoX āXje hūX/ oX āXr huX/ zhes pa ni rdo rje 'jigs byed lha tshogs kyi yin no/ /rgyas par na mtshon cha can la phreng ba'i sngags 'di dag bzla bar bya'o/ /oX hriXswāhā/ lkoX badz+ra gu rkye sirnyi pa ra ma yo ge shwa ri ka pā la mā la dha ri ṇi ru dhi ra pra ye shra shā na bā si nī huX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra tshwa shwa ri/ kha ṭāXdhi/ mahā badz+re ṇi ka pā la mā la/ mu ku ṭo ā kaṭa dha/ sarba du ni da ba mā kas/ ru lu ru lu smyo hūX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra pa ra dzi te pa ra ma gu hre ka pā la mā lā ni bhu te sarba du rnge mo ha ni pri ye e phya hi bha ga wa ti badz+ra gu hre shwa rī/ ba hu bi dha be sha dha ri ṇi/ sarba du ni ni bā ra ṇi huX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra be rta li kha kha ji hi 'a hi sarba du rte bi kṛ ta be ṣa dha ri ṇi/ bi kri ta laṅga ra bhu ṣe te ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa/ mā bi la sba/ mu bi la sba/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra pra be sha ya maṇ+ḍa la ma sbye/ gi tha pa ya sarba hūX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ e hre bha ga ba ti badz+ra gu hre shwa ri ba hu bi dha be sha dha ri ṇi/ sarba ta thā ga ta skye sne sa mā ya ma nu sma ra ha na ha na/ ra rgo be rgo/ ra rgo pā ya rwan pā ya/ su ra ya snyu ra ya/ ā be sha ā be sha /sarba bhu ta na rta na rta/ na rta pa ya na rta pa ya/ haXha ha ha ha hūX hūX hūX phaṭa/—40—

oṃ badz+ra shā la a gri dhin+ta dhin+ta sarba du ni hri da yaX/ ā kar+ṣa ya/ ā kar+ṣa ya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ ni rma tha ni rma tha/ mā ra ya mā rā ya/ ma bi la sba mā bi la sba/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra huX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra ma he shwa ri/ haX haX haX haX haX ru lu ru lu sbyo huX phaṭa/bhak+ṣa la sarba du tshin ni rma tha hri da yaX hūX phaṭa swā hā/ oX nga ni di sta sa ma ya badz+ra hūX phaṭa/ oX badz+ra ba ḍa bā mu khi yo ge shwa ri hiXhi hi hi hi hūX dzaX oX badz+ra bā rā hi mu khri tri baX ba skyoX/ oṃ tsan+d+ra srur+ya hu tā sha ni si ha sha ni ni rna de si ha bag tre ni ṭāX khyuX baX/ oX badz+ra dha ru dzī ba ni mahā yak+ṣi ṇi shwa ni ru pi nī mahā pru la ya ni rna dī kā ma ru pi ṇi t+yāX tra ḍa ṭa hoX dgyes mdzad lha dgu'i gtso bo la yang aṣ+ṭa mang du bzla zhing khyad par 'khor lo sdom pa'i phreng ba'i sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'ang ci rigs par bzlas te zur du rtogs par bya'o/ /thun mtshams su gtor ba 'bul bar 'dod na/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis rlabs la/rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig tsam gyis grub par gyur/ bzlas pa'i skabs su bstan pa ltar sngags re re'i mthar/ a kā ro sbyar ba'i gtso bo rnams la lan bdun bdun/ 'khor rnams la re re phul la/ gong du ye shes pa la mchod pa 'bul ba ltar / phyi nang gsang bas mchod/ rang rang gi bstod pas kyang bdag bskyed ltar bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ zhes sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po la bar 'dir gtor ma 'bul/ de nas spyi gtor ni/ slar yang gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol nam mkha' la chos 'byung sum brtsegs dbus ma'i nang du paX las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa sngon po/ steng ma'i nang du paX las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa dkar po/ 'og ma'i nang du paX las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa dmar po/ dbus ma'i pad+ma'i lte ba la bcom ldan 'das —41—

thugs rdo rje/ de'i 'dab ma brgyad la shar du i las dbang po dkar po glang po che la bzhugs pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lhor yaX las gshin rje mthing nag ma he la bzhugs pa dbyug pa dang tho ba/ nub tu wāX las chu lha dmar skya chu srin la zhon pa sbrul zhags dang pad+ma/ byang du yaX las gnod spyin ser po rta la bzhon pa shing thog dang ne'u le/ byang shar du bhaX las 'byung po dkar po spyan gsum pa glang la bzhon pa rtse gsum dang zhags pa/ shar lhor raX las me lha dmar po ra skyes la bzhugs pa bgrang phreng dang spyi blugs/ lho nub tu naX las srin po nag po ro langs la bzhon pa ral gri dang thod pa/ nub byang du bāX las rlung lha ljang gu ri dwags la bzhon pa ba dan dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ 'khor gnod spyin du ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ steng gi pad+ma'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das sku rdo rje/'dab ma brgyad la shar du shaX las brgya byin dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu/ lhor oX las tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la bzhugs pa spyi blugs dang rtse gsum/ nub tu bi las khyab 'jug dmar ser 'khor lo dang dung / byang du truX las dbang phyug mthing ga rtse gsum dang thod pa/ byang shar du kaX las gzhon nu smin drug dkar po mda' gzhu/ shar lhor gaX las tshogs bdag dkar po la phug dang la du'i snod 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu rmi las rngo gi ri ti dmar po mdung dang mda'/ nub byang du kaX las legs ldan nag po ral gri dang phub 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ 'khor 'dod khams kyi lhas bskor ba/ 'og gi 'dab ma brgyad kyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das gsung rdo rje/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du phaX las dga' po ser po/ lhor phiXlas dung skyong dkar po/ nub tu phuX —42—

las mtha' yas sngon po/ byang du phe las rigs ldan ljang khu/ byang shar du phoX las pad+ma chen po dkar po/ shar lhor phuX las 'jog po dmar po/ lho nub tu phriX las nor rgyas kyi bu khra bo/ nub byang du h+pha las pad+ma dkar po thams cad kyang pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ sbrul mgo bdun dang ldan zhing stod lha'i dbu can smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba/ phyag g.yas sbrul dang g.yon pad+ma 'dzin pa/'khor ngan song gsum gyis bskor ba/ 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu bzhi po thams cad rin po ches brgyan pa/ bu dang chung ma la sogs pa 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes bskyed la so so'i phyag rgya dang bos/ go rī a kar+ṣa ya dzaXzhes brjod pas go rdi'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa kha dog lnga 'phros nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa'i phyogs skyong lha klu zhan ra dang bcas pa mdun du bkugs/ tso ri pra be sha ya hūX gi dam tshig pa la zhugs/ be+e tā li ban+ta baX gyis gnyis med du bstims/ lha sma rī wa shaX ku ru hoX snyoms par zhugs pa ltar bde ba'i ro myang bas zhu ste/ dbus kyi phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams huX sngon po'i thig ler gyur/ steng gi lha chen 'khor dang bcas pa rnams oṃ dkar po'i thig ler gyur/ 'og gi klu chen 'khor dang bcas pa rnams āXdamar po'i thig ler gyur pa las/ bar ma'i huX rnams las mi bskyod pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa sku mdog mthing ga yum dang bcas par gyur/ steng ma'i oṃ brgyad las rnam snang sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa yum dang bcas par gyur/ 'og gi āXbargyad las snang mtha' sku mdog dmar po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa yum dang bcas par gyur/ thams cad dur khrod kyi rgyan can zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon —43—

bskum gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /go rī dzaXzhes pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sku gsung thugs kyi lha tshogs ye shes pa bkug tso ri huX gis so sor gzhug /be+e tā li baX gyis gnyis med du bstims/ bhasma rī hoX yis dgyes par byas/ gong bzhi skye mched dang sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs nas dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ mchod dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur/ sdig sgrib sbyangs/ chu'i lhag ma gyen du 'khyil bas/ bar ma rnams la mi bskyod pa/ steng ma rnams la rnam snang / 'og ma rnams la snang mtha' chags bral gyi cha lugs can rnams kyis dbu brgyan par bsam mo/ /bsdus par byed na/ rang gi snying ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs skyong bcu la srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa ma dzaXrang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ gtor mgron rnams la phog pas skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug pa'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i su 'gyur/ ces so/ /oX in da/ dza ma dza la/ dza klu bhu ta/ ba hi na bā u/ rak+ṣa tsan+da/ sudz+dza/ mā ta ba spa tā la pa tā la/ a the pa lpa swā hā/ e daX ba li bhu dza dzi gha/ phul+la dhu pa maX sa/ si gha/aX ba/ sa spa/ ka tho mā da kha ni khu ṇi phe ṭa ga ta/ oṃ ā ka ro sogs lan gsum gyisa'abul/ ar+ghaX la sogs pas mchod/ oṃ āXhūX gis nang mchod phul/ mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' wo po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad rab tu dag /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'a1khe /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /mi rtog nam mkha' dri ma med/ /dngos 'dzin dag pas gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro /rdo rje mi —44—

'chi 'dod chags che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro: /rdo rje dag pa gdod mi za/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid las byung / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / /sangs rgyas byang sems chos skyong la/ /bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i gtor ma dang / /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas dang / /mtha' yas sems can ma lus la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /yon tan 'phrin las rgyas par shog /kol+la e ri ṭa la a bol+la mu spru ṇi ri kak+ko la sogs rdo rje'i glu dbyangs yang blangs/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs sho lo gsum gyis bkra shis brjod/ skye shing skye bar rigs mchog tu/ /skye shing khengs med dam tshig ldan/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje ston pa dang / /brtse ldan bla mar gus 'gyur shog /skye shing skye ba thams cad du/ /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'brol/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang / /btsun mo'i khu ba len par rbe(ga /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ gang gi lam nas 'gro ba yi/ /lam de myur du 'grub gyur cig /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma sgrol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /rnal 'byor gtsug lag bstan bcos la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par ye|ga /ces smon lam btab yi ge brgya pas nyam chags bskang / ma 'byore pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de yang mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /lhag pa dang ni chad pa sogs dang / bag med spyod pa ma dag pas/ /rgyud las gsungs pa'i cho ga ni/ /ma lcogs 'khrul pa ci —45—

mchis pa/ /de yang mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces bzod par gsol/ oX khyod kyis sems can sogs/ mdzad du gsol/ ces bsnyan mnan/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'bor rnams bdag nyid la thim/ oṃ muX ga tsā ga tsā swā bha wa naX/ zhes 'jig rten pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ bdag nyid kyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor yang skad cig gis mi snang bar 'gyur te/ 'od gsal gyi ngo bo'o/ /de'i ngang las tha mal gyi shes pa yun ring du bskyang /stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid dgyes mdzad rdo rje phyag gnyis par gyur/ dpral bar oX/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ snang ba thams cad kyang lha'i 'khordo ra lor gyur/ slar yang smon lam btab te thun mtshams la 'jug go /kha zas bza' ba'i tshe gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ phud bla ma yi dam myur mdzad ye shes mgon po rnams la gtor ma'i tshul du phul/ rang nyid thun mtshams kyi lha la snying khar rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dang / lte bar myur mdzad mgon po dang / phyogs skyong pa rnams dang mkha' 'gro sde lnga la sogs pa rnams/ steng 'og gi lha de dag thams cad kyang lto ba thab khung du gyur nas 'bar ba'i me dpung gi dbus na gnas par bsam/ de rnams mchod pa'i tshul du bza' bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang khrus kyi rnal 'byor dang/ rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor dang / nyal ba'i rnal 'byor dang / ldang ba'i rnal 'byor te dus thams cad du yid gzhan du ma gyur bar de ltar bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar dgyes mdzad gsal bar bkod/ /'ga' zhig lam 'dir mi mos shing / kha cig mos kyang gzhan dang 'dres/ /ma 'dres rgyas bsdus skyon bral ba/ /'god pa gang de'ang rmad du byung / /yang dgyes pa rdo rje mtsho skyes la sogs par dkyil 'khor gzhan lnga po'i sgrub thabs la brten nas rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa 'dod na'ang / lugs 'di nyid kyi de dang de'i sgrub —46— (

pa 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin du nyams su blangs la/ gsang 'dus la lha rnams mngal byin grub mtshams dang / gzhan rnams la ye shes pa bsre ba'i sngon du lus dkyil gong bzhin 'god par bya'o/ /gal te dgyes mdzad mtshon cha can 'ba' zhig bsgom par 'dod na lus dkyil rnams bor bas 'grub cing / yang phyi dkyil drug po gang yang rung ba yang skad cig gis bskyed pa lus dkyil 'god pa dang / lhan skyes la gtso bo phyag mang lnga 'god pa dang / lhan skyes la lhan skyes lnga 'god pa ste/ rgyas bsdus drug gi dbye bas rgyud sde lnga'i sgrub thabs nyer mkho sum cu drug tu 'gyur zhing / phyi dkyil rgyas pa la lus dkyil bsdus pa bkod pa sogs kyis phye na mtha' yas par 'gyur la/dkyil 'khor so so'i nyams len la mngon rtog rgyas pa dang sa bon tsam las bskyed pa dang / skad cig gis bskyed pa dang gtso bo rkyang ba bsgoms pa dang / lhan skyes bsgom pas dbye bas sum cu tham par 'gyur zhing / me tog phog pa'i lha gang dang gang yin pa de/ 2sgrub par bya dgos pas dkyil 'khor drug pa lha brgya dang sum cu rtsa brgyad yod la/ de dag sgrub tshul na stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sa bon las bskyed la dbu rgyan rang chas su bsam/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs la/ ye shes pa dang bsres nas sngags bzlas pas 'grub pa yin no/ /༈ lwa ba pas mdzad gzhung bzhin te/ lus dkyil 'god pa man ngag yin/ /glegs bam klog pa'i phyugs de dag /gus dang bral ba skal ba'i skyon/ /rgyud sde lnga'i lus dkyil gcig tu sgom pa'i mngon rtogs ston zin pa'i skabs te dang po'o/ /'di man chad du bshad par bya ba'i dkyil 'khor lnga so so'i sgrub thabs dang / mtshon cha can gyi dkyil 'khor 'ga' zhig sgom par byed pa la'ang gong du bshad pa'i bdag bsrung ba yan chad byed par bla ma rnams bzhed par 'dug pas/ de ltar byas kyang skyon du 'gyur ba dka' mod/ gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bdun po 'di dag gi bsnyen pa sogs byed pa'i tshe/ de yan —47—

chad gegs bsrung ba'i don du yun ring bsgom par bzhed par mngon pas/ dkyil 'khor rkyang pa phyi ma 'di rnams la 'di yan chad ma bsgoms na mngon rtogs kyi yan lag chad par mi 'gro bar mngon la/ khyad par 'dus pa'am bde mchog la phur gdab pa lan gnyis sogs mi dgos par mngon no/ /༈ da ni so so'i mngon rtogs zugad par bya ste/ bdag nyid gang la mos pa de grub pa'i don du'am/ de la rab tu rgyas pa dgyes mdzad rdo rje lha dgu'i bskyed rim 'ba' zhig bsgom na/ rang dgyes mdzad he ru kar gsal ba'i snying gar raX las nyi ma la gnas pa'i huX/rang gi mdun du bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i he ru ka bzhugs pa la/ snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo brgyad kyis mchod par gyur/ dkar mo ri dwags lko pa la sogs pa brjod/ bdag gis sdig pa sogs/ grol bar rbe(ga /zhes yan lag lnga pa'am/ yang na gang zhig 'khor ba thog ma med nas ngan pa'i rnam par rtog pa las skyes pa'i bdag gis sdig pa byas pa de dag thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bshags shing slar yang mi bgyid do/ /gang gi sems can thams cad kyi dge ba kun la rjes su yi rang ngo / /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /bdag dang gzhan don rab sgrub phyir/ /bdag gis byang chub mchog sems bskyed/ /e ma ho sems can kun mgron gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog mdzad bzhin spyod/ /tshogs kyi zhing rang la thim/ oṃ med bzhi bsgom/oX shā n+ya ta stong pa'i ngang las raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūX las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa bcu gnyis pa/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang —48—

ba/ dbus sngo ba de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba gur ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas par gyur/ oX badz+ra rak+ṣa: sogs/ de las me lce khro bo dang bcas pa mched de phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bsregs shing tshar gcod par gyur/ de'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i nang du laX las dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ljang gu/ de'i 'og tu baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po/ de'i 'og tu raX las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po/ de'i 'og tu yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam sngon po/bdag nyid 'od gsal las langs nas bar do longs spyod rdzogs pa'i nga rgyal du gnas par byas la/ 'byung ba bzhi'i dkyil 'khor yang rang gi sems kyi ngo rnga ྅ sdo/ /'byung ba bzhi gcig tu 'dres pa las/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta bab bzhis brgyan pa/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang / kha khyer dang / pha gu dang /mda' yab dang / pu shā la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa do shal dang / do shal phyed pa la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba ste/ shing dang / chu dang /me dang / ri dang / mchod rten dang / phyogs skyong dang / zhing skyong dang / lha dang /klu dang / dngos grub 'grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams brgyad dang bcas shing /ro dang ro langs dang / dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang /'byung po'i tshogs rnams dang / mchod rdzas thams cad dang / rus pa'i tshogs kyis gang ba'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ dbus phyur —49—

bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po ches brgyan pa/ gzhal yas khang gi lha snam/shar dkar lho ser nub dmar byang ljang dbus sngo pa'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la nyi ma'i steng du bdud bzhi'i gdan shar sgor tshangs pa ser po/ lhor dbang po kham ser/ nub tu nye dbang ljang khu/ byang du drag po thal dkar gan rkyal du bkram pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du tshangs pa/ lho ru brgya byin/ nub tu nye dbang / byang du drag po/ byang shar gyi grwar tshi nin rje nag po/ shar lhor gnod sbyin ser po/ lho nub tu srin po sgrugs nag /nub byang du thags bzang ris ljang khu/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du a ā/ i yī/ u mū/ ṛ ru/ '-i lī/ e e/ o au/ aX āX dkar po rnams yongs su gyur ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ka kha gha nga / tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa t+ta ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa dmar ngo rnams yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūX las thod pa sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ aX las rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug /de rnams gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las dpal he ru ka /'og nas 'byung ba ltar rgyas pa'am/ bsdus na/ sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad pa/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi phye ba/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ zhal nas hūX spro ba/ lha dang lha min thams cad sdigs par mdzad pa/ 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ yum gyi mkha' hiX las pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad ze 'bru la as mtshan pa/ oX pad+ma su kha sogs/ ṣa me/ zhes yab kyi zhal nas gsungs par gyur/ yab kyi gsang gnas huX las rdo rje nag po/ zlaX ser po las byung ba'i nor bu'i bu gar phaṭa kyis bkag pa/ oX badz+ra mahā sogatsu/ ṣa me/ zhes —50—

yum gyis gsung bar 'gyur/ mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba chen pos dgyes pa/bsrubs pa dang srub pa'i sbyor bas zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems la sangs rgyas rnams thim/ yum gyi mkha' nang du byang chub kyi sems su gyur/ gaX tsaX baX gaX /paX shaX laX ṭaX/ sa bon brgyad du gyur/ phyogs mtshams kyi gdan rnams kyi steng du yang nyi zla kha sbyor re re gnas pa/ mkha' nang gi sa bon brgyad spros te/ de rnams kyi bar du phyin pas sa bon rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ gri gugacang tes rus sbal/ sbrul/ seṅge/ dge slong / 'khor lo/ rdo rje rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ so sor nyi zla phyag mtshan ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ shar du go ri sogs nas/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /yab yum snyoms par bzhugs pa'i bde ba chen po ldan pa la bar do'i rnam shes rjes su chags pas/byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur/ de nas puska si la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhis gdung ba'i dbyangs kyi bzhengs par bskul ba ni/ rje btsun snying rje nas/ ma mdzad cig /ces bskul bas bcom ldan 'das rab tu sad de thig le gong bzhin du ā li las zla ba bskyed/ de'i steng du sngar bzhin kā li las nyi ma bskyed de gnyis kyi bar du huX dang aX las thod pa dang gri gug hūX dang aX gis mtshan pa/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes mdzad rdo rje sku mdogazhes pa nas/ 'jigs par mdzad pa'i bar sngar bzhi/ drag po chen po rtsa ba'i zhal nag po nas/ gnyis ka'ang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ de las 'od zer 'phros/khams gsum thams cad khyab/ snod gzhal yas khang bcud he ru kar gyur/—51—

mkha' la spyod pa rnams oṃ la thim/ sa 'og nas spyod pa āXl thim/ sa steng nas spyod pa rnams snyeng khar thim/ yang hūX las 'od zer 'phros ye shes sems dpa' lha dgu oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaX ar+ghaX la sogs pas mchod/ dzaXhuX baX hoX ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bo gyur/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo la sogs pa'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/8do a bhi khri thu dz+wa/ maX sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes tagasol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa a bhi rdzi myu huX/ zhes rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu dang bcas pas dbang bskur/rnga'i sgra byung / gur gum dang me tog gi char phab/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ thabs dang shes rab dang / rgod pa dang / blta ba dang / 'byud pa dang /gnyis gnyis las/ bum pa dang / gsang ba dang / shes rab dang / bde ba chen po'i dbang rnams thob/ gtso bo yab yum dang / go ri sogs nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ khams gsum po thams cad dkyil 'khor du gyur pa bdag nyid la thim shing / lha mo brgyad yang zhal brgyad la thim/ rtsa 'khor lo bzhi po rnams la spyi bor haX mgrin par oṃ/ snying gar huX/ lte bar aX/ gtum mo yongs su 'bar te de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rgyud la 'gro 'ong byas/ haX yig la thim/ de las thig le yongs su 'dzag pa aX la thim/ 'khor lo'i gzugs kyi mi bskyod pa/ /hū ཾ ༷/ rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /dzi/ mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag /aX/ lag pa rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ khaX/ yan lag kun la rdor 'dzin 'god/ /huX/ sa bon de rnams las byung ba'i/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga thal chen rnams/ rgyal ba rigs drug gi bdag nyid du gyur/ rgyas par spo —52—

na/ rigs lnga dang rdor sems he ru ka phyag gnyis par bskyed la/ de zhu ba'i phyag rgyar bsam zhing /oX dha ra dha ra sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs par bya'o/ /mig tu oṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma sogs/ bdag med rnal 'byor ma nag mo/ thams cad kyang gri thod 'dzin pa g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs can no/ /de tsam sgom par mi nus na/ sa bon 'ba' zhig bsgom pas kyang chog go /de la lha phyi ma gnyis lte ba dang gsang bar 'god par bzhed do/ /de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab nas/ tseX( aṣ+ṭa sogs nas/ haX ha phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ka rta ri he badz+ra ya huX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ tseX( a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha swāhā/ zhes pa rnams bzlas bya'i sngags so/ /de nas mar me'i rtse mo lta bu'i dmigs pa bsgoms pas 'od gsal du bsdu bar bya ste/ rang gi snying gar nyi zla kha sbyor gyi nang du huX/ bdag med ma'i snying gar zla ba la aX/ khams gsum thams cad 'od du zhu nas thabs kyi cha rnams rang dang / shes rab kyi cha rnams yum la thim/ yum zla ba aX dang bcas pa bdag nyid la thim/ bdag nyid nyi zla la thim/ huX gis 'od zer gyi tshogs ā li kā li dang bcas pas khams gsum gyi dngos po thams cad 'od zer gyi rang bzhin du byas/ thams cad kyang hūX la thim/ zla ba dang nyi ma yang hūX la zhugs/ de nyid kyang nā da'i bar du bsdus te/ nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur/ 'dir ni thog ma mtha' dbus med/ /srid med mya ngan 'das pa med/ /bdag med gzhan yang med pa ste/ /'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ /ces mnyam par bzhag la/ khams gsum po mtha' dag sgyu ma'o/ /rmi lam lta bur shes par byas nas bar chad bsrung ba'i don du sngar bzhin go cha bcu gnyis la bkod nas thun mtshams la 'jug pa yin no/ /he ru ka gzhan gsum la gtso bo'i zhal phyag 'gyur ba dang / sngags kyi khyad par ma gtogs 'di kho na bzhin yin la/ 'khor gyi sngags sgrub thabs su ma zugad kyang byāzla bar 'dod na/oṃ a āXsogs/ aX āXhuX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bzla bar bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang 'grub pa'i slob dpon chen —53—

po mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sgrub thabs kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du byas pa ste/ grub chen khyung po rnal 'byor pa'i bzhed pa'i lugs ltar bkod pa/ dpal dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i sgrub thabs tshig zor yang ba la dga' ba rnams la phan pa'o/ /'dir smras pa/ byin rlabs che na nyung ba'ang mchog /byin rlabs chung na mang bas ci/ /gzhung don 'byog po'i bshad pa yis/ /ha cang thal bar ma byed cig / dgyes mdzad lha dgu'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs te gnyis pa'o/ /༈ 'khor lo sdom pa kho na'i bskyed rim rgyas pa bsgom par 'dod pas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs gyur cig /gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad do/ /tshor ba'i phung po ni rdo rje nyi ma'o/ /'du shes kyi phung po ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go /ཿ byed kyi phung po ni rdo rje rgyal po'o/ /rnam shes kyi phung po ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid gyur pa ni dpal rdo rje he ru ka'o/ /mig gnyis la ni gti mug rdo rje'o/ /rna ba gnyis la ni zhe sdang rdo rje'o/ /sna la ser sna rdo rje'o/ kha la ni 'dod chags rdo rje'o/ /lus la ni phrag dog rdo rje'o/ /skye mched thams cad la dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ /sa'i khams la ni ltung bar byed pa ma'o/ / chu'i khams la ni gsod byed ma'o/ /me'i khams la ni 'gugs byed ma'o/ /rlud gi khams la ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma'o/ /nam mkha'i khams la ni pad+ma drwa ba can ma ste/ tsham rngam dang bcas pa'i zhal bzhi pa'i sngags brjod do/ /sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba gur bla bre mda'i drwa ba ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad/ g.yon phur bu dang g.yas tho ba —54—

thogs pa spros/ yang sprul rnams kyi phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bkug ste/ rwa ba'i phyi rol phyogs mtshams brgyad du huX las byung ba'i grub khung rnams su bcug /phur bus spyi bor btab/ oX gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba sdo yan huX hūX phaṭa/ gī la ya gī lwa ya sarba pa paX hūX hūX phaṭa/ hūX huX huX badz+ra ki la badz+ra dha ro adz+nyā pa ya ti/ sar+pā snya kā ya nywa ka tsit+ta badz+ra kā la ya huX huX phaṭa/ ces tho bas brdung bas bgegs rnams tshar bcad/ oṃ badz+ra mut+na ra badz+ra gī la a ko ṭa ya a ko ṭa ya huX hūX phaṭa/ rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du hūX sngo skya 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba/de'i 'od kyis bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun du gsal bar byas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ sogs dang / dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs/ ar+ghaX sogs kyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs sho lo ka gcig brjod/ swa bhā wa sogs/ hūṃ n+ya ta sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems nā da'i rnam pas nam mkhar bzhag /'og tu yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ raX las me'i dkyil 'khor/ baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor suX las ri'i rgyal po ri rab rnams steng nas steng du brtsigs pa/ de'i steng du huX las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i lte bar paX las sna tshogs pad+ma/ de nyid kyi lte ba la a ā/ i sī/ u mū/ ṛ grwa/ le lī/ e i/ o au/ aX āXrnams yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du/ ka kha ga gha nga /tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa lha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa rnams yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de gnyis kyi bar du nam mkha'i nā da yongs su gyur pa zhugs/ nā da las thig le/ de las zla tshes/—55—

de las ha/ de las zhabs kyu te huX yig dkar po'o/ /de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dkyil 'khor thams cad dus gcig tu grub pa ni/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi dbus su bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ /de'i nang du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du/ sku'i snyen ra lo dkar po 'khor lo'i mu khyud can/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po pad+ma'i mu 'byud can/ de'i lhe bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rdo rje'i mu khyud can/ gsum ga'ang rtsibs brgyad dang ldan pa/ dbus su bde chen 'khor lo pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ mu khyud la gri gug gi 'phreng ba can/ sgo mtshams brgyad du ro'i gdan/sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ bdag nyid 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing nag zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa sogs/ 'on kyang phyag g.yas pa ni gri gug bsnams pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gong bzhi no/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs par gyur/yab kyi gsang gnas hūX las byung ba'i rdo rje aX las byung ba'i nor bu byāX gyi mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las pad+ma dmar po oṃ las ze'u 'khru truX gyi mtshan pa/lte bar sarba brnya'i sngags/ snying gar be+e ro tsa na'i sngags/ mgrin par yi ge bdun pa/ dpral bar yi ge nyer gnyis pa/ yum gyi dpral bar be+e no tsa nā/mgrin par sarba brnya/ snying gar yi ge bdun pa/ yab yum snyom par zhugs/ yi ge rnams kyang phan tshun rjes su chags pas sbyor ba la/ gnas par gyur/ oṃ —56—

sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ lus dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /tshor ba dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni la ma'o/ /chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni dum skyes ma'o/ /sems dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni gzugs can ma'o/ /'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa ni rab tu gtum ma'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni gti pa'i mig can ma'o/ /spyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni 'od ldan ma'o/ /sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni sna chen ma'o/ /dad pa'i dbang po ni dpa' bo'i blo gros ma'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi dbang po ni mi'u thung ma'o/ /dran pa'i dbang po ni la rgo'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po ni shing spib ma'o/ /shes rab kyi dbang po ni sa srung ma'o/ /dad pa'i stobs ni 'jigs byed chen mo'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi stobs ni shugs can ma'o/ /dran pa'i stobs ni su ra bhasti 'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs ni sngo bsangs lha mo'o/ khres rab kyi stobs ni rab tu bzang po'o/ /ting nge 'dzin yang dag par byang chub kyi yan lag ni rta'i sna ba ma'o/ /brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni bya gdong ma'o/ /dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o/ khren tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni ro hi'o/ /chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni sho ṇ+ḍi ni'o/ /dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni 'khor lo'i go cha ma'o/ /btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rab tu dpa' mo'o/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba ni stobs chen ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i rtog pa ni 'khor lo'i bsgyur ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ngag ni brtson 'grus chen mo'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa —57—

bzhi yang de rnams nyid kyi rnam par dag pa can no/ /yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' ni kha gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i rtsol ba ni khyi gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i dran pa ni phag gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka dang rdo rje phag mo'o/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa bskyed pa ni gshin rje brtan ma'o/ /dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams bsrung ba ni gshin rje pho nya mo'o/ mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa mi bskyed pa ni gnyen rje mche ba ma'o/ /mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa spong ba ni gzhin rje 'joms ma'o/ /spyi bo pu snyir ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pa la dang rab tu gtum mo/ /spyi gtsug dza lan+ta rar ma ha kaX ka la/ sogs gong bzhin la/pus mo gnyis ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen po ste nye ba'i dur khrod do/ /oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi ni kā ya nywa kyi t+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ oṃ badz+ra shuzloXsarba dharma badz+ra shurnyo3haX/ snying gar oX oX ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/mgo bor na ma hi sogs/ rta mchog gi ngo bo/ yum gyi lte bar oX baX dmar po rdo rje phag mo sogs/ tsaṇ+ḍa ka'i ngo bo/ phe/ zhes ye shes 'khor lo'i dbang gi lha dang lhan cig spyan drangs/ dzaXhūṃX baX hoX dam tshig pa dang / ye she pa dbyer med du gyur/ oX yo ga shudha sogs/ dbang gi lha mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams te dbang bskur/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshe/gas kun khrus gsol ltar sogs/ shrī skyoX/ zhes gsungs zhing dbang bskur bas chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo dang thugs 'khordo ra ba rnams la mi bskyod pa/ gsung 'khor ba rnams la 'od dpag med/ yum dang sku 'khor ba rnams la rnam snang / snying po'i rnal 'byor ma rnams la rin 'byung / sgo mtshams —58—

ma brgyad la don grub kyis dbu rgyan par gyur/ ar+ghaX la sogs pas mchod/ bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs te/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la myang / lha thams cad thabs shes snyoms par 'jug pa'i bde bas mnyes par bsam/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis bstod la/bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab ste/ tseX( shrī badz+ra he he ru ru ka sogs/ yab kyi snying po'o//oX hriXha ha sogs nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oX sarba budha ḍā ki nī sogs/ yum gyi nye snying ngo / /oX badz+ra be ro tsa na sogs snying po'o/ /'phreng ba'i sngags rnams ni logs su shes par bya'o/ /oX oX ha/ oṃ na ma hi sogs/ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces pa ni go cho'i sngags so/ /skabs 'dir rdzogs pa'i rim pa rnal 'byor chen mo yang bsgom par bya'o/ /thun mtshams la 'jug par 'dod na/ dkyil 'khore thams cad skad cig tsam gyis bdag nyid la thim/ sngar bzhi go cha gnyis bkod/ so dang sen mo la ni thod pa'i dum bu'o/ /skra dang ba sbu la ni keng rus chen po ma'o sogs nas/ snabs la ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /dpa' bo rtsa ba'i sngags sogs dang / tshangs pa'i skud pa la sogs btags/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yi/ /lus kyi khams ni btags pa po/ /dpa' bo'i go cha drug gi ni/ /phyag rgya yis ni lus mdzes pa'o/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sngags gang yin/ /mgrin pa mgur chas mdzes pa nyid/ /lha yi snying po sngags kyi ni/ /'phreng ba brgya yi phyed kyis mdzes/ /yi ge bdun pa'i gsang sngags kyis/ /gdub skor gyis ni rna bar mdzes/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro yis/ /lpags pa'i gos mchog 'dzin pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ma drug gsang sngags kyis/ /ska rags byas pa rnam par brgyan/ /'khor lo kun gyi rnal 'byor ma'i/ /sngags ni 'thung ba'i thod pa yin/ /rnam snang mdzad kyi sngags gang —59—

yin/ /thod po'i dbu la brgyan pa po/ /r+sā rngam dang bcas de ni lan gnyis kyis phyogs srungs/ gzugs su snang ba thams cad lha'i sku/ sgrar grags pa thams cad gsung gi rang bzhin/ dran rig rnam rtog thams cad thugs kyi rang bzhin du rnam par dag /kha ṭāX ga ni lha yi sku/ khres rab ḍā ma ru yi sgra/ /nyin mo bcom ldan dpa' bo ste/ /rnal 'byor ma ni mtshan mor brjod/ /mya ngan las 'byung dpa' bo ni/ /drug pa sems kyi sprul pa ste/ /dag pa chos kyi sprul pa ni/ /phag mo'i gzugs su bstan pa'o/ khres rab gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /zhes brjod nas thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug ste/ gtor ma la sogs pa las kyi bya ba rnams ci bde bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang slob dpon chen po lha yi pa'i gzhung ji lta ba'i rjes su 'brang zhing grub pa'i slob dpon chen po khyung po rnal 'byor gyi brgyud pa'i phyag srol gyi nyams bzhes ltar bkod pa'o /'dir smras pa/ deng sang sgrub thabs mang po dag /dpe ni sna tshogs kun btus nas/ /man ngag byin rlabs rgyun bral yang / /yig tshogs che ba ngom par byed/ /bde mchog lha yi pa'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs te gsum pa'o/ /'dus pa'i rgyud la brten nas bskyed rim sgom par 'dod na/ rang skad cig gis zhe sdang rdo rje mi bskyod pa zhal gsum phyag drug par gyur/ snying gar nyi ma la hūX sngon po de las huX bcu de spros te/ phyogs bcur nyi ma'i gdan la 'khod pa yongs su gyur pa ni/ shar du gshin rje mthar byed nag po/ ltor shes rab mthar byed dkar po/ nub tu rta mgrin dmar po/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ shar ltor mi —60—

g.yo ba/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal/ nub byang du dbyug sngon can/ byang shar du stobs po che/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ 'og tu gnod mdzes te/de rnams nag po thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ oṃ nga ni sogs/ huX/zhes bka' bsgo bas gnod mdzes dpag tu med pa byung nas phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams thams cad yan la zhags pas bsdams/ lcags kyus snying gar btang/ na maXs man+ta kā ya wa krit+ta badz+ra ṇaX skye( ḍak+ki huX dzaXzhes bkug ste/ brub khung gru gsum rnams su bcug /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba las rang 'dra ba'i bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bcu/ lte ba man chad phur pa'i rnam pa can byung ste/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor btsug /gnod mdzes rnams phyag tu tho ba thogs par gyur te/ phur bus spyi bo nas brdungs pas/ bgegs rnams bsgral te rnam par shes pa dbyings su spar bar gyur/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta sogs/ huX phaṭa/ sprul pa rnamasaganod mdzes la thim/ khro bo dang phur bu las me lce phyogs kun tu spros nas/bgegs rnams kyi lhag ma thams cad tshig cing gdug pa can rnams me ri'i rang bzhin du gyur/ de'i nang du 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ 'khor yug thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur du gyur te bgegs dang bral bar gyur/ dngos po med la sgom pa med sogs/ med pa'o/ /stong pa la cung zad ma yi par bzhag /stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi dbus su hūX yaX huX las rlud gis dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ de'i steng du huX raX hūX las me'i dkyil snyen ra dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du hūX baX hūX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du huX laX hūX las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ thams cad kyang rdo rje gnyis —61—

gnyis gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du rdo rje'i ste bar ghuX yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus en+t+ra nī la'i stegs bu'i steng du/ rdo rje'i ra ba zlum po 'od zer sna lnga 'bar ba/ nang ling tshe dgur gyur pa dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ khro bo bcu la nyi ma/shar phyogs pa rnams la zla ba/ mā ma gī la rdo rje/ gzhan lho phyogs pa rnams la rin po che/ nub phyogs pa rnams la pad+ma dmar po byang phyogs pa rnams la rdo rje rgya gram gyi gdan/ dbus su rdo rje 'chang sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis 'byud rgyas yum reg bya rdo rje ma/ rang dang 'dra ba/ pad+ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ ling tshe rnams la shar du rnam snang / lhor rin 'gyung / nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang du don yod grub pa/ shar lhor spyan ma/ lho nub tu mā ma gī/ nub byang du gos dkar mo/ byang shar du sgrol ma/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma/lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma/ nub byang du dri rdo rje ma/ byang shar du ro rdo rje ma/ rim pa gsum pa'i snam bu la/ shar sgo'i g.yas g.yon du byams pa dang sa snying / lho sgo'i g.yas g.yon du phyag na rdo rje dang nam mkha'i snying po/ nub sgo g.yas g.yon du 'jig rten dbang phyug dang 'jam dpal/ byang sgo g.yas g.yon du —62—

sgrib pa rnam sel dang kun tu bzang po/ shar sgor gshin rje gshed/ lho sgor gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ nub sgor rta mgrin/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed/shar lhor mi g.yo ba/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal/ nub byang du dbyug sngon can byang shar du 'chol ba/ steng gi ya phug gi nang du gtsug tor/ 'og tu sa gzhi'i nang du gnod mdzes/ lha thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad bkugs te dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi nas bcug /byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang bskur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba thob nas rang gi zhing du gshegs par gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od kyi rnam snang / spyan ma/ sa snying / gzugs rdo rje ma/ byams pa/ gzhin rje gshed/ mi g.yo ba rnams bdag la thim zhing 'od gsal gyi ngang du yal/ rin 'byung / mā ma gī/ phyag rdor/ sgra rdo rje ma gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ 'dod rgyal rnams 'od gsal du thim/ 'od dpag med gos dkar mo/ nam snying / dri rdo rje ma/ rta mgrin dbyug sngon can rnams 'od gsal du thim/ don grub/ sgrol ma/'jig rten dbang phyug /ro rdo rje ma/ sgrib sel/ kun bzang / bgegs mthar byed/ stobs po che rnams 'od gsal du thim/ gtsug tor gnod mdzes/ reg rdo rje ma rnams 'jam dpal la thim/ de dag gtso bo la thim/ gtso bo yang thams cad stong pa 'od gsal la thim/ de yan chad sngon 'gro yin no/ /oX hūṃ n+ya tas de bzhin nyid la yun ring du dmigs/ sngar gyi/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi nam mkhar/ nyi ma dang zla ba dang pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad oX āXhuX steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ 'bru gsum pad+ma nyi ma rnams rim pas zla ba la —63—

thim/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad zla ba la thim pas byang chub sems kyi ngo bor gyur/ oṃ dharmā dhar du swā bhā wa at+pa ko3haX/ zla ba'i dbus su/ oṃ āXhūX/ de las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ thim pa las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ut+pa ko3haX/ zla ba dang rdo rje 'dres pa las/ dang po'i mgon po dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ mi bskyod pa dpag tu med pa sprul/ sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i zag pa med pa'i bde ba la bkod/ mi bskyod pa la thim/ de nyid dbus kyi gdan la 'dug pa la/bdag nyid kyang thim pas rang rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum phyag drug pa dpa' bo gcig par gyur/ lus gzhal yas khang gi ngo bo la/ spyi bor gzugs phung oṃ las rnam snang / mgrin par 'du shes āXlas snang mtha'/ snying gar rnam shes huX las mi bskyod pa/ lte bar tshor phung swā las rin 'byung / brla'i rtsa bar 'du byed hā las don 'grub/ mig gli las sa snying / oṃ yig bzhi las rna ba phyag rdor/ sna nam snying / lce 'jig rten dbang phyug /rdo rje'i sgor/lus sgrib sel/ tshigs pa las kun bzang / snying gar yid huX las 'jam dpal/ hūX bcu la sa lag pa g.yas pa gshi/na rje gshe/da/ lag pa g.yon pa shes rab mthar byed/ kha la rta mgrin/ rdo rje la bgegs mthar byed/ dpung pa g.yas la mi g.yo ba/ g.yon la ḍak+ki/ pus mo g.yas/ ser po be con sngon po/ /g.yon la stobs po che/ spyi bor gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ rkang mthil gnyis su gnod mdzes rnams 'khod par gyur pa/ rang gi spyi bor zla ba —64—

la oX dkar po las 'od zer sna lnga lha mo spyan ma dang bcas nam mkha' gang ba spros/ sangs rgyas rnams rnam snang du gyur pa snyoms 'jug gi bde bas mnyes par byas/ sbyan drangs te mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pa/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje'i sku ni mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed: / deng bdag byin gyi mas /rdo rje'i sku ni mdzad du gsol/ /lha thams cad rjes chags kyis snyoms par zhugs/ 'od zer dkar po gyur spyi bo nas thim pas sku'i dbang phyug thob par gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gang yin/ /phung po lnga yi rab tu rgyas/ /sangs rgyas sku yi rang bzhin gyi/ /bdag kyang de dang 'dra bar shog /lkoX sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ rang gi lce'i steng du pad+ma la āX dmar po las 'od zer sna lnga gos dkar mo dang bcas nam mkha' gang ba spros/ sangs rgyas rnams 'od dpag med du gyur par snyoms 'jug gi/ sogs gong bzhi/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas gsung 'chang ba/ /chos kyi gsung lam dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje mi phyed:gsung gi rdo rje mdzad: /phyogs bcur bzhugs la sogs/gsol/ lha thams cad rjes chags kyi snyoms par zhugs/ 'od zer dmar po gyur te mgrin pa nas thim pas gsung gi /dbang phyug thob par gyur/ rdo rje chos kyi gsung gang yin/ /gsung de nges tshig phun sum tshogs/ /sangs rgyas gsung gi rang bzhin gyi bdag gi tshig kyang de 'drar shog /oX sarba ta thā/ waka: rang gi snying gar nyi ma la huX sngon po las 'od zer sna lnga mā ma ki dang bcas nam mkha' gang ba spros/—65—

sangs rgyas rnams mi bskyod par gyur pa snyoms 'jug sogs/ dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum: /deng bdag /thugs kyi rdo rje : phyogs bcu sogs/ 'od zer nag por gyur te snying ga nas thim pas thugs kyi dbang phyug: /gsang ba'i bdag po blo ldan pa/ /kun tu bzang po'i thugs gang yin//rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bu ni/ / bdag gi sems kyang de 'dra gyur/ /oX sarba ta thā:tsit+ta: bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur/oX sarba ta thu kā ya nywa ka tsit+ta rang dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje 'chang yum dang bcas pa/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūX nag po 'od zer 'bar ba/ spyi bor rigs bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems kyis bdag nyid tshim par byed par 'gyur/ rang gi bar du sme sha can gyi rigs las byung ba'i bu mo sngo bsangs mig yangs ma gzugs dang lang tshos brgyan pa/ de reg bya rdo rje ma gtso bo dang 'dra bar gyur/ de'i spyi bor oX/ mgrin par āXthugs kar hūṃX/ lte bar swā/ byin pa gnyis la hā/ rim pa bzhin du dkar dmar sngo ser ljang ba rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ lte bar sa khams laX las spyan ma/snying khar chu khams maX las mā ma gī/ mgrin par me khams paX las gos dkar mo/ spyi bor rlung khams taX las sgrol ma mig tu gzugs dzaX las gzugs rdo rje ma/ rna bar sgra hūX las sgra rdo rje ma/ snar dri baX las dri rdo rje ma/ lcer ro hoX las ro rdo rje ma/ pad+ma'i sna rtser reg bya khaX las reg bya rdo rje ma/ huX bcu las lag pa g.yas pa ro langs rdo rje ma/ g.yon la gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ kha la khro gnyer —66—

ma/ bha gar ral pa gcig ma/ dpung pa g.yas la de bzhin gshegs pa'i yum sna tshogs rdo rje ma/ g.yon sna tshogs rin chen ma/ pus mo g.yas la sna tshogs pad+ma/ g.yon pa sna tshogs las ma/ rkang mthil gnyis su sa 'dzin lha mo/ rdo rje ro langs ma la sogs pa bcu po de dag ni khro bo bcu dang 'dra'o/ /yab kyi gsang gnas hūX las rdo rje rtse lnga pa rtse mo oX gis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' āX las pad+ma 'dab brgyad ze'u 'bru la as mtshan pa/ mkha' gsang gi nang 'od zer sna lngas khyab par gyur/ bdag rin chen 'byung ldan gyi nga rgyal du 'phos la/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga: sogs/ zhes 'khyud de rang nyid rdo rje 'chang du gyur/ huX huX huX/ snyoms par zhugs mchog tu dga' ba thob/ phaṭa rang nyid don 'grub tu gyur/ byang chub kyi sems phyung ba las byung ba'i lha tshogs nam mkha' gang ba spros te/ 'gro don mdzad pa'i phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mchod par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dzaXbadz+ra sogs lus dkyil kyi 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/yab yum gnyis kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus dkyil gyi lha tshogs byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba dang 'dres/ mkha' nang du 'dus pa'i thig le cha sum cu rtsa gnyis su gyur/ dbus kyi thig le mi bskyod pa sngon po/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ badz+ra dhika thugs kar drangs te phyir phyung / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba sogs sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul —67—

dang mdzad pa thams cad mdzad/ sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang sbyangs/ mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ ye shes pa rnams 'dres/ gcig tu 'dus par rang gi snying gar thim pas/ bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rje mthing nag rtsa zhal khros pa/g.yas zhi ba g.yon chags pa'i nyams can du gyur/ shar gyi thig le rnam snang dkar po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum sogs gong bzhin/ ral gri 'dzin/ dzi na dzika thugs kar drangs te phyir phyung / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba sogs: gti mug sbyangs/ rnam snang gi go 'phang la bkod/sprul ba rnams dang 'dres/ gcig tu 'dus pa shar gyi le tsher 'khod/ de bzhin du 'don pa bsgyur te/ lho'i thig le rin 'byung ser po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can ser nag dkar ba'i rat+na dhika thugs kar ser sna sbyangs/ rin 'byung gi:lho'i le tsher 'khod/ nub kyi thig le 'od dpag med dmar po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i a ro lika thugs kar 'dod chags:'od dpag med kyi: nub kyi la: byang gi thig le don grub ljang gu mi bskyod pa'i:ljang nag dkar ba'i: pradz+nyā dhika thugs kar: phrag dog: don grub kyi go 'phang :byang gi le tsher 'khode/ 'di man chad spyi'i mdzad pa'i tshig rnams bor la/ shar rdzo thig le sbyan ma dkar mo rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor lo rdo rje ut+pal dkar po/g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ mo ha ra ti thugs kar drangs te phyir phyung / gdon dang nad dang gdung ba thams cad zhi bar byas/ spyan ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ sprul pa rnams dang 'dres/ gcig tu 'dus pa shar —68—

lho'i grwar 'khod/ lho nub kyi thig le mā ma gī sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i sngo dkar dmar dī ṣa rā ti thugs kar bgegs bsrung ba dang rgyas par mdzad/ mā ma ki'o lho nub kyi grwar: byang shar gyi thig le gos dkar mo dmar mo/ 'od dpag tu med kyi dbu: dmar nag dkar ba'i rā ga ra ti thugs kar: nad kyi nyen pa rnams bsrung bar byas/ gos dkar mo'i: nub byang gi grwar byang shar gyi thig le sgrol ma ljang gu don grub 'a kya ljang nag dkar ba'i badz+ra rā ti thugs kar de thams cad dbang du bsdus sgrol ma'i byang shar gyi grar de'i phyi rol shar lho'i thig le gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo rnam snang gi dbu brgyan can/dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis me long dmar po 'dzin pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ut+pa dkar po/ g.yon gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ thugs kar gzugs kyi skye mched sbyangs/ gzugs bde bas mchod/ gzugs rdo rje ma'i go 'phang spya rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lho'i grar lto nub kyi thig le sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo mi skyod pa'i:sngo dkar dmar ba'i: sgra'i skye mched: sgra bde bas sgra rdo rje ma'i bden bral gyi grwar: nub byang gi thig le dri rdo rje ma dmar mo 'od dpag med kyi: dmar nag dkar ba'i: dri'i skye mched: dri bde bas dri rdo rje ma'i nub byang gi grwarangubyang shar gyi thig le ro rdo rje ma ljang gu don grub kyi ljang nag dkar ba'i ro'i skye mched ro bde ba'i: ro rdo rje ma'i byang shar gyi grar dbus kyi thig le cha gcig reg rdo rje ma sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i sngo dkar dmar ba'i nas ral gri 'dzin pa zhes pa'i bar gtso bo bzhin/ reg bya'i skye mched/ reg bya'i bde ba'i reg —69—

bya rdo rje ma'i: yum la thim/ snga ma'i phyi rol rim pa gsum pa'i lha snam gyi shar sgo'i g.yas su shar gyi thig le cha gcig /me las byams pa rnam snang dang 'dra ba las/ rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ g.yas kyi dang po klu shing gi yal ga me tog dang bcas pa 'khor los mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ rtsa rgyus dang nyon yid sbyangs/ rdo rje'i rtsa dang zag med kyi mngon shes la bkod/ shar sgo'i g.yon gyi lha snam la shar gyi thig le cha gcig za las sa'i snying po rnam snang dang 'dra ba rnam snang gi dbu: mig dang mig shes sbyangs/ rdo rje'i mig dang mig gi mngon shes la bkod/ lho sgo'i g.yas su lho'i thig le cha gcig oṃ las phyag rdor rin 'byung lta bu rin 'byung gi: rna ba dang rna ba'i shes pa sbyangs/ rdo rje'i rna ba dang rna ba'i mngon shes: /lho sgo'i g.yon du thig le cha gcig oṃ las nam mkha'i snying po rin 'byung lta bu rin 'byung gi dbu brgyan/ sna'i rnam shes sbyangs/rdo rje'i sna dang sna'i mngon shes: nub sgo'i g.yas su nub kyi thig le cha gcig lkoX las 'jig rten dbang phyug 'od dpag med dang mtshungs pa 'od dpag med kyingulce dang lce'i rnam shes sbyangs/ rdo rje lce dang lce'i mngon shes: nub sgo'i g.yon du thig le'i cha gcig hūX las 'jam dpal 'od dpag med dang 'dra ba 'od dpag med kyi: yid kyi skye mched dang yid shes sbyangs/ rdo rje'i yid dang gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes la bkod/ byang sgo'i g.yas su byang gi thig le cha gcig oX las sgrib pa rnam sel don yod grub pa lta bu don grub kyi: lus dbang rnam shes dang bcas pa/ rdo rje'i lus dang rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes: byang sgo'i g.yon du thig le cha gcig saX las kun tu bzang po don grub lta bu don 'grub kyi: tshigs —70—

rnams dang kun gzhi sbyangs/ rdo rje'i tshigs dang sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa la bkod/ lha yab thams cad ral pa'i thor tshugs sogs/ rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /mkha' nang gi shar gyi thig le gshin rje mthar byed nag po rnam snang gi nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum dgra sta 'dzin pa ya man+ta krit+ta thugs kar dbang po la sogs pa bgegs rnams tshar bcad shar sgor lho'i thig le shes rab mthar byed dkar po rin 'byung gi dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal pratswan+ta krit+ta/ gzhin rje dang me'i gdon rnams/ lho sgor: nub kyi thig le rta mgrin dmar po 'od dpag med kyi dmar nag dkar ba'i pad+man+ta krit+ta klu'i gdon rnams nub sgor byang gi thig le bgegs mthar byed ljang khu don grub kyi: ljang nag dkar ba'i du krita gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams byang sgor shar lho'i thig le mi g.yo ba nag po rnam snang gi nag dkar dmar ba'i a tsa la rim gtong ba'i me lha'i gdon2shar lho'i grar lho nub kyi thig le 'dod rgyal sngon po rin 'byung gi sngo dkar dmar ba'i tak+ki rā dza: srin po'i gdon bden bral gyi grar nub byang gi thig le dbyug sngan can sngon po 'od dpag med kyi sngo dkar dmar ba'i nī la daṇ+ḍa rlung lha'i gdon rnams nub byang gi grar— byang shar gyi thig le stobs po che sngon po don grub kyi dbu brgyan nag dkar dmar ba'i mahā ba la mkha' 'gro ma dang dbang ldan gyi gdon byang shar gyi grar steng gi thig le gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba sngon po mi bskyod pa'i sngo dkar dmar ba'i usti ṣa tsakra warti tshangs pa dang gza' skar gyi gdon steng gi grwar 'og gi thig le gnod mdzes nag po mi bskyod pa'i —71—

nag dkar dmar ba'i : snudha rā dza: ku la ku ṭa la sogs pa'i dug brtan pa dang g.yo ba thams cad 'og gi phyogs su 'khod par gyur/ khro bo thams cad kyang stobs chen pha rol gnon pa sogs/ tshar gcod pa'o lko pa'i bar gong bzhi/yang khro bo drug la huX kho na snyun sngags su mdzad pa yang yod do/ /rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la sogs/ deng bdag stsol/ ces gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi sogs/ sbyin par bya/ oX badz+ra bha wa asti ṣañtsa huX/ zhes dbang bskur bar gyur/ de nas bar 'di phra thig gi rnal 'byor bsgom/rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya/ bzlas pa'i man ngag gsal btab/ h+ma( āXbadz+ra dhika hūX huX phaṭa/ ces ngag bzlas ci nus su bzlas shing / spro na 'khor gyi sngags kyang bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas yum yab la thim/ de ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la thim/ de yang de bzhin nyid kyi 'od gsal ba la zhugs te thams cad stong pa'i ngo bor gyur/ de nas bde ba chen po las sad pa'i phyir/ tshad med bzhi'i ngo bo lha mo bzhis bskul ba ni/ mā ma kis/sems can khams ni gnas kyi dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs/ /dga' ba yid 'ong don chen 'dod pa'i bdag la bskyab tu gsol/ /mgon po gal te bdag ni de ring gson par mchis bzhed na/ /sems can yab chen gnyen mchog bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ / spyan mas/ rdo rje'i sku khyod bka' yi 'khor lo sems can kun la phan/ /sangs rgyas don du byang chub don dam rjes su phan ston pa/ /mgon po gal te bdag ni: 'dod chags dam tshig —72—

chags pas bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /gos dkar mos/ khyod ni rdo rje'i gsungs te kun la phan/ /thugs brtse ba: /'jig rten dag gi dgos pa'i don mdzad pa la rtag tu brtson/ /mgon po gal te bdag ni /rab dga'i spyod pa kun tu bzang pos bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /sgrol mas/ khyod ni rdo rje 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam pa nyid gzigs pa/ /mgon po gal te: yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /ces bskul bas yab yum sngon bzhin du bzhengs par gyur/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba gsum khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal lam mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la: /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin nga/ brnyes/ /rdo rje gsung la: don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' khyod phyag 'tshal/ /ar+ghaX sogs kyis mchod/ nang mchod byin gyis brlabs la/ 'khru gsum gyis myang / snyoms 'jug gi bde ba chen pos mnyes par gyur/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga: sogs/ rang gi — snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad bdag nyid la thim/ gzhal yas khang yang rang lus la thim/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs/—73—

sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems kyis 'od zer spros te/ sems can rnams la dbang bskur bas sgrib gnyis sbyangs te huX yig tu gyur nas nam mkha' gang /thams cad kyang rdo rje 'chang du gyur pa bdag nyid kyi thugs kar thim/ spyi bor mtho gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la wa yig las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/'og tu oṃ mgo bo thur du bstan pas mtshan pa/ de las ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsi byung ste spyi bo nas thim pas bdag gi lus rgyas par bsam/ rjes kyi bya ba ni gzhan dang 'dra'o/ /'dus pa'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus kho na'i rjes su 'brang ba grub chen tshul khrims mgon gyi ci bzhed pa ltar bkod pa'o/ /'dir smras pa/ ba ched pa mi 'dra bsgrigs pa la/ /phyi ma'i dus kyi mkhas rnams ngal/ /slob dpon gong ma'i byin rlabs kyi/ /rgyun la gnod pa ma byas sam/ /lung rgyun tsam yang mi bzhugs pa'i/ /glegs bam dag gi don bsgoms kyang / /glegs bam mthong bas khengs zhes pa'i/ /tshig de thog tu babs min nam/ /'dus pa'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs te bzhi pa'o/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs te he ru ka bsgom par 'dod pas/ sngon 'gro spyi dang 'dra/ snying gar nyi ma la hūX/ de'i 'od kyis he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor badz+ra sa mā dza/ ar+ghaX sogs yan lag lnga'am yan lag bdun pa'i rgyun bshags/ tsho ( shu n+ya ta sogs/stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi nang du/ paX las pad+ma dmar po 'dab bzhi/de'i lte ba dang phyogs bzhir nyi ma la rang sems thig le dkar po re re de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon po sngo ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang po rdo rje/ g.yon dang dang po gri gug gnyis pa na kha ṭāX ga /g.yas gnyis pa na thod pa bsnams pa/ lhor —74—

rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo ser sngo dkar ljang ba'i zhal/ g.yas dang po rin po che'i rgyal mtshan/ g.yon dang po thod pa/ gnyis pa ce spyang gi mgrin par bcir ba/ g.yas gnyis pa kha ṭāX ga bsnams pa/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ dkar ser sngo ljang ba'i zhal/ g.yas dang po pad+ma/ g.yon dang po thod pa/ gnyis pa gzhu/ g.yas gnyis pa mda' bsnams pa'o/ /byang du sna tshogs rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu/ ljang ser dkar sngo ba'i zhal/ g.yas dang po ral gri g.yon dang po zhags pa/ gnyis pas ka pā la/ g.yas gnyis pa na ḍā ma ru bsnams pa'o/ /de ltar lha mo bzhis/ e ma gnyen mchog rdo rje'i 'od kyis pad+ma rab phye zhig /a la la la la ho/ /bde ba chen pos rab tu dgyes pa'i gar ma sgo cig /ji ltar nyi ma'i 'od kyi pad+ma rab kha 'byed pa bzhin/ /a la la la la ho/ bde ba chen po rab tu dgyes pa'i gar mdzod cig /ces bskul bas thig le huX/ de las rigs lnga'i sprul pa dpag tu med pa spros ye shes lnga la bkod/ tshur 'dus pa las dpal he ru ka sngon po sngo ser dmar ljang ba'i zhal phyag 'og ma gnyis kyis thod pa dang kha ṭāX bsnams pas rang dang 'dra ba'i yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma phyogs kyi gos can la 'byud pa/ dang po gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ khro chags mdzes shing sgeg pa'i rab tu khros shing 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ spyan gsum gsum dmar zhing g.yo ba/ skra ser gyen brdzes/ thod skam lnga'i dbu brgyan dang /rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ phyag rgya lnga dang / gar dgus rol pa/ thal chen gyis byugs shing mi lpags kyi stong g.yogs can/ g.yas brkyang ba'i gar stabs —75—

kyis nyi ma'i steng du/ mi ro'i snying gar mnan pa me dpung gi dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /lha mo lnga ni thal ba dang bral ba thod skam gyi 'phreng ba can no/ /rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mig tu a dkar po/ rna bar aX dmar po/ sna la khe dkar po/ mgrin par āX dmar po/ snying gar ra dmar po/ gnas gsum du oṃ āXhuX/ snying gar nyi ma la rdo rje sngon po'i lte ba la hūX/ de'i 'od kyis ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX ho/ oṃ dharma dhartu badz+ra swā bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/dbang gi lha spyan drangs de rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi kho zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las/ gtso bo dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la mi bskyod pa/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma la rnam snang / rin chen mkha' 'gro ma la rin 'byung pad+ma ma la snang mtha'/ sna tshogs ma la don grub kyis dbu brgyan/ thugs ka'i sa bon las mchod pa'i lha mo spros/ ar+ghaX sogs kyis mchod/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che/ /sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa'i/ /he ru ka la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /lko bstod/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i mgo bor oṃ dkar po/ snying kar huX sngon po/ lte bar swā ser po/ gsang gnas su a dmar po/ brla gnyis su hā ljang khu/ mkha' gsang stong pa'i ngang las hūX las rdo rje/ oṃ las nor bu/khyiXlas pad+ma a las ze'u 'bru'o/ /lha mo bzhis/ e ma gnyen mchog sogs kyis bskul bas/ 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal dang bcas snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas phaṭa kyis sgras/ sangs rgyas thams cad bkug te dha ti'i lam nas pad+ma ra lhung ba'i bde ba byang chub kyi sems myang bar bsam/ oṃ shweXsgruXhūX spyoX/ zhes —76—

bzlas par bya/ bsdu ba ni spyi dang mthun no/ /zhes pa'ang grub chen ku ku ri pa'i gzhung che ba ji lta ba bzhin gyi nyams len grub chen tshul khrims mgon gyi man ngag ji lta ba bzhin no/ /'dir smras pa/ lugs 'di spyod pa nyung ba'i phyir/ /bsre slad byas pa'ang shin tu nyung / /'on kyang nyog po'i tshig spangs nas/ /nyung ngu rnam gsal ngo mtshar che/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i mngon rtogs kyi skabs te lnga'o/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po bsgom par 'dod pas/ rang gi snying gar huX sngon po las 'od zer 'phros/ phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad dang bcas pa gyur/'od zer de'i bdag dang sems thams cad sbyangs/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khe rdor 'e1 badz+ra sa mā dzaX zhes spyan drangs/ yan lag bdun pa'am lnga pa gang rung bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang / sogs tshad med bzhi bya/oX swa bhā wa sogs/ oX shā n+ya ta sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūX las sna tshogs rdo rje las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra gur me ri dang bcas pa'i bsrung 'khor du gyur/bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du shin tu 'jigs pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad/dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa rang snang gi yum dang bcas pa zhu ba las chos 'byung du gyur/ de'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i lte bar pad nyi'i steng du/ bhuX las snyen ra lo'i lte bar zla ba baX gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa rang snang yum dang bcas pa zhu ba las/ gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar lho —77—

ser nub dmar byang ljang dbus su sngo ba'i steng du rdo rje rwa ba zlum pos bskor ba rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris pas re mig dgu pa / 'og gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje rwa bcu gnyis pa/ nye ba la rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du nyi ma'i gdan/ shar gyi rwa dbus ma dang shar lho'i grar zla ba/ gzhan lha'i gnas bcur nyi ma'i gdan dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ rang nyid zla ba la dhi las 'jam dpal gzhon nu dkar po rdo rje dril bu'am/ dmar ser pod ral gri 'dzin pa/ gang wo bskyed/ thugs kar nyi ma la huX de'i 'od zer gyis gzhin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs thams cad spyan drangs te bdag nyid zla ba dang bcas pa de thams cad nyi ma la thim/ de'i steng du huX las rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i 'od zer gyis 'phro 'du las/dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bdag nyid 'jigs mdzad nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ rtsa ba'i zhal ma he'i gdong pa can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis khro bo'i rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis 'khore lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyangs pas ma he'u steng du las kyi gshin rje yab yum dang bcas mnan pa / khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na zhugs par gyur/ oṃ dharma dha tu sogs spro na 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin du sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs pa dang yan lag drug pa bkod/ dbang bskur rnams kyang bya'o/ /yum gyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/snying gar huX nag po/ lte bar swā ser po/ gsang bar āX dmar po/ brla la ha ljang gu 'od zer sna lngas khyab pa/ huX las yab kyi rdo rje oX las byung ba'i nor —78—

bus mtshan pa/ hruXlas yum gyi pad+ma a las byung ba'i ze'u 'brus mtshan pa/gnyis ka'i bu ga ho dmar pos bkag pa/ oṃ a nu rā ga ya mi/ rjes su chags par byas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga sogs/ zhes snyoms par zhugs par bsam ste dang por sbyor ba'o/ /thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba lha mo'i pad+ma ra byung ba'i thig le cha gnyis su gyur/ cha gcig gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa dang / cha gcig cha bcu bdun du gyur pa/ yak+ṣi ya me da/ dza sa do sa ya smo ṇi ra/ṇa yo ni ra rnams su gyur/ dbus kyi ya las rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po zhal dgu phyag sum cu rtsa drug par rang gi thugs kar drangs/ yi ge bcu pa dang / badz+ra dhika thugs ka nas phyir phyung / zhe sdang thams cad sbyangs/ zhe sdang gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus nas bdag nyid la thim pas/ bdag nyid sprul pa'i sku rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur pa ni/ dus mtha'i sprin ltar sku mdog nag /zhal dgu sum cu rtsa bzhi'i phyag /bcu drug zhabs kyi g.yas rnams bskum/ /g.yon brkyang rnam par 'gying ba'i bzhugs sogs nas/ gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs tshigs bcad ma ltar las/ bcom ldan de la 'phyud pa'i yum/ /dmar mo gri gug thod khrag 'dzin/ /phyag rgya lngas brgyan mgo phreng can/ /lang tsho dar babs skra ser 'khyil/ /g.yas brkyang zhabs kyis yab la 'phyud/ /de ltar rdo rje phag mo ni/ /'jam dpal khros dang mtshungs pa'o/ khar gyi slo las gti mug gshin rje gshed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i sogs/ pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rang gi thugs kar —79—

drangs/ oṃ dzi na dzika thugs ka nas phyir phyung / gti mug can sbyangs/ gti mug tshi nin rje gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus shar gyi re mig la tshand/lho'i ma las phra ma gshin rje gshed ser po ser nag dkar ba'i: rang gi thugs kar drangs/ oṃ rat+na dhika thugs ka nas phyir phyung / phra ma can sbyangs/ phra ma gzhin rje gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus lho'i re mig la 'khod/ nub tu me las 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i sogs rang gi thugs kar drangs/ oṃ a ro lika thugs ka nas phyir phyung / 'dod chags can sbyangs/ 'dod chags gzhin rje gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus nub kyi re mig la 'khod/ byang gi da las phrag dog gzhin rje gshed ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i sogs/ rang gi thugs kar drangs/ pradz+nyā dhika thugs ka nas phyir phyung/ phrag dog can sbyangs/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/tshur 'dus byang gi re mig la bkod/ shar lho'i dza las lha mo 'a ka gti mug gshin rje gshed lta bu thugs kar drangs/ oṃ mo hi rā ti/ badz+ra tsa rtsi ka'am/thugs ka nas phyir phyung / sa'i khams kyi dri ma sbyangs/ tshur 'dus me mtshams kyi grar 'khod/ lho nub kyi sa las phag mo ser mo dbu'i steng du phag zhal gyen du blta ba dang bcas pa phra ma gshin rje gshed lta bu/ thugs kar drangs/ oX dī ṣa rwa ti thugs ka nas phyir phyung / chu'i khams kyi dri ma sbyangs/ tshur 'dus bden bral gyi grar 'khod/ nub byang gi do las dbyangs can ma dmar mo 'dod chags gshin rje gshed lta bu thugs kar drangs/ oṃ ra ga rā ti thugs kar: me'i khams kyi dri ma sbyangs/ tshur 'dus rlung mtshams kyi grar 'khod/ byang shar gyi ru —80—

las swo rī ljang sngon phrag dog gshin rje gshed lta bu/ thugs kar drangs/ lkoX badz+ra rā ti thugs kar: rlung khams tshur 'dus dbang ldan gyi: phyi rol gyi shar sgo ya las tho ba gshin rje gshed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phrag drug gi sogs/ 'khore lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ thugs kar drangs/ oX mut+pa dhika thugs ka nas phyir phyung / tshangs pa dang dbang po dang me lha'i gdon gyi dri ma sbyangs/ tshur 'dus shar sgor gyi grwar 'god/ lho'i tsa las dbyug pa lten rje ga sked dkar po dkar nag dmar oṃ rat+na lha ka gshin rje srin po'i gdonajolhor sgor nub kyi ṇi las pad+ma gshin rje gshed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i: oX pad+ma dhika lha ma yin dang chu dang rlung lha'i gdon nub sgor: byang gi ra las ral gri gshin rje gshed ljang gu ljang nag dkar ba'i: oX khat+pa lha ka:gnod sbyin dang 'byung po'i: byang sgor: 'khor rnams rgyan cha lugs bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs shing / 'on kyang lha mo bzhi ni/ bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gying ba'i rang snang gi thabs la 'phyud pa'o/ /rim pa gnyis pa'i gra bzhir/ ṇa yo ni ra rnams yongs su gyur pa las/thod pa bzhir gyur te phyi'i gzhal yas khang gi rim pa gnyis pa'i gra bzhir 'khod/ gzhal yas khang rang gi thugs kar drangs/ phyir byung snod kyi 'jig rten gyi dri ma sbyangs/ tshur 'dus phyi'i gzhal yas khang la thim/ rang gi snying gar hūX/de las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes sems dpa' lha bcu gsum pa/ dkyil 'khore dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX oX ut+pa ra lha ka hūX phaṭa/ rat+na lha ka hūṃX phaṭa/pad+ma lha ka huX phaṭa/ khat+pa dhika huX phaṭa/ ces bgegs bskrad/ yi ge bcu pas bsrung ba byas —81—
