la/ oṃ mut+pa ra dza/ daṇ+ḍa hāX/ pad+ma baX/ khat+pa hoX dam tshig pa dang ro gcig tu gyur/lha thams cad kyi/ mig tu k+ṣi dkar sa snying dngos/ /rna bar phyag rdor dzi nag po/ /sna la khaX ser nam mkha'i snying / /lce la gaX dmar 'jig rten dbang / /dpral ba sgrib sel skaX ljang khu/ /lte bar kun bzang saX sngon po/ /dpral bar sku'i rdo rje oṃ/ /mgrin par gsung gi rdo rje āX thugs kar thugs kyi rdo rje hūX/ /sangs rgyas thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spya na drangs/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta swa bha wa ut+pa ko3haX/ thugs kar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' phyag gnyis pa bsgom/ de'i thugs kar ting 'dzin sems dpa' nyi ma la huX sngon po/ 'di rnams gong du byas na 'dir mi dgos so/ /rang gi thugs ka'i huX las 'od zer 'phros/gshin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaX oṃ badz+ra bha wa a bhi khiñtsa hūX/ zhes dbang bskur bas gtso bo la mi bskyod pa dang / 'khor rnams la gtso bos dbu brgyan/ ar+ghaX la sogs pas mchod/ho gshin rje gshed nag po/ /bla ma srin po'i gzugs rang bzhin/ khyod mthong kho bo rnam par 'jigs/ /bla ma khro bo'i rang bzhin spongs/ khyod kyi gar gyis sa steng dang / /sa bla dang ni sa 'og spyod/ /añtsa na nag bcas 'dra ba'i/ /gar mdzad khyod ni ro langs lags/ /sku lus sbom thung nag pa ste/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs sprul pa/ /rdo rje dbyangs can ma yis bstud/ /gar mdzad khyod ni bde ba tshe/ /hriXsti'i gsang sngags dag gis khyod/ /sa gsum po yi 'khrul ba sel/ /snying rje khros pa rje btsun khyod/ /gar mdzad 'gro ba yongs la gzigs/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza badz+ra swa bha wa ut+pa —82—

ko3haX/de zhe nas bdud rtsa myang la/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab ste/ oṃ ya ma ra dza sa do me ya ya me du sa na yo da ya/ ya da yo ni/ ra ya slo ya/ ya slo ye smo ni ra ma ya hūX phaṭa/ rtsa sngags so/ /oṃ khyiXspyi bi kṛ tā na na huX phaṭa/ /snying po'o/ /oṃ ya man+ta ka huX phaṭaX ye ge drug pa nye snying ngo / /oṃ a kro te ka ya man+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza huX phaṭa/ las sngags so/ /de ltar bzlas pa byas la/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bdag la thim/ bdag nyid kyang ye shes sems pa la/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la/de yang 'od gsal du nye bar zhugs/ rjes kyi bya ba thams cad spyi dang mthun no/ /zhes pa slob dpon ka ma la rak+ṣi ta'i gzhung las phal che bar bstan pa/ /grub chen khyung po dz+wa ki'i man ngag ji lta ba'i lugs so/ /'dir smras pa/ 'ga' zhig rgya gzhung khungs tshol zhing / /dkyi' 'khor mchog 'di bsgom pa 'gog /ma mthong ba la med ces pa'i/ /tshig 'di'ang dub pa yin ces gsung / /rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi skabs te drug pa'o/ /༈ da ni cung zad cig dpyad par bya ste/ phyi ma'i dus 'dir sngags la mkhas par rlom pa mang po zhig log par rtog la 'di dang 'di lta bu sems par byed de/ dkyil 'khor lnga po 'di dag phyogs gcig tu 'god pa'ang mi rung na lus dkyil la 'god pa ga la zhig snyam pa dang / 'di lus la bkod pa'i lha yin gyi lus dkyil ma yin no snyam pa dang / lus la bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor lnga char la/ so sor yan lag bzhi rdzogs ma byas na/ dkyil 'khor de dang bsgom pa'i go mi chod snyam pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gcig gis lngar dbang bskur mi rung snyam pa dang / lha skad cig gis bsgom pa thams cad rdzogs rim kho na'i skabs yin nam snyam pa dang / skye shi bar do gsum so sor sbyong byed kyi dmigs pa ma tshang na sgom du mi rung bar 'dod pa dang / kye rdo rje mawo cha can bcu —83—

bdun nam mi 'thad snyam pa dang / 'jigs byed bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor mi 'thad pa'am/'thad du chug kyang lha dang cho ga ma 'khrul bar med par 'dod pa rnams so/ /de dag gis lan ni mtha' yas par yod mod/ rgyas par mi spro ste snyigs ma'i dus kyi gang zag rnams/ rang lugs kyi bla ma shes rab kyi rnam dpyod 'khyogs pa dang ldan zhing / nus mthu dang thugs rje mngon du gyur pa ni til 'bru tsam dang bral ba 'ga' zhig gtso bor byas te/ rigs pa dang mi rigs pa'i brtags dpyad gtong long med par grub mtha' skyo ma snga btsan la zhen pas kun nas bslangs te zhe sdang me bzhin 'bar nas spyor ba ngan pa kun tu rtsom pa tsam ma gtogs/ log rtog bzlog par mi byed par snang bas so/ /mu stegs pa rnams kyang rigs pa la yid rton par byed na/da lta bod kyi mkhas rlom 'di dag ni phyugs dang mtshungs pa nyid do/ /'on kyang lugs 'di la mos pa rnams la nges par byed pa'i phyir du/ snying po tsam zhig brjod na/ dkyil 'khor lnga phyogs gcig tu 'god mi rung ste/ de ltar ston pa'i lung gi khungs med cing / rgyud sde tha dad nas zugad pa'i dkyil 'khor phyogs gcig tu 'god pa yang rang bzo yin no snyam du bas ma pa'o/ /'dir smras pa/ khyed kyi lugs la lung de ci/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa nyid yin nam/ khyed kyis mthong ba la byed/ phyi ma ltar na khyed rnams byis pa chung ja'i skabs dkyil 'khor gyi rnam bzhag phra mo rnams dang / mdo rgyud kyi brda chad phal mo che rnams kyang lung khungs med la/ khyed rnams kyis phyis mthong ba na de yod par 'gyur ba sogs ha cang yang thal bar 'gyur ro/ /dang po ltar na ni/ sdom pa rgya mtsho'i rgyud las bshad par bzhed de/ ba ched pa de la 'gog byed ci yod/ sdom pa rgya mtsho'i rgyud ces pa gtan med pa'am/ gal te yod kyang de nas 'di ma bstan pa'i lung dang rigs pa rnam dag ci yod/ rgyud sde mang po'i lha'i mngon rtogs sna tshogs rgyud gcig tu bsdus te 'chad pa mi 'thad do snyam na/ bde mchog a bhi ta rna las sangs rgyas thod pa'i sgrub —84—

thabs sogs bshad pa dang / dus 'khor nas bde mchog gsang 'dus sgyu 'phrul dra ba rnams kyi dkyil 'khor bshad pa dang / thog mar rgyud sde gnyis khog cig /yang de dag rgyud sde gzhan nas bshad pa'i lha ma yin gyis zhal phyag sogs cung zad mi 'dra ba'i phyir/ rgyud sde de nyid kyi lha yin no snyam na/ zhal phyag mi 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan de ci/ mdor byas dang lha yi pa sogs mi 'dra bas so snyam na/ ye shes zhabs lugs kyi gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / nag po spyod pas mdzad pa'i bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor sgrub thabs sogs kyang so so'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor ma yin par 'gyur ro/ /rigs pa 'di mngon rtogs dang cho ga'i rim pa dang yang mtshungs so/ /yang cig tu na kho bo cag gi dkyil 'khor 'di yang sdom pa rgya mtsho'i de kho na'i dkyil 'khor yin zhes brjod na ci zhig smras/ yang khyed kyi lugs la/ a bhi dha na nas bshad pa'i sangs rgyas thod pa de yang rnam par ma dag ste/ thod pa'i rgyud da lta'i 'di nas ni de ma bshad/ ma rgyud rgyas par ni da lta ma mthong bas lung gi khungs med do zhes bskur ba 'debs dgos par 'gyur ro/ /yang kha cig dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i bde gsang la sogs pa rgyud sde rgyas pa nas bshad pa yin no/ /zhes smra bar byed do/ /de ltar na dus 'khor dang gsang 'dus gnyis rgyud sde tha dad yin pa'i phyir/ rgyud sde tha dad mang po'i dkyil 'khor rgyud sde gcig nas gsungs pa yang yod par 'grub bo/ /yang rang bzo zhes bya ba ci la zer/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa med pa'o snyam na/ kho bo cag la ni de yod par 'dod cing / rgya gar gyi grub chen dngos la thug pa'i khyung po rnal 'byor pas 'di'i sgrub thabs che chung gnyis mdzad cing / bla ma rnams kyi lo rgyus kyi yi ge kun la yang 'di'i dbang bskur ba sogs kyi gtam rgyud du mar byung zhing / chig brgyud kyi bka' brgya grol nas ni lag len rgyun ma chad pa 'di'o/ / —85—

yang bshad pa'i / khungs gsal kha med pa la rang bzo cis zer na ni/ birnya ba'i sgrub thabs la sogs pa gdam ngag zab mo mtha' yas pa zhig dang / bod phyi rabs pa la ni/ bla ma dbu ma pa'i 'jam dbyangs chos skor la sogs pa ston byed kyi rgyu dang rgya gzhung gang na yod/ de lta bas na rang bzo ni khyed cag rnams la thog tu bab ste brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la/ kha cig rang lugs ma yin ces pa dang / kha cig la lhag chad nor ba'i skyon yod ces skyon btang ste/ rang gi dbang zhus pa'i bla ma de lag len de lta bu byed pa lta zhog thos pa tsam yang med par/ rang nyid kyi rgyud 'grel pa dang rgya gzhung tha na lung rgyun tsam yang med pa rnams kyi don phyogs gcig tu dril nas/ rang yang bsgom zhing gzhan la yang ston par byed do/ /de'i byin rlabs dang lag len gyi rgyun yod 'phro la chad nas/zhi gnas skyon can tsam yang rgyud la mi skye shing / byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma sna gcig kyang med par nyin bsam mtshan bsam kho na 'das shing tshig gis bshad pas/ mi'i mngon du lus kyi spyod pa'i mdzes 'khrigs dang / zhing ma yin pa rgyal po la sogs pa rnams la ngo dga'i khyogs la sogs pa'i bya bas rang phyogs tsam dar ba la bstan pa skyong bar sems pa 'di mtshar ro /yang rgya gzhung sogs kyi khungs gtso bor byed na ni/ phyi rabs kyi mkhas rlom rnams kyis byas pa'i sgrub dkyil rnams ni/ rgya bod kyi yi ge thams cad bsres te 'dor len 'ba' zhig byed kyi/ rgya gar gyi paṇa grub tshad ldan dang / bod kyi mkhas pa dang sgrub pa po tshad dang ldan pa su'i lugs dang mi mthun par byed do/ /dgyes mdzad kyi sku la bde gsang sogs 'god pa yang mi rigs pa ma yin te/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i sku la bde mchog gi lha tshogs bkod pa'i lus dkyil a bhi da na rus gsungs pa yin no/ /yang slob dpon rdo rje gdan pa pu rgyu shris mdzad pa'i dkyil chog dkyil 'khor lnga char gcig bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor cho ga yod pa'i phyir/ rgya gzhung gi khungs med pa'ang ga la yin/ de nyid —86—

slob dpon des mdzad pa ma yin no snyam na'ang/ de'i rgyu mtshan ci/ bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog phyogs gcig tu glegs bam du byas pa rnams la mi bzhugs pas so snyam na/ de 'dra ba'i ma nges pa/chen po de dpyod ldan su zhig smra/ sngon 'gyur nges pa bstan 'gyur bsdu ba po rnams kyis ma rnyed pa yang yod la/ slad kyi 'gyur ba yang yod pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsod pa dang bcas pa rnams ni gang rgyu mtshan du yang mi wo ste/ theg pa chen po nyid kyang rang sde'i rtsod pa can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa'i lan ni/ /yang lus dkyil gyi lha dang / lus la bkod pa'i lha tsam la khyad par yod pa ni kho bo cag kyang 'dod de dkyil 'khor du byas pa dang / ma byas pa'i lha'i khyad par nyid do/ /'on kyang gsang 'dus 'phags skor dang bde mchog /li nag dril gsum lta bu'i lus dkyil gyi mtshan nyid lus thams cad nges par tshang dgos pa ni ma yin te/ lus dkyil la rtsa khams lhar bskyed pa dang / phung khams bskyed pa gnyis yod la/ de las gzhan med par gang nas kyang ma bshad cing gzhan du na/ 'dus pa 'phags skor gyi lus dkyil de yang / bde mchog nas bshad pa'i lus dkyil gyi mtshan nyid mi snang ba'i phyir/ lus dkyil rnam par dag pa ma yin no zhes smra dgos par 'gyur ro/ /g.yin yang rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i tshe/ snying ga'i dkyil 'khor la bdag 'jug byed pa yod cing / de la bla med 'ga' zhig dang mtshungs pa'i lus dkyil kyi sgrub gzhir byed pa ni med la/ snying ga'i dkyil 'khor yin pa'i phyir dang / snying ga de lus ma yin ci zhig yin/gzhan lus dkyil gyi lha la sgrub gzhi lus yin pas khyab par smra ba shin tu ma brtags pa yin te/rang nyid kyi lus dkyil mchog tu 'bad pas sgrub pa'i 'dus pa 'phags skor gyi lus dkyil de la/sgrub gzhi tshor ba'i phung po las byas pa'i rin chen 'byung ldan dang / sgrub gzhi rnam shes kyi phung po la byas pa'i mi bskyod pa la sogs pa de dag /sgrub gzhi lus la yin pa'i phyir/ lus dkyil gyi lha ma —87—

yin par 'dod dgos te/ phung po bzhi po de dag lus su khas blangs pa'i skabs nam yang med pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na lugs 'di skyongs pa'i phyi rabs pa 'ga' zhig 'khor lo lnga'i lha rtsa khams de yongs su gyur pa las/ dkyil 'khor lngar bsgom pa zhig ma byung na/ der de dag 'god pa tsam gyis lus dkyil du mi 'gyur zhes smras pa'ang / snying po med do/ /de bas na lus la bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor gang yin pa de dag thams cad lus kyi dkyil 'khor du ming don mthun du 'jug pa la ci zhig rgol/gzhan du na 'byung ba bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dang zhal gyi dkyil 'khor la yang khyed cag rtsod par byed dam/ de bas na phyis byung ba byis pa'i rtsod pa 'di dag ni smig rgyu dang mtshungs par mngon no/ /log rtog gsum pa yang phyis byung ba'i lugs 'di 'dzin pa phal che ba zhig dang / gzhan lugs pa kha cig kyang ste/ sa bon las bskyed cing so so'i lugs kyi go cha 'god pa dang / so sor ye shes pa bstims pa dang rang rang gi rigs bdag gis rgyas btab pa rnams byas na/ dkyil 'khor so so'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa re bsgom par 'gyur la/ gzhan du dkyil 'khor lnga po bsgom pa'i go mi chod snyam pa yin mod kyi/ lus dkyil thams cad la yan lag bzhi rdzogs dgos pas ma khyab ste/ lha nag dril gsum gyi lus dkyil ni sa bon las mi bskyed pa yang shin tu mang la/ 'dus pa'i lus dkyil yang sa bon las ni bskyed mod kyi/ yan lag lhag ma rnams ni gtan bsgom par mi byed pa bzhin no/ /gzhan yang paṇ+ḍi ta chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang 'phreng bar/ dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa gcig gnyis la skad cig gis bskyed de yan lag lhag ma rnams kyang mi byed pa'i sgrub thabs kyang mdzad na/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor la de dag dgos pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ 'on te de bskyed rim gyi skabs ma yin gyi/ rdzogs rim gyi bskyed tshul yin no zhes —88—

smra ba dang / kha cig ltar bskyed rim la bstan pa thob pa rnal 'byor bzhi pa'i skabs la bsgom par bya ba yin gyi/ las dang po la des bskyed pa'i rim pas go mi chod snyam na/ de nyid kyi sngon du bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang / tshogs zhing mchod cing rgyun bshags byed pa sogs bshad pas rdzogs rim gyi lha bsgom pa'i yan lag tu/ de dag dgos par 'dod pa las ngo mtshar che ba ci zhig yod/ bzhi pa'i lan ni/ re zhig khyed cag nyid la 'dri ste/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa gang la/ 'dus pa rtsa bshad nas bshad pa 'ba' zhig bya dgos sam/ rgyud sde gzhan nas bshad pas rung / dang po ltar na ni/ de ltar khyed rnams kyi lag len byed pa rnams smos kyang ci dgos/ tshad dang ldan par gyur ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nyi shu pa dang/ bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa la sogs pa de dag kyang khyed kyi lugs la shin tu 'khrul bar thal bar gyur te/ de dag gi cho ga mang po rgyud sde gzhan nas drangs par mi snang ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang rgya bod na cho ga rnam par dag pa sna gcig kyang med par khas blangs par song bas rang nyid la co 'bri bar byas so/ /gnyis pa ltar na rgyud sde sna tshogs nas bsdus pa'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga gcig gis 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur du wo zhing / 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur du mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang dag pa gcig kyang mi snang ngo / /'jigs med 'byung gnas kyis zhal snga nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje 'phreng ba zhes bya ba yang / rgyud sde mtha' dag nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis la cho ga gcig kho na sbyar ba yin pas re zhig de nyid khog la/ phyis 'di dgag par gyis shig /de lta mod kyi man ngag dang khungs med par phan tshun gcig gis rang bzo'i rgyas 'geb pa kho bo cag ni rmi lam na yang mi byed mod/ bla med kyi cho ga yang dag la kyai rdo rje'am/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'dres byed cing / bde mchog dang 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim mang po la yang / lam skor gyi brda chad 'dres par yang snang / la la dag ni rdzogs rim thams cad gnad bzhi —89—

dang bsre ba dgu la sogs pa sbyor ba dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed la sogs pa zhal phyag dag pa'i nges don du byas na rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chod kyi rna bar ma thos pa'i khrid sna tshogs pa zab zab ltar bcos nas ma rgyud kyi 'pho ba bsnan te rgya cher 'chad pa'i phyir khyed rnams nyid kyis gzab dgos so/ /log rtog lnga pa ni/ 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir/ lha dpa' bo gcig pa la sogs pa skad cig gis bskyed pa ji snyed cig byung zhing / brgyud pa'i srol 'di la yang skad cig gis bskyed pa la nyams len gyi gtso bor mdzad de/ de la bod kha cig gis bla ma'i man ngag med par rang gi blo bzo ma skad cig gis bsgom pa'i rma ngon rtogs dang / de'i dbang mi //sa gsar du brtsams pa dag byung ba la/ rang bzo'i krong bskyed bsgom du mi drang zhes chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas 'gog par mdzad pa yin mod kyi/ krong bskyed thams cad bkag pa ga la yin/ de bas phyi ma'i dus 'dir skad cig gis bskyed pa rdzogs rim gyi lha 'ba' zhig tu 'dod pa dang / bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor bzhi pa'i skabs kho na'i bsgom bya yin par 'dod pa ni gtso bo'i don la mtshungs te/ bskyed rim rnal 'byor bzhi pa yang rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa bzang po ma skyes pa la 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /de la 'di ltar btags te/ rdzogs rim gyi skabs ma yin par lha skad cig gis bskyed pa gtan nas mi rung ba'am/ spyir rung du chug kyang de 'ba' zhig la sems 'dzin du mi drang ba'o/ /de yang rung du chug mod kyi sa bon la sogs pa las bskyed pa g.yin zhig med par/ krong bskyed kyi lha 'ba' zhig bsgom pa mi rung ba yin/ dang po ltar na gsang 'dus 'phags skor gyi lhag mos dang / thun mtshams kyi lha bskyed pa yang mi rung bar 'gyur zhing / gnyis pa ltar na yang de ltar mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan cung zad kyang med pa kho nar ma zad bskyed rim la sems 'dzin pa'i tshe gzhan du cung zad sems yengs pa na slar yang mngon rtos mgo nas ma bcad par sems 'dzin du mi rung bar 'gyur —90—

ro/ /des na sems g.yin du yengs pa na slar sems 'dzin pa'i tshe skad cig gis bskyed pa las 'os ci yod/ gsum pa ltar na mi rung zhes bya ba ni ci zhig /'ga' zhig thun mtshams kyi lha tsam bsgom ste/ thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa mi byed/ de dag la mi rung ba med na/ thun bzhi'i lha skad cig gis bskyed pa la sems gnas pa brtan por byed pa dang / de'i sngags bzla ba la skyon du blta ba ni/ skyes bu zhig tshong dus kyi lam du nye bar zhugs pa la yang na khyod ma 'gro/ ci ste 'gro na 'khor yug gi pha rol tu 'gro dgos so zhes smra ba dang mi mtshungs sam/ rang gi blo dang 'tsham pa de tsam bsgom pa la skyon du ma 'dzin zhig /log rtog drug pa ni/ bod kyi phyi rabs pa 'ga' zhig la snang ste/ skye shi bar do gsum sbyong byed so sor tshang zhing / sku gsum lam byed so sor yod pa zhig bsgom na/ rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gyur zhing bag chags de dang de spyongs pa'i nus pa yod cing / mngon rtogs bsdus pa re la zab mor bsgom pa rnam pa rnams ni snying po med pa la brtson par byed pas dus don med du 'da'o/ /zhes smra bar byed do/ /tshig 'di ni shin tu mi rung ba yin te/ chos dang gang zag dam pa mtha' yas pa zhig la ngan smras su song ba'i phyir ro/ /yang zloX bhi he ru ka sogs grub pa'i skyes bu ji snyed pa zhig gis mdzad pa bde dgyes gsang 'dus dus 'khor gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs mtha' yas pa zhig mdzad pa ma yin nam/ yang sgrub thabs bsdus pa 'di dag gis skye shi bar rda'i sa bon dngos su 'joms mi nus pas sgom du mi rung ba yin na ni/ shin tu ma nges te de lta na bskyed rim mtha' dag dang / so so'i skye bo'i lam gyi rdzogs rim thams cad kyis sa bon de rnams dngos su 'joms mi nus pa'i phyir bsgom du mi rung bar 'gyur la rgyud nas de rnams 'joms pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang smon lam btang pa tsam yang 'gyur na/ sgrub thabs bsdus pa rnams kho nas nyes pa ci zhig byas/ g.yin yang dus gsum gyi snang ba lhar bsgom pa kho —91 —

nas tha mal gyi snang zhen yin no cog thams cad mgo non par 'gyur na/ skye shi bar do gsum kho nas snang zhen log zhig tu ci la sdod/ don gyi gtso bo yang tha mal gyi snang zhen bzlog pa yin pa'i phyir bskyed rim gyi gtso bo'i don sgrub thabs bsdus pa rnams la yang tshang ba yin no/ /sku gsum lam du byed mi nus pa zhes pa la yang rigs pa 'di nyid sbyar bar bya'o/ /ci ste sku gsum lam byed dang / srid pa gsum sbyong byed tsam yod du chug kyang / bsdus pa de dag mi zab cing rgyas pa de dag zab snyam na/ 'di la ni gang zag gi khyad par shes dgos te/ dkyil 'khor rgyas pa gsal thebs shing mngon rtogs rgyas pa de yang myur du bsgom thub pa'i gang zag la ni rgyas pa de dag shin tu zab pa yin pa kho bo cag kyang 'dod mod/ de lta bu'i gang zag ni shin tu yi ste/ dkyil 'khor de'i ngor gsal thebs dgos kyi/ mngon rtogs 'don shes pa dang go ba yod pa tsam gyis mi chog pa'i phyir ro/ /des na zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'am/ gtso rkyang tsam 'ol spyi gsal thebs la/ dkyil 'khor chen po bsgom pa'i tshe 'ol spyi tsam yang gsal thebs dka' ba sha stag 'dug ste/ mngon rtogs chen po 'don cing bsgom pa ltar bcos nas nyin zhag brgya stong 'das kyang mngon rtogs rgyas pa lan cig tsam yang / tshang bar gsal thebs dka' zhing / ngag gi nus pa rnyed pa dang sems gnas thob cig kyang mi yong ba'i tshod du snang bas/ gang zag de la mi zab bo/ /des na de la ni nyung ngu tsam bsgom na gsal yang thebs la/ bsgom bzlas mang du byas pas mthu nus pa yang rnyed/ sems zin sla bas mi ring bar gsal snang mched nas/ dkyil 'khor rgyas pa bsgom pa'i skal pa can du yang 'gyur bas na/ gang zag 'di la ni mngon rtogs kyang bsdus pa rnams zab pa yin no/ /'o na/ bsdus pa de rnams dbang po rtul bo'i nyams len du snang bas/ mi zab par grub pa'i phyir kho bo cag rgyas pa bsgom mo snyam na/ lha zhal gcig phyag gnyis po yang gsal mi thebs bzhin du dbang po rnon po'i nga rgyal mi 'tshal zhing / khyed cag dkyil 'khor rgyas pa bsgom pa la ni kho bo —92—

cag dgag pa brjod pa dang ngan par ga la sems te/ de tsam gyis kyang bag chags khyad par can 'jog par snang bas so/ /'on kyang da lta gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs par sems pa rnams ni/ re re tsam ma gtogs dbang po rtul por snang ba'i phyir dbang po mchog dman gyi khrid lugs shes dgos so/ /log rtog bdun pa ni kha cig na re/ slob dpon ka ma la pas bro ṭa'i snying po he ru ka bcu bdun pa'i dkyil 'khor mtshan ma bzhi bor nas/ de'i phyag mtshan sgo ma bzhi gtad nas bcu gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'dod de/ rgyud las/ pi waX dang ni gling bu dang / /ku mud dag dang rdza rnga ste/ /phyag gnyis pa la zhal gcig pa/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /zhes bshad pa dang /'gal lam snyam na/ 'di khyung po rnal 'byor gyi kye rdor mtshon cha can zer te/ rgyud 'grel rnams nas de'i tha snyad ma bshad do/ /zhes 'dri ste/ de la smras pa/ khyed ni grags pa dang ldan pa zhes kyang snang ste/ smra ba 'di lta bu la ci'i phyir 'byung bar mi 'gyur/ dgos pa med bzhin du rigs pa ma yin pa'i tshig gi chos dang gang zag mchog la sdang ba'i sdig pa rngam po che bsags pa'i phyir ro/ /spyir grub thob kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba lwa ba'i na bza' can lha bu la skyon 'dzin pa 'di lta bu'i snying khams ni nam mkhar mi shong ba tsam ste/ de lta bur na grub chen mtsho skyes kyis bstod pa dang sgrub thabs las/ sha ra bha dang byi la'i dod du khyi dang ma he bshad pa yang rgyud dang mi mthun ces khog ciganyi zer la chibs pa sogs kyi cho 'phrul la mnga' brnyes shing / shing gi lha mos bsod snyoms 'bul sogs kyi rtags las dngos grub brnyes nges pa/ rang gi brgyud pa'i bla ma bka' drin can/ rgya gar gyi mkhas pa chen po dpa' bo rdo rje ni zhabs kyis bzhugs stangs skabs rgyud dang mi mthun zhes khyed nyid kyis bkag zin to/ /khyung po'i dgyes mdzad ces gsungs pa'i ming tsam gyis yang khungs mi chod cing / mtshon cha can gyi tha snyad khungs med zer bzhin du rang yang de ltar brda chad byed pa ni —93—

shin tu blun no/ /kyai rdor gyi rgyud da lta'i 'brog mi'i 'gyur gsum po 'di ma gtogs gas shes bya la mi rigs cing / zhal gzigs dang man ngag sogs kyi sgrub thabs gtan byed du mi rung na ni khyed kyi de bden bden 'dra'o/ /de lta na ni birnya pa'i gshed dmar sgrub thabs kyang rgyud 'di dang mi mthun ces dgag dgos par 'gyur/ rgyud 'grel nas ma bshad pa kho nas rnam dag ma yin par 'gyur na bkag chog dang / mgon po dang lha mo la sogs pa'i rang nyid nyams su len pa du ma zhig la co 'dri bar gyur la/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma dang phag dkar/ shes rab gsal byed kyi sgrub thabs sogs kyang mi 'thad par 'gyur te/ bde mchog gi rgyud 'grel rnams nas ma bshad pa'i phyir/ brda chad kyang rgyud 'grel nas bshad pa dgos na/ lam 'bras gdams ngag tu nyams lnga gsum bco lnga dang grub brgyad mnyen lcug bzhi la sogs pa thams cad mi 'thad par thal bar 'gyur te rgyud 'grel rnams na de 'dra'i tha snyad ma bshad pas so/ /de dag grub chen rgya gzhung khungs yod pas so snyam na/ dgyes mdzad bcu gsum yang rgya gzhud gi khungs yod pa dang / phyogs 'dir skye bo phal mo che'i sngon du rdzu 'phrul dpag med ston pa sogs grub rtags mngon gyur can/ rgya gar gyis paṇ+ḍi ta lnga bcu'i rjes su bzung ba'i mkhas grub 'di nyid kyis gang gsungs pa de nyid las zab par bzang ba'i khungs ci zhig 'tshal/ kho bo cag ni rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas rjes su bzung zhing lung bstan pa bar dor mchog brnyes pa nges pa/ mdo sngags gzhung lugs rig gnas thams cad la cher mkhas pa/ rgyud chen po sum brgya thugs nas gsungs pa'i rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍita chen po a bha yas gsungs pa kyai rdo rje bdud bzhi bkram gdan pa la sogs 'di thams cad skyon du ga la 'dzin/log rtog brgyad pa bsal ba ni/ 'di na mi mkhas kyang mkhas su re ba/ 'ga' zhig 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor mi 'thad de/ rgya gzhung gi khungs med pa'i phyir dang / lha rnams —94—

mnga' 'byin byed pa yang 'jigs byed la yum med par bshad pa dang 'gal ba yin zhes mang du smra zhing yi ge 'bri bar byed do/ /tshul 'di la dpyod ldan rnams kyi sa mang du brgal lan byas pa yang yod cing / rgyas par gzhan du 'dri bar 'gyur bas 'dir mi brjod do/ /'on kyang slob dpon wo po ka ma la ra khris tas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyang yod la/ spyir khungs yod med kyi dpyad pa ni gong dang mtshungs so/ /'jigs byed la yum byar mi rung ba'i lung tshig gsal kha med la/ yum yod pa byar mi rung ste sgrub thabs phal cher na med pa'i phyir ro snyam na/ de lta na bde mchog dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs kyang mi rung ste/ sgrub thabs phal cher na yum yod par bshad pa'i phyir ces dang mi mtshung ngam/ des na rgol ba de la ni snying po ma mchis so/ / 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma mchog tu 'dod pa rnams kyang dang por zhal gsum pa bskyed/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi tshe zhal dgu par bsgyur ba ni mi 'thad par 'dod pa yang gong du bshad pa'i yum 'gog byed kyi rigs pa dang mtshungs so/ /gtso bo'i yum rdo rje rnal 'byor mas byed pa mi 'thad snyam pa yang de dang 'dra la khyad par phag mo ser mo byed pa ni mi drang zhes pa ni/ gshin rje gshed nag po dang 'di mtshungs dgos pa las/ gshed nag gi dkyil 'khor la ni phag mo sngon mor yod pa'i phyir snyam pa'o/ /gzhin rje dgra nag gi dkyil 'khor yin na de ni 'thad du chug kyang / dgra nag dang phyogs mthun tsam bkod pa ma gtogs rgyud tha dad pa yin pa'i phyir ma nges la/ phyogs tsam ni gshed dmar dang yang mthun cing / de ni phag mo ser mo yang bshad do/ /spyir phag mo mā ma ki'i ngo bo yin la/ de ni mi bskyod pa dang rin 'byung gnyis ka'i rigs bstan pa yin par rgyud sde phal mo che la grags pa yin pas/ kha dog kyang gnyis ka ltar rung bar mngon cing / khyad par ka ma la rak+ṣi ti'i sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba yin no/ /de lta bas na bskyed rim gyi lam bzang po lugs srol mchog 'di la yid gnyis dang log rtog gi dbang du ma gyur par gus pa chen pos nan du byos shig /—95—

'dir smras pa/ yid bzhin rin chen 'dam rdzab kyis gos blun po rnams kyis spangs gyur pa/ /nor bu mkhan mchog blo ldan mkhas pas nyer blangs rang gas don ston byed/ /blun pos blangs na chud 'dzar gyur bas re zhig bor ba nyid ni mchog /nya pa'i tshogs kyis rin chen rnyed pa'ang phye mar brdung ste bor la stos/ /blun po mkhas par 'chos gang de rnams kyis/ /tshad mar byas gang bsre bslad mang pos khyab/ /de dag rnams kyis bor gang lam mchog 'di/ /nyes skyon dri ma bral gang ngo mtshar rmad/ /rigs pas sgrub pa'i skabs te bcu bdun pa'o/ /'bras bu lam byed bde ba chen po'i rgyud/ /mthar thug ston byed rgyud rgyal rnam pa lnga'i/ /sgrub thabs kun ni mchog gyur zla bral ba/ /smra ba gang de zla med dpa' bo yin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dkyil 'khor che/ spyod 'chang dga' ba'i bde sgrub pas/ /snyid two mchog 'di sems can kun/ /rdo rje 'dzin chen rgyal gyur cig /rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs bskyed rim mtha' dag gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba mkhas pa dang grub pa'i dbang phyug khyung po rnal 'byor pa'i chos kyi rigs rus su skyes pa tā ra nā thas snga phyi bskul ba po mang po dang / nye bar dad ldan grags pa bzang pos yi ge pa dang bskul ba po byas nas/ rgyas bsdus bsre slad sogs kyi skyon dang bral bar nye bar sbyar ba ste yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal stag lung thang gi dben gnas rnam rgyal rab brtan zhes bya ba'i gnas su'o// //'dis rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che spyi dang / khyad par grub chen shangs pa'i bka' srol gyi sgrub rgyud 'di nyid phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /bkra shis//—96—

slob ma rjes 'dzin bzhugs/na mo badz+ra bhe rā wa ya/ gang zhig ye shes 'bar ba'i me lce yis/ /ma lus bdud sde'i tshang tshing kun bsregs nas/ /bden gnyis snang byed ye shes 'od brgya 'gyed/ /rdo rje slob dpon dpa' bo che la 'dud/ /bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs 'dir zhugs na/ /drag shul spyod pa mtha' dag ni/ /skad cig gcig gis 'grub 'gyur zhes/ /dus gzhan zhig na bla ma gsung / 'dir sgyu grwa 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud las kyang gsungs shing / dpal kha sbyor thig le las gsal bar bstan pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i gzhung gi don/ mchog tu bsdus pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sgrub thabs sgom par 'dod pas/ dur khrod la sogs pa dben pa'i gnas su skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams sngon du btang zhing / rang skad cig gi 'jig mdzad du gsal ba'i snying khar pad nyi la gnas pa'i hūX las 'od zer 'phros/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dza/ na mo gu ru khyoX na mo badz+ra bhe ra wa maṇ+ḍal khyu/ badz+ra lā gya/ sogs kyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs bdun rnam dag bya/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun/ oX hūṃ n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bha wa at+pa ko3haX/stong pa'i ngang las hūX yig las grub pa'i bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su chos kyi 'byung gnas chen po mi zad cing 'jigs pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi yongs su bskor ba'i nang du thod rus 'bar ba'i gzhal med khang yangs shing rgya che —97—

la dpangs mtho ba de'i dbus su/ yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam dud kha la gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i dhiXlas rang nyid 'jam dpal zhi bar 'gyur ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rig mar bcas pa thams cad du gdul dka' 'dul ba'i rnam pa can du spyan drangs te rang la thim/ rang nyid kyang thugs ka'i nyi ma la thim/ de nyid 'bar ba dang bcas shing dpag tshad brgyad stong gi tshad du gyur/ de'i 'gyur ba las/ hūX dang rdo rje 'bar ba chen po'o/ /yang 'od zer spro bsdus mkha' dbyings gang ba'i 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i tshogs rnams bdag nyid la 'dus pa las/ rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i skur gyur/ oX hiXrgiXwi kri tā na na hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jig byed sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar rab tu gnag pa/ zhal bzhi phyag brgyad zhabs bzhi pa/ sku sbom zhing thung la gsus khyim che ba gcer bu ling ga gyen du bsgreng ba/ sdang ba dang gdug pa can thams cad kyi sha dang rkang dang tshil za ba ha hā dang hūX hūX dang phe kyi sgra gnam du 'bod pa/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha thams cad la sdigs mdzub byed pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal mthing nag ma he khros pa'i gdong / rdo rje'i rwa gdeng bas phyogs thams cad gnon pa/ g.yas zhal dkar po rgya cher bzhad cing / g.yon zhal dmar po rab tu 'jigs pa/ ya sosam mchu mnan pa/ dbu'i gtsug tu 'jam dpal gyi zhal gser mdog yid tsam khro ba/ zur phud lnga dang ldan pa'o/ khro zhal thams cad dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang dbu skra kham ser me ltar —98—

'bar ba/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyi rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gshun shing dang / ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang / cang te'u rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭaX ga dang / thod khrag dang / mda' gzhu dang / zhags pa bsnams pa ste/ ral gri dang thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ dang po gnyis kyi glang po che'i lpags pa yang brgyangs te bsnams pa'o/ /zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang zhing / rgyab ma gnyis gar gyi tshul gyis mnan pa/sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug dang klu chen po brgyad kyis dkris pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu brgyan dang / khrag 'dzag mgo bo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku las sprul pa'i rdo rje pho nya'i tshogs kyis nam mkha'i khams rgyas par 'geng ba/ 'jigs dus kyi me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs shing / srid pa gsum gyi blta bar yang mi bzod pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ mig tu k+ṣaX/ rna bar droX/ sna la khaX/ lce la gaX /dpral bar skaX/ lte bar saX/ spyi bor aX dkar po/ mgrin par āX dmar po/ snying khar huX sngon po sangs rgyas thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs te gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru gsum la thim/ rang gi snying gar ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal zhi ba/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje'i lte bar nyi ma la hūX/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dbang gi lha dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX mchod yon nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oX a bhi 'khri phu'i tā maX sarba tā tha ga ta/ zhes/ sol ba btang pas/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi khri lto huX/ su ra ta stoX ā haX/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur te mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dzaXhuX baX hoX zhes de thams cad rang la gnyis su med —99—

par thim/ gshin rje gshed kyi dam rgya bcas gnas gsum du gtugs la/ rtsa sngags dang / snying po dang / nye snying rnams brjod do/ /de nas sgeg sogs brgyad kyis mchod pa dang / gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ /sogs dang / dur khrod rgyan gyi/ sogs kyi mchod cing bstod/bdud rtsi myang ba 'jigs byed sgrub thabs rwa lugs spyi dang 'dra/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa yang 'dra ste/ rtsa sngags yi ge so gnyis dang / snying po bcu pa dang / nye snying bdun pa rnams spyi dang 'dra ba dang /hruXgyiX yi ge bcu bzhi pa khyad par du bzla'o/ /mthar snying kha'i 'od zer gyi snod bcud dkyil 'khor 'khor lo gyur pa/ gzhal yas khang la thim/ de rang nyid la thim/rang ye she sems dpa' la thim/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la/ de yang stong pa nyid du sbyang ngo / /stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ srung ba'i don du skye mched dang gnas gsum byin gyis rlabs so/ /dge ba bsngo/ 'di la srung 'khor mi bsdu ba man ngag yin no/ /gtor ma 'bum tshul ni/ byin rlabs sogs thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs rgyas pa dang 'dra ba las/ 'bul ba'i sngags ni/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar mahā badz+ra ste ra wa mahā a dhi pa ti i daX ba ling kha kha ji hi ji hi huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyi 'bul ba ni khyad par ro/ /tshul 'dis snying po 'bum phrag bcu bzla ba ni bsnyen pa'o/ /yang gzhan yang sngar dang 'dra ba las/ dbang bskur rgyas btab kyi rjes su/ rang gi ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i 'khor bzhi skad cig gi grub pa ni/ mdun du raX las rdo rje srin po smug nag ral gri dang thod pa 'dzin pa khyi'i gdong pa can/ g.yas su ya las las kyi gshin rje sngo skya be con thogs pa/ g.yon du ma las dus mtshan ma dmar mo rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu huX las dpal mgon nag po gri gug dang thod khrag —100—

'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang ral pa mun ltar gtib pa/ stag lpags kyis smad dkris dang / mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs gsol ba/ sbrul rgyan dang mi mgo'i 'phreng ba can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyi mi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /zhes bskyed nas mchod bstod yan chad sngar bzhin bya/ gtso bo'i bzlas pa song rjes su 'khor bzhi po la gtso bo'i bzhi cha re bzla ste/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa sa bha k+ṣa sa sha truX i ti phaṭa/ rdo rje'i srin po'o/ /oX ka la rū pa huX phaṭa/ las kyi gon na rje'o/ /spyo kā la tri sbyoX dus mtshan ma'o/ /oṃ mahā kā la ru pa sha hūX phaṭa/ nag po chen po'o/ /gtor 'bul gyi skabs 'khor bzhi yang spyan drangs nas/ so so'i snying po'i mthar/ ā ka ro btags pas 'bul/ nag po chen po la sha sa nas kyang lhag por 'bul ba yin no/ /'khor gyi bstod pa bsdus pa ni/ dbang phyug chen po'i dkyil 'khor gnas mchog tu/ /dbang med dang pas 'dus pa dang / /ye shes sprul pa'i lha tshogs la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod par bgyi/ /zhes pa tsam gyis chog ste nye ba'i bsnyen pa'o/ /sgom don dang mthun par dkyil 'khor bris la/ dam rdzas mchod gtor tshogs pa byas nas/ bdag mdun tha mi dad pa'i tshul gyis zla ba drug la sogs par gtso 'khor gyi sngags sbrel nas bzlas sgom byed pa ni sgrub pa'o/ /'khor gyi sngags bsdu na/ raX ye sbyo hūṃX/ zhes pa tsam gyi chog go /de nyid dang 'dra ba las thun mtshams kyi skabs ma gtogs/ bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgom bzlas byed pa ste/ zla ba phyed nas zla ba drug gi bar byed pa ni/ sgrub pa chen lnga'o/ /de nas ni las la sbyar bas ji ltar bde bar 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /'di la sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang / kha sbyor las 'khor rdo rje srin po gcig pu las gsungs kyang / gzhan rnams bla ma'i man ngag las 'byung la/ 'di'i rtogs pa bsdus pa las kyang don gyi ma bshad do/ /yang mdun du rdo rje — 101 —

srin po gshin rje/ dus mtshan gsum gsum sbrags su chad pa'i lugs kyang yod de/ 'dam kha yin pa'i phyir ji ltar bde bar bya'o/ /sgrub thabs 'di'i dbang chog gam/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga ni/ stegs bu yangs pa la chos 'byung gru gsum mthing kha me ris bskor/ phyi zlum skor yang rdo rwa dang me ris skor/ gru chad dmar po bya'o/ /dbus nyi gdan la tshom bu nag po lnga bkod/ de'i steng du mañdzi la/ thod pa shas gang ba'i dkyil du/ 'khrul 'khor dang ral gri btsugs/ bdud rtsi lngas kyang sbags/ phyogs bzhir stegs bur dmar gtor re yang bkod/ mdun du 'bul gtor gnyis/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ khrag gi ar+ghaṃ sha chen gyi bdug spos/ sha rus kyi zhal zas rnams kyang khyad par du bsham/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / gnas yo byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ gong bzhin bdag bskyed sgom/ bzlas pa cung zad bya/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūX yig las/ zhes pa nas/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i nang du/ de'i dbus su thod rus 'bar ba'i gzhal med khang / zhes pa nas/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ de'i steng du hūX las rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i skur gyur/ ces pa nas/ mi bzod pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ mdun du ram las: sogs 'bor bzhi bskyed/ mig tu k+ṣi nas mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar yang bdag bskyed dang 'dra ba las/'khore rnams la rigs bdag gtso bo phyag gnyis pas dbu brgyan pa'am/ gtso 'khotshor thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ ces pa dang / bdag mdun gyi 'don pa spo tshul shes dgos so/ /bar 'dir bzlas pa cung zad bya/ de nas gtor ma 'bul te/ gtor ma dang po lha lnga la 'bul/ gnyis pa phyogs skyong bcu la 'bul/ thun mong du slob ma'i rgyud byin gyis rlob par gsol ba btab/ gang yang rung ba'i bum pa dri bzang gi chus bkang nas/ tso( badz+ra a — 102—

mṛ ta kun ḍa li ha na ha na huX phaṭa/ ces bya ba'i sngags kyi yig 'bru rab tu 'bar ba'i rang bzhin du bsam/ sngags de nyid brgya stong dang / a bhi ṣe ka ta nyer gcig bzlas/ 'di slob ma rnams dang por khrus bya ba'i bum pa de yin no/ /yang stegs bu gzhan zhig gi steng du dbang bskur ba'i bum pa 'cha' ste/ de yang thod pa'am/ rin po che'i bum pa yang rung la/ shing gi snod du bya ba min gsung / des na phal cher lag la rdza'i bum pa zhig khrag dang chang sres pa'i spos chus bkang /nag por byug kha rgyan mi dgos/ thod pa chang gis bkang bas kha bcad/ de'i dbus su lha lnga po skad cig gis gsal btab nas sngags brgya brgya tsam bzla'o/ /kā pa la'i myos byed so so'i sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas phul/ rdo rje'i 'phreng ba zhig la gtso bo'i sngags lan brgya bzla zhing / hūX las byung ba rgyal ba mi bskyod pa'i bdag nyid du mos/ oṃ āXbadz+ra dhika hūX swāhā/ zhes pa'ang brgya brgyad bzla'o/ /de nas slob ma rnams la bgegs sbyang ba dang / sdig pa sbyang ba dang / khrus rnams sngon du song nas sems bskyed gsal btab/ chos bshad bya/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ dga' chen khyod bdag /sogs kyis gsol ba bto/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /sogs kyis dam la bzhag /dkyil chog las 'byung ba ltar ye shes dbab pa bya/ lha ngo bstan/ e ma ho sangs rgyas slob dpon che/ /e ma ho chos dang tshogs kyi mchog /dam tshig de nyid bdag la lce'i// /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsole// /ces lan gsum/ de nasaslob ma gtso bo bskyed/ snying khar yang gtso bo dang / lte bar 'khor bzhi sgom/ re re bzhin bzlas lung phog re re bzhin sngags bzlas pa'i bum pa'i chu'i dbang lan lnga bskur dgos te/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ /sogs kyi mthar so so'i sngags kyi mjug la/ a bhi khri thu/ btags pas so/ /de rjes gtso bo'i dam rdzas dang / 'khor rnams kyi gtor dbang yang rim bzhi du bya/ rdo rje — 103—

'phreng ba la me tog sna tshogs bcings te/ slob ma'i mgo bor dbang bskur te/ u dum wa ra man+ta ra/ /zhes sogs brjod/ thod pa'i dbus kyi ral gri lag tu gtad la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ral gri che sogs/ rdor dril gto la/ shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin bdag /sogs/ bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod sbyin la/ btung ba rin chen/ sogs brjod/ gshin rje gshed kyi drag po'i 'khor lo lag tu gtad la/ bsgral bar bya ba'i yul lnga ni/ /'khor lo dang ni ting nge 'dzin/ /sngags sam sman gyi gsad bya ste/ /yang na gnas las spos par bya / /zhes dang rtsa sngags la/ adhi'i ṣañtsa btagasapa brjod do/ /slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra zhing / tshogs 'khor cho gas tshogs btang / dkyil 'khor gyi rjes kyi bya ba'ang gzhan gyi 'dre'o/ /kun la yongs su ma grags kyang / khyud don shes pa rnams dga' ba/ /mkhas pa'i snying la zhen pa ltar/ /gsal por bkod pa 'di nyid do/ /dngos grub kun gyi sgrub pa'i thabs /'jug sgo tsam zhig brjod pa las/ /dge ba cung zad gang bsags te/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed dpal thob shog /'di la rdo rje 'jigs byed rgyas pa sgrub thabs rwa lugs sngon du shes pa gal che la/ de nas 'di tsam kho nas 'grub ste/ mchog tu bsdus pa rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs slob ma'i rjes zung dang bcas pa gsal por bkod pa 'di yang / slob bu dam tshig can sngags 'chang dkon mchog legs 'dzin gyi bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas sbyar ba'o// //bkra shis//zhus dag /'di bris dge bas ma rgan sems can thams cad gshin rje dus dgra'i rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par rgyur gyur cig /— 104—

kyi lag len dngos grub kun stsol zhes bya ba bzhugs/oX swā sti/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i bsnyen pa la/ rwa skyo sogs kyi yig cha dngos bstan phal cher la/ las tshogs kho na don du gnyer ba'i bsnyen pa'i dbang du mdzad gda' na'ang / las tshogs don gnyer gyi gang zag nye tshe ba la dgongs pa yin/ spyir bsnyen pa'i skabs 'dir mchog sgrub pa kho na gtso che la/ sgrub pa'am bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma yin na/ las tshogs gtso mi che/ dbang po rab kyi mchog gi dngos grub kyi brgyud pa'i rgyu'am/ phal che ba la dgongs nas thun mong gi dngos grub kyi rgyu yin pa dang / dbang po shin tu tha mas kyang las thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub ces/ spyir gyi las tshogs 'grub pa zhar byung dang / las tshogs kyang drag las kho na ma yin gyi/ las bzhi cha mnyam yin no/ /de ltar yin pa rtog pa dang po kho na la brtags pas shes/ 'dir rgyud las dngos grub mchog ces gsungs pa ni/ thun mong gi dngos grub chen po'i ming yin pas/ dngos grub dang las sbyor tsam gyi phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub mi 'grub kyi/ de 'grub pa la rdzogs rim dgos par dgongs so/ /las sbyor zhes pa ni/ dngos grub la dngos su mtshams sbyor ba la yang las sbyor zer la 'on kyang de las bzhi sogs phra mo'i sgrub thabs ni ma yin no/ /des na rgyud 'dir —105—

las dang po pa'i sa la gnas pa rnams kyi/ las bzhi sgrub tshul rnam pa bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi las sbyor du shes par bya'o/ /de ltar spyir nges par byas nas/ las dang po pa'i bsnyen pa byed tshul ni/dang por sgrib sbyong dang tshogs bsags ci rigs par byas la/ legs par tshags su tshud pa'i gnas khang dang / phyir yo byad gsar du blang du mi btub pas/ yo byad kyang tshags su tshud par byas/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma rgya cher btang / bar chad mi 'jug par gsol ba btab pa lan mang du bya/ de rjes bgegs sbyang ba dang / sdig pa sbyang ba dang / khrus gsol dri ma sbyang ba rnams gal che/ tho brtsegs te khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags drag tu bzlas/ gu gul gyis bdug /de dag gi bar bar du 'gyung po spyi dang / gzhi bdag gtor ma yang mang du btang / bar chad bsrung ba dang mthun rkyen sgrub par gsol ba btab/ de dag ni dkyil 'khor gzhan gang yang rung ba la bsnyen pa grangs bsnyen tsam song na/ bdag nyid kho nas byas kyang rung la/ ma song na sbyang ba gsum po de bsnyen song dam tshig dang ldan pa gzhan gyis byed dgos so/ /zhag shas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang yig brgya mang du bzla/ a mo gha badz+ra kyis mdzad pa'i lha bcu bdun mas sgrub thabs dang / la li ti'i gzhung chung du grags pa'i ro langs brgyad bskor gyi rgya g.yi de'i lugs ltar na/ khro bo wu'i bsrung 'khor yang zhag shas sgom pa yang dgos pas bsnyen pa gzhan rnams dang mthun pas legs kyang / deng sang lags len la mi mdzad cing mi dgos so/ /bsnyen pa'i sngon 'gro'i chos de rnams dkyil 'khor 'di'i bsnyen pa thog ma'ang nges —106—

par gal che/ bsnyen pa skyar ma la mtha' dag la dgos pa'i nges pa med pas/rig pas ji ltar 'os pa dag bya'o/ /'di mchog sgrub yin pas kha blta phyogs gtso mi che yang / bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len gyi rgyun la/ rang gi gdong lho phyogs su lta ba kho na mdzad cing / bris sku dang mchod bshams phyogs su gang bde ba la bltas pas chog kyang / sgrub pa po rang nyid la phyogs pa gtso che/bsnyen pa'i gtor ma ni gsum ste/ yi dam gyi gtor ma dang / phyogs skyong bcu dang / gzhin rje chos kyi rgyal po rnams so/ /gsum gar yang zlum po dmar gtor du bya ste/ mchod pa bshams tshul sogs spyi dang mthun/ de rjes bsnyen mtshams dam por sdoms/ thun du bcad nas bsgom dgos pa la/ thun dang po la sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / gnas yo byin rlabs re bya ste/ thun phyi ma rnams la sngar yod gsal 'debs pa'i tshul ma gtogs/ gsar du bskyed chog mi dgos pa'i lugs kyang yod mod/ gsal snang la brtan pa ma thob pa dang / thun mtshams su ngag smra ba sogs la de mi legs pas/ mngon rtogs thun re bzhin bskyed/ thun re bzhin bsdu ba yin pa las/ skyabs sems dang yig brgya dang rigs lnga'i sdom bzung rnams bzhag kyang chog ste/ de dag gcig tu gsal bar ma gsungs pa dang / de rnams bdun rnam dag dang tshad med bzhir 'dus pa'i phyir zhes bla mas gsungs/ so so'i ngag 'don dang dmigs pa rnams ma chad par shar gyis btang la/ bzlas pa'i sngon du lha'i rnam pa gsal ba dang / dkyil 'khor brtan pa gcig bskyed/dmigs pa rgyas pa ni rgya ston gyi yi ge dang / shog khra dpe'u ris byas pa de ka rwa —107—

ba'i man ngag thun mong ma yin par snang ste/ rwa los mdzad par grags pa'i 'grel pa gsum gyi dgongs pa yang de kar gda'/ kho bo'i bla ma bla chen rnams kyang de ltar bzhed/ pha mes bla ma rnams ni rwa nub pa'i rjes su 'brang ste/sngags 'khor bsdus pa 'di ga kho na mdzad/ rwa shes rgyal gyis bsgrigs pa'i rwa pod du grags pa yang gser pod kyi dpe rnams nyams pas gser 'dra'i po ti brtsams so zhes lo rgyus cung zad dang bcas pa gsung gin gda'/ 'di pa'i lugs la mngon rtogs rim pa lnga dang / dkyil chog yid bzhin gter mdzod dang rtog bdun gyi rkang 'grel dug bcos skor dang bcas pa rnams yi ge snga ma stor ba'i yig tshab tsam yin par bzhed/ 'on kyang man ngag dang gsung sgros skyon med yin du drang gsungs/ bdag de gnyis las gcig kho na'i phyogs mi 'dzin yang / 'di ltar nyams len khyer bde ba bsdus pa'i lugs ltar na/ rang gi snying gar 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' zhi ba/ de'i thugs kar rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'ang rtse dgu pa rwa gdengs pa/ de'i lte ba khong stong du gnas pa la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūX nag po me 'bar ba gcig bsgom/ mtha' skor du sngags phreng rnams kha dog nag po me lte dmar po 'bar ba/ de'i phyi rol la 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba/ so so'i bzlas pa ni ci nus bzlas pa'i skabs/ sa bon ni sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las me lce 'ur gyi 'bar/ rdo rje'i rwa gseb nas thon/ 'jam dpal gyi sku'i cha thams cad nas 'phros/ rtsa zhal nas me lce myug myug byung / me gseb nas sngags kyi yi ge me 'bar ba dpag tu med pa byung / rtsa zhal gyi me lce'i rtse nas sngags kyi yi ge du ma lta bu dpag tu med pa —108—

'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs rnams sngags 'phreng gi rnam par bsdus/ rtsa zhal sogs sngar gyi lam nas zhugs te sngar gyi lam nas thim pas/ me lce 'bar ba dang / 'od zer gyi rkang mthil yan chad gang / lus sems thams cad bde bas khyab par bsam/ de nyid yang yang bsgom/ 'di ni rgyud kyi rgyal po rtog pa bdun pa las/ de ltar rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po ma he'i gdong can de bdag nyid yin par bsgoms nas/ shin tu mnyam par bzhag pas dpa' bo gnas la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ phyi nas sngags bzlas par bya ste/ bzlas pa'i dus su rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du rang gi sngags kyi rnam pa bsam te 'bar ba dang phyi nas ma yengs pa'i yid kyis bzlas pa bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang yang mthun/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dang mkha' dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bzla grogs mdzad pa ni spyi dang 'dra/ sngags kyi bzlas tshul ni/thun re re la rim can du/ bzlas pa'i go rim dang / bsnyen pa la 'jug pa'i go rim mo/ /dang po ni/ dang por rtsa sngags/ bar du snying po/ mthar nye snying ngo / /gang gtso bor bzla ba'i mang nyung gi khyad par ma gtogs/ thun gcig la go rim 'di kho nar nges so/ /man ngag bsdus pa 'di'i lugs la/ /rtsa sngags bzla ba'i skabs huX la rtsa sngags kho nas bskor/ snying po bzla ba'i skabs de zhu nas snying por gyur pa sogs/ nye snying la yang rigs 'gres/ gnyis pa bsnyen pa ni dang por/ nye snying la bar du snying po la mthar rtsa sngags la byed/ grangs tshad ni/—109—

sngags btus pa'i rtog pa'i skabs su gsungs pa rnams sngon gyi gang zag la dgongs pa yin la/ da ltar ni spyi dang mthun par snying po/ nye snying gnyis la 'bru 'bum dang / rtsa sngags la bzhi 'bum bzlas pa'i bsnyen pa chung ngu song ste/dkyil 'khor bri ba dang/ dbang bskur ba dang / sbyin sreg dang / rab tu gnas pa dang / gtor ma la sogs pa'i las tshogs ci rigs pa sgrub pa la dbang ngo /gsum po gang rung re la bye bsnyen song na/ so so'i bsnyen pa chen po zhes bya ste/ bsnyen pa chung ngus gsum ga dang / gang rung gcig gis bsnyen pa chen po song bas/ las mtha' dag sgrub pa la dbang zhing / gsum ga la bsnyen pa chen po song na ni/ las thogs pa med pa 'grub pa zhes bya'o/ /dngos grub kyi don du ni tshad med do/ /zhes gsungs yang / lha'i gsal snang la brtan pa thob na ni bzlas pa nyung yang dngos grub 'grub la/ de ma thob na bzlas pa bye ba phrag brgya'i kyang dngos grub mngon du 'gyur pa ma yin no/ /de bas na dngos grub kyi don du bsam gtan bya/ las tshogs kyi don du sngags bzlas bya ba yang phyogs gcig nas don la gnas so/ /grangs kyi bsnyen pa gang yang rung ba sngon du song nas/ kha bskong gi skabs su/ mkha' dbyings thams cad yongs su gang ba'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ khams gsum sngags kyi sgrar shes pa'i bzlas pa bya'o/ /gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ thun thams cad kyi tha mar gcig kho na 'bul na/nam phyed kyi dus sam/ srod kyi mthar 'bul/ lan gnyis 'bul na/ thun thog —110—

mtha' gnyis la bya/ thun thams cad la 'grub na shin tu legs/ thun grangs ni ji ltar 'dod pa byas kyang chog pa'i skabs yod de lag len gsum dang bzhi gtso che'o/ kha zas byin rlabs sogs ma chad pa dang/ thun mtshams thams cad du tha mal du ma song bar so so'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa gal che'o/ /'phreng ba byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ mngon rtogs dkyus ma rnams na'ang gsal mod kyi/ nyin re bzhin dang thun re bzhin du byin rlabs bsdus pa ni/'od dpag med kyi ngo bo hruX yig dmar po 'phred du bsgrags pa las byung ba'i mi mgo khrag 'dzag pa'i do shal du mos/ hṝXspyi sogs lan bdun tsam bzlas te/de tsam gyi chog /rgyas pa ni hiXlas byung ba'i 'od dpag med dam/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed zhal gsum phyag drug pa gang rung du bskyed/ skye mched dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ dbang bkur mchod bstod/ zhu ba las mgo 'phreng du gyur par mos la/ gang gtso bor bzlas pa'i sngags de brgya rtsa bzla/sen mo lcags kyu lta bu'i lha'i thugs ka nas 'dren par bsam/ 'di ni sngags so so'i bsnyen pa 'phro mtshams sogs la lan re re bya'o/ /'di rnams kyi gnad phran bu than thun da dung zhal las shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang ma ṇi pa sogs don du gnyer ba mang pos snga mo nas bskul ba dang / khyad par sa skyong chos bzhin pa nam mkha'i tshe dbang phun tshogs kyis bkas bskul nas tā ra nā thas 'phral du smras pa'o// // maṅga laX//

༄༅/ /bsnyen pa byed tshul bzhugs/na mo gu sa lar byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba yin pas/ bla ma la gsol ba thob/dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam yin pa'i lha sgoms sngags bzlas la 'bungs/gnas lugs spros bral yin pas/ 'dzin med lhug par zhog /'khor ba sdug bsngal yin pas/ gang la'ang sred pa sbong / 'gro drug pha ma yin pas/ byams dang snying rje sgoms/ bsnyen pa'i skabs 'dir snying gar sngags 'khor chen mo zhig bsgom par bshad cing / yig rnying logs pa zhig kyang yod mod kyi/dmigs pa gsal thebs pa dka' bas da lta lag len du mi mdzad/ gzhan yang dmigs pa 'dra min du ma 'dug ste/ dkyus kyi lag len la 'debs rgyu/snying gar 'jam dpal/ de'i thugs kar rdo rje rtse lnga pa gsal thebs na 'di rang sgom/ mi gsal na snying kha'i 'jam dpal zhi ba rdo rjer bsgom/ gang ltar yang rdo rje'i lte bar nyi gdan la huX/ de'i mtha' skor du bzlas pa gang byed kyi sngags 'phreng gi bskor ba ste/ de'i yig 'bru rnams mgo gyen bltas kha nang bstan mdun nas g.yas skor du 'god pas mdog sngon po yin/ de las 'od zer 'phros lus gang / ba sbu'i khung bu nas song / snang ba thams cad khyab/'phags pa rnams mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus nas snying kha'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ zhal dgu khar nas sngags bzlas shing / khams gsum snod bcud thams cad las sngags kyi sgra 'byung ba tsam —112—

bsgom/ de ltar na rang nyid yi dam gyi skur gsal ba tsam la sems gtad nas/sngags nyer gcig sogs brgya cam re bzlas/ de nas snying kha'i sngags 'khor la klog pa'i tshul gyi de tsam re bzlas/ de las 'od zer spro bsdus la de tsam re bzlas/ de rjes zhal dgu dang snang srid thams cad las rang sgra byung bar bsam nas bzla/ hruXdhi lta bu dper mtshon na/ sngags 'phreng skor gcig la dmigs pa bzhi po de tshar re tsam 'gro bar byed/ des gzhan gnyis la'ang mtshon/ bye bsnyen song nas nyer sgrub byed na/ sngar gyi 'phro la byas kyang rung / bar de mtshams bcad song nas/ slar yang nyer sgrub la zhugs kyang chog /de khyad par med pa lags/ zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /thar pa ru dbu mdzad blo bzang pas lo mtshams byas dus rtag brtan nas gnang ba yin lags/༈ yang 'jigs mdzad kyi bsreg blugs bsdus pa'i mjug tu byung ba ni 'di ltar/ snga dro'i thun pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ yig brgya nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam byed/ thun gzhan 'tshol/ de tshe tshar gsum res chog /bzlas pa'i skabs rang gi bzlas pas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nam mkha' khengs pas bzla rogs mdzad par mos/ ya mun+ta ka la 'bum phrag bdun/ hiXsgyi 'bum phrag bcu bzla dgos/ ya ma ra dza la bzla na 'bum phrag gsum/ thun mtshams su rang phyag gnyis pa gtso bo'i thugs ka nas spros par bsam/ gtor chog srod thun kho na la byas pas chog /rmi lam bzang bzang 'dra ba la dga' ba yang mi bya/ 'tshub pa byung na bla ma'i gsol 'debs dang / sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur shes pa la nan chags bya/ bkra shis// //—113—

rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs/rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra bhe ra ba tan tra kro dha rā dza na ma/ bod skad du/dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed khros pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhe bya ba/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po khro bo'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi/ /sgrub pa yang dag rab bshad de/—/des ni lha rnams thams cad la/ /drag shul che shing 'jigs par byed/ /de la thog mar sngags pas yid du 'ong bya'o /ga/nas gang yang rung bar gnas la/ dgos pa thams cad bsgrub par de la gnas bsrung ba ni/ dur khrod dam/ chu klung gi 'gram mam/ shing gnig gam/ mtshan ma gcig pa'am/ gzhi mdo'am/ ri'i rtse mo'am/ khang stong ngam / ma mo'i khyim mam/ lha'i khang pa'am/ 'thab mo'i gnas sam/ grong khyer ram/ nags khrod dam/ grong bar la sogs pa'i gnas sngags pa gnas te/'jigs byed chen po'i rgyud 'dir dbang bskur ba'i rnal 'byor bas/ dbang dang / dgug pa dang / bsad pa dang / bskrad pa dang / dbye ba dang / rengs pa dang / ral gri dang / mig sman dang / sa 'og dang / ri lu dang / ro dang / bca kyis len pa dang / nor dang / 'gyung po dang / ro langs dang / sha za dang /gnod sbyin dang / gnod spyin mo dang / klu la sogs pa cho ga 'dis bsgrub par —114—

bya'o/ /de la cho ga ni/ dang por re zhig sngags pa'i mi ro bsregs pa'i thal chen gyis lus byugs te/ mtshan phyed na gcer bu skra grol bar byas la/ ma he'i gdong can gyi rnal 'byor gyi kun tu spyod pas dur khrod la sogs par dkyil 'khore bri ste/ gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis rnam par brgyan/ /dril bu dar gyi 'phan la sogs/ /me tog 'phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /grwa rnams dag ni thams cad dang / /sgo khyud kyi ni thigs rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen gyis spras pa'i/ /zla ba phyed pa'ang de bzhin no/ /de dbus 'khor lo bri ba ni/ /re mig dgu pa tshom bu'o/ /sgo gcig pa ni dbye bar bya/ /lhag ma yongs su bcad par bya/ /de dbus mi ro bri bar bya/ shar du mgo bo/ lhor lag pa/ nub tu rgyu ma/ byang du rkang pa/ shar gyi grwar thod pa/ lhor thod tshal/ nub tu dur khrod kyi ras/ byang du skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa'o/ /'di dag ni 'khor lo'i dbus su mtshan ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nas 'khor lo'i phyi rol gyi phyag rgya rnams ni/ shar phyogs kyi snam bu dag la/ gri gug dang / mtshon rtse gcig pa dang /gshun shing dang/ chu gri dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / lcags kyu la sogs pa bri'o/ lho phyogs kyi snam bu la/ sta re dang / mda' dang / kha ṭaX ga dang / dbyug to dang / 'khor lo dang / rdo rje zhugs pa la sogs pa bri'o/ /nub kyi snam bu la/rdo rje dang / rnge'u chung dang / phub dang / gzhu dang / dril bu dang / rlung gi ras la sogs pa bri'o/ /byang gi snam bu la/ sdigs 'dzub dang / 'phan rtse gsum pa dang / glang po che'i lpags pa dang / rdo rje tho ba dang / mdung dang / me thab la sogs pa bri'o/ /sgo bzhi dang grwa bzhir ro langs chen po bri'o/ /gal te mchog —115—

gi dngos grub 'dod na/ mar khu chen po'i mar me 'bul/ mi dang / bong bu dang /rnga mong dang / khyi dang / wa dang / ma he dang / glang po dang / ba glang dang lug dang /ri dwags dang / phag la sogs pa'i sha rnams dbul bar bya'o/ /g.yin yang bya rgod dang / 'ug pa dang / bya rog dang / khra dang / chu skyar dang / thing ril dang / ba khyed dang / rma bya dang / ri skeg dang / bya chen po la sogs pa'i sha rnams dbul bar bya'o/ khren tu mnyam par ba theg pas/ bza' ba dang / ston mo dang / sbyin sreg dang / gtor ma'i las bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi grwa thams cad du khrag gi chag chag bya'o/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed ma he'i gdong gi sbyor ba la gnas pas lha bgos thams cad dbul bar bya'o/ /phyi nas sngags pa sngon du bsnyen pa byas pas bdag dang shin tu mthun pa bzhi'am/bdag gcig pu rnam par snang mdzad kyis lus byugs gcer bur phud skra sil la/ mtshan phyed na cang te'u dkrol pas/ ha ha zhes bya zhing shin tu mnyam par bzhag ste/ rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor du dngos grub 'dod pas 'jug par bya'o/ /rab tu zhus pa'i chang la sogs pa btung ba dang / bza' ba'i ro rnams dbul bar bya'o/ /phyi nas de'i dbus su 'dod pa'i dngos grub dmigs te/de'i steng du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byedang chen po ma he'i gdong can bsam par bya'o/ /de'i mdun du g.yas bskum du gnas la nga rgyal dang bcas pas sems rtse gcig tu shin tu mnyam par bzhag pas yi ge bcu pa'i sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /de nas 'jigs pa chen po byung na/ de la sngags pas 'jigs par mi bya —116—

ste/ gal te 'jigs par gyur na de la bgegs chen po'i bar chad 'byung ngo / /bar chad byung na dngos grub mi 'grub pa'o/ /de'i phyir sngags pas 'jigs par mi bya ste/ de la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po dgyes so/ /dgyes nas khyod la mchog ci zhig spyin zhes gsungs pa dang / de la rig 'dzin gyis smras pa/ral gri dang / sa 'og dang / mig sman dang / ro dang / bcud kyis len pa'am/gzhan yang yid la 'dod pa'i dngos grub bdag la nges par stsol cig ces brjod na/ de la the tshom med par stsol lo/ /gal te sngags pas mchog ma grub kyang / de yis phra mo'i las thams cad nges par 'grub bo/ /'di ni 'jam dpal mchog rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i 'khor lo'i sbyor ba'i rgyud las dkyil 'khor bstan pa ste/ rtog pa dang po'o/ /de nas las kun gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i dngos grub thams cad rab tu sbyin pa'i cho ga bshad de/ de la rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ bsad pa dang / bskrad pa la sogs pa sngags pa khros pas dpal jo/ rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sbyor ba la gnas pas bya ste/ dang por re zhig sngags pas bsad par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di la ni sngags dang lha'i sbyor pa dang ldan pas/ thog mar ni de bya ste/de'i sbyor ba gtso bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de la 'di yi las ni ji ltar bsad par 'dod pas sngags pas dur khrod kyi ras la/ dug dang / khrag dang / lan tshwa dang / ske tshe dang / nim pa dang / dha dha du ra'i dang khu ba yis rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i 'khor lo le tshe bcu drug pa dang / bya rog chen po'i sgro rtsa'i snyu gu'am/ mi'i rus pa'i snyu gus/ gcer bu skra —117—

bshig pa/ kha lhor bltas te ma he'i gdong can gyi sbyor bas bri bar bya'o/ /me gnyis kyi dbus su sgrub bya'i ming dang bcas par bzhag la/ de yi ge bcu pas bskor/ hūX brgyad kyang bri/ thur du phaṭa brgyad bri/ bdag nyid tsha ba'i mar gyis lus byug la/ thod pa gnyis kyi bar du 'khor lo bcug la/ skyed bu gsum gyi steng du bzhag la/ dur khrod kyi mgal bas me rab tu sbar te/ rkang pa g.yon pas mnan la/ yi ge bcu pa'i sngags bzlas so/ /de yis skad cig gis the tshom med par 'chi'o/ /g.yin yang rims kyis thebs par 'dod na/ 'khor lo de nyid mi'i nya phyis gnyis kyi dbus su legs par bzhag la/ me dur gyi 'og tu bcug na rims nad kyis 'dzin to/ /de le tshe bcu drug pa'i 'khor lo rab tu sbyor ba gzhan gsungs de/ 'on kyang 'di yi khyad par ni/ yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i sngags dang ldan pa/ yi ge bcu pa'i sngags bsgrub bya'i ming dang bcas pa lhan cig tu yi ge dang sngags spel ba dgod do/ /sngon du gsungs pa'i rdzas dang lhan cig tu bya rog gis zas btogs pa'i lhag ma mi gtsang ba dang / rnam par snang mdzad dang lhan cig dur khrod kyi ras la byugs te/ de la sngon du gsungs pa'i tshogs 'khor lo bris te/ dur khrod du sbas na 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ khreng gcig gi drung sbas na skrod par 'gyur ro/ /mtshan ma gcig par sbas na dbye bar 'gyur ro/ /chu'i nang du sbas na rengs par 'gyur ro/ khyim du bzhag na zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /phyung nas legs par bkrus nas grol bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang rab tu sbyor ba gsungs pa/ gnin rje'i 'khor lo sngon gyi cho gas dur khrod kyi —118—

ras la bris te/ dur khrod dam/ lam bzhi mdo dang / shing gcig dang / grog mkhar dang / chu 'gram dang / mtshan ma gcig pa dang/ rgyal po'i sgo khang dang /rnam par snang mdzad dang / rdo rje'i chu dang / dur khrod kyi sol bar bsgrub bya'i gzugs brnyan sor brgyad pa byas la/ de'i snying gar sngags bcug ste/ ma'i rus pa'i phur bu gnas lnga ru gdab par bya'o/ /tshigs thams cad la tsher ma rnon pos dgang bar bya'o/ /de thod pa gnyis kyi dbus su bcug ste/ der grog mkhar dang gnas bdun gyi yis gshin rje'i gzugs gru gang tsam zhal gtsigs pa/ gsus pa che ba/ zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ phyag na ral gri dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ gcer bu skra sil bur byas pa/ de'i snying gar thod pa gnyis bcug ste/ nyi ma phyed dam nam phyed nam dur khrod dam/ ro bsregs pa'i sar sba ste/ shin tu ring bar brkos te mgo lhor bstan la/ kha thur du sbub la sba'o/ /khyim du 'ongs/ pa dang / shin tu nga rgyal dang ldan pas ma he gdong gi sbyor bas bsgrub bya'i ming dang bcas pa'i yi ge bcu pa'i sngags bzlas par byas na nyi ma gsum gyis 'chi'o/ /byung nas dkrus na thar par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rengs pa'i rab tu sbyor bar gsungs te/ te'u lo bi lpags pa dug la sogs pa'i rdzas kyis yi ge bcu pa'i sngags bris la/ lpags pa de bsgrub bya'i rkang rjes kyi rdul dang / gcin btang ba'i shul gyi sas bkang la/ bsgrub bya de'i skras bcing bar bya'o/ /phyi nas bong bu'i gcin dang / rnam par snang mdzad dang lhan cig tu brdzis la/ blug ma yang dag par dgang bar bya ste/ de ru 'khor lo bcug la ro bsregs pa'i me la bzhag ste/ rkang pa g.yon pas mnan la/—119—

gshin rje'i sbyor bas yi ge bcu pa'i sngags bzlas pa byas na zhag gcig gis rengs par byed do/ /'di ni phyis mi grub pa'i rab tu sbyor ba'o/ /sngags pa shin tu khros pas rab tu sbyor ba bya'o/ /gas yang dbye ba'i rab tu sbyor ba ni/ gshin rje 'khor lo sngon gyi cho gas bris la/ gnas bdun gyi sas ma he dang rta byas la/ de gnyis gcig gi steng du gcig bzhag la/ de gnyis kyi snying gar 'khor lo bcug ste/ nim pa'i shing drung du sba'o/ /'khor lo yang ma he dang rta'i khrag gis bris te/ shin tu mnyam par bzhag pas zhag gsum gyis 'byed par byed do/ /de nas sngags pas bskrad par 'dod na/ gnas bdun gyis sa rnga mo'i gzugs byas la/ de yi rgyab tu yi ge yaX yongs su gyur pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla ba phyed pa'i rnam pa dmigs te/ de'i steng du bsgrub bya dmigs la/ de yi rgyab tu gshin rje'i gzugs lag pas dbyug pa 'dzin pa dmigs la/ de'i dbyug pas brdeg cing kha lhor bltas nas 'khrid par rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /'khor lo de de'i snying khar gong du gsungs pa'i cho gas/ bsgrub bya'i ming dang spel ba yang dag par bris la bcug na zhag bdun gyis the tshom med par skrod par 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan yang rab tu sbyor ba gsungs pa/ nyi ma'i tshes la/ gtum po'i lus tsha ba'i mar khus byugs la/ nim pa'i shing la 'dzegs nas der bzhag la/ de'i lus kyi mar khu nya phyis kyi bzhur la der gnas pa bzung ngo / /mar khu de blangs nas lha chen po'i rgyal mtshan sngon po'i ras sam/ de ma rnyed na dkar po blangs la/ bsreg pa'i bar gyi du ba'i dreg pa de dang mar khu de gcig —120—

tu byas la/ bskrad par 'dod pa de'i lham la de bsku/ de'i lag pa dang rkang pa gnyis la yang byugs na/ skad cig gis skrod do/ /de nas gzhan yang rab tu sbyor ba gsungs pa ni/ dur khrod kyi ras sam/ gro ga'i lo ma la rlung gi dkyil 'khor dur khrod kyi gsol ba dang bya rog gi khrag dang bya rog gi rkang gi stu gus bri bar bya ste/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bsgrub bya'i ming dang spel la/gtor ma za ba'i mgrin par bcings la/ bya rog bzung nas ma he'i gdong gi sbyor bas gnas pas kha ltor bltas la btang ste/ de skad cig gis bya rog bzhin sa kun tu skor ro/ /gzhan yang bskrad pa ni/ tsha ba'i mar khus bskus la/ nim pa'i shing las gtor ma za ba'i tshad rkyang la/ tshad de ba'i nags kyi shing gi mes bsregs pa'i thal ba de blangs la/ gang gi mgor blugs pa de bskrod par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang dbye ba'i rab tu sbyor ba ni/ bya rog dang / 'ug pa'i gshog pa dang/ bram ze dang / gtum po'i skra gcig tu byas la/ da ru ra'i shing la me rab tu sbar te/ du ba med pa'i mes bsregs te/ de'i thal ba blangs la yi ge bcu pa'i sngags bzlas nas/ bud med dang skyes pa gnyis kyi bar du thal ba bzhag na/ de skad cig gis dbye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas dur khrod kyi ras blangs de dug la sogs pa'i rdzas kyi sbags pa'i bar du bcug la/ bsgrub bya'i ming bris la sre mo'i skru dang sbrul gyi lpags pa blangs te bsres nas sdong bu byas te/ gang dang gang gi khyim du sbar ba de phan tshun 'thab par 'gyur ro/ /de nas gsang bar 'dod pas ni/ bshang gci las gzugs brnyan byas la/ de yi steng du dug gi phye mas rab dzi121—

tu byugs la/ dur khrod kyi me la gcer bu skra bshig pa byas la kha ltor bltas te/ma he'i gdong gi sbyor bas nam phyed na de btubs la dur khrod kyi me la bsreg go /gang gi ming dang bcas par byas na de skad cig gi mchi'o/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po nyid kyis rab tu sbyor ba 'di gsungs so/ /de nas bskrad par 'dod pas rgyal mtshan gyi ras la le tshe bcu drug pa'i 'khor lo/ sngon du gsungs pa'i rdzas dang dur khrod kyi sol bas gang gis ming dang bcas pa bris te/ nim pa'i shing la rgyal mtshan bzhag na de skrod par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rengs par 'dod pa'i gzhin rje'i 'khor lo g.yam pa8sprum ras la/ba bla dang yung bas gong gi ming dang bcas pa legs par bris nas bzhag na de rengs par 'gyur ro/ /gal te sngags pas dbang du bya bar 'dod na/ grog mkhar gyis dang / gur gum dang / 'gi haX dang lhan cig tu byas te/ bsgrub bya pho'am/ gal te mo'i gzugs brnyan tshad gsor bcu drug pa byas la/ 'gi haX dang srin lag gis/ khrag gis gro ga la gshin rje'i 'khor lo bris te/ de'i snying gar bcug nas rang gi khyim du bzhag la/ me tog dmar po dus gsum du dbul ba dang / kha nub tu bltas la yi ge bcu pa'i sngags bzlas pa byas na/zhag bdun gyi brgya byin yang dbang du 'gyur ba phra mo'i mi lta ci smos/ de nas yang dgug par 'dod na/ de la thod pa la 'khor lo 'gi haX dang srin lag gi khrag gis bris te/ seng ldeng gi me la bsre zhing gang la bya ba'i ming dang bcas par bzlas na/ de skad cig gis rlud gi shugs bzhin 'gug par 'gyur ro/ /de nas sngags pas/ smyo bar 'dod na/ da ru ra'i 'bras bu blangs la sha chen dang —122—

lhan cig tu/ shing srin gyi zos pa'i phye ma dang bsres nas bza' ba dang bsar ba la sbyin no/ /sngags kyang bzlas par bya ste/ de skad cig gis smyo bar 'gyur zhing zhag bdun gyis 'chi'o/ /de nas gzhan yang rab sbyor ba gsungs pa gnyen rje'i sngags dur khrod kyi ras la dul la sogs pa'i rdzas kyis bris te mar me chen po dang / rnam par snang mdzad kyis gzugs brnyan byas la/ de'i snying gar 'khor lo bcug nas pha'i nags su song la/ ro bsregs pa'i me la mtshon rnon pos btubs nas/ rnam par gtsigs pa'i sbyor bas rnal 'byor pas gnas la/rnam par snang mdzad kyis lus byugs te/ kha ltor bltas nas bsregs na de'i mod la 'chi'o/ /de nas bral ba'i cho ga 'byung ba ni/ bya rog dang lug pa'i rus pa blangs la/ de gnyis la lcags kyu'i tsher mas bsgrub bya'i ming dang lhan cig tu/ yi ge bcu sdi'i sngags bris la sa/cig pu gnas su gnas te/ gang gi ming dang bcas par bzlas shing / de gcig la gcig blud na 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /gshin rje / 'khor lo gro ga'i 'dab ma la/ bud med dang skyes pa'i ming bris nas sbal pa'i gsus par bcug la/ gang gis ming dang bcas pa them pa'i 'og tu sbas na/ de'i yan lag mtshon gyis/ gtub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bu mo rengs pa'i rab tu sbyor ba ni gshin rje'i sngags dur khrod kyi ras la dug la sogs pas bris te/ ro bsregs pa'i sol bas gzugs brnyan mtho gang tsam gyi tshad kha gtsigs par byas te/ de'i snying gar 'khor lo bcug nas rkang pa g.yon pas mnan la/ ma he'i gdong gi sbyor bas che ge mo bu mo rengs par gyur cig /ces yi ge bcu pa'i sngags bzlas na rengs par 'gyur ro/ /'di'i sgro123—

las rnams ni gzhan su la yang smra bar mi bya'o/ /gal te sngags pa rmongs pa'i bdag nyid kyis phyed na dmyal bar nges par lhung ngo / /dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa byed pa dang / bla ma la brnyas pa dang / dam tshig dang bral ba dang /sngags dang rgyud la 'phya bar byed pa dang / sems can la 'tshe ba 'di rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ sngags pas snying rjes gdung ba'i sems kyis gnod pas sbyor ba rab tu bya'o/ /gal te gzhan la byas na dam tshig nyams nas tshab chen por 'gro ba'o/ /rgyud gzhan las kyang gsungs pa/ slob dpon la ni snom byed dang / /theg pa chen po skur ba dang / /sngags rgyud rab sbyor ye shes la/ /'phya bar byed pa'i mi gang ni/ /de ni 'bad pas gsad par bya/ /yang na gnas nas g.yo bar bya/ /rnal 'byor snying rje med pa yis/ /g.yin la rung rung byas na ni/ de la de bzhin las de ni/ /phyir sgrog par ni 'gyung bar 'gyur/ /ci'i phyir sems can mtho ba brtsam phyir/ /rnal 'byor pa ni 'di la'o/ /'di ni 'jam dpal mchog rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyud las las thams cad grub pa'i rtog pa ste gnyis pa'o/ /de nas ji lta ba'i cho gas sngags btu ba rab tu gsungs te/ rab tu gtsang ba'i gnas su/ /sngags pa'i gnas la sngags btu bar bya'o/ /ji ltar drug pa'i dang po dang / /lnga pa la yang lnga pa dang / /drug pa yi ni gnyis pa la/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pa dang ldan pa/ /gnyis pa yi ni gsum pa la/ /yang ni dbyangs yig gnyis pa ldan/ /drug pa yi yang dang po dang / /yang ni drug pa'i dang po —124—

sbyin/ /dbyangs yig bcu gsum dang ldan pa/ /lnga pa yi yang lnga pa la/ /dbyangs yig bcu gcig dang ldan pa/ /drug pa yi yang dang po dang / /yang ni drug pa'i dang po sbyin/ /lnga pa yi yang lnga pa la/ /bcu dang gcig gis mnan ldan pa/ /bzhi pa yi ni gsum pa la/ /bcu gsum pa yi mnyam mnan pa/ /drug pa yi yang gnyis pa la/ /dbyangs yig lnga pa dang ldan pa/ /gsum pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /rlud gi sa bon de nas sbyin/ /dbyangs yig bcu gsum yang dag ldan/ /bzhi pa yi ni gsum pa dang / /de ni rlung gis sa bon spyin/ /drug pa yi ni dang po dang / /bzhi pa yi ni gsum pa dang / /de nas rlung gi sa bon no/ /dbyangs yig bcu gsum pa dang ldan/ /bzhi pa yi ni lnga pa la/ /dbyangs yig gsum pa dang ldan pa/ /de nas me yis sa bon byin/ /rlung gi sa bon de bzhin no/ /de nas yi ge tha ma sbyin/ /dbyangs yig bcu gcig pa dang ldan/ /rlud gi sa bon de bzhin mchog /drug pa yi ni dang po dang / /de nas yi ge tha ma spyin/ /dbyangs yig bcu gcig pa dang ldan/ /yang ni rlung gi sa bon dang/ /gnyis pa yi ni dang po dang / /gnyis pa'i gnyis pa dang ldan pa/ /bzhi pa yi ni lnga pa las/ /dbyangs yig gsum pa dang ldan pa/ /de nas me yi sa bon dang / /dbyangs yig gnyis par ldan pa dang / /lnga pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /de nas rlung gis sa bon sgyin/ /thog mar rnam par snang mdzad byin/ /mchog gi dbang phyug dang sbyar ba/ /steng du sa bon stong pas brgyan/ /lnga pa yi ni gnyis pa dang / /gsum pa yi ni dang po ni/ /mkhas pas gnyis su brjod par bya/ /'di ni dpal ldan 'jam pa'i mchog/'jigs byed chen po'i rgyud 'khor lo/ /ma he'i gdong can rtsa sngags te/ /'bum —125—

bzlas pas ni las kun byed/ /'di ni sngags kyi rgyal po ste/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /bdun pa yi ni bzhi pa la/ dbyangs yig bzhi pa dang ldan pa/'og tu me yis sa bon spyin/ /de nas mnga' bdag bcu drug mtha'/ /bdun pa yi ni gnyis pa la/ /dbyangs yig bzhi pa dang ldan pa/ /gsum pa yi ni dang po la/ /me yi sa bon 'og tu gdags/ /mnga' bdag bcu drug mtha' ma ste/ /drug pa yi ni bzhi pa la/ /dbyangs yig gsum pa dang ldan pa'o/ /dang po yi ni dang po la/ /dbyangs yig gsum pa dang ldan te/ /'og tu me yis sa bon sbyin/ /bzhi pa yi ni dang po la/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pa dang ldan pa'o/ /bzhi pa yi ni lnga pa ni/ /mkhas pa yis ni lan gnyis brjod/ /thog mar rnam par snang mdzad sbyin/ /sde tshan bdun gyi sa bon la/ /dbyangs yig drug pa dang ldan pa/ /spyi bo ru ni thig les brgyan/ /lnga pa yi ni gnyis pa dang / /gsum pa yi ni dang po'o/ /'di ni sngags kyi rgyal po ste/ /ma he'i gdong can sbyor ba yis/ /thams cad las ni byed pa'o/ /las kyi sngags su grags pa ste/ /gsum 'bum bzlas nas las kun byed/ /drug pa yi ni dang po dang / /lnga pa yi yang lnga pa la/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pa dang sbyar ba/ /bzhi pa'i lnga pas brten par bya/ /bzhi pa'i dang po 'og tu bzhig /dang po yi ni dang po dang / /thog mar rnam par snang mdzad spyin//sde tshan bdun gyi tha ma la/ /dbyangs yig drug pa dang ldan par/ /dran pa de bzhin mthar sbyin no/ /stong pa'i lha yi mnyam mnan pa/ /lnga pa yi ni gnyis pa dang / /gsum pa yi ni dang po'o/ /'di ni ma sto gdong pa yi/ /snying po'i sngags su rab tu grags/ /yi ge re re 'bum bzlas pas/ /'jig rten gsum gyi las —126—

ni gang / /ci yang rung ba thams cad byed/ /sngags btu ba'i cho ga'i skabs 'dir mchod par bya'o/ /'di ni 'jam dpal mchog dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i rgyud las sngags btu ba'i rtog pa ste gsum pa'o/ /de nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub pa chos thams cad bdag med pa sngon du song bas lha'i dmigs pa yang dag par bshad par bya ste/ dang po rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i sngags brjod par bya'o/ /chos thams cad bdag med pa'i ngo bor byas nas nam mkha'i dkyil du yaX gyi rnam pa las grub pa'i rlud gi dkyil 'khor mdog du ba'i rnam par bsam mo/ /de'i steng du dang po'i dbyangs yig las gyur pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dmigs te/ de'i steng du dhiX'i rnam pa las 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i gzugs su gyur par bya'o/ /de'i snying gar a'i rnam pa las grub pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms te/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / rig pa'i lha mo dang / khro bo la sogs pa shin tu bskul de/ yang 'ongs nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la zhugs par bsam mo/ /de yis 'jam dpal dang de bzhin gshe/gas pa la sogs pa de rnams gcig tu gyur nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du bsam par bya'o/ /'od zer 'bar ba'i rnam pas dpag tshad stong phrag brgyar khyab par bsam par bya'o/ /de'i steng du huX mdog nag po'i 'od zer lnga dang yang dag par ldan par bsam/ hūX de las 'od zer gyi rnam pa 'phros pas sngon du gsungs pa bzhin du yang zhugs te/ yi ge de las rdo rje chen po rnam par gdengs pa kha dog —127—

nag po 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa/ rnam par dmigs par bya ste/ rdo rje de las phra mo'i rnam pa'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / khro bo dang / rig pa'i lha mos nam mkha'i dbus til gyi gong bu ltar gang nyi ma la gnas pa rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas la sogs pa rnams kyis sems can yongs su smin par btul nas byang chub la rab tu bkod de/ de yang de dang lhan cig tu bsdus nas rdo rje'i gzugs brnyan la rab tu zhugs par bsam mo/ /rdo rje'i gzugs brnyan de nyid zhal dgu pa ma he'i gzugs can/ 'jigs pa'i dus kyi me ltar ‘sprubar ba/ rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po khams gsum za bar nus pa/ zhal gtsigs pa ha ha zhes ljags 'gril ba/ rnam par gtsigs pa'i khro gnyer 'jigs pa/ khro gnyer gyi 'gram na smin ma dang spyan 'jigs pa chen po'i dus ltar 'phro ba/ sgra sgrog pa/ mi'i khrag dang / tshil dang / zhag dang / rkang za ba 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la sogs pa la sdigs mdzub byed pa/ brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / khyab 'jug dang / gzhon nu rnams kha sbub tu byas nas zhabs kyi 'og tu mnan pa/ 'jigs su wo ba'i thod pa'i thod byas pa/ thod pa brtsigs pa'i rtse mo 'jigs pa chen po can/ phe zhes thod pa'i 'phyang 'phrul gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs bcu drug pa/gcer bu'i gzugs mtshan ma gyen du 'greng ba/ g.yon brkyang ba/ gsus pa che ba/ skra gyen du brdzes pa/ 'jigs pa chen por byed pa/ phaṭa ces sgra sgrog pa/phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi dang ldan pa/ glang po che'i lpags pa rlon pa 'dzin pa/ dpal —128—

rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po ma he'i gdong can rnam par bsam par bya ste/ de ltar shin tu bsam pa brtan pas byas te/ de kho na nyid kyi sbyor ba la shin tu mnyam par bzhag pas sngags pas rtag tu bsgom par bya ste/ g.yas dang po na rdo rje gri gug gnyis pa na/ mdung rtse gcig pa/ gsum pa na gtun shing / bzhi pa na chu gri dang / lnga pa na rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ drug pa na sta re/ bdun pa na mdung /brgyad pa na mda'/ dgu pa na lcags kyu/ bcu pa na dbyug tho/ bcu gcig pa na kha ṭaX ga /bcu gnyis pa na 'khor lo/ /bcu gsum pa na rdo rje/ bcu bzhi pa na rdo rje tho ba/ bco lnga pa na ral gri/ bcu drug pa na cang te'u 'o/ /g.yon pa'i phyag dang po na thod pa/ gnyis pa na mgo bo/ gsum pa na phub/ bzhi pa na rkang pa/lnga pa na zhags pa/ drug pa na gzhu/ bdun pa na rgyu ma/ brgyad pa na dril bu/dgu pa na lag pa/ bcu pa na dur khrod kyi ras/ bcu gcig pa na skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa/ bcu gnyis pa na me thab/ bcu gsum pa na thod tshal/ bcu bzhi pa na sdigs mdzub/ bco lnga pa na 'phan rtse gsum pa/ bcu drug pa na rlud gis 'phyar ba'i ras/ phyag gnyis kyis glang po che'i lpags pa rlon pa 'dzin pa'o /zhabs g.yas kyi dang pos mi/ gnyis pas ma he/ /gsum pas glang /bzhi pas bong bu/ lnga pas rnga mong / drug pas khyi/ bdun pas lug /brgyad pas lce spyang / zhabs g.yas pas 'di dag mnan pa'o/ /zhabs g.yon pas dang po bya rgod/ gnyis pas bug pa/ gsum pas bya rog /bzhi pas ne tso/ lnga pas khra/drug par khyung chen/ bdun pas re skeg /brgyad pas bzhad/ g.yon pas 'di —129—

dag mnan pa'o/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i zhal ni rab tu gnag pa/ma he'i rnam par shin tu khros pa can/ rwa'i g.yas su zhal gsum pa/ dang po sngon po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa ser po ste/ mnga' bdag gi zhal gsum shin tu khros pa'o/ /rwa'i g.yon par zhal gsum dkar po dang/ dud kha dang /nag po/ rab tu khros pa gtsigs pa'i zhal bsam par bya'o/ /rwa gnyis kyi bar du dbus kyi zhal dmar po rab tu 'jigs pa/ zhal nas khrag 'dzag par bsam par bya'o/ /steng du 'jam dpal gyi zhal cung zad ser ba yid tsam khro ba gzhon nu'i brgyan gyis brgyan pa/ spyi bor ral pa lnga dang ldan pa rnam par bsams te/zhal thams cad spyan gsum par bsgoms te/ 'di ltar bdag nyid rtse gcig tu dmigs so/ /de ltar rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po ma he'i gdong can de bdag nyid yin par bsgoms nas/ shin tu mnyam par bzhag pas dpa' bo'i gnas la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ phyi nas sngags bzlas par bya ste/ bzlas pa'i dus su rang gis snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du rang gis sngags kyis rnam pa bsam te 'bar ba dang / phyi nas ma yengs pa'i yid kyis bzlas pa bya'o/ /'di sbyor la gnas sngags pa yis/ /rtag tu 'jigs med las kun bya/ /dur khrod gnas la bsgom bya zhing / /rtag tu bdud rtsi lnga rnams bza'/ /'di yi sgrub las grub g.yin min/ /gzhan yang mar me che bza' zhing / /mtshan mo rgyu ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /gsum 'bum rtsa ba'i sngags bzlas bya/ /'di zlos pa yi sngags pa yis/ /thams cad las ni byed par gyur/ /'di 'jam dpal mchog rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyud las sgom pa'i rtog pa ste bzhi —130—

pa'o/ /de nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i gsang ba'i bris sku'i mchog rab tu bshad pa/ dpa' bo'i ras sam/ zhing la bkal ba'i ras sam/ me tog can gyi ras sam/ rab tu 'dzag pa'i ras sam/ bu btsas pa'i ras sam/ de ma rnyed na ras gzhan gang yang rung ba blangs la/ 'dir dngos po kun kyis mos pa rnam par rtog pa med pa mi khrog /gtsang ba/ mkhas pa/ gzhudas pa/ rang ba dang ldan pa/ brtse ba can/ srid pa dang bral ba/ 'di ltar yon tan dang ldan pa/shin tu ri mo mkhas pa'i lag par bri bar bya'o/ /gal te dngos grub 'dod pas dpa' bo'i yon sbyin no/ /de la cho ga ni/ gsang ba'i gnas su gnas la shin tu mnyam par bzhag pas bri bar bya ste/ ri mo mkhan dang / sgrub pa pos mthong ba las 'jig rten pa gzhan gyis mi mthong bar bri bar bya ste/ zhabs bcu drug pa/phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi pa/ zhal dgu pa/ gcer bu kha dog nag po/ g.yon brkyang ba/ 'jigs pa chen po yang 'jigs par byed pa'i rnam pa can/ mtshan ma gyen du 'greng ba'i rnam pa can gyi thad ka bri bar bya'o/ /zhal dang po ma he'o/ /rwa'i g.yas su zhal gsum ste/ sngon po dang / dmar po dang / ser po shin tu khros pa bri bar bya'o/ /g.yon du dkar po dang / dud kha dang / nag po'o/ /de gnyis kyi dbus su rab tu dmar ba bri bar bya/ de'i steng du 'jam dpal gyi zhal ser po cung zad khro ba bri bar bya'o/ /phyag g.yas pa na rdo rje gri gug dang / mtshon rtse gcig pa dang / gtun shing dang / chu gri dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / sta re dang/ mdung dang / mda' dang / lcags kyu dang/dbyug to dang / kha ṭāX ga dang/ snyen ra lo dang / rdo rje dang / rdo rje tho ba dang / ral —131—
