gri dang / cang te'u blo/ /phyag g.yon pa thod pa dang/ mgo bo dang / phub dang rkang pa dang / zhags pa dang / gzhu dang / rgyu ma dang / dril bu dang / lag pa dang /dur khrod kyi ras dang / skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa dang / me thab dang /thod tshal dang / sdigs mdzub dang / 'phan rtse gsum pa dang / rlung gis bskyod pa'i ras so/ /phyag gnyis kyis glang po che'i lpags pa rlon pa 'dzin pa bri'o/ /zhabs g.yas pas mi dang / ma he dang / glang dang / bong bu dang / rnga mong dang /khyi dang/ lug dang / ce spyang rnams so/ /zhabs g.yon pas bya rgod dang / lug pa dang / bya rog dang / ne tso dang / khra dang / khyung chen dang / ri skeg dang / bzhad rnams so/ /'di lta bur 'dug pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed r+ṣa po bri bar bya'o/ /de'i phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po yang bri ste/ 'jigs pa chen por byed pa'i gnod spyin dang / srin po dang / zhing skyong dang / ro langs dang ldan pa/ skyes bu mdung rtse btsugs pa'i gzugs der bstan par bya/ n+ya gro ta'i shing gi steng nas skyes bu 'khu/nga ba bstan par bya/ skyes bu bsregs pa yang bri/ mdung gis phug pa yang bri/ sna tshogs pa'i bya rgod dang / bya rog dang / khyi dang / ce spyang ha ha 'byin pa bri/ sgrub pa po rnams kyang bri ste/ bcom ldan 'das la rtse gcig tu lta ba gcer bu skra bshig pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ cang te'u dang / thod pa dang / kha ṭāX ga 'dzin pa/ thod pas spyi bor brgyan pa/ rgod cing dur khrod der 'jug pa bri'o/ /'di ni gsang ba'i bris sku ste/ gnas gcig tu legs par bzhag la/ sha chen gyis spos dbul/ de'i mdun du rus chen gyi 'phreng bas bzlas pa bya/ sngags pas mnyam par bzhag pas dus gsum du 'bad pas bris sku bsrung ngo / /—132—

gzhan yang gang du yang mi bzhag go /gzhan gang gi mdun du yang mi dgram mo/ /ldag pa dang / btung ba dang/ bza' ba dang / ston mo ni sha chen rtag tu mtshan mo bza'o/ /gal te mchog gi dngos grub 'dod na/ dus gsum du rnam par snang mdzad dang / khrag gis spos bris sku'i mdun du dbul lo/ /'di ni 'jam dpal mchog dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyud las bris sku'i cho ga'i rtog pa ste lnga pa'o/ /de nas sbyin sreg gi las kyi cho ga gsungs pa/ ji ltar sngon gyi rim pa ste/dang po re zhig sngags pas pha'i nags su phyin la/ mtshan phyed na sbyin sreg gi las kun bya ste/ gong du gsungs pa'i lha'i sbyor ba la gnas pas las thams cad bya'o/ /de la las ni 'di rnams yin te/ gal te gsad par 'dod na/ der mi'i rus pa dang / rnam par snang mdzad dang / bong bu'i sbangs dang / tsher ma dang / skra dang / sen mo dang / de dag thams cad mar khus sbus la/ ma he'i zhal gyi sbyor bas shin tu mnyam par bzhag la kha lhor bltas te/ ro bsregs pa'i me la gang gi ming dang bcas pa brgya rtsa brgyad bsreg na de zhag bdun gyis 'chi'o/ /yang na phyogs gcig tu gnas la/ me thab grub gsum byas la/ de ru sngon tu gsungs pa'i rdzas kyi gtum po'i me la sbyin bsreg bya'o/ /sbyor ba des ni las de nyid 'grub bo/ /de nas 'bral bar 'dod na/ bya rog dang / lug pa dang / rma bya'i sgro dang / sprul gyi shun pa dang / skra dang / 'bras phub dang / ma he dang / rta'i sha lhan cig tu gang gi ming dang bcas pa dur khrod kyi me la bsregs na de dang 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na dur khrod kyi shing la gtum po'i me rab —133—

tu sbar la khyim du gnas te/ gong gi rdzas de bsregs na rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bu yang nyi ma bdun gyis 'bral lo/ /de nas bskrad par 'dod na/ bya rog gi sha dang / rnga mo'i sbangs dang / lhan cig tu chang dang yang dag par ldan pa/ rlung gis dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dur khrod kyi me rab tu sbar la/ gcer bu skra bshig par bsgyur nas/ kha lhor phyogs su bltas te che ge mo'i ming dang bcas pa lag pa g.yon pa'i spyin bsreg stong byas na skrod pa las gzhan min no/ /de nas rengs par 'dod na/ pa bla dang / yung ba dang / lding ris dang / 'gi haX dang bcas pas dkyil 'kho(ra gru bzhi pa byas la/ kha byang du bltas te/ las kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i sbyor ba dmigs nas/ gang gi ming dang bcas pas spyin sreg byas na nyi ma bdun gyis rengs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas grong bsgrad par 'dod na/ nim pa'i shing la me rab tu sbar la/khyi'i sha dang / sbal pa'i sha dang / rnga mong gi sbangs dang / byi li'i khrag dang /gcig tu sprul te/ gshin rje'i sbyor ba la gnas pas grong gi ming dang bcas par yi ge'i sngags kyis rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su sbyin sreg stong phrag bcu byas na grong skrod par 'gyur ro/ /las de rnams ni shin tu mnyam par bzhag pas bya ba'am/ yang na sngags pa nyid kyis kyang las de dag mi bya/gzhan su la yang mi bstan to/ /de nas bu mo rengs par 'dod na/ tsher ma dang / dug dang / ske tshe dang bcas par rang gi khrag gis sprus nas yi ge bcu pa'i sngags dang bcas pas bu mo che ge mo rengs par gyur cig /ces dur khrod kyi me la sbyin sreg stong byas na —134—

rengs pa las gzhan min no/ /de nas zhi bar bya bar 'dod na/ mar dang / sbrang rtsi dang / 'o ma dang / dur ba dang bcas par ba la sha'i shing la me rab tu sbar nas zhi bar 'dod pa'i dmigs pas/ yul gyi shar phyogs su kha bltas te gnas pas/ dus gsum du spyin sreg brgya rtsa brgyad byas nas des yul zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyas par 'dod na/ til dang / 'bras dang / nas dang / /mar dang bcas pas u dum wa ra'i shing la me rab tu sbar nas las kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i lha'i sbyor ba dmigs te/ kha byang du bltas nas mnyam par bzhag pas dus gsum du sbyin sreg stong byas na rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dgug pa 'dod na/ ke tshes gzugs brnyan byas la seng ldeng gi me yis dbus su brgya rtsa brgyad du bsregs te des 'gugs so/ /nyi ma bdun gyis gang 'dod pa the tshom med par 'gyur ro/ /de nas smyo bar byed par 'dod na/ bya rgod chen po'i tshang dang sha chen bsregs na smyo bar 'gyur ro/ /de phub ma'i me la bsregs na bde legs su 'gyur ro/ /de nas nor nor ma yin par 'dod na/shing bal gyi me la da ru ra'i 'bras bu dang bcas par mtshan mo brgya rtsa brgyad sbyin sreg byas na shin tu chud zos par 'gyur ro/ /a ru ra bsregs na slar rdzas de nyid du 'gyur ro/ /rje btsun gyi mdun du sha wo chang dang bcas pa zla ba drug tu mtshan mo sbyin sreg brgya rtsa brgyad byas na yul thams cad kyi bdag por 'gyur ro/ /ba glang gi sha khrag dang bcas pa gang gis ming dang bcas par sbyin sreg stong byas na ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bran du gnas par the tshom med do/khyi sha rdo rje'i chu dang bcas par mtshan mo gang gi ming dang bcas par sbyin sreg —135—

brgya rtsa brgyad byas na/ bdag nyid nor dang bcas par dbang du 'gyur ro/ /rta'i sha rnam par snang mdzad dang bcas pa sbyin sreg brgya rtsa brgyad gnas gcig tu gnas pas/ mtshan mo rgyal po la dmigs nas byas na zhag bdun gyis 'khor dang bcas par dbang du 'gyur ro/ /glang po'i sha khu ba dang bcas pas 'jig rten kun la dmigs te mtshan mo spyin sreg stong byas na zhag bdun gyis dbang du 'gyur ro/ /nya dang sha dang chang dang bcas pas 'jigs pa med par spyin sreg brgya rtsa brgyad byas na bud med thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /de nas bskrad par 'dod na/ bya rog gi sha gzhan dang ma 'dres par gang gi ming dang bcas par spyin sreg stong byas na nyi ma bdun gyis rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bu yang rab tu 'bros par 'gyur na phra mo g.yin lta ci smos/ de nas bya rog gi tshang dang / 'bras kyi phub ma dang / lhan cig tu dha ru ra'i shing la me rab tu sbar te/ yi ge bcu pa'i sngags gang gi ming dang bcas par nam phyed na sbyin sreg byas na nyi ma bdun gyis skrod par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dbang du bya bar 'dod na/seng ldeng gi me la til dang 'bras dang bud med kyi me tog dang lhan gcig tu rdo rje chu dang bsres te/ rnal 'byor gyi gzugs dmar por dmigs nas kha nub tu bltas te/ yi ge bcu pa'i sngags gang gis ming dang bcas pa sngags pas bsregs na nyi ma bdun gyis dbang du 'gyur te/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du mi 'bral lo/ /de nas dgug par 'dod na/ bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas par seng lding gi me la gang gi ming dang bcas pa sbyin sreg brgya rtsa brgyad byas na de skad cig gcig gis 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /las 'di rnams ni sngon du bsnyen pa byas pa'i sngags —136—

pas bya'o/ /gzhan pas byas na sngags pa la 'jig rten pas 'phya bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar bye brag mi bya ste/ /gang la'ang bye brag spyin mi bya/ /bye brag phye na sngags pa yis/ /dngos grub 'grub pa ma yin no/ /rgyud gzhan dag las kyang gsungs te/ /ji ltar bye brag ma skyes na/ /de bzhin bya ba'i bye brag smras/ /rdo rje sems dpas kyang mi 'grub/ /gang gi mdun du'ang sngags pa yis/ /de phyir las rnams mthong mi bya/ /gzhan dang lhan cig tu mi bya/ /gal te sngags pas las bya 'dod/ /de dag gcig pu nyid kyis bya/ /sngags pa de yis las kun 'grub/ /'di ni 'jam dpal mchog rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyud las sbyin sreg gi las kyi cho ga rgya che ba'i rtog pa ste drug pa'o/ /de nas bsam gtan gyi las kyi cho ga ji lta ba yang dag par gsungs te/bsam gtan tsam gyis sbyor ba dgos pa thams cad sgrub par bya ste/ de'i cho ga ni/ dang por re zhig rnal 'byor pa ma he'i gdong pa'i spyor ba la/ gnas pa/sngon du bsnyen pa byas pas las thams cad bya'o/ /raX yongs su gyur pa'i me'i dkyil 'khor kun tu gsal zhing 'bar ba rnam par bsam la/ de'i steng du bsgrub bya gcer bu skra bshig pa byed par gyur pa bdag gis mdun du rnam par bsam mo/ /de nas rang gi lus las khro bo'i gzugs brnyan mang ba rnam par spros te/ khro bo de rnams kyis ral gris rgyab cing khrag 'thung bar bsam par bya'o/ /bsgrub bya de'i sha za ba dang / rgyu ma drangs par bsam par bya'o/ /'di skad smras te/ dkon mchog gsum la gnod par byed pa dang / bla ma la skur ba —137—

'debs pa la rgyob cig /sod cig sod cig /bsam shing brjod pa tsam gyis/rdo rje 'dzin pa yang zhag bdun gyis 'chi na/ phra mo srog chags gzhan lta ci smos/de nas gzhan yang bsam gtan gyi rab tu sbyor ba ni/ ma he'i gdong can gyi nga rgyal gyis gnas te/ las thams cad sgrub par bya'o/ /me'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bsgrub bya 'dar bar rnam par bsam la/ de'i mdun du srin po mang po bsam par bya ste/ srin po de dag tha dad pa'i lus can ma rungs pa/ shin tu gtum pas sha za ba dang / khrag 'thung bar rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /gzhan yang rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i bya rnams te/ bya rgod dang / bya rog dang / 'ug pa dang / lce spyang dang / khyi rnams kyis sha za ba dang / khrag 'thung bar rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /bsam gtan 'di'i sbyor bas the tshom med par 'chi'o/ /dpag tshad brgya na gnas pas skyes bu yang bzung ste bsam gtan tsam mo/ /sngags pas bsam pa brtan par bya'o/ /de nas dbral bar 'dod na/ ma he'i snying gar bsgrub bya bsam pa ste/ bsgrub bya gzhan rta'i snying gar bsam par bya'o/ /rta dang ma he gnyis phan tshun 'thab par byed par bsam ste/ ji srid rta dang ma he gnyis phye mar ma gyur gyi bar du bya'o/ /phyi nas bsgrub bya de gnyis rab tu mi 'dzag par bsam par byas na/ bsam pa tsam gyis nyi ma bdun gyis nges par 'thab par 'gyur te gzhan du min no/ /de nas bskrad par 'dod na/de ru yaX yongs su gyur pa'i rnga mo bsam par bya ste/ yang de'i rgyab tu yaX gyis rnam pa las gyur pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla ba phyed pa'i rnam par bsam mo/ /de'i steng du bsgrub bya gcer bu skra bshig par bred par gyur par bsam par bya ste/—138—

ma he'i gdong can gyis sbyor ba la gnas pas/ de'i rgyab tu gzhin rje'i gzugs lag pas dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ skra bsral pa rnam par bsam par bya ste/rnga mo de kha lhor bstan la btang ngo / /de'i ming dang bcas par gshin rje'i sngags brjod par byas na/ rnal 'byor pas 'di bsam pa tsam gyis zhag bdun na 'di ltar rdo rje 'dzin pa yang skrod par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang bsam gtan gyi rab tu spyor ba ni/ bya rog gi'am/ bya rgod kyi rgyab tu bsgrub bya skra brol ba gcer bu rnam par bsam mo /de'i rgyab tu gnyen rje rnam par bsam par bya ste/ lag na tho ba thogs pa/bsgrub bya'i skra bzung ste/ de la ma he'i gdong can gyis bka' bsgo ste/ kha lho ru bltas nas song bar bsam ste/ rtse gcig pa'i sbyor bas zhag bdun gyis skrod par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dgug par byed na/ yi ge yaX las rlud gi dkyil 'khor/de'i steng du a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du gzhin rje gzugs lcags kyu dang zhags pa lag na thogs pa rnam par bsam mo/ /ma he'i gdong gi rnal 'byor la gnas pas de la bka' bsgo ba/ gshin rje song la yul che ge mo nas bu mo che ge mo myur du khug gcig /de skad bskul bas yaX yig gis bskyod de/ song bar rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /bsam gtan 'di yi rab tu sbyor ba la gnas pas/ sngags pas khams gsum du gtogs pa'i bud med bkug la rol bar bya'o/ /ji ltar bsam pa brtan par 'gyur nas/ 'di'i rab tu sbyor ba'i de dag bya'o/ /gzhan gyis mi bya'o/ /de nas dug gis zin pa bslang ba'i sbyor ba gsungs te/ rang gi snying gar pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa rnam —139—

par bsam la/ de'i steng du dbyangs yig gsum pa mdog dkar po dang /'dab mar phaṭa brgyad bsam par bya/ de las lhag ma zhes bya ba'i klu'i gzugs rnam par bsam ste/ de'i spyi bor yi ge i kha dog dkar po las bdud rtsi 'dzag par bsam par bya'o/ /klu de'i mig rnams nas bdud rtsi 'phros nas bsgrub bya de'i lus la thim par bsam par bya ste/ bsam gtan 'di'i sbyor bas khams gsum yongs su gang ba'i dug kyang med par 'gyur ro/ /dug khur stong yang za nus so/ /de nas zhu ba'i bsam gtan gyi sbyor ba rab tu gsung ba ni/ bsgrub bya mdun du bsams te/ de'i rkang pa gnyis la yi ge yaX las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ de'i steng du gsang ba'i gnas su me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum/ kha dog dmar po raX gyis byin gyis rlabs pa bsam/de'i steng du snying gar sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa/ kha dog ser po laX gyis byin gyis brlabs pa bsam/ de'i steng du dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/de'i dbus su yi ge baX mgo thur du gnas pa las bdud rtsi 'dzag par bsam te/de ni legs par rnam par bsams nas rlung gis me rab tu sbar te me des dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor bsregs par rnam par bsam/ dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor gyi drod kyis bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor de zhu ba'i rnam par bsam par bya ste/ 'di'i sbyor ba tsam gyis bud med zhu bar 'gyur te/ 'o ma'i shing bzhin zhu bar byed par the tshom med do/ /de nas rgyal po'am/ rgyal po'i blon po dbang du bya bar 'dod na/ sngags pa'i ma he'i gdong can gyi rnal 'byor la rab tu gnas la/ bdag nyid mdog dmar po bsams te/ bsgrub bya gang du gnas —140—

pa de'i steng du gnas la/ phyi nas rang gi lus las 'jam dpal mdog dmar po phyag na lcags kyu dang zhags pa can rab tu byung ste/ 'jam dpal des bsgrub bya'i snying kha dang mgrin par bcings nas dgug par bsam mo/ /'jam dpal gyi sku la rab tu gzhug go /bsgrub byed myos par bsam par bya ste/ bsam gtan 'di yi sbyor bas de'i snying gar yi ge bcu pa'i sngags rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /yang kha dog dmar po'i sgrub pa po'i ye shes kyi gzugs kyis yi ge de la gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas bsgrub bya dang sngags gcig tu 'gyur bar bya'o/ /bsam gtan 'di'i rab tu sbyor bas nyi ma bdun gyis 'khor lo sgyur ba yang dbang du 'gyur te/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du the tshom med do/ /rab tu mnyam par bzhag pa'i sngags pas mi g.yo ba'i bsam gtan gyis bya'o/ /rgyud gang la yang mi sbyin no/ /gal te sngags kyang mi bstan/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po ma he'i gdong can gyi bsam gto gang la yang mi sbyin no/ /smra bar yang mi bya/sngags kyi dbye ba yang mi bya/ bri sku yang gang gis mdun du yang mi dgram/ thang ka yang gsal bar bzhag go /rgyud pa 'di'i rab tu sbyor ba dang / bzlas pa dang / smra ba gzhan su la yang 'ga' tsam yang mi bzla/ gal te yang bzlas na dam tshig nyams par gyur pas/ dpal 'jigs byed chen po dang / g.yin yang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis dang / mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis za'o/ /de'i phyir sngags pas su la yang mi sbyin no/ /sngags pas gzhan la sbyin na/ de dang slob mar bcas pa dam tshig nyams —141—

te/ 'jig rten 'di ni 'jigs pa chen por gyur/ 'jig rten pha rol tu dmyal bar 'gro bar the tshom med do/ /de nas sbyin na/ dam tshig ma nyams pa dang / rnam par rtog pa med pa dang /dam pa'i brtul zhugs can/ dpa' bo bla ma la gus pa/ dul ba can/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa nges par 'dzin pa/ rgyud sbas pa/ mi khro ba/ snying rje dang ldan pa/ bzlas pa dang bsam gtan la phyogs pa dang / rnam par smin pa la 'dzem pa dang / 'di lta bu'i yon tan gyi khyad par dang ldan pa ni/ slob ma bzang po ste/ dkyil 'khor dam pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la mchog tu gus pa/snying rje chen po'i yid brlan pa/ rnam par rtog pa med pa/ rab tu rtog pa la shin tu rnam par bsams te/ bla mas de lta bu'i slob ma la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i rgyud sbyin no/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i 'khor lo rgyud 'bum pa nas byung ba/ rtog pa'i phyogs bklags pas 'di ni 'jam dpal mchog rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyud las bsam gtan gyi las sgrub pa'i rtog pa ste bdun pa'o/ /sngags pas gzhan la byin na de dang slob mar bcas par dmyal bar 'gro bar the tshom med do/ /'jig rten 'dir ni 'jigs pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten pha rol tu ni dmyal bar 'gro'o/ /dam tshig kyang nyams par 'gyur ro/ /nyer rgyud sbyin no zhes pa'i rjes la yod/ kha cig tu'o/ khrub pa/ dpal 'jigs byed chen po ma he'i gdong can dngos grub sgrub pa'i rtog pa/ dpal u rgyan gyi gnas chen po nas 'jam dpal gyi rgyud las byung ba/ rgyud kyi rgyal po —142—

chen po dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i slob dpon dpal la li ta badz+ra sa phyung nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //nus bzhin shes rab bla ma yi/ /bka' 'di bsgyur ba'i dge ba gang / /de yis bstan la rnyed pa dang / /zhal ni nye bar ston gyur cig /slad kyis paṇ+ḍi ta bha ro phyag rdum dang/ lo ts+tsha ba dge slong rdo rje grags kyis kyang bcos shing gtan la phab pa'o/ khyud rgyal 'di la/ zhung cog gru /rong zom/ rwa lo/ ba ri/ nag tsho/ gyi jo/ mal gyo/ khu dngos grub/ paṇ+ḍita sa man tas bsgyur pa ste/ 'gyur brgyad yod ces sngon dus grags/ dus phyis skyid rong lo tsā ba ngag dbang gis dbus gtsang kun tu btsal bas/ snga ma bzhi po dang / brgyad po dar ma 'dus pa lha btsad po mu ne rā jo'i 'gyur dang / tshigs bcad ma dang gzhan gcig ste 'gyur byang ma thebs pa gnyis mthong gsung la/ khyung bos kyang 'gyur dang po gsum dang / mal 'gyur dang / ma ning chos shes dang / tshigs bcad ma ste/'gyur drug mthong ngo / /rwa 'gyur la/ 'gyur snga ma zhang gi 'gyur byang yod med gnyis snang ba/tshig rigs mi 'dra ba cung zad gda'/ rā ba'i ṭīk+ka rnying pa rnams/ nga yi 'gyur byang med pa de kho na la 'bru gnon par 'dug /mal 'gyur de yang lo tsā ba khyung po chos rtson gyi 'gyur la 'gyur bcos mdzad par 'dug pas/ ma ning pa dang /chos brtson gyi 'gyur 'di gnyis kyang / sngags kyi brgyad la mi the bas spyir 'gyur mi 'dra ba bcu gcig ni nges par byung snang ngo / /zhang 'gyur dang/ rong —143—

zom 'gyur la sngags tu tshig lhug par yod/ gzhan mthong ba bzhi la tshigs bcad du snang / spyir dpe rnying kho rang la brtags dus/ 'gyur gzhan la rwa'i 'gyur byang btags pa dang / 'gyur mi gcig pa phan tshun zhu dag byas pa tshig rigs 'gres pa dang / tshig sna ring thung dang / mchan bu dkyus la shor ba sogs sna tshogs snang yang / rgya bod kyi 'brel ba ji snyed pa zhig la gshugs shing / rwa 'gyur snga ma'i steng du yig nor rgyud pa 'ga' re 'dug pa thams cad spangs te/ brtag dpyad thub nges par zhus dag byed pa po ni tā ra nā tha'o/ /'di'i rgya dpe ma mthong bas/ bod skad kho na'i zhus dag las/ gzhan 'gyur bcos thabs ma byung yang / 'gyur mi gcig pa rnams bsdur ba dang / bshad pa rnams kyi don la dpyad pa na/ tshig zur tshun chad dag ma dag phyin ci ma log pa gsal bar rtogs pa'i rgyud nyid las so// //zhus dag/ maṅga laX// shu bhaX stu sarba dza ga taX//—144—

cho ga khams gsum zil gnon gyi dmigs rim gyis man ngag gi yi ge (snying dang 'dra ba/ gzhan la gsang ba 'a man ngag bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i khro rgyal gshin rje gshed mthar byed chen po'i rigs kyi las tshogs dang 'brel bas bsgrub par bya ba/ drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor ma'i cho ga khams gsum zil gnon zhes bya ba la/ dang por stod las byang chub sgrub pa dang / smad las dgra bgegs sgrol ba zhes bya ba las/ stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i skabs rnams spyir nas go sla ba las/ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren gyi skabs/ rje btsun nyid kyi man ngag nas 'byung bzhin/ dmigs pa brtan po dang bcas/phyir 'brang gi bgegs rnams phyir bskrad pa'i dmigs pa dang / gsum pa skyabs su 'gro ba dang / de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal 'debs pa sogs/ rta khal ma dang / gshed dmar 'khrul 'joms las gzigs 'tshal sngags bsdu ba'i skabs/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi zhes pa dang / 'od gsal du bsdu ba'i skabs/ khams gsum snod bcud zhes pa'i skabs/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / rang la thim zhes pa'i skabs/ dmigs pa gnad che ba zab 'tshal/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi mchod gtor 'bul bas —145—

skabs thams cad du bzlas nang la dmigs pa yin na'ang / zhabs su/(bla ma 3dang 'jam dpal gshin rje gshod pos bdag la mchog thun gyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas mdun bskyed thugs rgyud bskul ba'i phyir khro bzlas tshab 'tshal/ bkra shis/ /de nas smad las dgra bgegs sgral ba/ snyan gsan dbabs pa/ ma nyes par dpang gzigs pa/ bsgral chog /btab gtong zor lam dbye ba/zor 'phang ba/ zor lam gcod pa las/ snyan gsan dbabs pas/ gzi dpang gnyis go sla/ de nas bsgral chog gi skabs gzhan rnams go sla/ ling ga bskyed pa'i skabs bsad las dang sbyar bas/ bsad pa yin na go sla/ bzlog pa la bgegs lus rid cing nyam chung ba zhes pa'i skabs/ bgegs de dngos su gsal ba yod na rang gi ming gis 'bod cing de'i 'khor dang sprul ba yang sprul rnams la dmigs pa gtad/ liṅga sgrol ba'i skabs dgra bgegs lha dang 'phral ba'i skabs/ sngags kyi 'phral ba/ mchod pa'i 'phral ba/ rdzas kyi 'phral ba gsum la nan tan bskyed pa 'tshal/ gsal ba rnam pa gsum gsal 'debs/rang yi dam du gsal ba las byed/ phur ba yi dam gyis thugs sprul du gsal ba/ liṅga dgra bgegs dmigs bsal gang min du bsal ba zhes pa dang / tshe lung khrus long med na shan pa yin zhes te/ rang sgrub pa po tshe dang bsod nams sogs kyis kyang tshangs na/ dam can srung ma sha khrag bdud rtsi rnam pa lngar gyur pas gsol ba'i tshangs pa/ dgra bgegs gnas kyi tshangs pa zhes pa/ kho yi rnam shes ā yig skya 'char re ba de/ gnas gsum sogs nas 'thon/ phur —146—

bu'i khong seng nas mar drang te phaṭa ces pa'i ngang nas rgyal ba mi bskyod zhing ngam/bde ba can la sogs par gnas spar de/ phaṭa ces bskrad pas stong pa nyid dang snying rje chen po'i ngang du bzhag /rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang tshogs drug gsung chos skad spyi'i dpang du bzhag /yang gsang sngags spyi la gnad sbyor gnyis gnad che ba yin zhes gsungs pa yang go dgos so/ /'di yi 'phro las 'di ltar 'brel ba 'bum nag las/ liṅga dang ni nya mo gnyis/ /dmigs pa cag te rgya ru mi cag /liṅga nya mo 'di nyid snying gar zhugs/ /dus ni smin drug sa 'og dus/ /'bri mkhan rme mkhan dam tshig bla ma dang / slob dpon la nyams zhes bshad pa'i lung yang yod do/ /bto gtor skabs ltar byas pa bsad bzlog gang yin kyang zab pa'i gnad do/ /zor lam dbye ba/ yang rgyud 'bral ba'i ngang gser skyems la sogs dang / dmigs pa gsal ngang nas bya/ de nas zor 'phangs pa'i skabs gtor ma'i lha nam mkhar 'deg pa'am bris sku la bstims pa yang bshad do/ /de nas sprul gzhi sgrub khang der bzhugs shing / sprul pa yang sprul rnams sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khang pa che ba ri rab/ chung ba yung 'bru yang chung rdul phran du gyur na gang la dmigs pa'i yul khams sogs khang nas/ las gang la gang 'tshams pa med cing /gtor ma de yang dug dang zhes pas dug dug za dang sna tshogs dang me dang /mtshon cha'i phung po dang gnam lcags kyis thog sogs su gyur nas/ dgra bgegs lhag ma til 'khru tsam yang med par bsam ste/ de'i ngang nas stong pa nyid kyi don bsam mod/ de'i zor lam bcad par bya ste/ de mtshams 'byung ba —147—

lnga yi dkyil 'khor bsam pa dang / ri bdun rol ba'i mtsho bdun bsam pa/ de la phur bus rdo rje rgya gram bris pa'i dmigs pa dang / dang po gcig pus bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ thabs las dug kyang bdud rtsir 'gyur/ /ma skru'i sbyor ba'i lcags kyang gser/ /'chi ster dbyug gu'i ye shes cher/ /'dod pa kun 'byung ngo mtshar rmad/ /zhes dang / dpal ldan rgyud chen gsang ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /dngos grub kun 'byung yid bzhin nor rnyed pa/ /bdud las rnam rgyal rgyal mtshan rtser mchod pas/ /phun tshogs 'gro la phan bde dar gyur cig /dang / rwa lo gsum pa tā ra nā thā yis/ khyug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor ma'i man ngag 'di/ /lha spru gyis gdams pa yi ger bkod nas kyang / /man ngag yi ge snying dang 'dra ba yi/ /grub mtha' kha khar spel na bka' rgya yod/ /slob ma dam tshig ma nyams snying 'dra bas/ /de rnams ma rtogs kun la gsang ba gyis/ /gzhan la spel na phyi mar nā ra gan/ /dge legs 'phel bar shog / shu bhaX//sto148—

gya dbang dang brgyud bshad man ngag dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad bzhugs/na mo gu ru bhe ra wa ya/ dpal ldan ye shes rnam lnga'i rang snang las/ /zab gsal dbyer med 'jam dpal khro bo'i sku/ /'jigs mdzad chen po'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /rgyal ba'i yum chen rdo rje be ta li/ /lung bstan mchog brnyes grub chen lwa li ta//thugs rjes dregs pa 'bul mdzad a mo gha/ /gsol ba: /rim gnyis mngon gyur ye shes 'byung gnas dang / /mngon spyod rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag pad+ma pa/ /log lta'i rgyal po tshar gcod bha ro'i zhabs/ /gsol ba: /'jigs mdzad go 'phang mchog brnyes rdo rje grags/ /lam bzang bstan pa rgyas mdzad chos rab dpal/ /zab mos rgyud sbyangs ye shes seng ge'i zhabs/ /gsol ba: /blo ldan nus pa'i dbang phyug 'bum seng dang / /glog skya'i rigs 'khrung rton pa dbang drag mtshan/ /rdo rje 'dzin dbang ldong ston shes rab dpal/ /gsol ba: /dam chos 'khor los bsgyur ba 'phags pa'i mtshan/ /chos brgyad rnam rtog kun spangs dkon mchog dpal/ /rtse gcig sgrub pa'i dbang phyug bsod nams dpal/ /gsol ba: /mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bsod nams rgyal mtshan —149—

dpal/ /yon tan kun ldan byang chub seng ge'i zhabs/ /bsdu dngos rnam bzhis don mdzad shar chen pa/ /gsol ba /mtshan mchog don dang ldan pa'i kun dga' bzang / /rgyal sras g.yin phan mngon gyur kha phyar ba/ /'jam dpal dgyes pa'i bshes gnyen shākya'i mtshan/ /gsol ba /yang na chos rab kyi rjes su ra shang ba nas brgyud kyang rung ste/'di ltar/rgyud sde kun sbyangs dkon mchog seng ge'i zhabs/ /man ngag kun gyi mdzod 'dzin chos seng pa/ /snyan brgyud gdams pa'i mnga' bdag shes rab mtshon/ /gsol ba: /'khrul med lam bzang mngon gyur dbang phyug grags/ /rdo rje grags pa'i rnam 'khrul rgya ston rje/ /ris med thos pas brgyud phyug bag ston pa/ /'jigs mdzad zhal gzigs 'jam dbyangs ral spi'i zhabs/ /gnas lnga mthar son blo brtan bzhi pa dang / /'jam dpal dgyes pa'i ye shes shākya'i mtshan/ /gsol ba: /zhes brjod kyang yo ngo / /mkhas dbang chos nyid mngon gyur byams gling ba/ spyod 'chang rnam 'phrul kun dga' grol mchog zhabs/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos kun dga' rgyal mtshan la//gsol ba: /rab gsal mtshan dpes spras pa rdo rje sku/ /rab mnyen yan lag drug cu'i gsung dbyangs can/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i zung 'jug thugs kyi dngos/ /gsol ba /dbang bzhi rim pas rang rgyud smin byas te/ /zhi khro rnam par rol pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /'jam dpal khro bo'i bskyed rim mthar phyin nas/ /las dang dngos grub 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zab dang rgya che zung 'jug rim pa yis/ /snang stong dbyer med lha sku lam khyer dang / /dhu tir gnad du bsnan pa'i —150—

bde chen gyis/ /rdzogs rim ye shes rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bsnyen pa'i rim pas rang rgyud sbyangs byas te/ /sgrub pa'i tshul gyi rim pa mngon gyur nas/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis len pa'i las sbyor gyis/ /'jigs mdzad dngos su 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /brtul zhugs spyod pas rang don mthar phyin nas/ /mtha' dag 'gro kun theg mchog lam la bkod/ /sa dang lam rim thams cad bsgrod gyur nas/ /bla med byang chub thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes 'jigs byed rwa lugs ro langs brgyad skor gyi dbang dang / rgyud bshad/ man ngag dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad 'di ni/ sa skyong ga cho ne nu kun dga' bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //—151—

bkra shis brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs/oṃ su sti/ dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang dbang bshes gnyen tshul/ /mtha' yas 'gro la phan bde'i dge legs stsol/ /lā li ta sogs rtsa brgyud bla ma yis/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs ma lus 'dir stsol cig /mi 'gyur bde chen chos dbyings rnam dag las/ /ye shes rgya mtsho 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i thugs/ /bdud dpung kun 'joms 'jigs mdzad chen po'i skur/ /ston mdzad 'khor lo'i mgon pos bkra shis shog /bde chen g.yo med ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /mos pa sna tshogs sems can 'dul ba'i phyir/ /ye shes nyams brgya'i sprul pa sna tshogs 'chang / /rigs lnga'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i bkra shis shog /mtha' dag rgyal ba dgyes pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ /zag med bde bskyed sgyu 'phrul du mas sgeg/rjes chags rol pas rnam rgyan lha mo'i gtso/ /rtsa rtsi ka sogs lha mos bkra shis shog /dkyil 'khor kun tu sngags kyi lha rnams kun/ /dgug gzhugs bcing dang mnyes pas las mdzad cing / /bgegs kun 'joms mdzad dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /sgo srung khro bo rnams kyis bkra shis shog /gzugs sgra la sogs 'dod yon lha mo rnams/ /phung po nyon mongs 'chi bdag lha yi bu/ /'phrin las drag po 'dul phyir sku sprul pa/ /bde skyong thod pa bzhi yis bkra shis shog /—152—

dbang po bcas pa'i lha dang nad gdon sogs/ /gdugs can 'dul phyir 'jigs byed skur bzhengs pa/ /dpag yas rgyal ba sras bcas kun 'dus dngos/ /zhe dgu'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bkra shis shog /gdugs pa skrag byed rdo rje ro langs brgyad/ /mthar byed lus 'dzin phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs 'dul/ /sgrub la dngos grub gnyis kyis mchog stsol ba/ /sgo mtshams gnas pa rnams kyis bkra shis shog /bcu drug 'pho ba'i bag chags mthar 'dzin pa/ /bde chen ye shes ma gzhan bcu drug tshul/ /thog med 'phrin las sgrub pa'i mthu dpal can/ /las mdzad pho nya'i tshogs kyis bkra shis shog /byang chub phyogs chos rang bzhin rgyan gyis spras/ /rdo rje sa gzhi 'dam skyes nye bar gnas/ /srid las sgrol phyir dur khrod chen por bcas/ /ye shes gzhal med khang gis bkra shis shog /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i gur/ /rwa ba me dpung 'bar ba 'khor lo bcas/ /bar chad kun 'joms srung ba'i 'khor lo yis/ /srid gsum phan bde khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ sa skyong gzhon nu kun dga' bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis bskul nas/ /tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //dge'o//—153—

gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba bzhugs/chos rgyal man ngag chen mo dge'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po ya man+ta ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa dang / de'i man ngag rwa ba'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len ltar bshad par bya'o/ /de la dang por rgyun gyis gtor chog ni/ gtor ma gru gsum sha khra dre/sa brgyan pa mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad la sogs pa khro bo'i rgyal po gzhan rje gshed gang yang rung ba'i bdag skyed sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa dang gtor ma yi dam ltar byin gyis rlabs/ rten yod na amri tas bsangs/ rten yod med gang yin rung swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūX las bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang / dur khrod chen po'i dbus rang gi mdun du pad nyi la gnas pa'i ma he nag po dregs shing khros pa lus nyams rtsal dang ldan pa rwa brdar zhing rmig pa rdeb pa/ dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad brdzis shing gsod par byed pa shin tu 'jigs pa'o/ /de'i steng du rang gi thugs ka nas huX gcig spros te/ huX de las thod skam gyis mtshan pa'i spag to'am be con huX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'phags tshogs mchod/sems can gyi don byas dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/'khor 'das kyi nus mthu rnams bsdus/ sa bon phyag mtshan la thim pa yongs —154—

su gyur pa las/ las kyi gshin rje sku mdog mun pa ltar gnag pa/ shin tu ches khros 'khrugs rngam pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra ral pa khams ser gyen du brdzes shing phyogs kun tu g.yengs pa/rab khros ma he'i gdong mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ yang na srin po'i zhal ras/ phyag g.yas thod skam gyis mtshan pa'i dbyug to nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon dus kyi zhags pa nag po dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub gnod byed la bsdigs par mdzad pa/ sku sbom zhing thung ba gcer bu ling ga gyen du sgreng ba/ zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pas ma he la gnas pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan thod rlon gyi do shal/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i g.yon du hriX las mdung rtse gsum pa khyiXs mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros las gsum mdzad 'dus pa yongs su gyur pa las/ srin mo chen mo tsa mu ṇ+ḍi dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa'i mdog can nu ma rgyas pa/ phyag g.yas tri shu la 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod pa snying khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yon skum g.yas brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa glang po che'i ko rlon gyon pa rgyan dang cha byad las kyi gshin rje dang mtshungs shing / yab yum gnyis ka me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'dzam gling dbus kyi phyogs mtsho ma dros pa'i sa 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya nas/ dam can gzhin rje chos kyi rgyal po dang / srin mo chen mo tsa muṇ+ḍi 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX dbang gi lha gzhan rje —155—

gshed rgyal ba rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX pur+sha nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur bstsal tu gsol/ oṃ ba dzī bha wa a bhi khiñtsa huX/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku lus gang / nyes skyon dag /yab yum gnyis kar gyi spyi bor rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan/ stug pa'i phyag rgya dang yi ge ga gtsog pa lan gsum gyi mthar sa mā ya stuX zhes dam la bzhag /8( kā 'kha rā pa sa pā ri wa ra khyoX.ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod do/ /oṃ kā la rū pa huX phaṭa/ yi dam chos skyong gnyis ka'i sngags kyang yin/ chos rgyal nyid mchog tu nye bar byed pa'i nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūX phaṭa/ yi ge bstogacig pa ste byin gyis rlobs pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ kā la rū pa bhi ma yak+ṣa huX/ mahā ro ṣa ṇa ya ma rā dza huX huX phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa ni bsnyen pa'i sngagasate snying po'o/ /oṃ kā la rū pa bhi ma yak+ṣa hūX mahā ro ṣa ṇa ra sirnyi yo sarba bhu ta a dhi pa ta ye ya ma rā dza huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ nye ba'i bsnyen pa'i sngags te rtsa sngags so/ /tsho( kā la rū pa ya sarba sha trun dus bhā sa ya bhā sa ya/ a ga d+dha a ga ju sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ ban+ta ban+ta/ tsuṇi tsuṇi/ tsak+ṣa badz+re ṇa sto ra pa drwa ya spu tra pā lā ye/ sbyin da ri da/ lhin da rtsin da/ thāX kaX badz+ra nā da ru dhi ra ar+ghaX pā ya ya bā ra ya badz+ra ya nā sha ya stam bha ya hūX phaṭa/ yab kyi 'phreng sngags te gshin rje bye ba ther 'bum gyi sngags so/ /hriXtsa muṇ+ḍi ye sarba sha chun du gin dhu na dhu na ban+ta ban+ta ma tha ma tha/ pra ma tha pra ma tha/ hūX dzā la dz+wa ra dz+wa re ṇa bye dhi ro ga ṇaX nyi ga na shi baX yaX haX raX ri tshus ya a be sha ya dzi baX hri da ya/ tshin+ta tshin+ta/ bā ju pa shi gh+raX mā ra ya/ na sha ya hūX phaṭa/ lha mo tsa murnyi'i 'breng ba'i sngags te ma mo bye ba ther 'bum gyi spyi sngags so/ /'phreng —156—

sngags 'di gnyis la sngags btu med cing / skabs 'gar legs sbyar rang du'ang ma nges pas/'don tshul mi 'dra ba 'ga' re 'dug kyang / dag ther byas nas khungs che ba'i phyogs nas bris pa'o//oṃ hriXtsa musmyu ye hūX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa ni yum tsa mu rje'i snying po ste yab kyi nye snying dang snying po dang rtsa sngags thams cad kyi zla sdeb la 'di kho na spel te sbyar ro/ /'dir tsa murnyi ces pa'i gzhug tu baX hūṃX phaṭa dang / rtsa huX phaṭa sbyor ba'ang yod do/ /rgyu mtshan la brtags na gnyis ka mi 'gal kyang / dpe rnying ba rang tsho na mi 'dug cing / mgo na hiXyod phyin sa bon gnyis sbrags dgos kyang mi dgos pa 'dra'o/ /de dag thams cad blo la byang bar byas nas skabs 'dir thams cad tshar gcig brjod de/ 'phreng sngags ma gtogs gang yang rung ba gcig brgya rtsa sogs cung zad bzlas/oṃ āXhū ཾ ༷ zhes byin gyis glos/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por slar yang gsal btab/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza huX/ i daX ba ling gro hā gro hā kha kha ji hi ji hi/ zhes lan bdun las mi nyung bas yab la phul/ tsho( hriXtsa muṇ+ḍi/ ye i daX ba ling sogs gong bzhin sbyar ba lan gsum mam lngas yum la phul/ oṃ kā la rū pa tsa muṇ+ḍi ye zhes pa mgo bor sbyar nas ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyi mchod/ 'chi ba yi dwags rgyal po ni/ /ma dros mtsho yi 'bri dkyil na/ /ri nag dgu yi pha mtha' ste/ /sbos ngad ri yi bar dag na/ /mchu dang zhing du cha mnyam mtsho/ /de 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya'i 'og /'chi bdag yi dwags rgyal po bzhugs/ /'gro ba kun gyi lus kyi bdud/ /lus dang grib ma'i tshul bzhin du/ /'gro ba kun la gnas pa ste/ /phung po nying mtshams sbyor ba po/ /'jigs pa khyod kyi gzugs mthong zhing / /gshin rje khyod kyi dri ngad ldang //rtse na 'gro ba'i srog gi bdud/ /ltag pa'i phyogs na gnas pa ste/ gtsigs pa can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srin po'i lcam mo gshin rje'i yum/ /dus mtshan srog —157—

gi bdag mo ste/ /rgya mtsho chen po bdun la gnas/ /tsa mra'i la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs tshon las gzhol/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs shis pa brjod/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig/sogs smon lam btab yig brgya dang bzod gsol bya/ rten yod na chos skyong pho mo gnyis la brtan zhugs byed cing / khyed kyi sems can don kun sogs gtor 'gron rnams gshegs/ rten med na chos skyong nyid kyi ye shes pa yang gshegs shing / dam tshig pa rang gi lte bar thim pa'o/ /smon lam dang bkra shis gong gi de kas cho ga mod/ spro na 'dir yang byed pa mi 'gal lo/ /gal te drag po'i las la dga' ba'am/ de nyid kyi sgrub pa dang / las sbyor yin na/ gzhan gong dang du 'dra ba las/ gtor ma sha khrag gi rgya mtshor mos te/ gtor sngags snga mas phul ba'i de ma thag tu/ /ci sgrub bya dgra bgegs byad ma rnams bkug ste gtor ma la thim/ oṃ kā la rū pa sarba bisna na sha chun mā ra ye/ i daX ba kla ta kha kha sku hi 'a hi huX phaṭa/ oṃ tsa murnyi sarba bisnan sogs de bzhin du sbyar bas phul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs gong bzhin 'dod don gsol ba'i mthar/ 'chi bdag nag po lho phyogs kyi/ /zhes sogs gtso bo yab yum gyi bskul ba dang / dug mtsho nag po rba klong 'khyil ba nas/ /ro langs rngam pa dgu yi khri steng nas/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro ma tsa musmyu/ /bzhengs nas 'gal byed thal ba rdul du rlog /'jam dpal shin rje gshed kyis bka' byung gi /srin mo chen mo'i 'phrin las dus la bab/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i dmag sna khyod kyis drongs/ /zung zhig chings shig bsad pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bskrad dang dbye dang rengs pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /phur bus btab dang mnan pa'i las mdzode cig /dgra bgegs sha la zo zhig khrag la 'thung / /ming gi lhag ma —158—

tsam yang med par mdzodi/ /ces las mkhan gyi tshul du yum bskul lo/ /rtsa sngags kyi nyes skyon dang / u ni sha la seng ge te/ gsod byed mthar thug pa'o/ /zhes pa'ang zhal rgyun no/ /de ltar na gtor chog gi rim pa ste dang po'o/ /da ni 'di'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi rim pa la brten nas/ 'gal byed thams cad chom la 'bebs pa'i thabs bshad par bya'o/ /de la dang por mkho ba'i yo byad bsags pa ni/ ro ras sam dpa' bos rin gyis nyos pa'i ras la/sngags bzlas pa'i chus bkrus/ bgegs bskrad bsrung ba bya/ nye snying cung zad bzla'o/ /ras 'dul gyi dus gri khrag dang mngal khrag dang dug sna rnams cung zad byug /sku 'bri sar dri bzang gis ya dang khyoX'am huX dang hriXgang rung 'bri/nye snying bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/ skya bris kyi skabs ro sol gyis cung zad bri bar 'dod de/ mtha' gcig tu dgos pa'ang min/ sku gzugs khru tshad tsam byed par gsungs pa mtshon byed yin/ de bas chung ba dang che ba'ang mi rung ba min no/ /skabs 'dir chos rgyal yab yum sbags te sgrub pa'i dbang du byas na/yab yum gnyis kar gyi bris sku dgos pas/ de la gshin rje pho mo lcam sring ltar bsgrubs na bris sku so sor byas kyang rung / gcig la bris kyang rung mod kyi/yab mngon rtogs ltar dang / tsa muṇ+ḍi yab kyi gdan la mi bzhugs par/ g.yas g.yon 'og gsum gang rigs su gdan zur sa la 'bri/ zhabs g.yon brkyang du byed/ kha cig srog chags kyi gdan med pa dang / g.yin dag ma he'i gdan byed par yang 'dod mod/ tsa murnyi ni ro langs kyi gdan la gnas pa nyid yin no/ /—159—

'on kyang 'dir yab yum du sgrub pa nyid bsngags par bzhed pas/ de'i tshe yab kyi gdan ma he la yab yum gnyis rtsar bzhugs te/ yum gyi zhabs kyang g.yasabarkyang ngo / /dngos su mnyam sbyor du 'bri ba dang sgom pa dag med kyang / zhabs stabs de ltar byed pa de ni don gyis mnyam sbyor mtshon no/ /'dir bla ma'i zhal nas/ gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde'i srung ma bstan pa skyong ba'i bskor bdag tu bsgrubs na zhing skyong gi tshul du bsgrub dgos te/ 'di nyid kyi 'phreng ba'i sngags las kyang slo tra pā la zhes gsungs mod gsungs/ zhing skyong brgyad kyi gzhin rje gshed de gdong brnyan can du bshad pas/ las gshin ma he'i zhal can du mdzad pa 'di man ngag yin/ 'khor lo la sogs pa'i sgo nas mngon spyod la sogs pa'i las tshogs tsam sgrub pa la ni ma he'i zhal mtha' gcig tu dgos pa min te/ rtog bdun gyi gzugs brnyan sbyor ba'i skabs khro zhal du bshad/ de skabs kyi man ngag las kyang khro zhal du 'byung ba dang 'dra/ rtog pa 'di nyid nas ni gsal kha rang med kyang / gnyis kar rung ba'i 'then phyogs yod de/ kho bo cag gi bla ma brgyud pa ma gtogs mkhas mkhas mo sus kyang ma go bar 'dug go /dkor bdag la zhing skyong du bsgrub dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci snyam na/ zhing skyong zhes pa'i ming gis kyang der go dgos shing / sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dkor bdag che shos de mgon po yin/ mgon po thams cad zhing skyong yin/ 'dir yang gzhin rje mgon po nag po chen po'i lugs su sgrub pa yin no/ /spyir zhing skyong la mgon pos ma khyab/ mgon po la zhing skyong gis khyab pas zhing skyong du —160—

sgrub tshad la gdong brnyan dgos par ta ga la nges kyang / dkyil 'khor chen po'i dgod pa la/ dur khrod kyi zhing skyong de ltar yod pa de/ 'dir de ltar byed pa'i sgrub byed du sbyor ba ni bla ma dam pa'i man ngag yin no/ /gzhan dag yi dam chos skyong zhal ras mthun pa'i ched yin ces zer te cal col lo/ /ling ga gyen sgreng du mdzad pa ni/ sgrub tshul gzhan la mi dgos kyang / gshin rje de nyid las mkhan lha mgon dang dbyer med par ngo bo gcig tu sgrub pa'i lugs yin/ dgos pa ni/ 'di la man ngag gi gnad cung zad cig yod pa de bsnan na/ sgrub thabs gcig gis lha gnyis kar 'gru/ba pas lag len 'byer bde ba dang / de'i steng du yang man ngag cung zad dang bcas na sgrub po nyid kyi srung mar sgrub pa'i skabs/ zhor la dbang sdud la sngags pa yin ces nged kyi bla ma gsung ngo / /'di yang gzhan tshos ma go /sku gcer bur 'dod phyin dbang po 'chang ba dang / sbas pa mi rung bas 'di 'dod dgos mod gzhung 'di las gcer bur gsungs pa yang med/ gcer bu bkag pa'ang med pas/rtags mngon par mi byed na stag lpags kyis smad dkris so/ /rtog pa las rgyan med rus pa'i 'phreng ba can ces gsungs pa la/ kha cig thod skam gyi do shal las rgyan gzhan med zer ba dang / rgyan gtan med du 'dod pa sogs yod kyang / 'dir rgyan med pa'i don ni/ rin po che dang me tog sogs sgeg mdzes kyi rgyan med pa'i don no/ /de yang drag las kyi dbang du byed nas gsungs pa ste/ gzhan zhi ba la rgyan med pa dang rin po che'i rgyan phra mo/rgyas pa la rin po che'i rgyan mang po/ dbang la me tog sogs dang / de dag la ci —161—

rigs par dar gyi na bza' yang mi 'gal lo/ /rus 'phreng zhes pas mgo 'phreng dang rus rgyan dngos su gsungs/ stag lpags dang sbrul la sogs pa yang bkag pa ni ma yin no/ /yum la ba glang gi lpags pa dang gos nag sogs man ngag gi yi ge rnams las sna tshogs byung kyang / rwa phyi ma'i yi ge na glang lpags su bzhed cing / rtog pa las gsus chen ces gsungs pa lha mo sku gzugs kyi mtshan nyid la mi sbyor bar/ dud 'gro'i mawo nyid la sbyar te glang po cher 'dod pa'o/ /de'i tshe smad g.yogs ma yin stod g.yogs yin mod/ smad gcer bu'am stag lpags can ji ltar byed yab la ji ltar bris pa dang mthun par bya'o/ /spyan gsum mche gtsigs skra gyen brdzes sogs yab dang mthun no/ /bcu gsum ma'i lugs la yum dbu skra grol ba dang na bza' ba glang gi lpags pa can yin kyang / de 'dir bsre mi dgos so/ /yi ge la la nas sku sbom thung dang gsus pa rgyas par bshad pa la bsams nas/ ha cang sbom thung thal ba dang / grod 'jol che grags pa mi legs shing / kha cig gshin rje yin pas shin tu skem pa byed zer ba la yang rgyu mtshan med pas/ yab yum gnyis kar zhal tshad brgyad pa'am bdun pa gang rung du bri bar bya zhing / yum la lha mo'i mtshan nyid kyi phyir kha sbu mi 'bri ste 'dir ma zad mgo brnyan med pa kun la de ltar go bar bya'o/ /bris sku de la yab yum gnyis ma gtogs bla ma yi dam chos skyong gzhan sogs/ lha mgron gang yang mi 'bri/ dur khrod pa rnams ma gtogs 'khor yang mi dgos so/ /skya bzo grub/ mtshon ma btab pa'i bar der/ thugs —162—

kar yi ge bdun pa/ mgrin par bsnyen sngags spyi bor nye bsnyen lte ba man chad kyi cha la 'phreng ba'i sngags bri/ yum gyi gnas gsum char du snying po dang lte ba man chad la 'phreng ba'i sngags bri'o/ /skabs der yang sbyar ba dang khrus gsol dang / sngags de rnams nyid mang du bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas mtshon bkye zhing spyan dbye yan grub pa na/ zhag de nyid la rab gnas bya ste/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / gnas yo byin rlabs dang / yi dam gyi bdag bskyed bum bskyed sngon du btang / bgegs sbyang ba dang byur bsal ba dang / khrus gsol rnams nan tan du byas/ de nas mchod gtor dang dam rdzas rnams rgya cher bshams/ 'don cha gtor chog dang 'dra ba las/ rang gi snying kha nas huX spro ba mi dgos/ mdun bskyed gzhan dang 'dra bar sa bon las bskyed/ skyed ma thag tu yi ge bcu gcig pa bdun sogs ji ltar 'os pa 'don/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren lan bdun sogs tshar gang mang byed/ snga ma de la phyir 'brang gi bgegs skrod dgos/ dbang bskur rgyas btab tshar ma thag tu/ yi ge bcu gcig pa bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs par gsungs pa las/ yi ge snga ma rnams la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas me tog gtor gsung ba yod kyang / lag len la me tog dmar nag gam dkar dmar gnyis bya/ dkar po'am nag po la yi ge bdun pa stong phrag gcig bzlas/ dmar po la yum gyi snying po lnga brgya bzlas/ de nas me tog gnyis bsres/ ye dhar lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza ya hūX phaṭa/ ces pa'i yi ge bcu gnyis pa dang / oṃ hiXtsa murnyi tra ga rak+ṣa huX phaṭa/ ces pa gnyis sbrel nas brgya rtsa brgyad —163—

bzlas te me tog 'thor/ de nas rjes brtan zhugs kyi bar 'dra/ ji ltar 'os par tshogs 'khor mtshon pa zhig med ka med yin/ de nas phyogs skyong gi gtor ma dang 'byung po spyi gtor btang nas mgron rnams gshegs gsol dang smon lam dang bkra shis bya'o/ /de tsam gyis rab tu gnas par 'gyur la/ dang po 'bri ba nas brtsams te rab gnas ma grub kyi bar la/ rang dang lha bris pa dang / chos 'di zhug pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid dam rab gnas byed mkhan ma gtogs shin tu gsang ba gal che'o/ /de nas kyang dam tshig dang mi ldan pas ma mthong ba dgos shing / phal cher la gsang ba rang legs so/ /'di dam tshig bris sku'i tshul yin/ byin rlabs che zhing 'phrin las dang rtags mtshan shin tu myur ba'i gnad yin la/ de min bris sku dkyus ma rab gnas can gyis kyang / dmigs rten sgrub rten rung tsam ni yin no/ /bris sku 'bri tshul gyi rim pa ste gnyis pa'o/ /༈ da ni 'khor lo 'bri tshul bshad par bya ste/ bri gzhi ni zhing chen la bkab pa'i ras sam dar ram so ras sogs 'byor na rab/ de min shog bu la gri khrag dang / dug gis cung zad byugs/ bya rog gi khrag dang / ro sol dang /bong bu'i chu dug khrag rnams cung zad bsres pa'i sna tsha dang / bya rog gi gshog ru'am mi rkang gi snyu gu byed par bshad pa/ de la dngos su 'grub na rab/ ma 'grub na rkang gi sbubs su snyu gu bcug pa'am/ snyu gu la rus pa de dag bcings pas kyang rung / zhes bla ma gsungs/ de nas 'khor lo dngos ni/ zlum skor gsum byed dgos pa las/ thog ma tshangs zur skam thig bzhi btab/ lte ba —164—

btsal nas ji ltar 'os par skor ba las/ gal te sor lnga bskor yod na/ sor gsum pa'i mtshams su gcig bskor/ dbus kyi g.yas g.yon du sor gcig gis mtshams su gcig bskor/ de rnams kyi phyi nang gang yang rung bar yi ge shong tsam gyi mu khyud re yang bskor/ dbus kyi nye bar yi ge 'bri tshul ni/ dgra mang po'am dmigs bsal med pa'i gnod byed spyi la byed na rim pa ltar sarba sha chun rgyal grong pa rnams ni bā/ ra ya zer ba lta bu dang / rdo rje gdan pa rnams kyi sarba sha chun ni bā ra ya zhes pa lta bu 'bri ste/ des gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre shes dgos/ dmigs bsal re re la byed nas sarba zhes pa mi 'bri ste/ sha chun tsan skyabs ni bā ra ya zhes pa lta bu 'bri/ des gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre/ de'i mtha' phaṭa gyi skor ba'am phaṭa gnyis kyi bar du bcug /dbus su ya gcig 'bri ba'ang yod/ lte ba'i mu 'phyud la oṃ kā la rū pa dgra bo che ge mo mā ra ya nā sha ya staX bha ya bha smi ku ru huX phaṭa/ ces pa bri ste/ re mig brgyad pa nang ma la yab kyi 'phreng sngags kyi phyed snga ma 'god dgos pa las kha cig spel tshig mi dgos zer/ rwa shar ba dang rgya stong sogs bar skabs kyi mang po zhig re re bzhin dgra bo ma ra ya phaṭa ces pa 'bri gsungs/ de yang 'gal ba cher med cung mi bde/ 'dir rwa 'bum sogs nas brgyud pa'i man ngag ni tshig lan gnyis gnyis yod pa rnams la bar du ming tsam spel ba ste/ dper na tru sa ya che ge mo t+yā sa ya zhes pa lta bu'o/ /lan gnyis ma zlos pa rnams la ming thog mar spel te/ che ge mo ru 'dir ar+ghaX ba zhes pa lta bu ste/ yab yum gnyis kar gyi 'khor lo'i re mig phyi brgyad —165—

nang brgyad kyi yi ge 'god tshul kun la de ltar nges par bya'o/ /rang lugs lag len 'di la byed de/ de yang dbus kyi yig mgo phyogs de shar/ g.yon lho/smad phyogs nub/ g.yas phyogs byang du byas pa'i shar du tra sa ya tra sa ya/ shar lhor a ka ju a ka ju/ lhor sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ lho nub tu ha na ha na/ nub tu da ha da ha/ nub byang du pa tsa pa tsa/ byang du ban+ta ban+ta/ byang shar du sgo oṃ zhes pa rnams la dbus su ming spel lo/ /mu khyud bar ba la snying po yi ge nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la spel tshig nang gi dang 'dra ba 'bri/ phyi'i re mig brgyad la/ shar du che ge mo tsak+ṣa badz+re ṇa sto ra pa dra ya/ shar lhor che ge mo spu tra pā lā ya/ lhor tshin+ta che ge mo tshin+ta/ lho nub tu bhan+ta che ge mo dhin+ta/ nub tu che ga mo thā kaX badz+re bā dang / nub byang du che ge mo tu dhi ra ar+ghaX pā/ byang du che ge mo ya mā ra ya/ byang shar du che ge mo badz+ra ya nā sha ya staX bha ya huX phaṭa ces pa 'bri/ mu khyud phyi ma la rtsa sngags kyi 'jug tu spel tshig snga ma bzhin bya/ de'i phyi rol du 'khor lo de nyid las gzhin rje'i lto bar chud pa 'bri/ dbus kyi yig mgo phyogs la sku stod yong ba byed/gdan pad nyi dang ma he mi dgos/ ro gang na tsam bya gsungs/ gdan mi byed pa'i srol yang 'dug go /yum gyi 'khor lo yang skor thig drug dang lte ba'i yi ge yang gzhan yab dang 'dra/ dbus su hra'am smoX'abri ba'ang yod/ re mig nang ma brgyad kyi shar du dhu na che ge mo dhu na/ shar lhor ban+ta che ge mo ban+ta/ lhor ma tha che ge mo ma tha/ lho nub tu pra ma tha che ge mo pra ma tha/ nub tu che ge mo huX dz+wa la/ nub byang du dz+wa ra che ge mo dz+wa re ṇa/ byang du che ge mo bye dhi/ byang shar du che ge mo ro ga ṇaX/ rim pa phyi ma'i —166—

shar du che ge mo nyid gdan shi baX/ shar lhor che ge mo yaX haX ri tshus ya/ lhor che ge mo a be sha ya/ lho nub tu che ge mo dzi baX hri da ya/ nub tu tshin+ta che ge mo tshin+ta/ nub byang du che ge mo bā du pa/ byang du che ge mo shi gh+ri mā ra ya/ byang shar du che ge mo na sha ya hūX phaṭa/ 'di'i mu khyud gsum ga la oṃ hriXtsa muṇ+ḍi dgra bo che ge mo mā ra ya nā sha ya staX bha ya bha smi ku ru hūX phaṭa/ ces pa kho na 'bri'o/ /'khor lo de lha mo tsa murnyi'i lto bar chud pa 'bri/ de yang gong bzhin ro gdan tsam mam gdan spang pa'o/ /yab yum gyi 'khor lo'i mu khyud dang re mig bcu drug po'i yi ge rnams drag po'i las la mgo nang bstan byed pa la rtsod pa med/ zhi rgyas dbang gsum sgrub na mgo phyi blta byed ces 'ga' zhig bzhed mod/ gzhan rje gshed kyi 'khor lo la de bzhin yin kyang / 'di las kyi tshi nin rje'i 'khor lo yin pa'i phyir las thams cad la yig mgo rnams nang bstan kho na byed ces bdag cag gi bla ma gsung ngo / /'on kyang 'khor lo 'di la brten nas las gsum po de dag sgrub pa med bsam na/ ma yin te dngos bstan gyi 'khor lo 'di kho na la yang / zhi ba'i nang tshan bsrung bzlog gnyis dngos su yod/ rgyas pa dang dbang gi las byed pas dngos su cung zad dkon kyang de dag gi bar chad bsrung ba dang bzlog pa la nges par 'jug pa yin no/ /bsad las kyi spel tshig ni gong bzhin yin la/ dbye bskrad rmong rengs kun la'ang mā ra ya zhes pa'i tshab tu de dang de'i spel tshig 'jug pa yin no/ /de'i tshe bris gzhi snag tsha la sogs pa yang bsgyur dgos te spyi dang 'dra'o/ /—167—

dngos bstan 'di min par man ngag gis lde bsgyur ba'i las gsum gyi 'khor lo ni 'chad par 'ar ro/ /yang bla ma skyo ba rnams kyi bzhed pa ni/ zlum skor rim pa gnyis la mu khyud re re byed/ de nas thig bzhi snol mar btab pas/ nang ma le tshe dgu dang phyi ma la brgyad yod pa de thig lhag po re re btab pas dkyil 'khor gyi gdung thig 'dra ba yi ge shong ba re byed/ nye ba gru bzhi la ma ma sha kru5 che ge mo zhes pa 'dri de'i mtha' phyogs bzhi'i gdung la ma ma sha krun mā ra ya zhes pa kho na 'bri tra sa ya la sogs pa sngags tshan brgyad po yang g.yon skor gyis 'bri ste phyi ma la'ang des rigs 'dre/ mu khyud gnyis ka la'ang yi ge 'god tshul ka gdung dang 'dra/yum gyi 'khor lo la re mig nang ma brgyad la a mu ka su huX na sogs sngags tshan brgyad po yongs rdzogs tshar re re 'bri/ phyi ma brgyad la nyi gdan sogs sngags shaṃ brgyad po yongs rdzogs tshar rer 'bri bar 'dod do/ /yang skyo ba kha cig ni yab yum gnyis kar la re mig nang ma brgyad po dkyus dang 'dra ba la khyad par ni g.yon bskor yin/ phyi ma brgyad yab yum mtshungs par tsak+ṣa sogs dang nyi ma sogs yongs rdzogs 'bri ba'i lugs kyang 'dug go /dbus kyi yi ge mgo yab kyi g.yon dang yum gyi g.yas la ston no/ /de dag ni phyi'i yig rigs dang dpe rigs sna tshogs mthong na/ the tshom za ba bzlog pa'i phyir dang lugs so so go ba'i phyir bkod pa yin gyi lag len du gdab bya ni dkyus kho na'o/ /de ltar 'khor lo bris ma thag rab gnas bya ste/sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas yo byin gyis brlabs/ bdag bskyed bum sgrub dang —168—

bcas pa sngon du 'gro bas/ 'khor lo la sbyang ba dang bgegs bskrad drag tu bya/phyir bsal ba sogs mi dgos/ las bum gyis khrus gsol bya/ 'khor lo bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las huX yig las byung pa'i bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su bhuX yig nag po las ji ltar bris pa dang mthun pa'i lcags khang sgo med khang mig bcu bdun pa/ dug dang me dang mtshone cha 'phar rgyug byed pas gang ba'o/ /de'i lte ba'i yig 'bru las gshin yab yum du bskyed/ gzhan sngags kyi yig 'bru rnams re re bzhin ya las byung ba'i gzhin rje dang / smyoX'am ma las byung ba'i gshin rje mo rnams cha lugs ma nges pa'am/ yang na las gshin yab yum nyid dang 'dra ba re bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ snying gar sa bon ya dang spyoXre bskyed/ de dag dus gcig tu gsal thebs pa dka' bas re re bzhin rim pas gsal 'debs kyi/ bris gzhi'i sku 'dra gnyis kyang sa bon las mi bskyed snying po lan bdun bdun gyis chos rgyal yab yum du bskyed/gnas gsum byin rlabs bya/ spro na mig tu cha sogs kyang 'god/ de nas ye shes pa chos rgyal yab yum phyi nang gnyis dang / gshin rje bye ba ther 'bum dang ma mo bye ba ther 'bum spyan drangs te bstim pa rnams dmigs pa shugs che la drag pas lan mang du bsgom/ bum chus gtor zhing dbang bskur/ dbang rtags rdo rje nag po rtse lnga 'ba' zhig yin/ skabs 'dir dam rdzas kyi gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la phul/ mchod bstod dang las bcol rgyas par byas/ lha rnams zhu ba las/ yig 'brur gyur ces zhal bsgyur/ bris gzhi'i lha bsgyur mi dgos/su pra tiṣ+ṭha dang ye dhar dang nye snying po'i rtsa sngags rnams brgya rtsa sogs gang mang —169—

dang / 'khor lo gnyis kyi sngags kyang nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bzlas te/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad nas 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i byin rlabs thams cad gshin rje yab yum gyi rtsa sngags kyi rnam par spyan drangs nas 'khor lo'i sngags la yang yang bstim/ me tog nag po yang yang 'thor ro/ /me tog kyang sngon bris sku bzhin bsgrubs na legs par mngon mtshams 'dir mchod bstod brtan byed yig brgya dang smon lam bkra shis re bya/ de nas bsgrub bya'i ming yig rnams bris la bsgrub bya dngos su bskyed/ bden bdar dang dgug gzhug drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor chog chen mo bzhin lan mang du bya/ hiXgiX'am ya ma rā jo'i mthar/ gshin rje yab yum gyi snying po btags la dgra bo 'di zhes bya ba a kar+ṣa ya dzaXdzaXzhes btags pa drug cu tsam dang / dgra bo 'di zhes bya ba 'go ba'i lha dang bi khyu shā ya hūṃ phaṭa ces pa drug cu tsam ban+ta ban+ta dang stam bha ya zhes btags pa'ang drug cu tsam bzlas zhags pas bcings/ rdo rje rgya gram gyis mnan btson srung rnams kyis bskor bar bsam/ slar yang gtor ma dang mchod pa phul nas re zhig 'jog pa'am yang na de ma thag lteb rtsis byas kyang rung ngo / /de'i tshul ni 'og tu 'a ho do/ /ska ni na rje pho mo'am spyon pa pho mo'i 'bor lo 'bri tshul gyi rim pa ste gsum pa'o/ /da ni bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rim pa rnams bshad par bya'o/ /de la dang por bsnyen pa la dbye na rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa dang / nye ba'i bsnyen pa gnyis yod/ dang po ni bsnyen pa rang dang bsnyen pa tsam po dang bsnyen pa chung ngu dang bsnyen rkyang dang rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa dang gzhi'i bsnyen pa rnams don gcig ming gi —170—

rnam grangs so/ /de yang dam tshig bris sku sngar yod na legs/ nges par dgos pa ni min/ der ma zad bris 'bur dkyus ma tsam gyi rten bshams thub na ni legs/ med kyang chog ste/ gnas dben par mchod gtor bsham/ gtor ma 'dzin gtor du bya/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas brtsam rjes chog gi mthar thug par gtor chog tu bshad pa'i skabs bzhin yin pa las/ rten gzhan med kyang 'dzin gtor nyid rten yin pas bsnyen pa ma grol bar mdun bskyed yab yum gshegs gsol mi byed/ 'khor dang mgron rnams gshegs/ thun phyi ma rnams la yang lha sku snga ma 'od gsal du bcug nas slar bskyed pa yin pas 'don pa bsgyur ba mi dgos so/ /gang ltar yang nye snying yi ge bdun pa la 'khru 'bum byed/ bsnyen rdzogs dngos snying po la 'bum phrag gsum bzla bar bshad do/ /nye bsnyen gyi sngags sam rtsa sngags grangs bsnyen du byed na 'bum phrag gcig bzla/ bsnyen pa chung ja'i skabs rtsa sngags dang 'phreng ba'i sngags la grangs bsnyen ma bskyal kyang rung bas thun gyi mjug tu cung zad re ka bzlas pas khyab bo/ /yi dam gyi sngags spyir grangs med tshad med du bzla dgos shing khyad par du yang bye ba gcig nas lnga'i bar bzla bar gsungs pa sgrib sbyong dang tshogs gsog dang dngos grub dang las tshogs mtha' dag gi rgyu yin no/ /bka' srung 'jig rten 'das pa 'di kun yang de dang phyogs mtshungs tsam spyir yin mod kyang tshul ston dbang gis de tsam du bzla ba dgos pa chung zhing / 'khu ldog mang pos mtha' med du bzla mi dgos la/ bsnyen pa'i skabs 'dir sngar gyi de tsam la rtags med na nyis —171—

'gyur ram gsum 'gyur ram bzhi 'gyur gyi bar du bzlas zhing rtags kyang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yi dam gyi sngags ni dus rtag tu ci nus su bzla dgos pa yin pas de gnyis cung zad mi 'dra'o/ /yi dam gyi bsnyen pa sngon du ma song na 'di'i bsnyen pa byar mi rung / yi dam ni thob thang gi skyon rje gshed gang la brten kyang mchog yin mod/ spyir khro bo'i rgyal po gzhan la brten kyang mi rung ba ni ma yin no/ /mngon spyod kyi las mtha' byas pa dang / g.yin la 'di nyid kyi dbang rjes gnang byas pa dang / sngar ma thob pa'i mi la 'di'i sgrub thabs lag len bstan pa sogs kyis byin rlabs kyi bkrag mdangs ci rigs pa re yal 'gro bas/slar bsnyen pa kha gso cung zad re byed dgos so/ /de ltar rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa song nas las gshin dgos kyi'am yi dam dang sbrags pa'i sbyin sreg lnga stong ngam khri tsam 'bul/ de bas mang ba rang mi dgos/ gtor chen gcig dang gtor chung mang du bshams nas gtor ma brgya tshar stong tshar sogs 'bul lo/ /spyir 'di nyid chos skyong gi gtso bor byed na bsnyen pa dang nye bsnyen skabs skabs su bskyar gyin byas na shin tu legs so/ /de nas dus skabs gzhan la nye bsnyen byed na dam tshig bris sku 'grub par byas nas bla ma dkon mchog mchod cing /nang gtor phul nas gsol ba btab/ yig brgya bshags pa sogs bya/ yul lha bzhi bdag la gtor ma btang / bgegs bskrad cing tho btsigs/ de'i steng du srung ba'i don du las kyi gshin rje ral gri thogs pa bzhugs par gyur/sngags mang du bzlas/ me tog gtor gu gul bdug /'dir brgyud pa gong ma —172—

nus pa brnyes pa rnams kyi myong grub zhal gdams la/ spyir yang bod yul 'dir bsnyen sgrub byed pa la rgyal bsen the'u rang dang bcas pa la klu'i rgyab skyor ba 'di ka bar chad che zhing / dgos su las skyon nag po bsgrubs pa las pe dkar gyi 'khor rnams kyi bar chad gtong bas/ de dag la dmigs nas bgegs gtor glud sogs rgya cher tsam bto ngo / kho ra'i sger gyi gtor chog byas nas 'brel chung nas bar chad gtong du 'gro bas mi bya/ kho la dmigs nas sil gtor bgegs gtor spyi'i cho ga rang byed/ bgegs gtor bskyar gyin btang na kho yang bskyar nas log yong bas yang yang mi byed/ lan cig po de sngags grangs mang la dmigs pa gang gsal byed/ skrod pa'i tshe yang sngags dang dmigs pa drag la yun ring bas mtshams gcod dgos so/ /de rjes mtshams bsdams sgrub khang gi nang du bris sku lho la zhal gzigs pa'i mdun du rang nyid kha byang bstan nam/ yang de go ldog na yang bzang / rang dang bris sku gdong thad yong ba gcig byed dgos/ go skabs mi bde na kha blta phyogs la khyad tsam med/ rtags kyi gtor ma kha zas bzang tshad las byas shing dam rdzas kyis brgyan pa rul mi 'gro ba cig thod pa'am lcags snod du bshams/dar nag gam ras nag gi bkab bo/ /de'i drung du mchod yon rak+ta lag bur dang tsha ba gsum dang tsha sna btang pa zhig kyang bshams te kha gcod do/ /bris sku'i mdun du 'dzin gtor sha khrag gis brgyan pa dang mchod pa bshams thun gtor re yang bya ste thun thams cad la 'grub na rab/ de tsam ma lcogs na srod thun la phul kyang rung mod/ skya rengs shar ba'i dus su phul na bzang ba yin —173—

no/ /skabs 'dir bzlas pa ni rtsa sngags nyid nye bsnyen gyi sngags su gsungs pa'i phyir gtso bor de bzla dgos la/ sngags thung g.yin gnyis ji ltar rigs pa bzla/ yum gyi sngags ni rtsa sngags ji tsam song ba de'i phyed tsam bzla ba yin no/ /spyir 'phreng sngags la bsnyen pa ma song yang 'khor lo sgrub tu mi rung ba ma yin mod/ /bsnyen pa song na las myur ba la shin tu gal che ba gcig kyang yod do/ /de ltar na rab tu 'phreng sngags gnyis po 'bum phrag gcig /'bring du khri phrag bzhi/ ma mtha' la khri tsam gyis kyang rung ngo / /gtor chog dkyus ma de song ba'i skabs rtags kyi gtor ma'i khebs bsal/ kha gsos/ nang mchod kyis bran/ byin rlabs rgyas pa bya/ rtags byung na 'bul lo zhes byas nas de ma thag khebs bkab/ yi dam gyi snying po dang rak+ta'i sngags kyi bsrung ba bya/ rak+ta'i ar+ghaX la yang de dang 'dra/ rtags ni dang por mi nag po dang rgyal po dmag dpon dpa' bo'i rigs dang go mtshon can dang kla klo dang brnyi nag po dang / tshom po dang shan pa sogs yab kyi cho 'phrul la 'ong / ma sring dang bud med dang / mtsho chen po dang chu bo rgyug pa dang / khrag mtsho sogs yum gyi cho 'phrul yin/ mun nag dang mi dang rlung 'tshub sogs gnyis ka'i cho 'phrul la 'ong / mdze sbrang dang hrul po hrul mo sogs sel gyi ltas yin pas yig brgya dang bshags pa bya/ rad rod can dang na ba'i rnam pa 'dug na grib kyi phog pa yin pas khrus gsol sogs byed/ 'bag seng dang me chen dang rgyal po sgra dang thog 'tshig pa dang / sa 'gul ba dang / sgo srog pa dang / bya gdug pa can dang gcan gzan sogs ni rtags dang bar chad gnyis ka la 'ong bas/ rjes shes la brtags na shes —174—

dgos/ spyir bsrung bzlog drag tu byas pas rtags yin na gong 'phel la 'gro/bar chad yin na sangs 'gro/ mthar rtags rab bris sku bzhad pa dang / dngos su mthong ba yin kyang deng sang phal che ba la 'byung ba dkon/ gong gi de rnams rang la 'dud pa dang / shin tu dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur byed pa dang / ma he la bzhon nas rgyug pa sogs yin par grags/ rmi lam du zhal mthong gi rnam pa rab rib 'byung ba yang srid/ zhu ba can phyag 'tshal ba dang / ma sring gzugs dang / chas gos phun sum tshogs pa'am bud med nag mo phyag 'tshal ba byung na nges pa can du byed/ sngags kyi rtags gtor dang rak+ta mchod yon du phul nas yi dam gyi sngags drag tu bzla ba dang / mna' bkag dam la bzhag /las sbyor drag tu bya'o/ /gtang rag rgya chen po tshogs 'khor byed pa yang gal che/ de nas rjes bsdus te/ de ma thag gam dus gzhan du'ang rung ste drag las kyi sgrub pa la 'jug go /bsnyen pa dang nye bsnyen ji ltar sgrub pa'i rim pa ste bzhi pa'o/ /da ni sgrub pa la 'jug pa bshad par bya'o/ /de yang ye shes lha'i sgrub pa ma yin/ drag po mngon spyod bsad las kyi sgrub pa'o/ /skabs 'dir bsgrub bya de'i brten skyob kyi lha rnams kyis bar chad 'chad rtsom nyen che/ de las gzhan pa'i lha 'dres dkyus ma'i bar chad 'gyung nyen chung ngo / /nye bsnyen gyi skabs bzhin sngon 'gro dge ba'i dpung rnams bya/ rgyal 'gong la bgegs gtor gtong ba'i dod du bsgrub bya'i gsang sde rnams bgegs gtor spyin/ bgegs bskrad drag tu gzir zhing de ma thag bsrung 'khor sgom pa gal che/ nyi phyed yan la yig brgya bzla ba dang / de man chad mngon rtogs sgom ste/ yi dam gyi sngags —175—

drag tu bzla/ de lta bu zhag gsum sogs ji ltar 'os pa'i rigs la sngar ma bsags na rdzas rnams bsags shing 'khrul 'khor skabs 'dir nges par 'bri'o/ /de yang 'khor lo'i rgyu rnams la sbyang ba bya/ khrus chus gtor/ mchod rdzas la sogs pa rdzas kyi rigs gzhan rnams la'ang de bzhin du byed/ rdzas kyi gtso bo thod pa mtshan ngan la/ yi ge mang po na dum bu gcig gam gnyis pa la zer ba 'dug kyang / gzhung yi ge ma dag pa bklags pas phyis gsal byed/byas pa kun kyang ma dag go /des na dpe rnying 'ga' las dum bu drug gam brgyad pa las zhes 'byung ba ltar bya ste/ dum bu brgyad drug gnyis rang bzhin gyis mtshan ngan yin cing gcig pa dang gnyis pa mtshan ngan nyung bas so/ /thod pa de'i 'breg mtshams cung zad mtho ba dpral ba dang / ltag khung gi kha la thig btang ste gras bdar legs par byas/ chu dron gyis mi 'khrur/ ma thod rnyan gyi phyogs la gshin rje'i dbu phyag gi rnam pa rang grub yod pa ste/ gong 'khor lo 'bri ba'i rdzas kyis skya ris gsal btab/ tshon rtsi rnams la dug bsreg la gzhan rje nyid kyi sngags mang du bzlas te tshon rngam 'jigs kyi rnam pa yong bar bya/ de la pra tshil mnan no/ /'grub na pra tshil ma mnan gong du sku de'i spyi bor nye snying dang / mtha' skor du rtsa sngags/ zhal dang phyag la oṃ kwa la rū pa sha nan na ma rbad ru lu ru lu sbyo dzaXru lu tshal pa ya ni to sha ru ni nan mā ra ya nan oṃ zhes pas bri/ gal te zhal dbye 'di ma 'byor na thod pa mawo ngan pho thod mo thod kha sbyor du byung na'ang nus pa che bar 'ong wo pho thod kha sbyor dang / mo thod kha sbyor yang wo tsam yin no/ /—176—

zhal dbye yod pa'i dbang du byas te ka pā la'i rgya srub ma rnams la rja sa snga ma ltar gyis snying po dang rtsa sngags dang yum gyi snying po rnams drag po'i spel tshig can 'dra/ ya thod ma thod gnyis kar gyis dbus su dug khrag gi ya chen po re 'bri/ ya ma rwa dza spel tshig can gyi mtha' skor la 'bri zhes gsung sgros las 'byung ste/ sngags 'di yi dam gyi sngags su byed pa dang / 'jig rten gshin rje'i sngags su byed pa gnyis las 'dir phyi ma ltar yin no/ /bsad las la spel tshig dgos pa thams cad du bshad tshod thob thang mā ra ya zhes pa kho nas chog kyang / da ltar lag len du de tsam gyis rnon po mi yod pas trig nan e hur thum dzaXmā ra ya hūX phaṭa ches 'bri ba las myur ba'i man ngag yin/ mthu mkhan 'ga' zhig bring shag ces sogs kyi mtha' rten 'dzug pa'ang 'dug /nus pa yong 'phro yin zer ro/ /'on kyang de ni rbad sngags dang 'brel gyi/ 'khor lo dang 'brel ba ma yin no/ /zhes bdag gi bla ma gsung ngo / /'khor lo shin tu rno bar 'dod na mjug tu lha srin gang la gtod par 'dod pa'i lha 'dre de sde brgyad gang yin brtags nas de'i srog snying spel tshig dang bcas pas skor/ ya ma rā dza adz+nyā pa ya ti rbad ces pa bar bar du spel ba lag len man ngag yin/ de nas shog bu la rdzas sngags bzhin gyis dgra bo'i ling ga spyi dang mthun pa la/ snying gar ming gi mthar yab kyi nye snying dang / yum sngags kyi mthar spel tshig can gyis bskor/phyi'i rma/tha' skor du snying po dang rtsa sngags dang yum sngags spel tshig can gyis bskor bar bya/ 'khor lo dngos gzhi'i ming yig bsgrub bya'i zag rdzas kyis byug —177—

pa byung kyang legs/ ma byung kyang cho ga ling ga 'di la zag rdzas lnga po gang rung gcig med kha med dgos/ des dang por mi 'khyam/ bar du bla 'khor/ mthar bla mi 'bros pa'i dgos pa'o/ /de la 'brub khang du dgug gzhug drag po lan mang du byas/ yab yub gyi sngags gnyis la dgug gzhug/ gi sngags btags pa yang lan mang du byas nas/ 'khor lo'i gsham gyi phyogs su mgo bstan te 'khor lo gnyis kyi bar du bcug /ling ga'i snying kha na yod pa'i sngags dang 'khor lo gnyis kyang lto bar sbyor bar bya/ lag pa bde bas yi ge phra zhing 'khor lo chung na ma bltabs pa dam rtsis sbyar te kha sbyor 'grigs sor bzhag pas legs blta'i tshigs dgos pa byung na brang thum zer ba'i bsteb tshigs de byed/de yang yab gtsor che bas phyi nang gi bltab lugs ma nor ba yab 'khore la byas pas mdun blteb yin/ yum 'khor la phyi klog dang rgyab bstan shugs la 'ong /'khor lo'i rgyab steng dang / sug bzhi 'og tu yong ba'i rtsis kyi steng 'og mi 'khrul ba'i rtags btab nas drag po'i dkris spyi dang mthun par bya/ yang blteb tshigs ma byas kyang dkris ni dgos/ mo 'khor 'og dang pho 'khor steng du bya/ de rjes lag len lugs gcig la thod pa rdzas ngan sa bsob kyi 'ol spyi bkang ba'i steng du 'khor lo bzhag lte ba'i yig mgo dpral ba'i phyogs su bstan/ 'khor lo la rgyu mnga' mi rus sam mi lpags kyi srad bu btags/dpral ba'i phyogs nas bton/ 'khor lo'i steng du yang rdzas than thun 'grems/yang lag len lugs gzhan la 'khore lo blteb tshigs byas pa de ling ga'i snying gar gzhug /ling ga'i rgyu yang dgra bo zag rdzas bsres te 'jim pa'am bag —178—

zan la byed/ de yang dang po ling ga khog stong bcos la skam/ der 'khor lo bcug ste kha sgrib bo/ /de'i snying kha'am nye ba'i thad du ag tshe khung yong ba bya/ de la mthun lam btod nas thun 'debs pa'i lugs kyang yod/ de gnyis gang ltar yang de nas ma thod gshin rje'i gzugs kyi steng nas bkab thod pa'i phyi nas ro skra dang rgyu ma srad bu sngo nag gis rgya gram ris su thod pa phyed mthong tsam du bsdam/ bden stobs dang drag sngags mang du brjod/ sha chen dang gu gul gyis bdugs/ yungs kar yungs nag bsres la bsrung ba byas te bzhag go /sgrub pa'i dus kha lta phyogs la spyir gzhan rje lho phyogs na gnas pas lho la lta zer de/ kha cig spyir btang ba de ltar yin yang rtog pa 'di'i lugs kyi byad du lta dgos zer/ gzhan dag 'di lho phyogs kho na'i gzhin rje ma yin/dbus kyi gshin rje yin pas lta phyogs la nges pa med/ dgra gang yod kyi phyogs la lta zer/ 'on kyang 'di ltar go bar bya ste/ drag las spyi'i cho ga la dgos par lhor bltas kyang rung / dmigs pa gsal ba'i phyir dgra phyogs la bltas kyang chog pa yin cing / kha lta phyogs 'di dag sgrub pa po gtso che'am/ mdun skyed gtso che zhe na/ gzhan dag sna tshogs 'chad kyang rang lugs sgrub pa po gtso che'o/ /des na sngar bzhin bris sku yod na dkyil 'khor la sogs pa mi dgos/bris sku med na gru gsum mthing nag phyag mtshan bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor 'bri/rang dang bris sku'i bar du 'brub khung blos bslangs khru gang las mi chung ba zhig bya/ bris sku'i mdun du gtor ma sha khrag snying la sogs pas brgyan pa dang drag —179—

po'i mchod rdzas spyi mthun las mi rta khyi gsum gyi sha khrag dang ra nag nya sprul rnams kyi sha dang sbyar ba'i mchod pa dang / tshil chen gri khrag nya skam ra nag gi dbang po lnga rnams sres pa'i gu gul gyi bdug sbos rnams dgos/ skam thun rlon thun spyi dang mthun par bshams shing sgrub lugs kyang 'dra/ sngags ni rtsa sngags kyi mthar kā la rū pa k+ṣaX ma dug tsa tsa tshal pa rbad rbad ma dug k+ṣaX ya la k+ṣaX zhes pa'o/ /cho ga'i rim pa ni mchod bstod kyi bar gong dang 'dra ba las/ bzlas pa'i mgo mjug gnyis car du gtor bsngo re byed/ 'grub na gtor chung la sogs re bya/ de ma lcogs na gtor ma che ba kha gsos pas kyang chog /'khor lo gnyis dang ya thod ma thod gshin rje yab yum dang 'brub khug lcags khang du sgom/zhes 'dod pa dang / thod pa ril po lcags khang du 'dod pa gnyis yod mod/cung zad mi bde bas zhal dbye yin na 'brub khung du ya thod skyon rje'i pho brang zhal dbye dang 'khor lo gzhin rje yab yum du bskyed/ ya thod kha sbyor yin na 'brub khung du thod pa dang bcas pa gzhal yas khang du bskyed kyang chog /yang na 'brub khung gzhal yas khang dang thod pa gnyis 'khor lo dang bcas pa yongs rdzogs yab yum du bskyed kyang rung ba yin no/ /skyed chog mdun skyed ma dang mnyam du byas pas yong / ling ga dang ming yig bsgrub bya dngos su mos dgos/gtor chog dang bzlas pa'i bar du ling ga la dmigs nas dgug gzhug mang du bya/ yab kyi nye snying gi mthar dgra bo che ge mo ak+ṣa ya dzaXdzaXbla srog thams cad n-i dza dza zhes btags pa brgya nyi shu tsam dang / snying po dang rtsa sngags gang —180—

rung gcig la sngags de btags pa drug cu tsam dang / cig shos la stong phrag sogs gang mang du yum gyi snying po la'ang de dang mtshungs/ mjug tu 'phreng sngags la spel tshig sbyar ba nyer gcig tsam bzla/ de nas yang gtor bsngo byas te/ mjug tu rjes chog rnams bya ba yin kyang las sbyor ma tshar bar du 'khor dang gtor mgron tsho yang dbang po'i tshul du bzhugs pa yin gyi gshegs gsol mi byed de/ de ltar na thun gsum mam bzhi la sogs pa bya/ de 'dra zhag gsum mam bdun gyi bar byas pas khugs pa'i rtags 'byung ste spyi dang 'dra/ de nas kyang mi 'bros par bya ba'i phyir dgug gzhug bcings mnyes mang du byed pa gal che ste zhag gcig gnyis gsum gang rung bya'o/ /de nas bzung thun mtshams su ag rtse khung sngags kyi shog ril gyis bkag /de tshun la thun bsgrub par bya yi brdeg mi dgos/ 'di nas bzung rdeg go /sbrags sgrub kyi skabs 'dir yab yum kyi sngags bzla mkhan so sos byed par bshad pa/ cig yod kyang sgrub pa po gcig nyid kyis sngags gnyis ka bzla ba ka da lta'i lag len la bde bar 'ong / mi mang pos bsgrubs na yang thams cad kyis gnyis kas bzla ba la brtson par bya'o/ /cho ga'i rim pa g.yin 'dra ba las snga gtor song ba'i rjes la dgug gzhug tshar gsum byas nas thod pa'i dpral ba'i khung mtshams nas bton pa'i srad bu de la drag po'i gzungs thag btags te bzung / mang pos bsgrubs na'ang gzungs thag mi gcig pa re re dgos so/ /bsad sngags dang bcas pa'i sngags thams cad tshar gcig brjod/de nas mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs las pho nya dpag tu med pa spros/—181—

snyen ra lo'i gzhin rje yab yum zhal sprod du yod pa'i zhabs gnyis kyi bar mtshams su sgrub bya de spyi bo tshugs sam/ gan rkyal du 'dug pa la bsad las mdzad par bsams te nye snying dang yum gyi snying po brgya rtsa re'i mthar bsad sngags btags/ snying po dang rtsa sngags gnyis so/ /gang rung gcig la bsad sngags btags pa 'phreng skor tsam dang / cig shos la yum gyi sngags btags/de la bsad sngags btags pa stong phrag sogs ji ltar 'os par bzla/ bsad sngags ni nā sha ya staX bha ya mā ra ya hūX phaṭa ces pa dang 'khor lo la 'bri ba'i trig nan sogs kyang yin/ 'phreng ba'i sngags la ྅spyin zhes pa'i gnas su bsgrub bya'i ming 'jug pa ma gtogs bsad sngags la sogs pa mi dgos te rang shugs kyis yod pa'i phyir ro/ /'phreng ba'i sngags bzla ba'i tshul la nyin par yab kyi sngags gtso bor bzla ste/ nyin phyed yan la oṃ kā la rū pa ya sha trun che ge mo tru sa ya nas tsu r+ṇa tsu r+ṇa huX phaṭa ces pa dang / dgongs phyogs oṃ kā la rū pa ya sha trun che ge mo tsak+ṣa badz+re ṇa zhes pa nas/ staX bha ya huX phaṭa ces pa bzla/ gshin rje'i pho nya gtso bor gyur pa'i dmag tshogs kyis dgra bo bsad bcad kyi las byed par bsam/mthar yum gyi 'phreng sngags bdun tsam re bzla'o/ /srod thun gyi skabs hriXtsa murdzi ye sha trun che ge mo dhu na dhu na nas bya dhi ro ga ṇaX phaṭa/ ces pa bzla/ tho rangs hriXtsa mu khyu sha chun che ge mo nye ga na shaX paṃ ces pa nas/ na sha ya huX phaṭa kyi bar bzla/ mjug tu yab kyi 'phreng sngags bdun tsam re yang bzla'o/ /gshin rje mo gtso bor gyur pas dgra bo bsad bcad kyi las mdzad par bsam/ nye —182—

snying gi skabs su thun mi 'debs/ sngags gzhan rnams kyi skabs su 'brub khung gi phyi la ma bo bar thod pa la thun brdegs te/ pho sngags la skam thun dang mo sngags la rlon thun sngags de dang de la thun sgrub kyi sngags dang ha la ha la lcoXdang trag rak+ṣa sbyoXbatags pas brdeg go /skabs de dag ci rigs par gu gul gyis bdug cing lha dbye ba'i dmigs pa bya yi/ gzhan lha dbye mi dgos par grags/ ci ste byed na gshin rje gshed kyi 'khrul 'khor chen mo dang 'dra bar bya'o/ /'dir cho ga'i yan lag la med kha med min kyang nyin phyed kyi thun la drag po'i sbyin sreg re 'bul thub na'ang legs so/ /de ltar bsgrubs pas zhag bdun nam zla phyed nyer gcig tshun la bsad rtags nges par 'ong ngo / /bsad rtags ni spyi dang 'dra ba las/mi nag pho mos dgra bsad pa dang glo snying mchin pa ster mkhan byung zhing zos pa rmi na nges can du byed do/ /da ni 'di dpyad de bca' gzhi'i skabs su rgya ston gyis bzhed pas/ zhal dbye ma thod 'og tu byas/ ya thod kyis steng nas 'geb par bzhed pa ni/ zhal dbye'i skabs bris lang la thun thebs pa gcig dgos pa la/ ag tse khung kha 'og tu bstan na de mi rung ba dang / zhal dbye spyi'i lugs dang yang 'gal bas de mi legs so/ /'bri khung dpal 'dzin sbrags sgrub kyi skabs 'dir rab tu ma thod pho mo gnyis/ 'bring du ma thod gang rnyed gnyis kha sbyor byed/ tha ma ka pā la kha sbyor yin/ yab rkyang du sgrub pa kho na la ya thod ma thod kha sbyor byed/ sbrags sgrub la de mi byed par 'dod do/ /de mi 'thad de spyir thod pa kha spyor rkyang sgrub —183—

sbrags sgrub thabs thams cad la rung mod kyang ma thod kha sbyor byed pa 'di zhal dbye spyi'i lag len dang 'gal zhing / rtog pa las thod pa'i nang du 'jug par bshad pa la ka pā la med na ma thod kho na la thod pa'i tha snyad mi 'jug pa'i phyir dang / sbrags sgrub kyi skabs gong gi thod par bcug par bya zhes rkyang sgrub kyi skabs la kha 'phangs mdzad skabs der rgya srub la yi ge 'bri ba dang ban+ta sro bar mug da na ma thod la de gnyis ka mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /thod ngan kyi nus pa ni gtso bor ka pā la la yod pa yin pas/ de bor na thod ngan 'bad pas btsal ba don med du 'gro lags/ de bzhin du dpal 'dzin ni 'phreng ba'i sngags bzlas na las 'gyang ba myong bas grub gsungs na yang khong rang gi de la bsnyen pa ma mdzad pa'am/ sngags ma dag pa las byung ba yin gyi/ 'khor lo'i sngags bzlas pas las 'gyangs pa min no/ /sngags thung rnams la bsnyen pa song / 'phreng sngags la ma song na 'khor lo la bkod pa'i sngags rnams ched gtad bzla ba mi rung yang bsnyen pa song na 'khor lo'i sngags bzlas pa nyid ches myur ro/ /rtsa sngags gnyis po'i yang phyed snga mas dregs pa las la bsdu/ phyed phyi mas gtor zhing las la 'gyed pa'o/ /de ltar sgrub pa lag tu blang ba'i rim pa ste lnga pa'o/ /da ni las ‘5 sbyor ba bshad par bya ste/ gsang rtags byung ba nas las la sbyor te/ sngar gyi sgrub pa'i 'phros de la ka byed dgos kyi/ bar mtshams chod na mi rung ngo / /skabs der bzheng pa'am snga nas yod kyang rung ste grog mkhar la sogs pa bdun gyis so dang ro sol dang dug khrag sna tshogs bsres pa'i sa la —184—

gshin rje'i gzugs rgyun du ji ltar sgom pa dang mthun pa gcig bya/ gzugs 'di la yab rkyang dang sbrags sgrub la khyad med/ gshin rje pho kho nas chog /de yang pho gtso bo yin pa'i gnad kyis kyang yin/ 'khor lo la bgo bsha' dang thod pa la bgo bsha' byar mi rung ba dang / yum gyi skur bzhengs kyang nang bzhugs 'jug rgyu med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /sku de gsar du bzhengs pa yin na skabs 'dir bris sku dang mthun par rab gnas bya'o/ /de nas sku de'i lto bar sngar gyi thod pa kha sbyor gzhug /sku'i rgyab tu thun khung la thun lam btod/thod pa nyid la 'bab par bya/ de yang ag tse khung gi nang ngam spyi bo'i steng gang rung la yong ba byed/ dmar gtor chen po gcig bsham/ bsang gtor yin yang las ma grol bar 'dzin gtor dang 'dra/ cho ga'i rim pa sngar dang mthun/thun brdeg pa'i tshe rang nyid yi dam gyi nga rgyal brtan pos sku gzugs kyi rgyab tu 'ongs nas lcags thur sogs kyis blangs nas thun khung du bsdig par bya'o/ /yang na rnying ma ba 'ga' lag ko gyon nas rdeg pa ltar byas kyang rung ngo / /thun mtshams su gtor ma rgyas par bshams/ byin rlabs kyi rjes la dgra bgegs dgug gzhug bya/ 'debs kha dang bsgral chog dmigs pa dang ngag tu bya/dngos su phur bu 'debs pa sogs mi dgos/ de nas gtor 'bul dang bcol gtad drag po bya/ 'dzin gtor rgul bskyod mi btang bar/ thun gtor gsar pa de zor du 'phen par bya'o/ /dmigs pa ni rang nyid yi dam ri rab tsam gyi mdun du gzugs brnyan de srid pa thams cad khong du chud pa'i gshin rje dngos yi dam gyi sku'i phyed tsam du sleb pa 'jig rten gyi khams sam 'dzam bu'i gling lto —185—

bar chud pa zhig bsgom/ 'brub khung nam mkha'i khams su mos/ gshin rje de'i lto bar ka pā la skyon rje'i grong khyer gyi nang du/ zhal dbye yod na de dang 'khor lo gshin rje yab yum nyid du mos pa'i zhabs 'og tu ling ga de bsgrub byar mos/ de zhabs 'og tu mnan pas bu dgu nas khrag 'dzag cing lus shig pa dang gcig /mtshon cha dang dbyug pa brgyab pas zhig pa dang gnyis/ 'khor lo pho nya pho mo 'jigs su drang ba rnams dang bya dang gcan gzan sna tshogs kyis bsad cing zos pa dang gsum/ gshin rje yab yum nyid kyis chom chom du gsol ba dang bzhi/ srid gsum khyab pa'i gshin rje'i sku'i nang nas pho nya drag gtum nang du spros/ 'khor lo'i phyogs bcu nas bskor te bsad las mdzad pa dang lnga/ dug dang khrag phab pas zhig cing rus bar byas pa dang drug /phyogs bcu nas ma 'bar bas thal bar byas pa dang bdun te/ de rnams rim can rim can du bskyar gyin yang yang bsgom/ sngags kyi sham bu zhal shes ni/ ni mā ra ya snu ma ra du ya ma snying ya ma khrag tshal pa bam rim dum bu dum bu rbad/ ces pa sngar gyi bsad sngags thams cad kyi 'jug tu gdags/ dri can sogs mi dgos/ nyin re bzhin nam thun bzhir phyi gtor grol mtshams ling chung re bsgral te gtor ma dang sbyin sreg btang/ de ltar zhag gcig gam gsum mam lnga'am bdun du bya/ de las lhag pa nam yang mi dgos/ nyer dgu lta bus dus rtsub mo'am/ mig mar dar ba sogs gza' skar rtsub po gang rung la rbad nas bzang bar grags shing / yang gcig tu gza'i tshes gtso mi che/ rang nyid dmigs pa gsal zhes zhe sdang skye ba'i dus der las la sbyar bas chog go /—186—
