gza' skar drag po la ling ga bsgral/ te lo'i sha khrag rus gsum bsres/ thab nang du dbang phyug chen po'i bskyed la sngags 'bru bcu bdun pa la/ bcu gnyis pa btags te sbyin bsreg phul/ 'di la sbogs chog dang yang chog gi 'khor lo sogs yod kyang lag len la gcig tu nges par dgos pa'ang min/ sngags kyis rkyal pa 'khor lo dang bcas pa de ka spyin sreg tu 'bul ba nyid spogs chog yin/ 'di dang gshin rje'i 'khor lo chen mo sbrel lugs kyang shes dgos so/ /da ni 'khor bdag po gshin rje gshod kyi drug cu rtsa bzhi'i sde thung du sbyor bas gtor bzlog gi cho ga ni 'di yin te/dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyogs gang yang rung ba zla gam sngon po'i dkyil 'khor du chos 'byung gru gsum dmar nag de'i dbus su mi ro la dbyug to gnas pa zhig 'bri/ chos 'byung gi rtse mo'i phyogs su gtor ma nor bu mig gsum gyi gzugs can cig dang / mdun du 'phen gtor thog lde'i dbyibs can dug khrag gis byug pa 'god/ drag po'i mchod gtor gyis g.yon skor du bskur/bsham bkod rnams snga rol nas sdeb gcig la bya/ de'i phyir mchod gtor byin rlabs rgyas pa yang dkyus kyi de kas chog /rtsa ba'i gtor ma bsngo ba'i rjes sam/ drug cu rtsa bzhi phul grub mtshams las kyi gshin rje'i snga phyi gang rung du sbyar kyang rung ste/ 'bru gsum gyis mchod pa byin rlabs kha gsos/ skye( shu/ n+ya ta zhes pa nas/ bzlas pa'i bar gong bzhin/ de la bzlas pa ni snying po'i sngags thung la/ e a ṇa sogs btags/ de la mahā de bā e dza sogs btags pa ste/bod rbad sbrel pa ci 'os pa bzlas/ de rjes mchod bstod zhig byas nas/ legs ldan lha'i mgon po de nyid las kyi srin po mi bzad pa dbang phyug chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas mi mgo rlon pas mchon pa'i dbyug to 'phyar ba nas sogs kyi bskor ba'o/ /mahā de ba de ṣa ra ra dgra bo ma ra ya tsit+ta hur thum/ zhes pa nyid ci mang bzla zhing / de la/ mahā de ba te dzo sogs btag go /rkam rlon mda' zer gsum la btab/—239—

drag po'i gtor ma la dgra bgegs dgug gzhug bya ste/ snying po yi ge brgyad pa la/ i daX ba ling sogs gong bzhin btag la lan nyer gcig tsam drag tu bzlas/ mchod 'phreng las gshin gyi de 'don pa spos te mchod pa rnams drag gtor la btab/ sngar gyi bstod thung gi mthar/ lha yi rgyal po rdzu 'phrul can/ /srid pa gsum gyi byed po ste/ /sde brgyad yongs kyi dmag dpon lags/ khyod kyis mi thub gang yang med/ /lha min grong khyer sum brtsegs bcom/ /mdung rtse gsum pa gcig bskyod pas/ /sa gzhi chen po ring du 'phangs/ /gdug pa can kun 'joms pa po/ /sgrub po rnal 'byor can rnams la/ /tshe dang blo gros dbang phyug ster/ /nyams pa kun gyi gshed ma mdzad/ khyu mchog rgyal mtsho ni las la ya/ /dgra bo'i dbug la thum ril li li/ /dgra bo'i mgo la baX ril li li/ /dgra bo'i srog la hur thum dzaX /dgra bo'i snying la breng shag spyoX /dam nyams dgra bo phung bar mdzod/ /lha sngags thams cad gshed du phob/ /mdza' bshes gnyen dag 'thab tu chug /dgra bgegs 'khor bcas thal bar rlogs/ khyod kyi 'khor ni mi bsrun te/ /log 'dren bgegs byed bsam mi khyab/ /dgra la ltas ngan cho 'phrul phob/ /god kha sna dgu thong la shor/ /mdangs dang bla tshe phrog la shog /dbang thang longs spyod chom la shog/gtso 'khor grogs gnyen thams cad dkrug /rgya mtsho'i mtha' dmar bskrod la shog /gling bar mun nag chen por bsgyur/ /lha dang gnod sbyin yi dwags dang / /klu dang srin po mi bzad pa/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro drag shul can/ /sde brgyad 'gong po ther 'bum rnams/ /da lta nyid du las la bskul/ /dgra bo'i yul mkhar rmang nas bskyel/ /zhing dang lo tog sad ser chom/ /mi nad phyug —240—

nad char ltar phob/ /bdud g.yos ri ltar snyil du chug /bsad skrad dbye dang rings par mdzod/ /mtshon gyi bskal ba der thong zhig /thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la lcoX /thams cad gnod pa'i bgegs la lcoX /bsam ngan byed kha'i steng du smyoX /bzlog cig bsgyur cig sa ma ya/ /zhes drag tu bskul lo/ /'di logs su byed pa yin na 'dir ling ga sgrol chog bya/ ling ga la rtse gsum dang mnga'i 'debs pa nges par bya/gzhan mang nyung ji ltar 'os pa sbyar bas chog /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i lde'u thung la sbyor na ling sgrol dkyus kyi des chog pas/ skabs der dmigs pa gtod kyi 'dir mi dgos so/ /de nas zor 'phang ba ni sngar bzhin bskul nas thog mar skam zor/ de nas rlon zor/ de nas mda' zor/ de nas gtor ma nyid 'phen te/ bsad sngags kho na drag tu bzla'o/ /'di yang drug cu rtsa bzhi'i sngon du 'phang dgos so/ /de nas nang du 'khor nas gtor ma nor bu'i dbyibs de 'thebs kyu gcig gis bsos/ spyan 'dren bsngags la/ a kā ro btags pa tshar gsum gyis phul/ rjes chog rnams dkyus gyi zhor la 'grub pas logs su mi dgos so/ /zhes pa 'di yang rwa lugs kyi yig rnying gab 'khrugs bsdus shing mi gsal ba rnams gsal byed du/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa ste dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i las tshogs kyi cha lag tu gal che ba zhig yin no// //maṅga laX// dge'o//'di bris dge bas skye ba kun tu nges don bstan pa'i mi mthun phyogs thams cad gzhom nus pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ dge legs 'phel// shu bhaX//—241 —

'bru non brjed tho tsam zhig bzhugs/oṃ swā sti sid dhaX/ sku bzhi'i bdag nyid dus gsum rgyal ba yi/ /ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes kun/ /gcig tu bsdus pa 'jam dpal khro bo'i sku/ /bcom ldan bhi ra wa yis dge legs stsol/ /'dir mnyam med yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa'i snying po ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yin la/de la yang rgyud sde'i dbye ba gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga dang / drug sogs dbye ba mang du yod pa las / 'dir bshad par bya ba ni rnal 'byor bla na med pa yin/ 'di la yang pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis las/ pha rgyud yin zhing / pha rgyud la rigs lnga'am 'dod chags zhe sdang dang gti mug gi rgyud gsum thabs rgyud kyi dbye ba yin/ zhes dang /de la 'dir bshad par bya ba ni/ zhe sdang gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud yin pas/de la'ang dmar nag 'jigs gsum las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed ces bya ba yin la/ de la yang rwa skyo gnyos sogs lugs srol mang du yod pa las/ ches mchog tu gyur pa'i byin rlabs kyis gzi byin dang ldan pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs zhes phyogs thams cad du nyi zla ltar grags pa 'di la/dam pa gong ma'i sgrubs thabs mang du mdzad mod/ 'dir dus gsum sangs —242—

rgyas sgrol ba'i mgon po 'khor lo sdom pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ rgyas 'bring bsdus pa dang gsum las/ rgyas pa 'bar ba zhes bya ba slob ma'i dbang dang mdun bskyed sgrub pa'i thabs dang 'brel ba'i/ gzhal yas khang gtso 'khor ro langs chen po brgyad dang bcas shing phyag mtshan sogs sgom pa gcig dang /rang gi rgyun gyi nyams len la sgrub thabs snying po/ /blo dman nyer 'tsho zhes bya ba gtso rkyang zhal phyag yongs rdzogs dang / thod ra khrag mtsho bsrung 'khor chos 'byung dang bcas pa sgom pa gnyis yod pa las/ sgrub thabs snying po'i 'bru non brjed tho tsam zhig /dam pa'i gsung las ji ltar byung ba bzhin bri bar bya'o/ /'dir chos tshul 'di spyan 'dren mkhan gyi slob dpon/ spyan ji ltar drangs tshul/ lugs srol ji ltar byung tshul sogs rgyas par dam pa'i mchog gi zur na mdzad yod der blta bar bya'o/ /de la sgrub thabs 'di 'chad pa las/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis so/ /thun mong la gnas dang gdan bshad pa/ gsum las skyabs su 'gro ba/ sems bskyed pa/ rdor sems sgom bzlas kyi rgyud sbyang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dur khrod la sogs pa dbugs bral gyi gdan la 'dug ste 'di skad do/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dur zhes pa ro dang / khrod zhes pa ro'i dkyil la 'dug ste dbugs dang bral ba ro'i gdan zhes pa ste/ rgya gar sogs na ro gdan dngos su byed pa'ang yod cing /rang nyid kyi de lta bu dang ldan pas/ dur khrod du gnas pa ni/ dgongs pa yin pas mchog tu legs la/ yang ci bde bar gnas pa'i tshe/ dmigs pas sa —243—

phyogs thams cad dur khrod kyis khyab cing / mi ro'i gdan la 'dug par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ skyabs yul 'di ltar du gsal btang ste/ de yang skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul dkon mchog gsum/ dus ji tsam sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du 'gro ba/ bdag dang sems can thams cad do/ /de yang rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / rin po che'i rgyan dang / dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ mtshan dang dpe byad sogs kyis spras pa zhig lam gyis sgom zhing / bla ma'i g.yas g.yon dang mdun du gdan khri sgom pa sogs gong dang 'dra ba las/ cung zad kyis dma' ba mdun gyi gdan la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang / g.yon gyi sa/dan la rig pa 'dzin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / rang rgyal dang / nyan thos sogs theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun rnams dang / g.yas kyi gdan la dam pa'i chos rnam pa glegs bam brag ri lha bu/ gdong dar thams cad rang la bstan pa ste/ khra shig ge ba dang / gzhan yang steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma/ bar gyi cha la yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams/ 'og gi cha la mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams sprin dpung 'khrigs pa ltar bzhugs par mos la/ skyabs 'gro bya zhing 'dir rgyud bla mar yi dam chos skyong sogs gsal kha med kyang de lta ra bsgom par bya'o/ /yang rnam pa gcig tu ni/ de thams cad khrom tshogs su bzhugs par bsgoms pas rung —244—

zhing / bsdus na skyabs yul kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma yin te/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi zhes sogs kyis sangs rgyas kun 'dus bstan cing chos kyi phung po sogs kyis dam pa'i chos thams cad kyi 'gyung gnas yin pa'i phyir chos kun 'dus dang / 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi zhes sogs kyis don dam pa'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dun ni/ rtsa ba'i bla ma yin la/ rnam pa ni theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun thams cad kyi dpon nam gtso bo'am bdag po lta bur gyur pas dge 'dun kun 'dus rgyud par bcas pas zhes pas rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas kun 'dus yin pas/ rgyud pa'i bla ma smos mi dgos la/ 'on kyang rdo rje 'chang nas legs par brgyud pa'i gdams pa zab mo kun rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dus pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus so/ /de yang rgyud bla las/ thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir/ /tshogs kyang de'i mthar thug phyir/ /zhes sogs/ de ltar skyabs yul de nyid la blo ling gis bkal te/ skyid sdug legs nyes ji ltar yang khyed rang mkhyen snyam pa'i sgo nas/ skyabs 'gro mang nyung ji ltar rig par byas nas/mthar skyabs yul rnams 'od du ldem gyis zhu ste rang la thim par bsam mo/ /gsum pa ni/ sems bskyed tshul bshad pa las/ dang po skyes bu rab ni/sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa/ 'bring ni rang nyid kho na sangs rgyas 'dod pa/ tha ma ni rang nyid tshe 'dir bde ba tsam don du gnyer ba'o/ /des na 'dir skyes bu rab kyi sems bskyed la bslab dgos te/de yang 'di ltar du bsam mo/ /nam mkha'i gar khyab ni sems can thams cad kyis khyab la/ de thams cad rang gi pha ma sha stag yin zhing 'dir bde ba la —245—

bzhag /sdug bsngal las bskyab pa zhig ste/ nam mi 'dod bzhin du sdug bsngal myong ba snying re rje na/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal las skyabs shing / bde ba la bzhag dgos par 'dug kyang / da lta rang la de lta bu'i mthu med pas de ltar mi nus shing / de lta bu nus pa la bdag ci nas kyang / sangs rgyas thob dgos pa 'dug /sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la thabs zhig dgos pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor 'di nyid nyams su blangs te sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam pa'i sgo nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sogs tshar gsum ngag tu brjod do/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blangs zhes pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ lha bsgom pa sngags bzla ba/ mnyam par 'jog pa sogs kyi don no/ /de dag ni sems bskyed kho na yin la/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod sogs ni skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang bcas pa yin la/ 'di mdzad pa po ni kha che paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī nyid kyis mdzad do/ /de'i don ni 'gro ba ma lus pa ngan song las bsgral bar 'dod pas/byang chub ma thob kyi bar du dkon mchog gsum la skyabs zhu zhing / chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs rtogs par byed pa'i shes rab dang / brtse ba snying rje chen po gnyis dang ldan pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don byed par dam bcas pa yin la/ de lta bu'i dam bca' ba de'i dpang por su zhe na/ dkon mchog gsum mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i drung du bdag nyid gnas bca' nas brtson 'grus dang ldan pas/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /zhes pa ste/ skyabs sems sbrags ma 'di yang tshar gsum ngag tu brjod par bya'o/ /—246—

bzhi pa ni/ de ltar sems bskyed nas/ rang tha mal gnas pa'i spyi bor sna tshogs pad ma'i ze'u 'bru'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba de'i steng du huX dkar po de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' bskyed pa ste/ 'di'i skabs kyi rdo rje sems dpa' ni rab tu zhi ba rin po che'i rgyan can dbu skra phyed bcings/ lhag ma dpung pa'i steng na si li bun ne ba dang / dar gyi na bza' sogs sgrub thabs bzhin du bskyed pa yin zhing / sngags yang / badz+ra satwa sa ma ya zhes sogs shrī badz+ra he ru ka zhes pa'i sngags kyi rdor sems ni he ru ka ste/rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / dbu skra yang ral pa'i thor tshugs chen po ste dbu skra'i rtse sogs sil bu yin kyang / 'dus par thor tshugs kyi nang du chud pa zhig go/yum ni rang mtshungs zhes pa la don dam par ngo bo la dbye ba med cing tha dad du med kyang rnam par na tha dad pa'i tshul gyis 'phyud pa yin cing / rgyan sku mdog phyag mtshan rnams yab dang / mtshungs su bshad pa yin no/ /rang snang zhes pa rnams la/ yab rang nyid kyi sku'i 'od zer yum gyi rnam par gyur nas 'khyud pa yin zhes mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed pa yin/ de lta bu'i yab yum dam ye dbye ba med pa de nyid lam gyis gsal btang pa'i dbu skra phyed bcings kyi mdun/ rin po che'i prog zhu'i nang du rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pa bzhugs pa'o/ /de lta bu'i rdor sems de nyid kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje/ mgrin par āXdamar po gsung rdo rje/ thugs kar huX sngon po thugs rdo rje/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūX yig gi mtha' skor du sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba gsal btab cing / yig —247—

'bru thams cad kha dog dkar po'o/ /de nas spyi bor rdo rje sems dpa' la bcom ldan 'das zhes bos nas/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i zhes pa nas/ mdzad du gsol gyi bar de de yang sdig pa zhes bya ba mi dge ba bcu dang / sgrib pa zhes pa sogs thar sogs kyi sdom pa rnams nyams te/ thar pa'i lam sgrib par byed pa ste/nyes lhung thams cad dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu gdab cing / bzlas dmigs 'di ltar du bya'o/ /thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sdig sgrib 'joms pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun skya khral khral byung bas/ yab kyi sku gang / rdo rje'i lam nas brgyud yum gyi sku lus kyang khengs te/ sbyor mtshams nas skya na ra ra byung / rang gi spyi bor thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad rim gyis gang / sdig sgrib thams cad bu ga dgu dang ba sbu'i bu ga nas nag nu ru ru thon te/ sa 'og thag ring por song lus thams cad bdud rtsis skya mer re re gang / mthar sha rus dang bcas pa'i lus 'di nyid kyang sbrul gyis shun pa phud pa ltar dag ste/bdud rtsi las grub pa dang bcas gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du skya khrol gyis dag pa ltar bzhin pas sngags mang nyung ci rigs pa bzlas zin pa'i na/ thal mo snying gar sbyar te/ phyag 'tshal 'dud cing zhes sogs brjod/ 'di phyag 'tshal lnga po ye shes lnga la phyag 'tshal ba ste/ 'di la don dam pa'i phyag 'tshal ba zhes bya'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes pa bdag sogs sems can thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du 'grub par mdzod/ ces sogs/ de nas mgon po zhes bos nas/ bdag cag ni chos dang chos min mi shes pa dang / ston pas —248—

gsungs pa'i chos dang / khyad par gsang sngags la ma gus pa dang / dam tshig spang blang shes bzhin du bag med par spyod pa dang / nyon mongs mang po'i dbang du gyur te/ spang bya bzlog pa'i dam tshig ni ma spangs pas 'gal/ bsrung bya sgrub pa'i dam tshig ni ma sgrub pa'i nyams pa'i bdag cag 'gro ba 'di dag la skyabs su gsol/ zhes ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa rdo rje sems dpa' bzhugs pa de la gsol ba drag tu gdab cing / slar yang rigs thams cad kyi gtso bo rdo rje 'chang thugs rje chen pos sems can ngan 'gro la thar bar mdzad pa'i gtso bo khyod la/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs zhu zhing / sngon chad sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad gnong 'gyod chen pos bshags par bgyid cing / phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi bgyid pa'i/ sngon chad sdig sgrib ci bsags pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba snying thag pa nas btab pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' de nyid 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par mer gyis zhu ste rang la thim pa'i/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum chu la chu bzhag pa ltar dbyer med ro gcig tu gyur par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la/ bsod nams tshogs bsags dang ye shes tshogs bsags gnyis/ dang po la yul dag pa la tshogs bsags pa dang / ma dag pa ma bsags pa gnyis las/ dang po la tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa/ phyag 'tshal ba mchod pa 'bul ba/ rgyun bshags bya rig lnga spyi dang so so'i sdom pa bzung ba rnams so/ /—249—

dang po ni/ rang nyid sngar tha mal par gnas pa de skad cig tsam gyis rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ ma he'i gdong can phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba ling ga gyen du langs pa/ thod skam gyi dbu brgyan/ rlon pa'i do shal sogs/ dur khrod mas brgyad sku la rdzogs pa gsal zhing dwangs la snyog pa med pa zhig tu lam gyis gyur pa'i/ thugs kar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte bar ze'u 'bru'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la/hūX yig mthing nag 'od kyi rang bzhin can zhig bsgom la/ de'i 'od zer gyi rtse mo lcags kyu lta bu'i rnam pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas ni bcom ldan 'das 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa rtsa zhal gyi thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan gyi nang / srin zhal lta bu'i mdun du ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba ste/de lta bu'i dbu rgyan du byas pa'i bcom ldan 'das kyi mtha' skor du ro langs chen po brgyad/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa/ skad cig gis khra mer gyis mdun gyis nam mkhar byon par bsam la/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX zhes brjod pa'am/ yang rnam pa gcig tu na tshogs kyi zhing de dag thams cad rtag tu bzhugs bzhin pa la/ sngar las ngan pa'i bag chags 'thug pos bsgribs nas mthong bar ma gyur pa/ 'od zer des khra lam gyis mthong ba sgom par bshad de/ dper na mun khang zhig na dngos po gya nom pa yod pa de mthong bar ma gyur cing yod pa ma shes pa —250—

la/ lag tu sgron me zhig thogs te byin pa na/ dngos po de dag mthong ba dang 'dra bar sgom pa'am/ yang na 'ja' tshon shar ba ltar skad cig der khra mer gyis bzhugs 'dug par bsam ste/ 'di gsum blo ru gang 'dzom zhig sgom pa'i rung bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ dmigs pa bde na rang gi lus grangs med par sprul nas phyag 'tshal ba dang / mi bde na rang rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa de kas phyag 'tshal bar mos la/ na mo gu ru khyoX zhes pas thal mo spyi bor sbyar te bla ma dang / na mo badz+ra dzhai ra wa maṇ+ḍal/ zhes sogs kyis thal mo snying gar sbyar te yi dam 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bar mos shing / gang gi drin gyis zhes sogs kyis bstod pa dang bcas pa phyag 'tshal bar mos la/ de'i don spyir dam pa'i chos thams cad bde ba chen po'i ye shes skye bar byed pa'i rgyu yin yang skad cig de nyid du rtogs par mi nus/ bla ma'i drin gyis bde ba chen po'i ye shes de skad cig la 'char bar nus pa/ bla ma de nyid dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung ba 'dra ste/ rdo rje can de nyid kyi zhabs 'og gi pad+ma la'ang phyag 'tshal na/ sku dngos smos ma dgos pa yin no/ /'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab nang gnas pa sogs kyi don ni/ 'khor ba 'dam rdzab lta bu'i nang na gnas pa'i sems can rnams thugs rje chen po'i phyag gis drangs te/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad pa'i bla ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa dang /sangs rgyas kun 'dus pa thugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi slob dpon khyod la bdag cag rnams skyabs mchi'o/ /zhes pa ste de yan chad ni bla ma la phyag 'tshal —251—

ba yin la/ dang por me tog phog pa yi/ /zhes pa'i tshigs rkang gnyis pa yi dam la phyag 'tshal ba ste/ de'i don ni/ rgya gar sogs na rang gis dmod pa bor nas me tog gang la phog pa'i lha de la yi dam byed pa yod kyang / 'dir de ltar ma byung bas/ me tog phog pa'i lha yin snyam pa'i mos pa byed pa dang / me tog 'bul ba'i skabs su yang rang gang la mos pa'i lha de la phog snyam byed pa'o/ /gsum pa mchod pa ni/ sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gsum las/sngags ni oX badz+ra la mya hūX te rdo rje sgeg mo/ phyag rgya ni sgeg pa'i phyag rgya/ ting nge 'dzin nas rang gi snying kha na lha mo sgeg pa'i phyag rgya can dpag tu med pa spros nas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad mchod pa'i mnyes par bsam/ de bzhin du badz+ra ma l+ya draX te/ rdo rje 'phreng ba ma me tog 'phreng ba 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya dang / snying ga nas me tog gi 'phreng ba thogs pa dpag tu med pas mchod pa dang / badz+ra girti te rdo rje glu ma/ ngag nas glu 'byin pa'i phyag rgya dang /glu ma dpag tu med pas mchod pa dang / badz+ra nirti te rdo rje gar ma/ gar bsgyur ba'i phyag rgya/ karma dpag tu med pas mchod pa dang / badz+ra dhu pe te/ rdo rje bdug spos/ bdug spos kyi phyag rgya dang / spos sbyar thogs pa dang / lhan skyes sogs kyis spos snod thogs pa dpag tu med pas mchod pa dang / badz+ra pur+sha te/ rdo rje me tog ma/ me tog gis phyag rgya dang / ma ṇa dha ra ba ut+pal tsam pa ka sogs dang / rin po che'i me tog thogs pa dpag tu med pas mchod pa dang / badz+ra a lo ke dang / dī paX zhes pa rdo rje snang gsal ma ste/ mar me'i phyag rgya dang / snang —252—

ba gsal bar byed pa/ nyi zla rin po che dang / mar gyi rkong bu sogs snang ba gsal bar nus pa thogs pa dpag tu med pas mchod pa dang / badz+ra ga rnye te/ rdo rje dri chab ma/ dri mchog gi phyag rgya dang / dung chos sogs dri bzang po btab pa'i chu thogs pa dpag tu med pas mchod pa'i mthar/ slar yang lha mo rnams rang gi snying gar bsdu'o/ /bzhi pa rgyun bshags ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar yan lag bdun par 'dod pa'i mkhas pa mang po snang la/ 'dir thams cad mkhyen pa sgrol ba'i mgon po'i lugs kyis yan lag bdun pa brtsi bar 'dod na/ gong du bstan pa'i phyag 'tshal dang / mchod pa dang / dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pa dang / sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /zhes pa'i tshigs gsum sdom pa skyabs 'gro dang / dge ba la rjes su yi rang dang / sdig pa bshags pa dang / sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung dang /rang gzhan don ni zhes pa nas/ byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /zhes pa'i bar dang bcas pa sems bskyed pa dang / dge ba bsngo ba ste/ bdun no/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar ni rgyun bshags yan lag lnga pa zhes bya'o/ /de'i don ni/ dkon mchog gsum la byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su 'gro ba dang / 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ da lta'i bar sdig pa'i las byas pa la 'gyod sems dang bcas pas bshags pa/ phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi bgyid snyam pa'i sdom sems —253—

dang / 'jig rten gyi khams na dge ba'i rtsa bar gyur pa thams cad la rjes su yi rang zhing / rang nyid kyis dge rtsar gyur pa la yang sems dang ba cung zad bskyed pa ma gtogs/ ngar 'dzin bzang rlom shin tu mi legs pa'i mi bya'o/ /gzhan yang sngar rang nyid kyis bgyis pa'i dge rtsa ci lta bu la'ang / 'gyod sems byung na de'i 'bras bu nyams par 'gro ba dang / g.yin gyi dge rtsa la yi rang rnam par dag pa skyes na/ dge rtsa de'i 'bras bu rang la'ang cha shas thob par 'gyur zhes gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung nas/ don dam byang chub kyi sems bzung ba yin la/ rang gzhan gyi don gyi mchog de nyid rab tu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ bdag gis bla na med pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed par bgyid cing /de lta bu'i sems bskyed nas/ sems can thams cad mgron po lta bur bya ste/byang chub kyi spyod pa mchog gi bdud rtsis tshim par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i don yin zhing / 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa dge ba bsngo ba ste/de la'ang dper na/ mi zhig gis gtor ma zhal zas bshams te/ sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzin rnams med par/ gtor ma 'di thob par gyur cig /ces brjod pa tsam gyis smon sems tsam du ni 'gyur gyi thob par mi 'gyur/ thob par byed pa cho ga zhig dgos pa ltar/ rang nyid kyis kyang dge ba'i las zhig la brten te rang gzhan thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa bar gtogs pa ci dang ci bgyis pa thams cad gcig tu bsdoms te/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur bsngo ba'o/ /lnga pa rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba la/ rigs lnga spyi'i dam tshig sdom pa dang / so so'i dam tshig sdom pa bzung ba gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ ma rdzo pa'i —254—

yul thams cad bzhugs pa la/ dgongs su gsol zhes brjod nas bdag 'di zhes bgyi bas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/ 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis sems can 'khor ba las bsgral ba'i ched du/ bdag sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i thugs bskyed pas sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig /thob par gyur la thob par mdzad pa/ de bzhin du bdag kyang sems can gyi don du byang chub thob par 'dod sems mchog de bskyed par bgyi/ zhes pa ni/ smon pa'i sems bskyed do/ /'jug pa'i sems bskyed la/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims so/ /dang po ni/sngon chad sdig pa'i las byas pa la/ 'gyod sems dang / slan chad srog la babs kyang mi bgyid pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dge ba'i chos thams cad ci nus ci lcogs kyis bgyid pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sems can gyis don gang la gang 'dul gyis byed pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa/ so so'i dam tshig sdom pa la/ rnam snang / mi bskyod pa/ rin 'byung / 'od dpag med/ don grub rnams kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa bzung ba la/ dang po ni/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing / de'i bslab bya la slob pa yin zhing / sangs rgyas rnal 'byor zhes pa ni rnam snang ngo / /gnyis pa ni rdo rje thugs/ dril bu gsung / phyag rgya sku rnams kyi dam tshig dang / rdo rje slob dpon rab tu gus pas bsten zhing smad par mi byed pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ nyin mtshan dus drug tu/ chos dang zang zing dang / mi 'jigs pa'i skyabs dang / byams pa dang spyin pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ phyi'i theg pa —255—

nyan thos rang rgyal phar phyin dang / nang gi theg pa rgyud sde 'og ma gsum dang /gsang ba'i theg pa rnal 'byor bla med kyi don nyams su len pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/gong du bshad kyi sdom pa kun dang / bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mchod pas mnyes par byed pa'o/ /de ltar byang chub kyi sems bla na med pa dang / sdom pa bzung bar byed pa des 'bras bu gang 'dod pa'i phyir na/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched du bdag gis byang chub kyi sems bskyed cing /sdom pa ma lus bzung nas/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba las ma bsgral ba sgrol cing / sems rgyud nyon mongs pa'i bcings te/ ma grol ba rnams grol bar byed pa dang / lam sgrub pa'i thabs sna tshogs kyis nga rgyal te dbugs ma byung ba rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams/ mya ngan las 'das pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bla na med pa la 'god par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa yul ma dag pa la tshogs bsags pa ni/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom ste/ de yang byams pa tshad med/ snying rje tshad med/ dga' ba tshad med/btang snyoms tshad med de bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ sems can thams cad tshe 'dir bde ba dang ldan zhing / tshe rabs thams cad du bde ba'i rgyu dge ba rlabs po che dang ldan par gyur cig /snyams pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral zhing tshe rabs thams cad du sdug bsngal myong ba'i rgyu sdig pa'i las thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /snyams pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral zhing bde ba dang ldan pa de dang nam —256—

du'ang bral bar ma gyur cig /snyams pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sems can la nye 'gyang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig /snyams pa ste/ 'di rnams kyang kha tsam tshig tsam du ma yin pa'i zhe thag pa'i sgo nas lan gsum ngag tu brjod do/ /gnyis pa ye shes tshogs bsags ni/ kun rdzob snang grags kyi chos thams cad stong par sbyong ba yin pa la/ de la'ang sngags tshan bzhis stong par sbyong ba dang / gsum gyis sbyong ba dang / gnyis kyis sbyong ba dang / gcig gis sbyong ba sogs du ma zhig yod pa las/ 'dir ni bsdus pa'i tshul gyis gcig gis sbyong ba ste/ de yang bod skad du/ brjod na/ rang bzhin gyis ma dag pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i/ zhes so/ /'di la'ang kha cig sgyu ma lta bu'i 'dun par sbyong ba sogs mi 'dra ba dag snang yang / rang lugs ni tha mal gyi snod bcud stong par ma sbyang ba'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ma 'byung bas/ tha mal gyi snod bcud 'di dag stong pa nyid du bsgom zhing / gnas lugs bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba 'di bskyed gzhir bya ste/ 'ja' tshon lta bu'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor sgom par byed pa yin no/ /de la su bhā wa'i dag bya dag byed ni/ sbyang bya 'chi ba 'od gsal zhes pa shi nas bar do ma shar ba de sbyong bar byed nga / 'bras bu chos sku thob par byed pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig cing / rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gro ba dpe don gyi 'od gsal nyams myong dka' ba med par skye bar byed do/ /—257—

rtsa ba'i gnyis pa dngos gzhi sgom par byed pa la/ rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa dang / brten pa lha bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las chos kyi 'byung gnas zur gsum zur gcig 'og tu bstan pas/ bzhir 'gyur yang phyogs gang nas bltas kyang zur gsum mo/ /de yang phyi dkar pa thab nang dmar ba shes rab/ 'phel ka gyen du bstan pas yon tan gong du 'phel ba/steng gi zur gsum nas/ stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa dang gsum/ 'og gi zur gcig 'dus ma byas te/ rnam par thar pa sgo bzhi'i bdag nyid can shin tu rgya che ba/ 'di'i dbyibs gtor ma zur gsum khog stong zhig gi rtse mo sa la btsugs pa 'dra ba zhig go /de'i nang du bsrung 'khor sgom pa skabs 'dir bstan kyang / chos 'byung gi phyi nang gang du bsgom kyang 'gal ba med do/ /de nas chos 'byung de nyid kyi nang gi dbus su hūX mthing nag de yongs su gyur pa las/ sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa ste/ rwa bcu gnyis pa bsgom pa dang / dbal kha'i tshul du yod kyang skabs 'dir rwa nyi shu pa bstan pa yin zhing / dbus rwa'i g.yas g.yon du gnyis gshib steng mar bsgom par bya'o/ /dag pa bsgom par byed pa ni/ shar rwa me long lta bu'i ye shes lnga'i dag pa sbyor ba yang mi 'gal mod/ 'on kyang rwa nyi shu pa 'di ni 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu 'joms par byed pa'o/ /de lta bu'i lte ba mthing nag de'i steng du huX de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba'i steng du rdo rje sa gzhi ste/ rdo rje go mtshams med par gtams pa/ rgya che ba dbyib zlum po/ stegs sa la rdul chags pa'i rnam pa mi mngon pa rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ de'i steng gi mtha' las —258—

cung zad kyi nang du son par rdo rje'i rwa ba zlum po/ 'thug cing rgya dpang dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rdo rje'i gur 'byung ste / kha gcig rwa ba mnan te sbrags ma'i tshul du sgom pa 'dug kyang / rwa lugs ni rwa gur kha sprod du sgom par byed cing / kha sbyar mtshams kyi nang thams cad la/ rdo rje'i bla re gru bzhi pa zhig yod pa sgom par byed pa'o/ /phyi rol tu rdo rje'i rwa gur las steng du ye shes kyi me 'bar zhing phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba dang 'og tu rdo rje'i sa gzhi las me dpung rab tu 'bar te/ phyogs bcu thams cad ye shes kyi mes gtams pa'o/ /badz+ra rak+ṣa zhes sogs lan gsum mam gcig brjod de/ rdo rje bsrung ba zhes pa ste brtan par byed pa'o/ /rdo rje'i rwa ba'i nang 'gram nas/ khrag mtsho'i bar la/ji skad gsungs pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad shin tu rgya che ba/ de rnams kyi ro sna tshogs pa'i khrag rnams dbus su tshogs pa las/ khrag gi rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrugs pa/ de'i dbus su thod rwa'i gdan rin po che'i rdo rwa zlum po khrag mtsho'i dbus nas cung zad steng du thon pa ste/ de yang dper na ka to ra'i dbus su maṇ+ḍal gcig bzhag /ka to ra'i ri dang maṇ+ḍal gyi bar chus gang ba dang 'dra'o/ /rin po che'i ri bo de'i steng du thod pa skam po'i rwa ba zlum po/ rgya che ba sgo gcig pa keng rus kyi ka gdung thog phub pa dang ldan zhing / g.yang bzhi'i bla bre/ rgyu ma rlon pa'i lda ldi can/ stegs dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mo rdo rje nor bu tog gis brgyan pa/ zhes gsungs te/ 'di la nor bu'i dbyibs kho na sgom pa dang /nor bu'i steng du rdo rje'i rnam pa gnyis te/ gang sgom kyang wo bar 'gyur ro/ /'dir kha gcig khrag mtsho dang thod rwa mi 'thad gsung bar 'dug kyang khrag mtsho —259—

ni ro sna tshogs pa'i khrag dbus su 'dus pa las byung zhing rgyud nas kyang bshad de/ rtog bdun las/ dkyil 'khore gyi grwa bzhir khrag gi chag chag gdab/ ces gsung pa 'di'i don no/ /spyir khrag mtsho dang thod rwa ni dur khrod kyi khongs su gtogs shing ro sna tshogs pa 'dus pa las de dag 'byung ba shugs las grub pa yin no/ /yang pha rgyud ma rgyud dur khrod yod med la brtags pa dag kyang byung mod/ de lta bu'ang mi 'thad de/ rdo rje 'jigs byed pha rgyud yin pa ni kun gyi shes la/ dur khrod 'bri ba ni/ rtog bdun gyi bri sku'i rtog pa'i skabs su gsungs yod do/ /gang ltar na'ang rdo rje'i rwa ba'i nang 'gram nas khrag mtsho'i bar gyi phyogs bzhi/ mtshams bzhir dur khrod chen po brgyad mthong ba dang /gtam thos pa tsam gyis skyi g.ya' ba/ 'jigs pa dag kyang 'jigs par byed pa ste so so'i ming ni bcu gsum ma'i nang ltar brjod par bya'o/ /de dag rnams su me tog 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas pa/ ljon shing chen po brgyad de/ so so'i ming ni gshed dmar nas brgyud pa nyid do/ /brgya byin sogs phyogs skyong brgyad ni spyi dang mthun/ zhing skyong ba brgyad ni/ lha'i dge 'dun dkar po glang po che'i gdong can sogs so/ /chu brgyad ni rje rigs la sogs pa chu brgyad do/ /me brgyad la kha gcig bsil bar byed pa tsan+dan gyi me zhes sogs zer de/ rtog pas btags par zad do/ /ri brgyad ni/ma la sogs so/ /mchod rten brgyad ni/ 'dus byas 'dus ma sogs klu brgyad/sprin brgyad de dag ni grangs nges pa yin la/ gzhan yang ro dang / keng rus dang / ma mo dang / srin po dang / ཿnga po dang / sha za dang / tshon rje dang / ro —260—

langs la sogs dpag tu med pa lang long du rgyu zhing / ha ha zhes pa'i sgra dang /ku co chen po rnams grags/ phan tshun la 'thab cing lhang lhang por 'bod pa dang /ro mdung la bskyon pa/ shing brag la dpyang pa/ mes tshig pa/ mgo bo med pa'i ros gar byed pa/ sha rus lpags pa rnams dum bur dum bur 'dug pas khyab pa/ khrag dang klad pa phyogs thams cad du 'thor ba dang / bya dang gcan gzan gdug pa can sna tshogs lang long du rgyu zhing 'khrugs pa dang / 'byung po sna tshogs kyi spyod pas yid bsgyur ba dngos grub kyi rdzas dang / yo byad dang mchod pa'i rdzas du mas yongs su gdams pa/ sa bcu'i sar gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma dang / mchog thun gyi dngos grub sgrub par byed pa rnams dang / grub pa rig pa 'dzin pa du ma dang / thod pa'i rnga thogs te gar byed pa'o/ /'di yan gyis rten gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa bskyed pa sogs zhing sbyong gzhal yas khang dur khrod dang bcas pa 'dis/ sbyang bya ni gang du skye ba len pa'i gnas sbyong zhing rnam par dag par skye ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/rdzogs rim gyi smin byed 'ja' lus myur du dka' ba med par 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa brten pa lha bskyed pa la/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sa bon phyag mtshan tshul gyi bskyed pa dang / 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa zhing sbyong rnam pa gsum gyis sgo nas bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thod pa'i rwa ba yangs shing rgya che ba de nyid kyi nang du/ rlud gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zlum po/ thod ra'i nang gi 'og gzhi dang rgya mnyam pa/ de'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa/ yal ga rlung gis dkyil 'khor dang tshad mnyam pa/ lte ba'i ze'u 'khru'i steng du raX yig zhu ba —261—

las nyi dkyil rgya tshad pad+ma lte ba dang mnyam pa 'od zer tsha ba rtsub pa dpag tu med pa 'phro ba ni 'jigs byed kyi dngos gdan bskyed pa yin cing / de'i steng du aX yig zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor reg bya bsil ba 'jam pa'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba ni/ 'jam dpal kho na'i gdan te nyi ma las rgya cung zad chung ba'i steng du dhīX yig dmar ser zhu ba las ral gri sngo sangs rin po che'i yu ba sbubs stong gi nang du zla ba'i gdan la/ dhīX yig gnas pa ral gri de yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jal dpal gzhon nu gur gum gzhon nu'i me tog rgyas pa lta bu dmar ser phyag g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri dpung pa'i steng du 'phyar zhing / g.yon ut+pal sngon po'i sdong po'i rtsa ba thugs kar mtheb mdzub kyis 'dzin cing / snyan gyi thad kar me tog kha phye ba'i steng du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti bsnams pa rab tu zhi ba'i sgeg pa dang bcas pa rin po che'i dbu rgyan snyan rgyan mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub zhabs gdub sor gdub do shal sogs kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan dpe rdzogs pa bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can bung ba ltar gnag pa'i dbu skra'i thor tshugs lnga ste/ de yang dbu gtsug tu gcig /de'i g.yas g.yon dang mdun rgyab tu re re ste lnga dang ldan pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i huX mthing nag las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros pa'i phyogs bcu'i zhing na de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga rnam snang sogs dang / gshegs ma yum bzhi ste spyan ma sogs dang / sems dpa' 'jam dbyangs sa snying nam snying sogs dang / rig ma sgra rdo rje ma sogs —262—

dang / khro bo bgegs mthar byed nas gnod mdzes kyi bar te/ spyir 'di dag gi rigs rnams bgrang ba las 'das mod/ mtshon byed du de ltar brjod pa'o/ /de thams cad 'jam dpal la thim zhing / 'jam dpal zla ba dang bcas pa yang nyi gdan la thim pas tsha zer lhag par 'bar ba dpag tshad 'bum du khyab pa/ de'i 'od zer gyis ā li kā li rtsa sngags snying po nye snying rnams/ 'khrug sgra lta bu'i rang rang gi sgra dang bcas te mkha' dbyings gang bar byon pa rnams nyi ma'i steng du gcig tu 'dus pa las chos dbyings ye shes kyi rang bzhin hūX yig nag po ye shes lnga po 'od zer kha dog sna lnga'i tshul du 'phro bar gyur/ de'i 'od zer gyi ngo bo de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs ye shes chen po rnam pa ral gri gri gug sogs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par byon te hūX la thim pas/ de nyid rdo rje mthing nag rtse lnga pa rwa cung zad gdengs pa 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'bar ba ste/ kha cig rdo rje rtse dgu kho na sgom pa 'thad zer kyang / 'gal ba med pas gang bsgoms kyang chog pa ni yin mod/ 'on kyang 'dir ni rdo rje rtse lnga pa bstan pa yin no/ /de las gong du bstan pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa sogs dang / rdo rje phra mo nam mkha' la char 'bab pa ltar spros pas/ sdang ba'i dgra gdug pa can gyi bgegs sogs gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad de dag gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la bkod/ ma dag pa'i snod thams cad dag pa'i zhing du gyur cing de bzhin gshegs pa sogs dang / rdo rje phra mo rnams dang / khyad par 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor tshad med pa spyan drangs/ de thams cad gcig tu gyur pa las/ zhes pa ste/ 'di'i skabs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaX dang rdo rje bsdu —263—

pa'i phyag rgya sogs mi dgos yid kyis spyan 'dren pa yin no/ /de yang zhing sbyong gsum la/ gong 'jam dpal gdan byas bstim pa spyi 'gror bzhugs nas/ phyi ma hūX dang rdo rje dang gcig tu gyur pa las zhes pa rnams la ngos 'dzin pa dang /yang na tsha zer ba zhes sogs sku'i zhing sbyong ngo / /hūX dang gyur sogs gsung gi zhing sbyong / rdo rje rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa sogs thugs kyi zhing sbyong / zhes lugs gnyis yod pa las/ 'gal ba med cing 'dam ga yin kyang / dkyus kyi dbang du byas na phyi ma 'thad par mngon no/ /dag pa dran par byed pa ni nyi ma dang pad+mas gang du skye ba'i grong sbyong bar byed/ rlung dkyil dang zla bas ni rang nyid gdos bcas kyi lus dang yid ldan zhing / bar do'i lus kyang ma grub pa'i bar gyi rlung sems phra mo de sbyong ba dang / dhīX bsgom pa ni/ gsung gi rang bzhin te bar do'i ngag sbyong ba dang / ral gri ni thugs te bar do'i yid sbyong ba dang / 'jam dpal rgyus ni bar dos lus dbang po kun tshang ba las kyi rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa de sbyong ba dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob par byed pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa dang / rdzogs rim gyi smin byed sems dben dang / sgyu lus dang zung 'jug gi sku myur du thob par byed pa'o/ /'jam dpal zla ba dang bcas pa nyi ma la thim pa ni/ 'jam dpal ni bar do'i lus zla ba'i khams nyi ma'i rdul de de gnyis kyi bar du yid lus de brgyal thabs su gnas pa de dag sbyong bar byed do/ /de yang rang bur skyes na pha la sdang sems dang ma la chags sems dang ldan pas 'jug la/ bu mor skyes na ma la sdang sems dang pha la chags sems dang bcas te 'jug go /de yang pha'i kha sgo nas zhugs/ khams dang bsdongs nas —264—

ma'i mngal du 'pho ste/ nur nur po dang / mer mer po dang / tar tar po sogs huX dang rdo rje bsgoms pas sbyong ngo / /rdo rje de las de bzhin gshegs pa sogs dang / rdo rje phra mo'i spro ba'i mer mer po sogs de dag sas brtan pa dang / chus sdud pa dang / mes smin pa dang / rlud gis rul ba sogs mi 'byung bar rgyas par byed pa dang / nam mkha'i de dag gi go 'byed par byed pa de dag sbyong bar byed do/ /de nas ma'i mngal du zla dgu ngo bcu sogs lon te mngal ni btsas pa de'i lus skye bo kun gyis mthong ba ste rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi skus sbyong ste/ de yang sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin lta bur rab tu gnag la mun pa lta bur ngam za ba rtsa zhal ma he nag po rab tu khros pa/ rwa sngo sangs las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i mes phyogs thams cad zil gyis gnon pa/ de nas zhal dgu ni skyo lugs sogs steng zhal gnyis ma gtogs 'khor zhal du sgom pa dang kha cig 'bab 'khor zhal la/ g.yas zhal gsum lta bu/ rtsa zhal gyi rna ba'i ltag dang ltag pa gnyis kyang / dbus su sngon po g.yas su dmar po/ g.yon du ser po/ de bzhin du g.yon zhal la'ang sbyar zhing / srin zhal lta bu dang 'jam dpal brtsegs mar sgom pa sogs 'dug kyang / 'dir rwa lugs ni lugs gnyis yod pa la/ rnam pa gcig tu na g.yas kyi zhal rnams g.yas rwa'i logs la brtsegs mar yod pa dang / g.yon zhal rnams g.yon rwa'i logs la brtsegs mar sgom pa zhig rdzogs rim gyi skabs su yod pa dang / bskyed rim rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la brtsegs zhal kho na sgom pa yin te/ de yang ma he'i zhal gyi snyan gyi ltag tu shin tu khros pa'i zhal sngon po dmar po ser po rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa —265—

dang / g.yon du g.yas zhal las cung zad zhi ba'i zhal dkar po dud kha nag po rnams brtsegs pa dang / rwa gnyis kyi dbus su srin po lta bu'i zhal shin tu dmar ba zhal gdangs shing ljags 'gril ba/ mche ba rab tu gtsigs pa/ ha ha pho pho zhes drag tu bzhad pa/ zhal gyi 'gram nas khrag 'dzag pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum pa/ shin tu khros la chags pa'i nyams cung zad dang yang ldan pa/ de'i steng du 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i zhal gser btso ma lta bu khro zhing 'dzum bag dang ldan pa zur phud lnga pa/ byis pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhi ba'i spyan gsum pa'o/ /skabs 'ga' zhig tu 'jam dpal gyi zhal mgrin pa dang bcas sgom gsung ba dag kyang yod de/ sngon gyi ras bris sogs na dbu brtsegs pa kho na snang bas de ltar bya ste/ snga ma yang 'gal bar gyur pa ni ma yin no/ khro zhal brgyad po rnams ni ha ha hi hi zhes sogs rdo rje'i gad mo dang / huX phaṭa kyi sgras stong chen po'i 'jig rten khyab pas dgra dang / bgegs kyi sha dang / rkang dang /tshil sogs zhal du gsol ba/ zhal ras rnam par 'gyur ba khro gnyer rab tu bsdus pa smin ma 'byog por gcus pa/ skra ser gyen du 'bar ba/ dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan gsum po rnams sdang mig gis lta zhing myur du bzlogs pa/ me rtag lta bu rno zhing tsha ba rtsub pa'i 'od zer 'bar ba'i smin rdzi dang sma ra dang ba spru can/ 'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das pa dang ma 'das lha thams cad la rab tu bsdigs pa/ zhal brgyad po rab tu rno bas mche ba bzhi bzhi dang ldan pa/ljags 'gril ba tshams rngam gyi sgra 'brug stong dus gcig tu ldir pa'am bskal —266—

pa 'jig pa'i rlung gi sgra lta bu bdud kyi sde'i snying 'gas par byed pa/ lang tsho la bab pa sku las sprul pa'i pho nya gdong sna tshogs dang ldan zhing / phyag mtshan sna tshogs thogs pa/ mdog sna tshogs su 'dug pa dpag tu med pa spro zhing sdud pa/sku las shin tu che ba/ yan lag nying lag rnams sbom zhing thung ba hrag pa 'khregs bag dang ldan pa/ gsus khyims che ba/ liṅka rab tu rgyas pa gyen du bsgreng ba'o/ /phyag gsum cu rtsa bzhi'i dang po gnyis zhes pa nas/ glang lpags kyi bar sgrub thabs ltar bskyed pa las/ phyag mtshan 'phang mdung ni rtse mtshon gyi rnam pa mdung so lta bu la/ mjug tu rma bya'i sgro phod yod pa zhig yin la/ gshun shing ni shing sbom thung sked pa shin tu phra ba zhig dang / rdo rje rtse gcig ni ka na ya zhes zer te/ shing 'dom gang tsam gyi rtse gnyis po 'khor lo re re/ shing rtse dang 'khor lo dag las 'thon pa'i mtshon mdung so'i dbyibs can/ shin tu rno ba mtho gang tsam re yod pa zhig go /dbyug pa ni rdo rjes mtshan pa'o/ kha ṭāX ni mgo bo rnam pa gsum brtsegs par yod pa ste spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'khor lo ni rtsibs brgyad dam drug dang ldan pa'i ma zhi pa'i 'khor lo ngar dang ldan pa'o/ /rnge'u chung ni ḍā ma dra'o/ /mgo bo ni bdud kyi ste rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa zhig go /me thab ni zur gsum pa'o/ /thod tshal ni mi'i mgo bo dum bu sha lpags skra dang bcas pa nang bdud rtsis gang ba ste/ sngags pa rnams kyi ban+ta zer ba 'di lta bu yin par mngon no/ /sdigs mdzub ni/ kha cig mi lag sdigs mdzub can zhig phyag gis bzung ba yin zer kyang / rang lugs phyag gis sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /ba dan ni 'phan rtse —267—

gsum pa'o/ /rlung ras ni kha dog ljang gu rlud gi rang bzhin can bskyod pa zhig go /tha ma gnyis kyis ni glang lpags rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa sku stod kyi phyogs su phyar te sku la ma 'byar ba stod g.yogs kyi tshul du 'dzin pa'o/ /gzhan rnams go sla'o/ /la li ta dang / a mo gha/ slob dpon a bo sogs kyis dang po'i phyag gis glang lpags 'dzin par gsungs pa ni/ rgyab kyi phyag nas brtsam ste bsgrigs par mngon la dang po yin tshad rtsa phyag yin pa'i nges pa med do/ /'dir ni rtsa phyag nas brtsam ste bshad pa'o/ /zhabs rnams bris thang sogs la brgyad brkyang bskum dang / brgyad gar stabs su byas pa yod pa'ang 'dug kyang de dag ni stabs ma bde ba'i phyir de ltar byas pa yin la/ sgom pa'i skabs su g.yas brgyad bskum zhing g.yon brgyad lhag par brkyang ba sgom pa'o/ /de yang g.yas kyi zhabs re res mi nas/wa'i bar te gdon brgyad kyi ngo bo yin la gdon brgyad ni phyogs skyong ba brgyad do/ /g.yon rnams kyi bya rgod nas/ ba tsā kyi bar ni nad brgyad kyi ngo bo ste/bzhad ni bod du mi 'byung ngo / /de rnams kyi 'og tu bdud bzhi gdong drug la sogs pa rnams kha sbub tu bskyel nas mnan pa/ sku gcer bu shin tu gtum pa zhal brgyad la thod pa lnga lngas brgyan pa/ sprul nag dang mi mgo khrag 'dzag lnga bcu rgyu rlon la brgyus te do shal byas pa/ 'khor lo'i snyan rgyan sogs rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / khrag gi thig le dang zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bus brgyan pa/ bskal ba 'jig par nus pa'i me lta bu'i klong nas bzhugs pa 'dod pa'i khams dang / gzugs khams dang gzugs med khams rnams kyi blta bar —268—

yang mi bzod pa'i dam tshig sems dpa' nyid du bsgom par bya'o/ /'di ltar sku yongs rdzogs kyi dag pa ni/ 'khor lo sdom pa sgrol ba'i mgon po'i mdzad par blta zhing sems par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du ye shes sems dpa' bstims/ gzhi 'jam dpal sku mdog sogs rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bu dang / spro na de'i thugs kar rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa'i rtse lnga pa'i nang du nyi dkyil gyi steng du ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' huX nag po bsgom zhing bsdus na huX kho na bsgom mo/ /de nas skye rma/ched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa na/thal thams cad la sbyor ba byung mod/ rang lugs ni rtsa zhal kho na'i mig g.yas g.yon gyi dbus su k+ṣi dkar po kha phyir bstan pa 'od zer 'phro ba ste/ sa snying dngos kyi 'du shes dang / de bzhin du rna ba gnyis kyis khung bur dziXsngon po phyag na rdo rje sogs thams cad la 'gres so/ /sna bug gis rtse'i nang ngam 'dom so la khaX ser po nam mkha'i snying po dang / lce rtsar gaX dmar po 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / dpral ba'i mthong sam skra mtshams su skaX ljang khu sgrib sel dang / lte bar saX dkar po kun tu bzang po ste/ kun rdzob tu sbyar na dpral ba dang lte ba'i 'di sha lpags mtshams su sgom par byed kyang / lha sku ni gdos byed dang bral ba'i tshad gzhal bar bya mi dgos so/ /spyi bo'i dbus su oX dkar po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje/ mgrin pa'i dbus su āX dmar po gsung rdo rje/ snying kha'i dbus su hūX nag po thugs rdo rje ste/ de gsum yang yi ge gsum 'dus pa ste/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ngo bo'o/ /hūX de las 'od zer mkha' dbyings khyab par spros pas/ gdod ma ni grub pa 'og min gyi gnas nas rdo rje 'jigs byed —269—

sangs rgyas byang chub dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs nas mchod pa lnga phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod cing snying kha nas mchod tshogs dpag tu med pa spro'o/ /de nas/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /ces dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad/ bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /zhes gtso bo la bos te/dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pas/ dbang lha rigs lngas dbang bskur/gshegs ma bzhis khrus gsol/ sems dpa' drug gam brgyad kyis shis pa brjod cing me tog gi char dang / rol mo'i sgra bsgrag /gzugs rdo rje ma sogs kyis yang dag par mchod/ khro bo khro mos bgegs thams cad bskrad cing /sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs gsung zhing dbang bskur ba ste/ de'i don ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba las byung gzugs gzugs med 'dod khams te khams gsum gyis phyag byas pa'i dbang de khyod la dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /zhes so/ /oṃ sarba tā thā ga ta zhes sogs gsung zhing ye shes kyi chus dbang bskur lus thams cad gang / rdo rje khro bo'i mthu stobs thams cad la dbang bar byas/ sdig sgrib thams cad yang dag par sbyangs te/ chu'i dwangs ma yar lud nas/ rtsa zhal gyi spyi bor 'khyil ba la/ mi bskyod par gyur nas dbu rgyan gyur par bsam mo/ /de ltar dbang bskur ba'i las ye shes pa de nyid kyis mdzad zin pa na/ badz+ra aX gu sha dzaX zhes phyag dang bcas pas mdun du byon par bsam/ de bzhin du pa sha zhes pa'i lus la gzhugs/ sbo ṭa zhes pa'i dam ye 'bral med du bcings/ gaṇ+ḍi zhes pas mnyes par byed pa ste/ dgug gzhug —270—

kyang mi mnyes bzhin du ma yin gyi mnyes pa dang bcas pas so/ /de nas sngar sems dpa' gsum brtsegs bsgoms pa med na skabs 'dir nges par gsal 'debs dgos la/ sngar yod na sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i yig 'bru dmigs bcas dran pa tsam gyis kyang chog ste/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya gnas gsum du gsags te/ hruX gyiX re re brjod do/ /dag pa ni/ ma'i mngal nas btsas te skye bo kun gyis mthong ba'i lus de ni bcom ldan 'das kyi skus sbyong zhing / sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa dang / smin byed zung 'jug kha sbyor myur du thob pa dang / skye mched gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi lus cher song zhing khams rgyas pa'i skabs sbyong /rgyas btab kyi rang rigs kyi byed las rnams sbyong bar byed do/ /de nas bdag nyid la mchod par bya ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas gzugs rdo rje ma sogs lnga dang / sgeg mo lha mo brgyad spros nas rang nyid la mchod par bsam ste/ sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin dang bcas pa bya'o/ /de nas gzugs sgra la sogs pa ngag tu brjod de/ de'i don ni/ gzugs sgra sogs kyi mchod par 'dug kyang /dngos 'dzin med cing nam mkha' lta bu yin kyang / longs spyod kyi rnam grangs du mar snang ste/ dper na tsho ni sna lnga zhig gis steng du shel g.ya' dag pa dkar po zhig bzhag na/ de tshon mdog ji bzhin du snang ba lta bu'i 'dod yon de dang de la rtag tu spyod par shog /a la la hoX zhes ngo mtshar ba'i tshig dang / mchod pa 'di dag la rol zhing longs spyod du gsol/ zhes pa ste/ de yang mchod pa de dag 'dzin pa med pa sgyu ma lta bu/ dbang yul du 'gag pa med par rig pa/—271—

don dam par mig yor lta bu de la rol te hoX zhes chags tshig gis bskul ni/don dam par chags pa dang bral yang rnam par chags par mdzod/ oX sarba sogs/ ko3 haX gi bar te/ de'i don ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mchod pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag nyid nga'o/ /zhes sogs/ de ltar mchod nas lha mo rnams slar yang rang gi snying gar bsdus/ de nas sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rang nyid la bstod par bsams te/ dud khrod ces pa nas/ 'dud ces pa'i bar brjod do/ /de'i don ni dur khrod kyi rgyan gyi rab tu brgyan pa zhe sdang gshin rje gshod khyod ngo bo bde ba chen po spros pa dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu yin yang / thugs rje chen po'i 'gro ba'i don du sprul pa'i sku ye shes chen po'i khro bo rab tu khros pas/ sku mdog dud kha dang mun pa lta bu gnag cing ngam za ba khyod la 'dud/ces pa ste/ oṃ sarba nas ko haX te de'i don ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bstod pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag nyid nga'o/ /zhes so/ /de nas rjes chags kyi bde ba bsgom pa ni/ 'phyud rgya byas la/ oṃ āXhuX zhes yum rdo rje ro langs ma spros nas rang la 'byud rdo rje pad+ma'i sbyor bas bde ba sgom par byed do/ /oX sarba nas/ ko3 haX ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rjes su chags pa'i rdo rje rang bzhin bdag nyid nga'o/ /swa bhā was sbyangs te/ mdun du rlung dkyil zla gam bcad kha rang la bstan cing / chang zung g.yo ba'i ba dan can/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaX gsum yongs su gyur pa las mi mgo'i skyed bu gsum gyis steng du thod pa —272—

shin tu rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i sa bon na las mi'i sha ya yig gis mtshan pa sogs te/ ya ni gshin rje gshed/ slo ni gti mug gshin rje gshed/ ma ni ser sna gzhan rje gshed/ me 'dod chags gshin rje gshed/ dha phrag dog gshi/na rje gshe/da/ dbus kyi steng du shu las byang sems huX gis mtshan pa sogs te/ hūX ni rdo rje ro langs ma/ dza ni 'a ka /sa ni phag mo/ do ni dbyangs can ma/ ru ni go ri ti/ rigs lnga yum dang bcas pa'i sa bon no/ /rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros rlung g.yos mes sbar te sha bdud rtsi yi ge rnams zhu zhing khol te/ spris ma sna tshogs rdo rje'i tshul du gyur pa'i nye bar zhe sdang gshin rje gshed nag po'am sngon po/ de bzhin du shar gyi dkar po/ lhor ser po/ nub tu dmar po/ byang du ljang khu rnams yin la/ de nas rgya mtsho chen por gyur ces pa'i bar bsam zhing brjod pa ste/ oX āXhūX ha ho khyoX zhes byin gyis brlabs nang mchod dngos su yod na myang / med na dmigs pa'i rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal brtan pa dang / phyag rnams byang phyogs so bdun/ zhabs stong nyid bcu drug sogs sku'i dag pa dran par byed pa'o/ /de yang lha sku snang ba de lta bus/ rang lus mgo gcig lag pa gnyis pa'i snang ba 'di sbyong ba dang / nga rgyal brtan pos bdag tu zhen pa sbyong bar byed do/ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa rjes ni/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/khams gsum gyi snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang / bcud thams cad lha'i rang bzhin du bya ste/ thams cad bdag gis sgom pa'i bsrung 'khor la thim/bsrung 'khore dur khrod khrag mtsho yang gzhal yas khang la thim/ rang gi zhal —273—

phyag lhag ma rnams kyang rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim/ de yang 'od gsal du zhu bar bsam nas cung zad mnyam par bzhag /'dis ni 'chi ba sbyong zhing chos sku thob pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa dang / des don gyi 'od gsal mngon du byed par lngar ro/ /de nas bsrung ba ni/ stong pa'i ngang de las slar yang rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis par krong gis song ba'i mig tu cha nas/saX gis bar gong bzhin bsgoms pa ste/ smon lam ci rigs bkra shis dang bcas pa brjod pa'o/ /zhes pa rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyis sgrub thabs snying po'i (yā non brjed tho zin bris mdo tsam 'di ni rdo rje 'chang chen po tā ra nā thas zhabs rdul spyi bor len pa'i dge slong rin chen rgya mtshos bgyis pa'o/ /sarba maṅgalaX// dge'o// //'dir bzhengs rab dkar bsod nams kyis/ /'brel thogs yod tshad la phan te/ /gnas skabs mthar thug legs tshogs thob/ /ring min gtan bde dbang gyur cig/ // —274—

snyan rgyud thun mong ma yin pa bzhugs/shin tu gsang ba'i bka' rgya yod/oX swā sti/ chos kunaX sgrib med gzigs pa mkhyen pa'i gter/ /legs bshad dgaX' ston 'gyed la mthu grub pas/ /dam chos rgya mtsho'i snyid bhoX gsal mdzad pa/ khyab bdag bla mas rtag tu shis par mdzod/ /'jam dpal thugs kyi rdo rje gshin rje gshed/ /mi bzad khro bo wo po 'jigs pa'i sku/ /ye shes me lce 'bar ba'i 'od dpung gis/ /bdud sde 'jom byed bhi ra wa yis skyongs/ /rtog bdun brjod bya'i snying po'i don/ /rwa lo'i thugs bcud rmad byung ba/ /snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa yi/ /zhal gdams bla ma'i gsung bzhin 'bri/ /'dir dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa la/ bsnyen pa dang rjes su 'brel ba'i zhal gdams dang / sgrub pa dang rjes su 'brel ba'i zhal gdams dang / las sbyor dang rjes su 'brel ba'i zhal gdams dang gsum mo/ /dang po la/ thun mong bskyed rim gyi zhal gdams dang / thun mong ma yin pa mchog gi bsnyen pa'i zhal gdams dang gnyis las/ dang po la/ tshogs zhing gi skabs su dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar/ bla ma mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor la/ bla ma steng gi cha la sgom pa dang / rigs —275—

bdag gi tshul du bsgom pa ma yin par/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang ngo bo dbyer med pa 'khor lha bcu gsum mam dgu'am brgyad kyis bskor ba dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor badz+ra sa ma dzaXzhes spyan drangs/ a mṛ ta'i sngags sam/ ya man+ta kas: phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad cing byur dang bkra mi shis pa thams cad bsangs shing sbyangs bar bsam pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa dang po'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ rgyun bshags yan lag bdun pa'i skabs/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pa dang / sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/chi/byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pa'i skabs su thun mong ma yin pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba ste/ mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po ni/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang / rtsa sngags dang snying po/ nye snying la sogs pa'i sngags rnams ni chos dkon mchog dang /thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khor rnams ni dge 'dun dkon mchog ste/ de rnams yid yul du 'char bar byas te/ de rnams la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gdams gnyis pa'o/ /mthar tshogs zhing rnams gshegs su gsol ba dang / mi dmigs par sbyangs pa dang / rang la bstim pa la sogs pa'i lugs du ma yod kyang / skabs 'dir rang la bsdu ba gtso che la/ 'di ni thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gdams ma yin kyang 'phros don gyi tshul du gsung ngo / /gsum pa ni/ thun mong pa la bsrung 'khor gyi nang du chos 'byung sgom pa —276—

yin kyang / thun mong ma yin pa'i skabs 'dir bsrung 'khor gyi phyi rol tu chos 'byung sgom pa yin la/ de yang mchog sgrub pa la chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ drag po'i las la chos 'byung gru gsum nag po/ me rab tu 'bar ba bsgom pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gdams gsum pa'o/ /chos 'byung bsrung 'khor thod ra dang bcas pa bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ chos 'byung gi phyi rol tu bsrung 'khor bsgom pa la ni/ slar yang chos 'byung gi nang du rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ de'i steng du phyi rol tu dur khrod dang / de las cung zad kyi dma' bar khrag gi rgya mtsho dang / de'i dbus su rin po che'i ri bo kha dog nag po khrag mtsho dang /dur khrod las cung zad kyi mtho bar gyur pa'i steng du thod ra bsgom mo/ /chos 'byung gi nang du bsrung 'khor sgom pa'i rigs la dmigs pa ni/ chos 'byung gi nang du bsrung 'khor gyi rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyi rol phyogs kun tu rdo rje'i ra ba zlum por bskor ba'i nang gi 'khor yug tu dur khrod chen po brgyad dang / de las cung zad kyi dma' ba'i nang du khrag gi rgya mtsho'i bskor ba/ de'i dbus su rin po che'i ri bo'i steng du thod ra bsgom mo/ /bzhi pa ni/ thod ra'i nang du yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dbyibs zlum po/ du ba 'thul bar byed pa kha dog nag po/ rlud nag 'tshub ma'i rnam par bsgom zhing de las kyang phyogs kun tu rlung nag 'tshub ma'i rnam pa dpag tu med pa spros pas sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs thams cad phyogs kun tu gtor te lhag ma tsam yang med par brlag par bsam pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa bzhi pa'o/ /—277—

lnga pa ni/ rgyu'i 'jam dpal sgom pa'i bar sgrub thabs kyi dkyus nas 'byung ba bzhin byas la/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga khro bo'i rnam pa dang / de bzhin gshegs ma rnams kyang khro mo'i nyams dang bcas shing / byang chub sems dpa' yang khro bo'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ 'jam dpal gdan dang bcas pa nyi ma la thim par sgom/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor las kyang tsha zer 'bar ba dpag tu med pa phyogs kun tu spros pas/ dgra bgegs spyi dang / dmigs gsal can gyi dgra bgegs thams cad thal ba tsam yang ma lus par bsregs par bsam pa ni thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gdams lnga pa'o/ /drug pa ni/ yang de'i 'od zer gyis/ ā li kā li dang sngags 'phreng rnams rang rang gi sgra 'brug ltar sgrog pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te nyi ma la bstims pas/ huX nag po 'od zer 'phros pa'i bar tsam zhig gsal 'debs pa'i bar dkyus bzhin las/ hūX zhes pa'i sgra 'khrug stong ldir ba lta bu'i sgras phyogs thams cad khyab par bsam zhing / sgra des ber langs pa lta bur gyur te/dgra bgegs thams cad kyi gnas rnams zhig cing shin tu skrag pas brgyal bar gyur par bsam/ yang hūX las dug gi sprin nam mkha' gang ba spros te de las nad dang dug chu'i char ba dpag tu med pa byung nas dgra bgegs thams cad rul myags shing bsngos pas rdul du brlag par bsam pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gdams drug pa'o/ /bdun pa ni/ 'od zer 'phros pas phyag mtshan rnams spyan drangs la —278—

bstims pas/ huX de nyid rdo rje mthing nag rwa gdengs pa 'od zer 'phro ba sgom pa'i bar dkyus bzhin las/ rdo rje de las khro chung dang / phyag mtshan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spros pas phyag mtshan me 'bar ba rnams kyis dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad cing khro chung rnams kyis sems can thams cad kyang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku'i rnam par bsgyur cing go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnam par gyur te rdo rje la thim par bsgom pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gdams bdun pa'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ de nas rang nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku'i rnam par lam gyis grub par bsam ste/ nyud mtha' la yang / khyoX ྅jiX bdun tsam gyis sngags kyi lhar sgrub pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gdams brgyad pa'o/ /dgu pa ni/ zhal phyag gsal 'debs dkyus bzhin las/ sku las sprul pa'i pho nya spro ba'i skabs su/ nges pa'i 'khor dang / ma nges pa'i 'khor gnyis las/ dang po la mngags pa dang / pho nya gnyis las/ dang po ni/ srin po dang /mkha' 'gro ma gnyis/ gnyis pa ni/ gshin rje dang / ma mo gnyis so/ /de rnams spro ba'i tshul ni/ mar me las/ mar me'i 'od bzhin du/ rang nyid 'jigs byed chen po'i skur gsal ba'i snang cha las dur khrod chen po brgyad du/srin po dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang/ gshin rje dang ma mo ste/ de rnams gsal 'debs pa ni/ srin po brgyad g.yas ral gri dang / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/yang na g.yas kyi phyag mtshan gri gug dang 'dam kha yin kyang / phyag len la ra lu —279—

gri gtso che bar mdzad de/ srin po'i zhal du dgra bgegs thams cad chom chom gsol bas zhal mchil dmar po thor thor 'thor bar bsam/ mkha' 'gro ma brgyad ni/ g.yas gri khug dang / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gshin rje brgyad ni g.yas ral gri dang / g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ de'i yum ma mo brgyad ni/g.yas rtse gsum dang / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ de rnams thams cad kyang sku mdog nag por bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ ma nges pa'i 'khor ni/ bran pho mo ste/thams cad kyang sku mdog ma nges pa/ mgo brnyan sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa/ sku dang gzhal yas khang dang / dur khrod la sogs pa gnas ma nges pa nas phar 'phro ba dang / tshur gnas ma nges pa rnams su bsdu bar byed pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gdams dgu pa'o/ /de nas dam tshig pa bskyed zin pa'i skabs dang / ye shes pa rang la bstim pa la sogs pa'i skabs su/ drag shul gyi nyams dang ldan pas/ ri rnams snyil zhing rgya mtsho drag tu 'khrugs pa dang / gza' skar thang la lhung ba la sogs pa gzi byin dang mthu stobs dpag tu med pa dang ldan par bsam/ mig tu skruX la sogs pa'i sa bon gyi yi ge de rnams sa'i snying po la sogs pa lha so so'i rang bzhin du mos/ spyi bor gnas pa'i oX yig rnam snang dang / rin 'byung gcig tu bsdus pa sku rdo rje dang mgrin pa'i āX yig 'od dpag med dang / don grub gcig tu 'dus pa gsung rdo rje dang / thugs ka'i hūX yig mi bskyod pa thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du mos so/ /bcu pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rdo rje 'jigs byed sprul pa'i sku ri rab kyi rtse'am/ khong gseng na bzhugs pa de nyid skad cig nyid —280—

la mdun du spyan drangs/ gong tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar bsangs pa byas la/ oX hiX ྅lngeX haX zhes pa'am/ oṃ badz+ra lwa su hūX/ zhes pa'am/ an+taX la sogs pa gang rung gis mchod pa las/ phyag len la phyi ma gtso che bar mdzad nas/ oX badz+ra aX gu sha dzaX zhes sogs sam/ bsdu na dzaX huX baX hoX zhes pas rang la bstims pas bkrag mdangs gzi byin dpag tu med pa skyes par mos la/ brtan pa'i phyir du/ yā man+ta ka lan gsum sogs bzla ba ni/ zhal gdams bcu pa'o/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ yang snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku'i rnam par gyur pa rnams/ yā mun+ta ka'i sngags kyis 'jigs byed du sgrub la/ spyan 'dren pa/bsangs pa/ mchod pa bstim pa'i bar sngar bzhin las/ rang nyid sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun 'dus su mos la/ brtan pa'i phyir du yā man+ta ka sngar bzhin bzla ba ni/ zhal gyi gdams pa bcu gcig pa'o/ /bcu gnyis pa ni/ sngar bzhin 'od zer spros pas gdod nas grub pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku nam mkha' khyab par bzhugs pa de nyid rang gi mdun tu mngon du gyur pa'i tshul gyis badz+ra sa ma dzaX spyan drangs/ bsangs pa mchod pa/ bstim pa rnams sngar bzhin byas/ rang nyid gdod nas grub pa'i longs sku rdo rje 'jigs byed dngos yin snyam du mos/ ya man+ta ka'i sngar bzhin brtan par byed pa ni/ zhal gyi gdams pa bcu gnyis pa'o/ /de yang ye shes spyan 'dren gyi zhal gdams gsum po 'di rnams la/ thog mtha' gnyis la spyan 'dren/bsangs pa/ mchod pa/ bstim pa/ brtan par byed pa ste/ don tshan lnga lnga dang /—281—

bar ba la 'od zer gyis 'jigs byed kyi skur bsgyur ba sngar gyis lhar sgrub pa/spyan 'dren pa/ bsangs pa/ mchod pa/ bstim pa brtan par byed pa ste/ don tshan bdun no/ /rang nyid 'jigs byed du gyur pa la/ mig tu k+ṇi la sogs pa bkod pa'i tshe rgyud tha dad pa'i tshul gyis rang nyid bsrung ba'i phyir bkod pa yin la/ sprul sku rdo rje 'jigs byed bstim pa'i skabs su rang nyid 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i sbyan dang phyag dang dbu la sogs pa rnams/ sprul sku rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi de dang de yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal bskyed do/ /sangs rgyas byang sems 'jigs byed kyi rnam par gyur pa rnams rang la bstim pa'i ska pas ṭa su spyan la sogs pa'i sku lus kyi cha shas rnams/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi de dang de yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal bskyed do/ /gdod nas grub pa'i gnas lugs chos nyid kyi longs sku rdo rje 'jigs byed bstim pa'i skabs su/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i sku gsung thugs rnams/ chos nyid gdod ma'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku gsung thugs dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal bskyed do/ /bcu gsum pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug rnams spyan 'dren pa las/ thams cad kyang khro bo'i rnam pa/ rigs lnga dang sems dpa' rnams g.yas rang rang gi phyag mtshan phyar ba/ g.yon rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pas/ so so'i yum khro nyams dang bcas pa la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi tshul gyi bzhugs par mdun du spyan drangs te bsang ba bya ba ni/ zhal gdams bcu gsum pa'o/ /—282—

de nas rigs bdag mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa'i bar dkyus bzhin no/ /bcu bzhi pa ni/ dbang gi lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gtso bor spro zhing /rang gi snying ga nas kyang 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros pas 'khor 'das kyi snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs bcud thams cad dang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi sku'i byin rlabs 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par spyan drangs te/dzaXhūX baX hoX zhes pas rang la bstims pas/ rang nyid la gzi byin dpag tu med pa skyes par mos la/ oṃ yā man+ta ka huX phaṭa/ oX oX oX/ zhes bzla ba ni/zhal gdams bcu bzhi pa'o/ /bco lnga pa ni/ dbang lha dang / rang gi snying ga nas 'or zer 'phros pas 'khor 'das kyi snod bcud thams cad kyi mdangs dang / ye shes mi shigs pa'i bcud rnams dang / sangs rgyas byang sems kyi gsung gi byin rlabs 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ rang la bstims pas sngar bas kyang gzi byin 'phel bar bsam la/ yā mun+ta ka'i mthar/ āX.āX.āX zhes bzla ba ni/zhal gdams bco lnga pa'o/ /bcu drug pa ni/ dbang lha dang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad kyi mdangs dang / bcud rnams dang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs rnams 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par spyan drangs te bstim pas/ gzi byin lhag par 'phel bar bsam la/ yā man+ta ka'i mthar/ huX hūX stoX/ zhes bzla ba ni/ zhal gdams bcu drug pa'o/ /bcu bdun pa ni/ dbang gi lha'i thugs ka nas dang / rang gi snying ga —283—

nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'khor 'das kyi snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs spyi dang / khyad par rang rang so so'i yon to/ dper na sa'i yon to sra ba dang / de bzhin du chu'i brlan gsher dang / me'i drod dang / rlung gi yon tan g.yo ba la sogs pa rnams dang / sems can so so'i yon tan gyi khyad par rnams dang / sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang /yon tan gyi khyad par sna tshogs pa rnams te/ mdor na 'khor 'das kyi brtan g.yo thams cad kyi thabs snang ba'i cha thams cad 'od zer ser po'i rnam par spyan drangs shing / de dang lhan cig tu rgyan dang / na bza'i khyad par mang po yang tshur bsdus/ rang la bstims pas 'od zer rnams rang la thim zhing / na bza' rnams glang lpags la thim/ rgyan gyi khyad par rnams sku'i rgyan cha rnams la thim pas/ rgyan rnams kyang 'od 'bar zhing 'phro ba'i rnam pa dang / rang nyid kyi gzi byin yang lhag par rgyas par bsam zhing / mchod yon/ me tog /bdug spos/snang gsal/ dri mchog /zhal zas sogs mchod pa'i khyad par sna tshogs pa rang nyid la 'byung bar bsam la/ ya mun+ta ka'i mthar/ swā swā swā/ zhes bzla ba ni/zhal gdams bcu bdun pa'o/ /bco brgyad pa ni/ dbang lha dang / rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'khor 'das kyi brtan g.yo thams cad kyi mdangs dang / bcud rnams dang / khyad par du yang de dag gi shes rab stong pa'i cha rnams 'od zer ljang gu'i rnam par spyan drangs shing / de dag dang lhan cig tu gri gug la sogs pa mtshon cha sna tshogs pa yang bkug ste/ rang nyid la bstims pa las/ 'od zer rnams —284—

rang gi sku lus la thim pas gzi byin sngar las kyang lhag par rgyas/ mtsho ni cha rnams phyag mtshan so so la thim pas/ phyag mtshan rnams kyang me lce 'bar bar gyur par bsam la/ rang nyid la khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang po lnga'i me togasha chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi snang gsal/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha khrag gi zhal zas/ zhing chen gyi bla re/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi sogs drag po'i mchod pa sna tshogs pa byung bar bsam la/ ya mun+ta ka'i mthar/ hā hā hā/ zhes bzla ba ni zhal gdam bco brgyad pa'o/ /bcu dgu pa ni/ dbang gi lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros/ 'khor 'das snod bcud rnams kyi spros bral stong ba'i cha rnams 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par spyan drangs shing / de dang lhan cig tu tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa 'jig rten na mthu dang stobs che bar gyur pa'i skye 'gro rnams bkug ste/ zhabs 'og gi srog chags rnams la bstim/ 'od zer rnams rang la thim pas gzi byin dpag tu med pa rgyas par mos la/ ya mun+ta ka'i mthar/ hi hi hi/ zhes bzla ba ni zhal gdams bcu dgu pa'o/ /nyi shu pa ni/ de nas rang gi snying ga nas phag mo dang dbyangs can ma dang /ro langs ma dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ste bzhi po gang rung zhig rjes chags kyi don du spro ba yin pa las/ phag mo dang / dbyangs can ma gnyis dgra nag nas 'byung ba ltar/ zhal gsum phyag drug ma dang / rdo rje ro langs ma zhal gsum phyag drug ma'am/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gang rung du bsgom zhing / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ni dgra nag nas 'byung ba ltar/ zhal gsum phyag drug mar bsgom mo/ /de —285—

ltar rang gi snying ga nas lha mo bzhi po gang rung zhig 'khor sgeg sogs lha mo brgyad dang bcas pa spros/ thabs shes kyi mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs la/rang nyid la yum bzhi po gang rung zhig gis 'khyud par bsam la/ sgeg sogs lha mo brgyad po rnams kyang / mtha' skor du glu dang gar la sogs pa chags pa'i rol rtsed sna tshogs pa byed par mos la/ rang nyid yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas dga' bzhi'i ye shes skyes par mos la oṃ āXhuX oX sarba tā tha ga ta a nu rā ga na sogs brjod pa ni gsang ba'i mchod pa ste/ zhal gdams nyi shu pa'o/ /de nas gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ /zhes sogs 'don bzhin pas rjes chags kyis bde ba dang / lha mo'i rol rtsed sogs snang stong rgyu ma lta bur shes par byas nas/ snying ga nas spros pa de dag slar rang gi snying gar bsdu'o/ /dkyus nas 'byung ba bzhin gyi bstod pas bstod cing / rang nyid la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis brag cha lta bu'i sgras bstod par bsam mo/ /bdud rtsi myang ba dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar byed do/ /nyer gcig pa ni/ rang nyid 'jigs byed chen por gsal ba'i mdun du 'brub khung zhig gsal gdab/ hruX gyiX 'i mthar dmigs gsal can gyi dgra yod na/ ming nas smos la a kar+ṣa ya dzaX zhes pa dang / de lta bur med na sarba sha krus a kar+ṣa ya dzaX zhes brjod pas zhabs 'og gi srog chags rnams las pho nya'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te/ dmigs kyis gsal ba'i dgra yod na de nyid bkug cing / de lta bu med na phyogs bcu'i gdug pa can kun bkug nas/thams cad kyang gcig tu 'dus par gyur te/ 'brub khung gi nang du bcug par —286—

mos la/ dzaXhuX boX hoX zhes brjod do/ /de nas rang gi snying ga nas sku stod rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa can la/ smad phur ba'i dbyibs can spros la/ khyiX dhi༄༷ 'i mthar sarba sha trun gī la ya hūX phaṭa/ ces pa gsum bzhi tsam brjod pas/ dgra bo'i lus sems phral zhing dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la sgrag par bsam/ de nas hiX dhi'i mthar sarba sha truX tshin+ta tshin+ta bin+ta bin+ta mā ra ya hūX phaṭa/ ces lan gsum mam bzhi tsam brjod pas/ mtsho ni cha sna tshogs thogs pa'i pho nya drag gtum rnams kyi dgra bgegs kyi lus rnams dum bur gtub pas/ phyi nang thams cad du sha khrag gi tshogs thod pa'i snod dang / mi lpags kyi g.yang bzhi'i snod rnams su dpag tu med pa byung bar bsam/ de lta bu'i sha khrag gi tshogs pa rnams 'jigs byed chen po'i zhal dgu po rnams nas 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs te/ sha chom rus chom du gsol bar bsam zhing / nges pa dang ma nges pa'i 'khor rnams dang / zhabs 'og gi srog chags rnams kyis kyang hab thob tu khyer zhing gsol bar mos la/ hiX gyiX 'i mthar badz+ra bhe ra wa a dhi pa ti e dam ba li ta kha kha ji hi ji hi hūX hūX phaṭa/ ces pa lan gsum brjod do/ /de ni drag po'i mchod pa ste/ zhal gdams nyer gcig pa'o/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa ni/ zhi khro sbrags sgrub byed pa ste/ drag po'i mchod pa grub rjes su rang nyid kyi thugs ka'i rgyu'i 'jam dpal gnas gyur te/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa zhal bzhi ka dkar po/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang po ti 'dzin pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang zhu 'dzin —287—

pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyi lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pas/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'byud pa/ 'jam dbyangs kyi thugs kar zla ba la dhīX dkar po/ yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma la khyoX dmar po/ dhīX yi mthar rtsa sngags snying po nye snying rnams kyis bskor bar dmigs la/ khyiX dhīXzhes pa lan kha yar bzlas pa'i mthar ya mun+ta ka /hiX sgyiX ya ma ra dzaX rnams bzla'o/ /sngags 'phreng las bdud rtsi dmar po sh+ka gsher drod kyi rang bzhi can dpag tu med pa byung / 'jam dpal gyi sku lus gang / ba sbu'i bu ga nas byung / snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo gang rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis nas brgyud/rang nyid rdo rje'i 'jigs byed kyi sku lus thams cad gang / dri nan nag po dang sdig sgrib thams cad bkrus shing sbyangs/ dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin dag pa'i shel ltar gyur/ bdud rtsi rnams rim gyi 'dus/ 'jam dpal gyi ba sbu'i bu ga nas 'dus/ thugs ka'i dhiXl thim/ de lta bu'i dmigs pa la sems gtad nas bzlas pa bya'o/ /zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi bsnyen pa byed pa'i skabs de kho na la dmigs pa gtod cing / rgyun gyi nyams len la ni/ thog mar zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi dmigs pa dang / bzlas pa cung zad byas la/ sems dpa' gsum brtsegs dkyus bzhin du sgom la bzla par bya'o/ /zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi dmigs pa de la brten nas shes rab 'phel bar byed na/ 'jam dbyangs kyi thugs kar dhīXyig mthar/ oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣa na dhiX zhes pa'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsam zhing /de rnams las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'jam pa'i —288—

dbyangs kyi sku lus thams cad gang / ba sbu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ rang nyid kyi lus kyi nang thams cad gang ba sbu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros pas/ me ri dang 'dres te 'od zer gyi tshogs rnams kyis mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i mkhyen pa rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim par bsam la/ gong gi sngags de bzla'o/ /yang dbang sdud kyi dmigs pa ni/ sku mdog dmar po bsgyur/ bsdu na g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa bskyed/ rgyan dang yum sogs sngar bzhin bsgom/ 'jam dbyangs kyi thugs kar dhīXyi mthar/ oX ma hā ra ga badz+ra ra ga ya sarba satwa na hoX zhes pas bskor bar dmigs/ yang na yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du dhīX yig dmar pos mtha' bskor du/ oṃ mañdzu shrī wa shaX ku ru sgru dzaX zhes pa kha dog dmar pos bskor bar bsgom/ de nas sngags bzlas pas 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa byung / 'jam dpal gyi sku lus gang / ba sbu'i bu ga nas phyir byung / rang nyid 'jigs byed kyi sku lus gang / ba skru'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros 'od zer gyi rtse mo la pho nya drag ga tshu dpa' ba rtul phod dang bcas pa'i nyams can/ lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ dbang du bsdu rgyu'i bsgrub bya pho mo gang yin thams cad zhags pas bcings/ lcags kyus skyes pa'i snying kha dang / bud med kyi gsang ba nas phug ste skad cig nyid la drangs nas/ rang gi zhabs gnyis kyi bar ram mdun du nyi ma'i steng du bkug /de dag thams cad gan rkyal nas brgyal ba dang / myos —289—

pa'i rnam pa can gsal btab/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/de dag la phog pas lus kyi nang thams cad 'od dmar pos gang bas/ rang la shin tu dga' ba dang gus pa dang dad pa'i rnam pas/ thal mo sbyar nas 'dug par bsam/ sngags bzlas nas thun 'jog pa'i tshe de dag de nyid du mi dmigs par bsam pa ma gtogs phar spro ba sogs mi dgos so/ /yang 'jam dbyangs yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems sbyor mtshams nas babs/snying ga'i rtsa bzhi nas rim gyis brgyud/ lus thams cad khrig mer te gang bar bsam la gong gi sngags de bzla'o/ /de rnams ni zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi gdams pa ste/ zhal gdams nyer gnyis pa'o/ /nyer gsum pa ni/ srog sgrub ste/ de yang rang gi snying khar lha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog dmar mo/ dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa khrag gis gang ba'am/ mgo bo ril bo 'dzin pa/ g.yas gnyis kyis po tis mtshan pa'i pad+ma dang / 'khor lo dang / g.yon gnyis kyi ri po ches mtshan pa'i pi waX dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa stag lpags kyi shams thabs sogs zhi ma khro'i rnam par gsal btab/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma la sa bon hiXyig gam/ do yig /de'i mthar/ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradz+nyā warta ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha wa rna ni/ dhi ri dhi ri/ brnyi wadhe ni ye swāhā/ zhes pa rnams kha dog dmar por dmigs la/ de las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/dbyangs can ma'i ba sbu'i bu ga nas thon/ rang gi sa lus kya nang thams cad gang /—290—

ba sbu'i bu ga nas phyir spros me ri dang 'dres pa'i me 'od kyis sems can rnams kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs rnams mkhyen pa'i ngo bor spyan drangs te snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim par bsam la/ gong gi sngags bzla bar byed pa ni/ shes rab 'phel bar byed pa'o/ /dbang sdud kyi dmigs pa ni/ snying ga'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs spros/ dbyangs can ma dang rang gi ba skru'i bu ga nas phyir spros/ khams gsum thams cad dbang du bsdus/ sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs rnams 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim par bsam la/ gong gi sngags bzla'o/ /rgyud 'jam par byed pa ni/ rang gi snying gar dbyangs can ma dang / dbyangs can ma'i thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng sngar bzhin gsal btab la/ sngags 'phreng las byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun byung sku lus kyi nang thams cad gang / gsang gnas nas thon/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang zhing bkrus pas/ nyams bde ba dang ldan par mos la/gong gi sngags bzla'o/ /thugs rgyud bskul ba ni/ rang gi lte bar dbyangs can ma/ de'i gsang gnas su chos 'byung gru gsum gyi nang du nyi ma la hūX de'i mthar nye snying snying po rtsa sngags rnams kyi bskor ba/ rang gi snying khar nyi ma la dbyangs can ma'i sa bon dang / sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung / lte ba na bzhugs pa'i dbyangs can ma'i gsang gnas kyi sngags 'phreng la thim pas/ thugs rgyud rang dbang med par bskul bar bsam mo/ /—291—
