gsang gnas kyi sngags las kyang 'od zer 'phros/ thugs ka'i yi ge la thim/de rnams ni srog bsgrub ste/ zhal gyi gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa nyer gsum pa'o/ /nyer bzhi pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung ba ste/ de yang nyin bsrung ba ni rang nyid 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i lus kyi g.yon sked pa tsam/ mtsher ba'i gnas su gshin rje sku mdog nag po/ g.yas ral gri dang / g.yon phub 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum stag lpags dang sbrul rgyan sogs/ khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku can zhig gsal btang la/ oṃ ya ma ma tha na huX phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags 'di mang nyung ci rigs pa bzla'o/ /dus kyi khyad par skya rengs shar ba tsam la bsngags par bshad do/ /mtshan bsrung ni/ sngar gyi gnas su gshin rje sku mdog nag po/ g.yas ral gri/ g.yon phub 'dzin pa/ rmogs sog go chas brgyan pa/ 'jig rten pa'i cha lugs can zhig dmigs la/ oṃ sdiXkā la ru pa hūX khaX zhes pa mang khung ci rigs pa bzla'o/ khyad par can gyi dus ni mun tshab tshub la'o/ /de gnyis ka la'ang rab tu 'bar ba'i spyan steng 'og thams cad du gzigs pa/ spyan gsum las me lce'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros pas/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku lus kyi nang thams cad gang bar bsam mo/ /de gnyis ni 'jig rten pa'i gshin rje gshed kyi bsrung ba yin la/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsrung ba ni/rang gi lus kyi g.yas phyogs/ mchin pa'i gnas su gshin rje de/ g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i be con dang / g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ sku las me 'od 'phros —292—

pas/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bar bsam la/ oX khyiXkruX bruX sruX snyuX huX gzhes pa brgya rtsa la sogs pa ci rigs pa bzla'o/ /zhal gdams nyer bzhi pa'o/ /nyer lnga pa ni/ las gshin gyi sgrub thabs ni/ snying ga nas spro ba dang /spyan 'dren pa gnyis las dang po ni/ rang gi snying ga nas yi ge yaX gcig spros/mdun du las kyi gshin rje sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas dbyug pa dang / g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ khro zhal spyan gsum pa/ sprul rgyan dang / stag lpags grol ba'am/ gcer bu ling ga gyen du bsgreng ba'i rnam pa can du gsal btab/ de g.yon du yum tsa mun ṭi rtse gsum dang thod khrag 'dzin pa'i rnam pa can skad cig tsam gyis gsal btab la/ sa ma ya stuX/ zhes dam la bzhag /mchod bstod bya/rang nyid 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i yi dam gyi sngags 'phreng gi mthar/ las gshin gyi sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs la/ thog mar yi dam gyi sngags dang /de'i rjes su chos kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa las byung ba'i sngags ring de lan bdun brgyad tsam bzlas la/ de nas/ ya mā kā la ru pa huX phaṭa ta a zhes pa bzlas la/rang gi snying ga'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ las kyi gshin rje yab yum la phog pas/ rang gi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / las gzhan 'khor bcas kyi rang la 'tshub pa dang 'khu ldog gi rnam pa thams cad zhi zhing mthu stobs dang gzi byin dpag tu med pa rgyas par bsam la/ mtha' bskor du rang la bskor ba byed par mos so/ /yang snying ga'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs —293—

dpag tu med pa spros/ las kyi gshin rje la phog pas rang gi dbang du 'dus shing bran bzhin du bka' nyan par bsam mo/ /yang snying ga'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer sngon po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ las kyi gzhin rje la phog pas rang la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa la sogs pa drag po'i las thams cad thogs med du sgrub pa'i las mdzad par bsam la mtha' skor du bskor ba mdzad par mos so/ /de nas thun gyi mthar las ni shin gyi gtor bsngo'am/ yi dam gyi gtor ma'i zhor la gtor ma phul la/ rang gi lte bar yi ge yaX gcig gsal btab la/ de la las gshi/na yum dang bcas pa bsdu'o/ /gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas lto phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas las kyi skyon rje spyan drangs la/ a mṛ tas sngags sam/ ya man+ta kas bsang ba bya/ gzhan sngar bzhin las/ mthar ga kho/gas su gsol/ de ni zhal gdams nyer lnga pa'o/ /nyer drug pa 'khor lo'i bsnyen pa ni/ rang gi lte ba'i nang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ de'i phyi bskor rtsibs bcu gnyis/ de'i phyi bskor du drug cu re bzhi rnams su yod pa las/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ 'khor lo nang bskor la re mig brgyad/ de'i phyi la re mig bcu gnyis/ de'i phyi la re mig bcu drug ste/ thams cad kyi bar rnams rtsig pa 'then pa lta bu la thog phub byed na lcags mkhar sgo med dang / thog phub mi byed na 'brub khung lta bu'o/ /re mig gi dbus su yaX yig dang / shar nas g.yas bskor du/ spu ma me da dang / phyi —294—

bskor gyi re mig bcu gnyis la/ dzaXs do ru ṇa yo ni ra ya smo ni ra/ zhes pa rnams 'god pa yin pa las/ de yang lto ma'i thad du ra dang de nas dzaXsogs g.yas bskor du bkod/ phyi'i re mig la/ oX dang hiXgacig tu byas na na gnyis gcig tu byas pa'i snying po'i sngags 'god cing / yig 'bru med pa'i re mig stong pa rnams su/ gti mug gi sa bon maX dang / ser sna'i sa bon baX dang / 'dod chags kyi sa bon taX dang / phrag dog gi sa bon i baX dang / zhe sdang gi sa bon daX rnams las byung ba'i bdud bzhi'i rnam pa can gyi bgegs dang dgra ste gnas par bsam la/ 'jam rlung bzung zhing 'gog bzlas kyi tshul gyis/ oX ya ma rā dza sa do me ya hūX phaṭa/ oX ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya hūX phaṭa/ oX ya da yo ni ra yak+ṣi ya hūX phaṭa/ oX yak+ṣi yasnro ni ra ma ya hūX phaṭa/ ces rtsa sngags dum bu bzhir byas te bzla ba yin pa las/ dmigs pa ni yig 'bru rnams las me lce dang pho nya dpag tu med pa spros/ re mig stong pa rnams la yod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad par bsam mo/ /grangs ni khri phrag lnga tsam zla ba yin pa las/ thun re la sngags tshan re re byas te bzla ba ni cung zad rtsub pa yin zhing / thog mar sngags tshan dang po khri phrag lnga 'gro bar byas la/ de nas rim pas tshan pa re re bzhin khri phrag lnga lnga bzla ba ni 'jam pa yin no/ /de bzhin du hiXgyiXbazla zhing re mig phyi ma la dmigs pa sngar bzhin gtad do/ /de ni gshin rje spyi'i 'khor lo/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'bor lo la/ spyir rtog bdun las sdiXgyiXrkyang ba'i 'khor lo dang / hiXrgiXdang ya ma rā dza sbrags pa'i —295—

'khor lo ste gnyis po de gsal bar gsungs shing / hiXgyiXrkyang ba'i 'khor lo gsungs pa'i shugs la/ ya mun+ta ka dang / ya ma rā dza rkyang ba'i 'khor lo'ang bstan cing / hiXgyiXdang ya ma rā dza sbrags pa'i 'khor lo bstan pa'i shugs la/hiXzhingaXdang ya mun+ta ka sbrags pa dang / ya ma rā dza dang / ya man+ta ka sbrags pa'i 'khor lo dang / gsum char sbrags pa'i 'khor lo ste bdun yod pa las/ nang gi bsnyen pa'i skabs 'dir khyiXgyiXdang / ya ma rā dza sbrags pa'i 'khor lo sgom par byed pa yin te/ de yang rang gi lte bar snyen ra lo phyi brgyad nang brgyad/ re mig gi bar dang phyi nang gi mtshams la lcags ri 'then pa la/ thog phub mi byed na 'khrub khung dang / thog phub byed na lcags mkhar du mos la/ lte bar yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor raX gyis mtshan pa/chos 'byung gnyis brtsegs kyi rnam pa can gyi steng du/ g.yas g.yon du raX re re/de'i bar du ṇi dang dri gnod byed thams cad ces pa lta bu dang / dmigs gsal yod na dgra bgegs 'di zhes bya ba zhes pa'i ming dang / de'i steng du yaXyig gzhin rje gshed kyi ngo bos mnan par bsam/ re mig nang ma la phyogs bzhir huX sha truX mā ra ya huX zhes pa dang / mtshams bzhi la phaṭa sha druX mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces pa dang / re mig re re'i mtha' skor du hiXgyiXs bskor ba/ re mig phyi ma'i phyogs dang mtshams kyi sngags spyi gong dang 'dra ba las/ re mig re re'i mdun nas rim pa bzhin du/ ya ma rā dza zhes pa dang / de bzhin du sa do me ya dang / ya me do ru dang / ṇa yo da ya dang / ya da yo ni dang / ra ya spu ya dang / yak+ṣi ru dang /ni ra ma ya dang/ zhes pa'i yi ge bzhi bzhis bskor bar bsam la/ rlud cung —296—

zad bzung la/ nye ba'i me rlung gi steng na gnas pa'i raX gnyis kyi bar gyi dgra bgegs kyi ming dang / de'i steng gi yaXyig la sems gtso bor gtad cing / oṃ ya mun+ta ka sha truX mā ra ya hūX phaṭa/ ces pa khri phrag gcig tsam bzlas la/ de bzhin du oṃ hruXgyiXbi kri tā na na sha truX mā ra ya huX phaṭa/ ces pa phyogs mtshams kyi re mig brgyad po rnams la rim pa bzhin du bzlas la/ rgyas par na thams cad la khri phrag re re dang / bsdu na thams cad sdom pa la khri phrag gcig go /de bzhin du phyi'i re mig la dmigs la phyogs bzhi la/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sha truX mā ra ya huX/ zhes pa lta bu mthar huX yod pa dang / mtshams bzhi la/ oṃ sa do me ya sha truX mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces pa lta bu phaṭa tha mar yod pa bya'o/ /grangs ni rgyas par na khri phrag re re dang / bsdu na thams cad sdom pa la khri phrag gcig bzla zhing / bzlas pa'i dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa/ yig 'bru las 'od zer 'phro ba la sems gtad cing / thun gyi mjug tu drag po'i dmigs pa ni/ 'khor lo'i lte ba na gnas pa'i gnod byed kyi ming de nyid dgra bgegs kyi gzugs su gyur par bsam zhing / yig 'bru rnams las pho nya drag gtum sna tshogs pa mtshon cha thogs pas dgra bgegs kyi lus dum bur gtub pa dang/ mes bsregs pa dang / dug dang nad kyi char phab ste lus rus zhing myags par byed pa sogs sngags brgya tsam gyi ring / thun gyi tha mar dmigs pa de lta bu bya'o/ /de ltar 'khor lo gnyis po'i bsnyen pa legs par song nas/ drag po'i dmigs pa'i bsnyen pa zhag bdun la sogs pa ci rigs pa bya ba las/ de yang rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnam par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i rgyu'i 'jam dpal rdo rje'i 'jigs byed kyi sku'i rnam —297—

par gyur pa la/ yid kyis mchod pa/ bstod pa/ gtor ma 'bul ba rnams byas la/ drag po'i las 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab pas 'jigs byed/ kyi thugs ka nas hūX sngon po zhig spros/ lte ba'i 'khor lo la thim pas/ rma dang me'i dkyil 'bor gyi steng du rdo rje sa gzhi'i steng du gong gi snyen ra lo gnyis po gang 'god zhig gsal btab/ thugs ka'i 'jigs byed kyi sku las huX yig sngon po dang / pho nya'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ lte ba'i 'khor lo'i nang gi yig 'bru'am/ yang na yig 'bru rnams lhar gyur pa la thim/ dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod cig /ces bka' bsgos pas yig 'khru'am lha sku rnams las 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i pho nya'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ dmigs gsal can gyi dgra bgegs yod na de dang / med na phyogs bcu'i gdug pa can gyi dgra bgegs thams cad me rlung gi steng du/lcags kyu zhags pas sbyor bas bkug ste/ 'khor lo'i lte ba'i yaXyig gi dbus kyi dgra bgegs ming / dgra bgegs kyi gzugs su gyur pa la thim par bsam zhing / oX ya mun+ta ka sha druX a kar+ṣa ya dzaXdzaX zhes pa dang / de bzhin du snying po dang / rtsa sngags la yang sbyar ba bzla zhing mthar/ dzaXhuX baX hoX zhes brjod do/ /de nas yig 'bru rnams las 'jig rten las 'das pa'i khro bo dpag tu med pa spros/ de dag gis dgra bgegs kyi lus mtsho ni cha sna tshogs pas dum bur gtubs shing / sha khrag rnams zhal du gsol bar bsam yang dgra bgegs kyi lus sngar bzhin grub pa la yig 'bru'am lha sku rnams las gshin rje dang / srin po dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / ma mo la sogs pa 'jig —298—

rten pa'i lha tshogs spros te/ de dag gi mtshon cha sna tshogs pas lus dum bur gtubs shing sha khrag zhal du gsol bar bsam/ yang dgra bgegs kyi lus sngar bzhin grub pa la/ bya dang gcan zan dang / sprul gdug pa can dpag tu med pa spros te/ dgra bgegs kyi sha rus rnams zos par bsam/ yang sngar bzhin grub pa la/ dug gi char phab ste lus thams cad rul zhing myags par bsam/ yang lus sngar bzhin grub pa la/ nad kyi char ba khrag gi rnam pa can dpag tu med pa babs te tshar bcad par bsam/ yang lus sngar bzhin grub pa la/ mes bsregs shing mthar thal ba rnams kyang rlung gis khyer bar bsam mo/ /de dag gi ring la/ oX hruXgyiXbi kritā na na gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya hūX phaṭa/ ces pa dang / de bzhin du ya mun+ta ka dang / ya ma rā dza la yang btags la bzla'o/ /de dag gi skabs su yang bum pa can gyi sbyor bas 'gog bzlas bya zhing / ci ste mi nus na yid kyis bzlas pa bya'o/ /de ltar na nang gi 'khor lo'i bsnyen pa sngon du legs par song na phyi'i 'khor lo la brten pa'i las tshogs rnams thogs med du 'grub par gyur ro/ /zhal gdams nyer drug pa'o/ /༈ sa bcad gnyis pa mchog gi bsnyen pa rdzogs rim gyi gdams pa la/mtshan mo rgyu ba'i rnal 'byor/ rwa bsgom pa'i zhal shes mtshan ma gyen bsgrengs te gsum las/ dang po ni/ lus gnad legs par bcas la/ zhal phyag lhag ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la bsdus la/ rang nyid zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i ma he'i zhal gyi sna rtse la sems gtad cing / rlung dal bus phyir bus —299—

la/ sna rtser rlud gi reg bya la sems gtad/ tshul de lta bu thun bzhir bcad la zla phyed la sogs par bsgom la/ de nas rlung dal bus nang du rngub cing / sna rtser rlung gi reg bya la sems gtad/ de yang zla phyed tsam gyi bar du bsgom/ de nas rlung dal bus phyir bus shing / dal bus nang du rngub la sna rtser rlung gi reg bya la sems gtad do/ /de nas rang nyid kyi lus nang nas rlung rnams 'od zer sna lnga'i rnam pas rlud rnams phyir 'gro ba dang / mnyam du sna bug gnyis nas phyir song brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad la phog pas/ thams cad gdos bcas kyi rnam pa spangs te 'od du yal yal 'dug par bsam la/ bden med yin/ sgyu ma lta bu yin snyam pa'i dran 'dun drag tu bya/ de nas rlung 'od zer gyi rnam pa can rnams nang du dal bus rngub pa dang mnyam du/ sna bug gnyis nas zhugs te lus nang thams cad gang bas/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnam par gsal ba de nyid dwangs gsal 'od du yal yal bar 'dug par bsam la/bden med yin/ sgyu ma lta bu yin snyam pa'i dran 'dun drag tu bya'o/ /de nas mtshan mo rgyu ba'i dmigs pa dngos gzhi ni/ mtshan mo yin na de dang / nyin mo yin na mun khung du 'dug la/ lus gnad legs par bcas/mig gi lta stangs sna rtse la gtad/ sems rlud phyir 'gro nang 'gro la cung zad gtad cing / gzhan bzo bcos med par shig ge bzhag /de dag ni dmigs chen gcig las phye ba'i dmigs phran lnga'o/ /de yi bogs 'don yan lag tu 'di ltar bsgom par bya ba yin te/ rang dang snod bcud thams cad 'od du yul yul ba/ snang yang bden pa'i stong pa de la dmigs pa'i gzhi byas gnas la —300—

cung zad cig bzhag go /de nas sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal la sogs pa gzugs can du snang ba'i rnam rtog ci shar ba thams cad med bzhin du 'khrul ba'i snang ba sgyu ma lta bur shes par byas la/ de nas dbyings su yal bar bsam zhing / bzo bcos med par bzhag /de ni gzugs phung gi rnam rtog dbyings su bkod pa ste/ zla phyed la sogs ci rigs par bsgom mo/ /de la 'byongs na dus gsum du snang ba'i bde sdug gi rnam rtog yid la shar ba rnams sgyu ma lta bur shes par byas la dbyings su yal bar bsam zhing / bzo bcos med par bzhag /de ni tshor phung dbyings su skyel ba ste/ sngar bzhin 'byongs 'byongs kyi bar du bsgom mo/ /de nas 'di dang 'di lta bu'o snyam du 'dzin pa'i ming don gyi 'du shes rnams sgyu ma lta bur shes par byas la dbyings su skyel zhing / bzo med du bzhag ste 'du shes kyi phung po dbyings su skyel ba ste/ de ma 'byongs kyi bar du bsgom mo/ /de nas 'dod chags zhe sdang la so gas pa mi dge ba'i las kyi rnam rtog dang / dad pa nges 'byung la sogs pa dge ba'i las kyi rnam rtog ste/ 'du byed kyi rnam rtog thams cad kyang sgyu ma lta bur shes par byas la dbyings su skyel zhing / bzo med du bzhag go /de ni 'du byed kyi phung po'i rnam rtog dbyings su skyel ba ste ma 'byongs kyi bar du bsgom mo/ /de nas mig gis gzugs dngos su mthong ba dang / de bzhin du rna bas sgra dang / snas dri dang / lces ro dang /lus kyis reg bya la sogs pa dngos su myong ba rnams kyang sgyu ma lta bur shes par byas la/ sngar bzhin dbyings su yal bar bsam la/ bzo med du ba theg/—301—

de ni rnam shes kyi phung po dbyings su skyel ba ste/ ma 'byongs kyi bar du bsgom mo/ /de nas 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug zas za ba gtam smra ba sogs spyod lam thams cad la yang sngar bzhin sgyu ma lta bur shes pa dang / dbyings su skyel zhing ma bcos par bzhag go /de ltar dmigs pa'i rnam grangs drug tu byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sbyin sreg gi rtog par sha drug gi sbyin sreg bya bar gsungs pa'i nges don bsgom pa'i tshul yin no/ /de dag ni mtshan mo rgyu ba'i zhal gyi gdams pa'o/ /de'i yan lag tu sbyor ba bcud len gyi dmigs pa la nang gi bcud len dang / phyi'i bcud len gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i smin mtshams su huX nag po/ spyi gtsug tu haX dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ lce chung du sum dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ klu lhag ldan zhes bya ba sbrul gyi rnam pa zhig sgom pa yin pa las/ de'i mjug ma'i nang tsam du smin mtshams kyi huX chud pa/ sbrul gyi bshang lam gyi thad du hūX dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa de gnas pa/ sbrul gyi mgo bo thur du bstan pa'i kha nang du suX dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa de tshud par bsam/ snying ga'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi nye ba la la rnyu'i i mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la phaṭa re rer yod pa/ thams cad kyang dkar ram me ba zhig dmigs la/ rlung phyir sna nas bus la nang du rngub pa'i tshe/ so bsregs nas sa'i sgra dang bcas te lce steng nas drangs la/ smin mtshams kyi hūX las bdud rtsi'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung / sprul gyi mjug ma'i nang nas zhugs te/ spyi bor sbrul gyi bshang lam gyi —302—

thad du slebs pa na haX las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung sprul gyi lus nang nas brgyud de kha nang gi suX la reg pas/ de las bdud rtsi tshogs dpag tu med pa byung /mgrin pa nas brgyud/ snying ga'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi yi ge rnams la thim pas/de dag las bdud rtsi'i tshogs mtha' yas pa byung ste/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bar bsam la/ rlung bum pa can bzung ngo / /gnyis pa phyi'i bcud len ni/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag mang du gsal ba'i thugs kar huX las 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spros pas brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad la phog cing / phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad pa'i sha khrag nam mkha' gang ba rnams rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi khro zhal brgyad po rnams kyis gsol bar bsam zhing / snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs rnams 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas drangs shing thugs kar slebs pa na de gnyis dbyer med du gyur te bdud rtsir zhu zhing mthar lus thams cad gang bar mos la bum pa can bzung ngo / /mtshan mo rgyu ba'i yan lag tu sbyor ba nang gi sbyin sreg ni/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i spyi bor bdud rtsi'i bum pa mgo thur du bstan pa/zhabs khrol tshags su yod pa'i nang bdud rtsis gang ba/ snying gar rgyu'i 'jam dpal lam yang na rdo rje zhig bsgom/ lte ba'i rtsa bdud gru gsum gyi nang du chos 'byung rtsa ba lte 'og tu zug cing gdengs ka lte ba'i thad du sleb pa'i/ me thab kyi rnam pa can du gsal btab/ de'i nang du 'khor lo gnyis po gang rung zhig yig 'bru dang bcas pa gsal 'debs pa las/ gshin rje gshed spyi'i 'khor lo —303—

gtso che bar mdzad do/ /de nas rlung ro bsal la/ gsang gnas kyi rlung 'then/de nas bshang sgo'i rlung yang 'then zhing lte bar slebs pa na/ chos 'byung gi nang thams cad du me lce 'bar te snying gar slebs pa na/ yi dam gyi me ri'am 'od zer dang 'dres te/ 'bar ba'i me nang du bzhugs par bsam zhing / snying ga'i yi dam gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas brtan g.yo thams cad kyi bkrag dang mdangs rnams bdud rtsi'i rnam par bkug nas rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/bum pa'i zhabs nas zhugs te bum pa'i nang gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres te/ bdud rtsi'i tshogs dpag tu med pa babs te/ snying gar me lce 'bar ba'i steng du babs pas tshim par bsam la/ rngub chung byas la steng rlud drag tu mnan/ 'og rlung rang sar glod cing / yi dam gyi sngags gsum po gang rung gi mthar/ oṃ asne ye huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa bzla'o/ /las bzhi so so'i lde kha bsgyur na gzhan gong dang 'dra ba las/ zhi ba la me sngags kyi mthar shan+ti ku ru swāhā/ zhes dang / me lce dkar po 'bar bar bsam/ de bzhin du dbang la ba shaX ku ru hoX zhes pa dang /me lce dmar po/ rgyas pa la tshe dang bsod nams pu giX ku ru oX zhes pa dang / me lce ser po/ drag po la dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra 5/ phaṭa/ ces pa dang / me lce dmar nag 'bar bar bsam mo/ /drag po'i las kyi dmigs pa ni/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs su gsal ba'i spyi bo'i bum pa mi bsgoms pa ma gtogs gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ snying ga'i yi dam gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs bkug la zhal dgu po rnams kyis sha chom rus chom du gsol ba rnams snying gar me lce 'bar ba'i —304—

steng du cil cil zhu bar bsam mo/ /'di ni nang gi drag po'i sbyin sreg go /de nas yang gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ snying ga'i yi dam gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ brtan g.yo thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs rnams bdud rtsi'i rnam par bkug pa rnams rang gi sgo dgu nas zhugs/ snying gar me lce 'bar ba'i steng du babs shing zhu bar bsam mo/ /'di ni rlung sems dbu mar thim pa dang/ rlu8 dul bar gyur pa'i thabs so/ /de dag ni masno mo rgyu ba'i man ngag dang rjes su 'brel ba'i man ngag zhal gyi gdams pa'o/ /gnyis pa rwa sgom pa'i zhal shes sam/ zhal dgu po'i rdzogs rim la sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lus gnad bcas la nyin gcig rlung phyir 'bud pa 'ba' zhig byas shing / de yang thun bzhir bcad de grangs lnga brgya la sogs pa bya/ yang nyin gcig lus gnad bcas la rlung rang babs su bzhag tshul de lta bu zla gcig la sogs pa bsgoms na/ lus ldang ba yang ba dang / nad byang la sogs pa 'byung ngo / /de nas 'jam rlung bzung la mgo bo la sogs pa lus kyi gnad thams cad khu tshur gyis brdeg pa dang / shugs dang ldan pas lus thams cad la 'phur mnye byed pa da/nga / mgo dang rkang lag la sogs pa sprugs pa dang / yan lag rnams brkyang bskum byed pa sogs dang / 'jam rlung bzung ste gyen la rgyug pa dang / thur la rgyug pa dang / 'drab pa dang / ngag nas ha 'don zhing 'khrab pa sogs bya'o/ /de ltar byas pas 'khru skyug dang nad gzhi ldang ba sogs byung na/ phyis —305—

gegs mi 'byung bas legs shing / skabs 'dir gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar gyi lus sbyong sbyar na yang legs gsung ngo / /dngos gzhi ni/ rang nyid rde rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa'am/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis par ji ltar bde bar gsal ba'i lte 'og sor bzhi'am sor brgyad tsam du ma he'i zhal rwa dang bcas pa/ dbu skra dang / mgrin pa sogs me 'bar ba'i bsgribs pa/ dper na me dpung gi dbus nas ma he'i zhal 'thon pa lta bu zhig bsgom/ 'di la dmigs pa gsal na mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon mtshams bzhi sogs gang nas bltas kyang ma he'i zhal yod pa'i kun tu zhal du bsgom/ de lta bu las dang po pa la mi gsal na/ mdun du bstan pa'i ma he'i zhal gcig ka bsgom/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma kha dog sngon po yas sna rang gi spyi bo dang / mas sna lte 'og ma he'i zhal gyi spyi bo brgyud de rkan gyi sbubs su zug pa/ g.yas phyogs kyi rwa la dum bu gsum du byas pa'i sum gcig yar song / gsum gnyis mar lus pa tsam gyi mtshams su thog mar thig le ser po zhig rwa nang du yod pa de phyir brdol de/ rwa'i phyi ngos la khro zhal ser po ltag pa'i cha la brten pa/shing sdong gi sbal lta bu zhig gsal btab/ rang gi g.yas phyogs su ro ma ser po yas sna spyi bo dang / mas sna khro zhal ser po'i zhal la zug par bsam/ lus gnad rkang ba skyil krung / lag pa khu tshur brla ba theg bya/ rlung sbyor ni/ rlung ro bsal la/ rlung nang du hūX gi sgras dal bus rngub la kha sbyor du bzung / de nas phyir drag tu bus la/ nang du drag tu rngub la grug zhud kyi rlud sbyor cung zad bya zhing / de nas phyir dal bus btang ngo / /de dag gi skabs —306—

su dmigs pa ni rang nyid kyi lus nang nas rlung thams cad kha dog ser po'i rnam pas byung / ro ma'i nang nas brgyud nas mar song khro zhal gyi zhal nas zhugs/rwa'i nang nas mar song / ma he'i zhal gyi rkan gyi sbubs kyi dbu ma'i mas sna nas zhugs te/ sor bzhi tsam song ba na yal bar bsam mo/ /de ni sa rlung 'dzin pa'i thabs so/ /thun gyi mthar khro zhal ser po de nyid thig le ser por gyur te rwa'i nang du zhugs/ mthar yal bar bsam mo/ /chu rlud 'dzin pa'i thabs ni/ lus gnad pad+ma'i skyil krung dang / lag pa gnyis brkyangs te pus mo'i steng du bzhag ste zla gam gyi tshul du bya/ dmigs pa ni lte 'og gi ma he'i zhal gyi g.yon gyi rwa yi rtsa ba'i nang du thig le dkar po de yongs su gyur pa las/ rwa'i phyi rol kyi rtsa bar g.yon zhal dang po dkar po rmongs par byed pa gsal btab pa'i lus kyi g.yon phyogs su rkyang ma dkar po yas sna spyi bo dang / mas sna lte ba'i ma he'i g.yon phyogs kyi zhal dkar po'i nang du tshud par bsgom/ rlung ro bsal la/ rlud nang du sgra dang bcas te rngub/rngub pa rdzogs mtshams su kha nang gi rlung yang sgra bcas su rngub ste bum pa can gyi rlung sbyor bya/ dmigs pa ni lus kyi nang nas rlung thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pas byung / rkyang ma'i nang nas shong tshad du song rwa'i rtsa'i zhal gyi nang nas zhugs/ ma he'i zhal gyi rkan gyi sbubs kyi dbu ma'i mas sna nas zhugs/sor bzhi tsam nas yal bar bsam/ rkyang ma'i nang nas zhugs pa ma yin pa'i rlung thams cad kyang khro zhal dkar po'i zhal gyi grwa zur nas zhugs par mos so/ /'di'i dmigs rten snod gang drang zhig chus gang ba la mig gtad/ thun —307—

'jog khar khro zhal dkar po thig le dkar po zhig tu gyur te/ rwa'i nang du zhugs par bsam zhing mthar thig ler thim mo/ /me rlung 'dzin pa'i thabs ni/ lus gnad sems dpa'i skyil krung dang /lag pa gnyis khu tshur mkhal khung gnyis la brten pa'i lag pa gru mo cung zad brkyangs te/ me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum gyi tshul du bya/ dmigs pa lte 'og gi ma he'i zhal dang / dbu ma sogs sngar dang 'dra ba las/ g.yas phyogs kyi rwa'i rked pa tsam gyi nang du thog mar thig le dmar po/ de yongs su gyur pa las rwa'i phyi rol du khro zhal dmar po/ ro ma dmar po zhal du chud par bsam/ rlung sbyor ni/ rlung ro bsal la/ nang du rngub la kha sbyor du cung zad zhig bzung la/ de nas gsang gnas kyi rlung dang / bshang sgo'i rlung drag tu 'then zhing rlung kha sbyor sto/da du drangs shing rked pa nyag tsam bya/ de nas rlung lte bar phab la sangs kyis btang ngo / /dmigs pa ni lus nang nas rlung thams cad kha dog dmar po'i rnam pas stod smad thams cad nas byung / ro ma'i nang nas zhugs te/ khro zhal dmar po'i zhal gyi nang nas zhugs/ ro ma'i nang du ma zhugs pa'i rlud thams cad khro zhal dmar po'i zhal gyi grwa zur nas zhugs te/ thams cad kyang rwa'i nang du brgyud de ma he'i rkan sbubs kyi dbu ma'i mas sna nas zhugs/ sor bzhi tsam du yal bar bsam/ 'di'i dmigs rten mar me lta bu zhig la mig gtad/ thun 'jog khar khro zhal dmar po de nyid thig le dmar po zhig tu gyur te rwa'i nang du mi dmigs par bsam mo/ rlud gi rlud 'dzin pa ni/ lus gnad zlum po'i —308—

'dug stangs su byed par bshad kyang / da lta lag len la rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung 'chug par bya zhing lag gnyis khu tshur byas la 'phong tshos g.yas g.yon gyi thad kyi gdan steng du bzhag /rlung sbyor ni/ rlung dal bus phyir bsam zhing / nang du yang shugs chung ngus dal bus rngub la nang du kha sbyor du bzung la/ gsus pa smad phyir phul la ldir bar bya/ rlung gtong ba'i tshe lto ba ma zhum par byas la sangs kyis gtong / dmigs pa ni/ lte ba'i ma he'i rwa g.yon phyogs kyi rtse mo'i cha la thog mar nang du thig le nag po/ de phyir thon nas yongs su gyur pa las khro zhal nag po/ de'i zhal du rkyang ma kha dog nag po'i mas sna zur ba/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba zhig bsgom la/ rlung sbyor gyi skabs su lus kyi nang nas rlung rnams kha dog nag po'i rnam pas stod smad thams cad nas byung / rkyang ma'i nang nas zhugs/ khro zhal nag po'i zhal du zhugs shing / rkyang ma'i nang du ma chud pa'i rlung thams cad zhal gyi grwa zur nas zhugs shing thams cad kyang rwa'i lam brgyud/ ma he'i zhal gyi rkan sbubs dbu ma'i mas sna nas zhugs te/ sor bzhi tsam du yal bar bsam zhing / 'di la dmigs rten dkar po khung nas rlung gi reg bya lus la phog par bya zhes bshad kyang / skabs 'gar de ltar bya zhing /rgyun du byas na rlung khams ldang bas de ltar mi bya gsung / rnam shes kyi rlung 'dzin pa ni/ lte 'og gi ma sto zhal gyi g.yon phyogs kyi rwa'i dkyil gyi nang du thog mar thig le dud kha/ de phyir thon te yongs su gyur pa las khro zhal dud kha zhig bsgom/ lus kyi g.yon phyogs su rkyang ma dud kha'i mas sna khro zhal dud kha'i nang du zug pa/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las lus gnad rkang pa sems skyil —309—

lam rdo rje skyil krung gang rung zhig byas la/ lag pa mnyam bzhag bya/ rlud sbyor ni/ rlung ro bsal/ nang du rngub la bum can bzung la/ mdun ngos su phyir phul/rgyab ngos su phul la lto ba tshigs pa la gcer ba byas la btang ngo / /dmigs pa ni/ rlung dud kha'i rnam pas lus nang nas byung rkyang ma'i nang nas zhugs/ zhal dud kha'i nang nas zhugs/ rkyang ma'i nang du ma zhugs pa'i rlung thams cad kyang zhal gyi grwa zur nas zhugs te/ ma he'i rkan sbubs nas brgyud de dbu ma'i mas sna nas zhugs te/ sor bzhi tsam du yal bar bsam/ mthar zhal dud kha thig le dud khar gyur te/ rwa'i nang du zhugs la yal bar bsam mo/ /nam mkha'i rlung 'dzin pa ni/ g.yas phyogs kyi rwa'i rtsa bar khro zhal sngon po sgom pa dang / ro ma yang kha dog sngon por byed pa dang / rlung rnams kyang kha dog sngon por byed pa'i khyad par ma gtogs lus gnad rlung spyor dmigs pa la sogs pa bshad ma thag pa dang 'dra'o/ /srin zhal dmar po bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ rang gi lte 'og gi ma he'i zhal gyi steng du srin zhal dmar po de'i spyi bo nas brgyud de/ ma he'i rkan sbubs su dbu ma'i mas sna zug par bsam la/ rlung sbyor dang lus gnad kyi khyad par ni/ rkang pa'i brang sa la btsugs shing rting ba gnyis gyen du bstan pa'i steng du 'phong bzhag pa'am/ de mi bde na rkang mthil sa la bzhag pas tsog pu'i 'dug stangs dang rlung ro bsal ba'i skabs su lag pa gnyis gyen du brkyangs shing / 'og rlung drag tu 'then zhing / 'phong yang cung zad bteg cing / rlung phyi rol tu cung zad bzung / nang du rngub pa dang mnyam du lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcings pa mchan khung g.yas g.yon gnyis su bcug —310—

cing / pus mo gnyis sa la btsugs shing 'phong yang rting ba'i steng du bzhagarlung kha sbyor du bzung zhing de nas rlung kha sbyor de nyid stod du 'then zhing / mgo dang ro stod g.yas su lan gsum bskor ba dang / g.yon du lan gsum bskor bar bya/ rlung phyir 'bud pa'i tshe lag pa gnyis gyen du brkyang ba sogs sngar bzhin bya'o/ /dmigs pa ni/ lus kyi smad kyi cha nas thur sel gyi rlung gtso bor gyur pa'i rlung rnams kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rnam pas byung ste/ srin zhal gyi zhal nas zhugs/ ma he'i dbu ma'i nang nas brgyud/ rkan sbubs kyi dbu ma'i mas sna nas zhugs te sor bzhi tsam nas yal bar bsam mo/ /'di ni thur sel gyi rlud stod du 'dren pa'i thabs so /srog gi rlung smad du 'dren pa'i thabs ni/ lus gnad sems dpa'i skyil krung la lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis rkang ba'i bol gong gi stod tsam la 'ju ba'am/ yang na de dang de'i thad kyi gdan steng du btsugs la/ ro stod sgur ba dang / dgye ba re mos su bshad kyang / rlung phyir 'bud pa'i tshe sgur ba dang /gzhan ro stod sogs lus skyed par bya zhing / rlung sbyor ni/ rlung ro bsal ba'i tshe thur sel gyi rlud yang drag tu 'then nas/ kha sna gnyis kar nas rngub la nang du 'dzin pa'i tshe/ 'og rlung rang gnas su bzhug cing / steng rlung gsang gnas kyi bu ga'i phyogs su drag tu gnon pa dang / bshang sgo'i phyogs su 'phul ba re mos su bya/ de nas rlung phyir 'bud pa'i tshe/ thur sel 'then zhing rngub pa'i tshe kha sna gnyis kar nas dus gcig tu rngub pa sogs sngar bzhin bya'o/ /dmigs pa ni/ lte 'og gi ma he'i zhal sogs dgu char yod pa la lam tsam dmigs la/—311—

gtso bor srin zhal gyi steng du 'jam dpal gyi zhal ser po bsgom la/ lus kyi stod kyi cha mgo bo dang lag pa'i sor mo wo chad kyi nang nas rlung kha dog sna tshogs pa dpag tu med pa byung ba rnams 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas zhugs/ srin zhal dang ma he'i dbu gtsug nas brgyud de/ ma he'i zhal gyi nang tsam du yal bar bsam mo/ /srog dang thur sel mnyam par byed pa'i thabs ni/ rtsa zhal la brten nas sgom pa ste lus gnad ni rkang pa ya gcig gis bshang sgo bkag cing / ya gcig gis gsang gnas mnan/ lag pa khu tshur brla'i steng du bzhag cing /mig steng du blta'o/ /rlung sbyor ni/ kha sna gnyis kar nas rlud bus shing / nang du sna nas rngub la kha sbyor du bzung zhing / lto ba tshigs pa la gcer/ mig gyen du bsgrad la/ rkang lag gis sor mo bskums shing lus kyi nywa bzhi bsgrim mo/ /dmigs pa ni/ lte 'og gi ma he'i zhal gyi nang tsam du/ raX maX k+ṣa dmar po zhig gsal 'debs pa las raX sgom pa gtso che/ rang gi snying ga'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du hūX sngon po 'od zer 'phro ba zhig bsgom/ spyi bo'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du haX dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa zhig dmigs la/ raX las me 'bar dbu ma'i nang du brgyud de/ spyi bo'i haX la reg pas haX las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa/ snying ga'i huX la babs pas tshim zhing rgyas par bsam la gtum mo'i me rang gnas su log /yang gtum mo'i me 'bar ba sogs sngar bzhin bsgom mo/ /'di la sbyor ba drug dang ldan pa ste dbang po'i mchog gyen du bgrad pa dang / ro 'dzin rkan la sbyar ba dang / rgya mtsho ri rab la gcer ba dang / gling bzhi dbang du bsdu ba —312—

dang / rlung phyir 'bud pa'i tshe kha sna gnyis car nas bum pa'i stobs kyis he'i sgra 'byung ba'i ngag gi 'gyur ba dang / lus nywa bzhi bsgrims pa dang drug /rkang pa g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi rting pas bshang sgo 'gag pa dang / gsang gnas gnod pa gnyis res mos su bya/ de dag ni rwa sgom pa'i zhal shes sam zhal dgu'i rdzogs rim mo/ /༈ gsum pa mtshan ma gyen bsgreng la/ sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi dang /rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi dang ldan pa yas sna spyi gtsug tu zug cing mas sna gsang gnas su zug pa'i spyi bor haX dkar po/ rdo rje nor bur thig le yungs 'bru/ tsam mam sran ma tsam kha dog dkar po zhig bsgom la/ lus gnad legs par bcas la/ huX gi sgras rlung phyir 'bud pa'i tshe rdo rje nor bu'i thig le dbu ma'i nang nas yar hril gyis song ste/ spyi bo'i haX la thim par bsam/ haX de nyid 'dar khril khril 'dug pa la sems gtad la/ rlud phyir thub tshad du bzung /nang du rngub pa'i tshe spyi bo'i haX las thig le skya hril gyis byung ste/ dbu ma'i nang nas mar song ste rdo rje nor bur lhan gyis sleb par bsam la de la sems gtad cing rlung cung zad bzung ngo / /de'i go zlog ni/ rang gi spyi bor dbu ma'i nang du thig le dmar po/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor a dmar por bsgom la/ rlung ro bsal/ rlung nang du rngub pa'i tshe khyoXsgra yid la dran par byas te rngub la/ rngub pa rdzogs mtshams su gyiXzhes pa'i sgra yid la dran par byed cing / de'i skabs su dmigs pa ni/ spyi bo'i thig le dmar hril gyis dbu ma'i nang nas mar song ste/—313—

nor bu'i a la thim gyis thim par bsam zhing / a 'dar khril khril 'dug pa la sems gtad cing / rlung kha sbyor thub tshad du bzung / rlung phyir 'bud pa'i tshe nor bu nas thig le dmar hril gyis byung / dbu ma'i nang nas yar song / spyi bor sleb par bsam mo/ /de nas rang nyid 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma/ snying ga dang nye bar huX re re bsgom/ de nas rlung phyir kha na ha'i sgras bus la/ nang du rngub pa'i tshe sna nas rngub cing / he'i sgra yid la dran par bya/ de nas rma kha sbyor du bzung la de nyid pho bar drangs shing / pho stod kyi cha ldir bar bya zhing / snying ga'i hūX la sems gtad/ yang kha sbyor de nyid rgyu zhabs su mnan zhing phyir bskyed la ldir ba bya zhing lte ba'i hūX la sems gtad do/ /༈ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dngos dang/ bogs 'don gnyis las/dang po ni/ lus gnad spyi dang mthun par bcas la/ lta stangs smin mtshams kyi thad kyi nam mkha' la blta/ rlung sbyor ni/ rlung ro bsal la rlung phyi rol tu thub tshad du bzung zhing / ma ning gi rlung gi ming can khog nang gi rlung shugs yang kha sbyor du bzung / rlud bus la phyi rol tu gzhil ba yang bya'o/ /gnyis pa bogs 'don la/ rlung sbyor gsum las/ dang po ni/ lus bskyed cing lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcings te bsnol ba rgyab tu sa la btsugs/ rlung sangs kyis bus la phyir thub tshad du bzung / nang gi rlung gi shugs kha sbyor du bzung ba de nyid stod du 'then 'then bya zhing phyir bus la gzhil ba yang bya'o/ /rlung sbyor gnyis pa ni/lus cung zad sgur ba'i lag pa khu tshur/ bcings pa mdun du sa la bzhag—314—

rlung ro bsal la phyi rol tu thub tshad du bzung / de nas nang du rngub la rlung kha spyor du bzung zhing sked pa nyag bya/ mi thub pa na kha nas gtong ngo / /rlung sbyor gsum pa ni/ lus gnad lag pa khu tshur brla bzhag gam/ brla'i rtsa ba'i gdan steng du bzhag la rlung ro bsal/ phyir thub tshad du bzung / nang du khog nang gi gsang gnas kyi rlung gi shugs dang / bshang sgo'i rlung gi shugs gnyis dus gcig tu 'then/ dus gcig tu 'then mi thub na res mos kyis 'then/ de nas rlung nang du rngub la kha sbyor du bzung / de nyid mdun gsang gnas phyogs su gnod pa dang / rgyab bshang sgo'i phyogs su gnon pa res mos bya zhing / de nas rlung gtong / dngos gzhi dang / bogs 'don gyi skabs kyi dmigs pa ni/ mi rtog par 'jog pa kho na nyid yin zhing / de ltar thabs de rnams la brten nas bsgoms pas rlung nang du rngub rgyu med par phyi rol tu yal ba lta bur gyur na cung zad 'byongs pa yin zhing / de nas yon tan rnams rim gyis skye'o/ /de yang yun ring du dngos gzhi'i rlung sbyor de nyid goms par byas la/ de'i rjes su bogs 'don gyi rlung sbyor dang po lta bu zhig thun gyi rjes su bcu gcig gam nyer gcig la sogs par bsgom pa zhag bdun la sogs par bya'o/ /de bzhin du rlung sbyor gnyis pa dang / gsum pa la sogs pa yang de mtshungs bya zhing / mthar gsum char thun gyi rjes su grangs ji ltar rigs pa bsgom pa zhag bdun la sogs par bya'o/ /bogs 'don gyi dmigs pa 'di rnams skabs su bya ba yin gyis dus rgyun du dngos gzhi'i rlung sbyor nyid sgom mo/ /gsum pa rjes la/ 'dren dang 'grem gnyis las/ dang po la/ thun mong —315sgro

dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis yod pa las/ dang po la thig le bzung ba ni/ mig steng du bsgrad/ lag pa'i sor mo shin tu bskum pa snying ga'i thad du bsnol ba'am/ yang na brang g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi thad du sbyar/ rkang pa'i sor mo rnams shin tu bskum par byas la/ lus nywa bzhi sgrim zhing lto ba tshigs pa la gcer/ thur sel gyi rlud bshang sgor drag tu glod do/ /thig le zlog pa ni/ dud 'gro'i 'gyur ba bzhi las/ glang chen hi ni/ lus gnad sems skyil lam/ pus mo gnyis btsugs pa las/ lag pa gnyis mdun du btsugs la lus cung zad sgur bar bya/ sna nas hi gi sgras rlud phyir bsal la/ lus cung zad sgur ba dang /de nas mgo dang ltag pa bskyed byas la/ lto ba tshigs pa la gcer bar bya'o/ /stag mo'i ngur ni/ lus gnad byed lugs spyi gong dang 'dra ba las/ rlung sna nas ngur sgra dang bcas 'bud pa'o/ /ce spyang hag ni/ g.yin sngar dang 'dra ba las/rlung kha nas hag ces pa'i sgras 'bud pa'o/ /wa yi snom ni/ rlung sna nas bus la 'bud thag chod pa dang / slar yang nang du ma rngub par lan gsum la sogs pa 'bud do/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa la dngos dang / yan lag gnyis las/dang po bzung ba ni/ lus gnad spyi dang mthun par bcas la rlung ro bsal/'og sgo glod nang du sa cing / steng hro spunang sgo'i gnas su drag tu mnan cing /de nas rlud gi shugs mdun phyogs su phul la/ gsus pa ldir gyis bya zhing gsang gnas nas slar yang gyen du log ste/ rked pa'i thad tsam du sleb par bsam la rked pa nyag bya'o/ /de lta bu lan gsum bya'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i —316—

bzlog pa ni/ lus spyi g.yon phyogs su gcus te/ sog rtse 'phrod par bya/ mgo g.yas su gcus la rlung sna nas bus la stong 'dren bya/ de nas rlung nang du bzung la/ lus drang por bsrangs te/ lto ba g.yon du lan gsum bskor/ de rjes mgo dang ro stod yang lan gsum du bskor ro/ /de rjes rlung bus la stong 'dren bya'o/ /g.yas phyogs la yang de go zlog pa'o/ /de ni thun mong ma yin pa'i stong 'dren gyi rlung sbyor dngos so/ /gnyis pa yan lag la‘sprung gnyis las/ dang po ni lag gnyis bsnol ba rgyab tu btsugs/ rkang pa skyil krung bya/ de nas rlud sangs kyis bus la phyi rol tu bzung zhing / ltag pa skyed la stong 'dren bya/ de nas rngub la rlung kha sbyor du bzung la dgang 'dren bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lag pa gnyis bsnol ba mdun du btsugs/ lus cung zad sgur la/ rlung ro bsal zhing / rlung phyi rol tu bzung la ltag pa sgur zhing stong 'dren bya/ yang nang du rngub cing kha sbyor du bzung la dgang 'dren bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'grims la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ thun mong ba ni/ seng ge rnam rol spyi dang mthun pa de yin zhing / thun mong ma yin pa la sdom ni/ lag pa zhags pa 'phang zhing dkrug sdeb bya/ zhes pa'i don ni/ rlung bzung zhing / lag pa g.yas mgo la bskor zhing / lan gsum thegs pa ltar 'phangs/ de bzhin du g.yon pa la yang bya/ lag pa gnyis dus gcig tu 'phangs shing / mgo dang lus sprug pa dang / 'phongs sa la bsdebs so/ /de bzhin du rlung phyir btang zhing ha sgra dang bcas la mgo lus sprug cing /'phong sa la brdebs so/ /yang sdom ni/ khu tshur pus mor bzhag la gcus shing

sprug ces pa/ lag pa gnyis khu tshur byas pa pus mo'i steng du ba theg /rlung bzung la ro stod g.yas su gcu ba dang / g.yon du gcu ba bya zhing / mgo lus thams cad sprug go /yang sdom ni/ khu tshur pus mo nas brtsams nu thad drangs//gru mo brgyangs la rtsibs log ngos la brdeg /ces pa'i don ni/ lag pa khu tshur pus mo nas brtsams nas nu ma'i thad du drangs/ gru mo brgyangs la rtsibs ma'i ngos la lan gsum brdeg go /〈'dir sdom ni/ ro stod sgur zhing lag gnyis chur btsal te/ g.yas g.yon dbus su drag tu brkyang ba dang / rlud phyir bzung la rdor bsdam spyi bor brdeg /nang du rngub la mnyam bzhag bya ba'o/ /ngag dbang tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i mchan yin/〉 lag pa gnyis shed bcug ste/ ro stod sgur zhing gyen ngos kyi g.yas phyogs su drag tu skyong ba dang / g.yon phyogs su yang skyong ba dang / dbus drang thad mgo'i thad du yang drag tu brkyangs shing / rlung phyir cung zad bzung la/ de nas lag pa'i sor mo rnams phan tshun bsnol ba'i lag mthil spyi gtsug la brdeg cing / rlung rngub la nang du bzung / lag pa mnyam bzhag bya'o/ /de nas rlud dang bsre ba ni/ rlung bum pa can 'dzin pa'o/ /dbyings su skyel ba ni/ dngos gzhi'i rlung sbyor ci rigs bsgom zhing / sems mi rtog par bzhug go /skabs 'dir gong gi hiXrtsiXha zhes pa'i rlung kha sbyor yang sbyar ro/ /de dag gis ni mtshan mo rgyu ba'i zhal gdams rnams song nas/ de'i rjes su yan lag phra mo rnams ston pa las/ dang po rwa'i khrid ni/ rwa zhal mi byed na/ rwa thung ba la sor bcu drug pa dang / ring pa la nyi shu'o/ /rwa zhal byed na thung ba sor nyi shu dang / ring pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o/ /de la thog mar sor nyi shu'i dbang du byas te/—318—

rang nyid 'jigs byed chen por gsal ba'i rwa shin tu rno ba/ sor nyi shu'i tshad du yod pa'i g.yas phyogs kyi rwa'i nang du rtse mo nas brtsams te/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya huX hūX phaṭa/ ces pa'i yi ge nyi shu pa kha dog sngon por yod pa la dmigs la sngags de nyid bzla'o/ /g.yon phyogs kyi rwa'i nang du rtse mo nas brtsams la/ oṃ ya da yo ni ra ya slo ya ya slo ru ni ra ma ya huX huX phaṭa/ces pa kha dog sngon por yod pa la dmigs la sngags de nyid bzla'o/ /sngags tshan gnyis po rwa g.yas g.yon gnyis la thun re mos bya zhing / tshul de lta bus khri phrag gcig gis bsnyen pa bya'o/ /grangs bsnyen song nas/ tshe sgrub kyi dmigs pa ni/ rwa nang gi sngags rnams kha dog dkar po bsgom zhing snying gar nyi ma la hūX sngon po dmigs la/ rwa g.yas g.yon gyi nang gi sngags rnams las bdud rtsi dkar po dpag tu med pa byung rwa'i nang khengs pas/ rwa sngo sangs du song ste/ rwa'i phyi rol tu me lce lhabs te 'bar/ rwa nang gi bdud rtsi rnams rim gyis zhal gyi rkan sbubs su sleb par bsam/ phyag g.yon gyi thod pa'i nang gi bdud rtsi ya slo ma me da zhes pa'am/ bhuX aX rdzuX khaX hūX zhes pa yongs su gyur pa las bdud rtsi dpag tu med par gyur/ brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs ye shes mi shigs pa thams cad bkug ste/ de la thim pa rtsa zhal gyis drangs te/ zhal du sleb pa rwa nang nas byung ba'i bdud rtsi rnams dang 'dres te/thugs ka'i hūX la thim pas/ bkrag mdangs dang gzi brjid rgyas par bsam la/ rlud bum can bzung zhing / yid kyis khyoXgyiXyi mthar/ ya mun+ta ka oṃ zlaX badz+ra ā yu she dzaXhūX aXzhes 'gog bzlas kyi tshul gyis bzla/ de lta bu mi thub | thog —319—

mar rlung ci rigs bzung la/ de nas ngag bzlas bya'o/ /rwa ring ba'i sgom tshul ni/ sor nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod pa'i rtse mor thig le/ oṃ ya mun+ta ka ya ma rā dza sa do me ya ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya hūX huX phaṭa/ ces pa dang / g.yon phyogs su yang rtse mor thig le/ de nas/ oṃ ya mun+ta ka ya da yo ni ra ya slo ya ya spu ru ni ra ma ya hūX huX phaṭa/ ces pa bkod la gzhan sngar dang 'dra'o/ /rwa thung bar bsgom na sor bcu drug yod pa'i g.yas phyogs la ya ma rā dza'i yi ge bcu drug dang / g.yon phyogs la yang / ya da yo ni la sogs pa'i yi ge bcu drug dang / gzhan thams cad gong dang 'dra'o/ /rwa dang ling ga'i dag pa sbyor tshul ni/ rwa sor bcu drug gi'i phyogs la/g.yas la bcu drug dang / g.yon la bcu drug ste/ sum cu so gnyis ni/ phyi rol tu dkar phyogs nag phyogs zla ba'i 'phel 'grib byed pa dang / nang du khams kyi 'pho ba dang sbyor ba dang / rwa ring ba'i phyogs la g.yas la nyer bzhi dang /g.yon la nyer bzhi ste/ bzhi bcu zhe brgyad de'i steng du ling ga sor bcu gnyis bsnan pas drug cu ni/ chu tshod drug cu rnam par dag pa dang / 'bring po rwa nyi shu yang bcu drug gi steng du slar bzhi bzhi bsnan pa yin pas dga' ba bcu drug gi dag par sbyor zhing / ling ga sor bcu gnyis ni rlung 'pho ba bcu gnyis kyi dag par spyor ro/ /de nas ling ga sgrub pa ni/ rang nyid 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i ling ga gyen du bsgreng ba/ gsang gnas nas bshang sgo'i thad du rtse sor bzhi'am sor gsum tsam gyen du gzhal ba'i rgyab ngos la cung zad nye ba'i dbus su gsang —320—

gnas kyi rtsib brgyad pa/ kha dog dkar po nye ba dbu ma'i mas snas phug pa/'dab ma brgyad la ya ma rā dza'i sngags kyis bskor ba/ ling ga skye mtshams su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i lte ba la yang rtsas phug pa/ mtha' bskor du hiXrgiXkha dog dmar pos bskor ba/ rdo rje'i mgul bar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa phyed pa/ de'i lte ba dang dbus kyi rwa yang rtsas phug pa/ lte ba'i mtha' bskor du pha dang ṭa gnyis so sor phral ba'i ya mun+ta ka sngon pos bskor ba/ rdo rje nor bur thig le dmar po nyi dkyil lta bu de'i steng du/ a kar+ṣa ya hūX phaṭa/ ces pa kha dog dmar pos bskor/ 'bras bu gnyis la som re re bsgom/ thog mar bsnyen pa bya ste/ 'khor lo bzhi po de rnams la dmigs pa gtad la sngags rnams khri phrag re bzla'o/ /de nas grangs bsnyen song nas 'di ltar bsgom par bya ste/ 'bras bu som las reg bya shin tu tsha ba'i 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'phros dbu ma'i sbubs nas brgyud de gsang gnas kyi 'khor lor slebs pas/ lus kyi gnas thams cad nas 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung / gsang nas kyi 'khor lo la thim pas drag tu 'khor zhing 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba la/ 'bras bu som las byung ba'i 'od zer reg bya shin tu tsha ba de phog pas/ 'od zer dkar po rnams dum bur 'thor zhing 'khor ba la sems gtad la/ ya ma rā jo'i yid bzlas cung zad bya/ de nas gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa thams cad 'od zer dang 'dres par gyur te/ de rnams rtsa'i bu ga nas brgyud de/rdo rje'i rked pa'i nyi dkyil sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la reg pas 'od zer dmar po 'bar zhing 'phro ba drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtad la/ hruXgyiXyid —321—

bzlas cung zad bya/ nyi dkyil sngags phreng dang bcas pa yang 'od zer dang 'dres te/ de rnams rtsa'i bu ga nas brgyud/ rdo rje'i mgul ba'i rdo rje sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa reg pas 'od zer sngon po 'bar zhing 'phro ba drag tu 'khor ba sems gtad la/ ya mun+ta ka'i yid bzlas cung zad bya/ de na rdo rje sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa yang 'od zer dang po 'dres te/ de rnams rtse'i bu gnas brgyud rdo rje nor bu'i thig le dmar po sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la reg pas/'od zer sna tshogs 'phro zhing 'khor ba la sems gtad la/ a kar+ṣa ya sogs kyi yid bzlas cung zad bya/ de nas nor bu nas gsang gnas kyi bar du a ā/ i yī/ u ྅/ e e/ o au/ aX aX zhes pa'i yi ge bcu gnyis po rnams kha dog dkar po/ mu tig gi 'phreng ba bstar la brgyus pa lta bu zhig bsgom/ rlung phyir bus la dbugs thengs gcig gam yang na yi ge re re la dbugs thengs re re lta bu yang byas te/ gang na yang a yig la sogs pa'i sgra dang bcas a stong 'dren bya zhing / 'od zer sna tshogs pa a la thim/ a ā la thim/ rim pa'i gsang gnas su aX āXl lhan gyis thim pas/ 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phros te lus thams cad gang bar mos/ de nas rlung rngub la kha sbyor du bzung bas/ lus kyi phyi nas me lce lhab kyis 'bar bar bsam/ de nas gsus pa phyir bskyed cing / ro stod kyi cha yang ldir byas la/ lus g.yas su bskor ba dang / g.yon du bskor ba dang / ro stod g.yas su gcu pa dang/ g.yon du gcu pa dang / lus thams cad sprugs pa ste/ de rnams lan gsum gsum byas pas me lce yang shin tu 'bar bar gyur te/ lus kyi stangs stabs dang mthun par g.yas su tshes cher —322—

'bar ba la sogs par bsam mo/ /'di mtshan ma gyen bsgreng gi yan lag tu sbyor ba ste/ gsang gnas la sogs pa'i gnas bzhi po lte ba la sogs pa'i 'khor lo bzhi dang gnad gcig pa zhig yod pas/ 'khor lo bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dga' bzhi'i yas babs dang / mas brtan gyi rim pas ye shes yang skye bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /༈ rwa sgrub pa ni/ rang 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i rwa gnyis hiXlas byung ba'i rwa rno zhing mi bzad pa ri rab la sogs pa yang bzhig par nus pa/ me lce 'bar ba hiXs mtshan pa zhig tu gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ hruXkruX bruX sruX snyuX hūX gaXzhes pa bzla/ grangs bsnyen khri phrag gcig go /༈ sdigs mdzub sgrub pa ni/ rang gi lag pa g.yas g.yon sdigs mdzub byas la/ de nyid huX nag po me 'bar ba las byung ba'i sdigs mdzub huX gis mtshan pa/ g.yas pa la rtsa ba nas rim pa bzhin du oṃ hi hi ha hā hi hi swāhā/ zhes pa dang / g.yon pa la rtse mo nas rim pa bzhin du oṃ zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /de rnams la dmigs pa gtad la sdigs mdzub 'cha' bzhin du/ sngags de nyid grangs bsnyen khri phrag gcig bzla'o/ /oṃ hi hi ha ha he he badz+ra tardza swa dha ya sā dha ya swāhā/ zhes pa yang ci rigs bzla'o/ /༈ lta stangs sgrub pa ni/ rang nyid 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i spyan gsum gyi 'bras bu stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las phaṭa nag po las byung ba'i rab tu 'bar ba'i spyan phaṭa kyis mtshan pa la/ spyan g.yas g.yon gnyis la sngags 'bru drug gis spras par dmigs la/ oṃ ma me ma mi ma mu swāhā/ zhes —323—

grangs bsnyen khri phrag gcig bzla/ de nas/ oṃ ma me ma mi ma mu badz+ra tirdzi swā dha ya swā dha ya swāhā/ zhes pa ci rigs bzla'o/ /༈ zhal dgu sgrub pa ni/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs su gsal ba'i ma he'i zhal thog mar stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slar yang bhaX las ma he'i zhal gyi dpral bar bhaX yig gis mtshan pa'i zhig gsal btab la/ oṃ ya mun+ta ka badz+ra bhe ra ba bhaX swāhā/ zhes pa'am/ huX phaṭa ces ji ltar rigs pa sbyor la/ grangs bsnyen khri phrag gcig gcig bzla'o/ /de'i rigs 'gre bar byas te/ srin zhal gyi sa bon bha dang / sngags ni/ oṃ ya mun+ta ka badz+ra bhe ra wa bha swāhā/ zhes pa dang / steng zhal gyi sa bon bhi/ sngags kyang hrag tu bcug pa ma gtogs sngar bzhin/ g.yas zhal sngon po'i sa bon bhu/ sngags kyang sa bon gyi khyad par ma gtogs 'dra/ g.yas zhal gnyis pa dmar po'i sa bon ste/ sngags kyang sa bon gyi khyad par ma gtogs 'dra/ g.yas zhal gsum pa ser po'i sa bon bho/ sngags kyang sa bon gyi khyad par ma gtogs sngar bzhin/g.yon zhal dang po dkar po'i sa bon bho/ sngags kyang sa bon hrag tu bcug pa ma gtogs 'dra/ g.yon zhal gnyis pa dud kha'i sa bon bhaX/ sngags kyang sa bon gyi khyad par ma gtogs 'dra/ g.yon zhal gsum pa nag po'i tre/ bon bhaXsngags kyang oṃ ya mun+ta ka badz+ra ste ra wa bhaXswāhā/ zhes pa'am/ hūX phaṭa ces pa gang rung ngo / /thams cad kyang grangs bsnyen khri phrag re re bzla'o/ /zhal dgu po thams cad la yang zhal so so stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sa bon so so las/ zhal de dang de'i dpral ba rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa la dmigs —324—

nas/ sngags so so bzla zhing / 'di dag thams cad la snying po'i sngags kyis byin wos bya'o/ /de yan chad kyis bsnyen pa dang rjes su 'brel ba'i zhal gdams mtha' dag song nas/ de'i rjes su nyer sgrub bam bsnyen pa chung ngu'i lag len ni/ thog mar bgegs gtor/ de nas spyi gtor dang / gzhi bdag gtor ma rnams btang la/ sa blang / de nas mngon rtogs bsgom la bzlas pa ci rigs bya zhing /yungs dkar dang thal ba la yang sngags kyis btab cing / ya mun+ta ka'i sngags kyis sna drangs la/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags drag tu 'don bzhin pas/ sa gzhi la yungs dkar dang / thal ba gtor ro/ /de nas sa'i lha mo lhag par gnas par bya zhing / de'i rjes su bum pa bsgrub par bya'o/ /de nas thig tshon byin brlab ni/ thig skud bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ya mun+ta ka'i sngags kyi phung por gyur bar bsam la/ ya mun+ta ka mang du bzla zhing khyiXgyiXyang ci rigs pa bzla'o/ /rdul tshon bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ya ma rā dza'i snga gas kyi phung por gyur par dmigs la/ ya ma rā dza mang du bzla zhing / sdiXgyiXyang ci rigs bzla'o/ /de nas las thig dang / ye thig gi dbye ba mi dgos shing / rang nyid 'jigs byed dang las kyi rdo rje yin na 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa dang / sgrub grogs rig ma lta bu yin na rdo rje ro langs mar bsgom la las thig btab/ de nas sngags bzla bzhin pas dkyil 'khor 'bri'o/ /'di dag gi skabs su sgrub po gcig gis spyin sreg bya zhing gcig gis gtor ma gtong ngo / /de lta bu'i mi 'grub na/ rang nyid kyi drug cu rtsa —325—

bzhi dang bcas pa'i gtor ma rgyas pa zhig dang / sbyin sreg rgyas pa zhig bya'o/ /de yang rdul tshon gyi rgyu ni dur khrod kyi so phag la sogs pa las 'grub na bya ba yin kyang / de lta bu 'grub dka' bas sha chen dang khrag la sogs pa bsres/sgrub pa'i skabs 'dir zhag mang por 'jog dgos pa'i phyir rdul ma rdzo mi gsal bar 'gyur bas chu tsho ni lta bus bris na yang shin tu legs/ dkyil 'khor ni 'grub na mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs dang / ma 'grub na rtsig pa yan chad bris la/ nang du lha snam sogs legs par bris/ pha gu dang rta babs la sogs pa dang / sna tshogs rdo rje pad rwa nyi ma la sogs pa spangs pa'i phyi rol tu dur khrod legs par bris/ de ltar dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa bri ba las/ rgyas pa'i phyogs la rtsig pa yan chad bris zin pa dang / mtshan ma rnams 'god dgos pa yin no/ /de nas dkyil 'khor dang gdan dang phyag mtshan la sogs pa sbyangs pa byas la/ de rjes gdan dang mtshan ma rnams dgod pa yin pa las/ 'grub na phyag mtshan mtha' dag 'bur dod du bri/ de lta bu ma 'grub na gzhan rnams bris ma dang / gtso bo dang / ro langs brgyad kyi phyag mtshan rnams 'bur dod du nges par bya'o/ /de yang thun mong ba tsam la gtso bo'i mtshan ma gri gug lags kyang / thun mong ma yin pa'i zab mo'i phyogs la/ gtso bo dang / ro langs brgyad kar gyi phyag mtshan ral gri'o/ /de yang lcags sam shing lta bu la byas te/ gtso bo'i de cung zad che ba dang / gzhan rnams de las cung zad kyis chung bar bya ba yin no/ /gdan yang mi ro yongs rdzogs kyi gzugs brnyan shog bu'am ras lta bu la —326—

bya/ yang na bag zan nam 'jim pa lta bu la sha chen dang / gri khrag lta bu bsres la ro'i gzugs su bya'o/ /oṃ huX tshiX zhes pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la gtso bo'i gdan bkod/ oṃ pre ta u ska ya hūX phaṭa/ ces nyer gcig tsam bzlas la shar gyi gdan bkod/ de nas/ oṃ pre ta bi mun+ta ka huX phaṭa/ ces pa nyer gcig tsam bzlas la lho'i gdan bkod/ oṃ pre ta dz+wa la huX phaṭa/ ces pa nyer gcig tsam bzlas la nub kyi gdan bkod/ oṃ khyi pra pre ta ut+pa ṭa hūX phaṭa/ ces pa nyer gcig tsam bzlas la byang gi gdan bkod/ de nas oṃ hūX laX hā/ zhes pa nyer gcig tsam re bzlas te/ mtshams kyi gdan rnams bkod la/ bkod grub pa dang / slar yang brtan pa'i phyir du gtso bo'i gdan gyi sngags bdun tsam re dang /'khor gyi gdan bkod pa'i sngags rnams gsum tsam re bzla'o/ /phyags mtshan 'god pa ni/ snying po brgya rtsa dang / gzhan gnyis ci rigs bzlas la/ gtso bo'i phyag mtshan bkod/ 'khor rnams la/ oṃ huX hi ṭi khaXzhes pa nyer gcig tsam re bzlas la/ phyag mtshan rnams rim pa bzhin du bkod/ slar yang byin rlabs brtan pa'i phyir du gtso bo la bdun tsam dang /'khor rnams la gsum tsam re bzla'o/ /de nas rdul tshon lhag ma rnams legs par bris la/ mchod gtor rnams bsham la thog mar bdag bskyed dang / de nas mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod bzhin du byas la/ ye shes spyan 'dren dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams grub mtshams su 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags so sos gtso bo la nyer gcig tsam dang / 'khor rnams la bdun tsam re bzlas la byin gyis —327—

brlabs/ de nas mchod 'phreng sogs dkyil chog nas 'byung ba ltar byas shing /de nas gtor ma phul la bzlas pa bya ba yin pa las/ de yang 'jig rten pa'i lho dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra ud+ma ṭa sa mā ya pra be sha ya huX/zhes pas sgo phye/ de nas snying po'i mthar oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya hūX/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs nas zhugs te/ re mig gi nang mgo bo'i mtshan ma'i steng du/ rang nyid 'jigs byed kyi rnam pas gnas par bsam la bzlas par bya'o/ /'di la gzhin rje ltar sgrub pa dang / srin po ltar sgrub pa dang / dbang phyug ltar sgrub pa dang / mgon po ltar sgrub pa ste bzhi yod pa las/ gshin rje ltar bsgrub pa la/ pho brgyad ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mo brgyad kyi ngo bo ro langs kyi bzhon pa la bzhon par bsgom la/ sngags ni/ ya ma me da spu oṃ huX sdi ṭi sha /zhes pa ni gshin rje pho brgyad kyi sa bon dang / bzhon pa brgyad kyi sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra tsa rtsa ya tsa rtsa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i mjug la phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi gdan 'god pa'i sngags rnams btags la bzla'o/ /srin po ltar sgrub pa ni/ srin po pho brgyad ni/ ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ srin mo brgyad kyi ngo bo ni/ ro langs brgyad kyi bzhon pa la bzhon par bsgom la oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa sa bha k+ṣa ya i ti hūX phaṭa/ ces pa'i mthar/ oṃ huX sdi ṭi lga zhes pa btags la bzla'o/ /ro'i bzhon pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ ru ru ro ru hūX phaṭa/ ces pa'i mthar phyogs mtshams kyi gdan brgyad 'god pa'i sngags btags la bzla'o/ /dbang phyug ltar sgrub pa ni/ ro langs chen po brgyad gri thod 'dzin pa/—328—

ro'i gdan la gnas par bsgom/ sngags ni/ oṃ bha hūX phaṭa/ de bzhin du/ bhi bhu bhe ste bho bho bhaX zhes pa sa bon gyi mgo bor/ oX dang mjug tu hūX phaṭa/ zhes pa sbyar/ de dag re re'i mthar/ oṃ hūX hi ṭi lga zhes pa btags la bzla ba ni pho brgyad kyi sngags dang / mo brgyad kyi sngags ni/ oṃ khyiXha huX phaṭa/ ces pa'i mthar gdan brgyad kyi sngags rnams rim pa bzhin btags la bzla'o/ /mgon po ltar sgrub pa ni/ ro gdan gyi steng du mgon po brgyad kyi gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ sku mdog nag por bsgom la/ sngags ni/ oṃ mahā kā la huX phaṭa/ ces pa'i mthar/ oX hūX sgru ṭi sha /zhes pa btags la bzla'o/ /mgon po brgyad yab rkyang kho na yin la/ de yang sgrub lugs bzhi po de phyir rang gi mos pa dang bstun pa'am brtag pa la ji ltar babs pa gcig bya ba yin kyang gshin rje ltar sgrub pa gtso che bar mdzad do/ /de yang bzlas pa'i gtso bo/ rtsa sngags dang / snying po dang / nye snying rnams la bya ba yin zhing / mjug tu 'khor sngags rnams kyang ci rigs bzla zhing / thun gyi mjug tu gtor ma 'bul lo/ /yang na gshin rje pho dang / srin po pho dang / dbang phyug pho rnams bzhon pa'i tshul du ro langs pho brgyad du byas la/mo'i tshul du sgrub na yang rung ngo / /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ rang nyid 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i thugs ka dang / mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar rgyu'i 'jam dpal/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūX gi mthar sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor bar dmigs la/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams mchod pas mnyes par byas/ sems can —329—

kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pas spyan drangs te/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim/ yang snying kha'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng la phog pas/ 'od zer gyi rtse mo las mchod pa dpag tu med pa sprul te/ mchod pas mnyes par byas/ 'od zer rnams tshur 'dus rang gi snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim par bsam/ de lta bu'i dmigs pa sngags brgya tshar re la bskyar gyin bya'o/ /mthar thun 'jog khar/ rang gi snying kha'i sngags 'phreng 'od zer 'bar ba las ngo bo sangs rgyas kyi byin glos/ rnam pa 'od zer dkar po'i gong bu zhig chad de/ snying ga'i stod tsam du gnas par bsam la/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags 'phreng gi byin rlabs brtan pa'i phyir yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod/ de nas 'phreng ba dkyil 'khor dbus sam mdun du bzhug la/ 'od zer gyi gong bu de nyid rang gi kha sgo'am/ spyi bo'am snying ga gang rung nas thon te mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng la thim pas byin rlabs phul bar bsam/ sgrub pa zla drug byed na zla ba lnga'i ring la dmigs pa de nyid kho na bya zhing / zla ba drug pa la thun gyi mjug tu sngags 'phreng skor lnga tsam gyi rang la mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng las sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pas byung ste/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim pas bkrag mdangs gzi brjid rgyas par bsam mo/ /sgrub pa zla ba lnga dang bzhi dang gsum la sogs pa byed na yang de'i rigs 'gre/ zla ba phyed gnyis byed na zla ba gcig gong gi dmigs pa de ka byed cing / zla ba phyed kyi ring la mdun bskyed las byin rlabs —330—

len pa'i dmigs pa de bya zhing / 'khor rnams las kyang dngos grub len pa'i dmigs pa bya'o/ /mthar sngags kyi nor bu 'bul ba yang bya'o/ /dngos grub len pa'i dmigs pa byed pa'i skabs kyi bzla bya'i sngags gsum po gang rung zhig gi mthar/ oṃ mahā badz+ra ste ra wa sarba sirnyi da ya ka ṭaX hūX kuX draX ṭa/ 〈dpe la lar dh+waX zer ba yod/〉 ces pa bzla zhing / 'khor rnams kyang rang rang gi sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ hūX rtsa sarba sirnyi da ya ka huX/ zhes pa'ang bzla'o/ /thun gyi mthar rang nyid dkyil 'bor nas phyir thon te/ dge ba bsngo zhing / gtor ma 'bul la spyod lam la 'jug go /de yang 'grub na thun re re bzhin sbyin sreg byed pa yin kyang / de bzhin mi 'grub na thun ji ltar rigs pa gcig la nges par bya dgos shing / ci ste de yang ma lcogs na nyer sgrub grub mtshams su zhag 'ga' zhig sprel te bya'o/ /nyer sgrub kyi skabs 'dir ci ste rdul wo gyi dkyil 'khor 'bri ba ma thub na/ phyag mtshan rnams gong bzhin bkod pa'i dbus su/ ras bris shing lta bu zhig la brten nas bkram mo/ /phyag mtshan so so'i sngags ni/ de yang re mig brgyad kyi nang gi mgo bo la sogs pa brgyad kyi sngags ni/ oṃ āXhiXhūX phaṭa/ oṃ āXrnyingaXhuX phaṭa/ oṃ āXbi hūX phaṭa/ glud āXkri hūX phaṭa/ skye( āXta huX phaṭa/ tseX( āX.a huX phaṭa/ skye( un huX phaṭa/oX āXn huX phaṭa/ shar gyi lha snam gyi mtshan ma drug gi sngags ni/ oṃ āXya huX phaṭa/ skye( āXm hūX phaṭa/ tsho ( āXr huX phaṭa/ tseXṭo āXdza huX phaṭa/ tso ( āXs hūX phaṭa/ skye( āXd hūX phaṭa/ lho'i lha snam gyi mtshan ma drug gi sngags ni/ oṃ āXya huX phaṭa/ oṃ āXme huX phaṭa/ skyed āXdo huX phaṭa/ skye( aXru huX phaṭa/ eX( āXṇa huX phaṭa/ skye rna aXye tsho huX —331—

phaṭa/ nub kyi lha snam gyi mtshan ma drug gi sngags ni/ oṃ āXya huX phaṭa/ oṃ āXd huX phaṭa/ skye( āXya hūX phaṭa/ tso( āXze de hūX phaṭa/ tshod āXr huX phaṭa/ glu( āXya huX phaṭa/byang gi lha snam gyi mtshan ma drug gi sngags ni/ oṃ āXya huX phaṭa/ oṃ āXspyo hūX phaṭa/ 8( āXya huX phaṭa/ tso ( āXsme hūX phaṭa/ tso( āXni huX phaṭa/ tseX( āXr huX phaṭa/ces pa rnams so/ /ro langs brgyad kyi sngags ni/ oṃ āXya hūX phaṭa/ oṃ āXmun huX phaṭa/ tseX( āXta huX phaṭa/ skye( āXka hūX phaṭa/ glu( āXhūX huX phaṭa/ skyed āXhūX hūX phaṭa/oṃ āXphaṭa hūX phaṭa/ oX āXphaṭa huX phaṭa/ ces pa rnams so/ /gdan brgyad kyi sngags ni/ tseX( āXme huX phaṭa/ tseX( āXya huX phaṭa/ tsho( āXd hūX phaṭa/ skye( āXya hūX phaṭa/ tseX( āXkhyo huX phaṭa/ skye( āXya hūX phaṭa/ glu( ā0༷ma huX phaṭa/ tseX( āXya huX phaṭa/ces pa rnams so/ /gong gi byin gyi brlabs pa'i skabs dang / bzlas pa'i skabs gnyis kar du ro langs brgyad dang / gdan brgyad la sogs pa so so'i sngags gong du bshad zin pa 'di dang / 'di skabs kyi sngags rnams rgya nyis rim gyi tshul gyis gnyis kar bzla bar bya'o/ /phyag mtshan so so'i sngags rnams kyang byin gyis rlobs pa dang / bzlas pa'i gnas skabs gnyis kar bzla bar bya'o/ /de yan chad kyis nyer sgrub kyi skor rnams song nas/ /༈ da ni sgrub pa'i rim pa rnams bshad par bya ste/ dkyil 'khor 'bri tshul sogs nas bzung / mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'bor gyi nang du 'jug pa'i bar nyer sgrub ji lta ba bzhi las/ yum bzhi khar bsgom na phyogs kyi re mig bzhi'i mtshan ma'i mdun du thod pa bzhi bri/ yang na dbyangs can ma dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma gang rung zhig bsgoms na/ shar phyogs kyi re mig gi mdun du —332—

mtshan ma thod pa gcig bkod/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i gnas skabs su yang yum bzhi khar bsgoms na/ shar du tsar tsi ka /lhor phag mo/ nub tu dbyangs can ma/ byang du go ri rnams dgra nag nas 'byung ba bzhin bsgom la byin gyis brlabs pa dang / bzlas pa'i gnas skabs su yang / oṃ mo hā ra ti hūX phaṭa/ oX pi tsu na rā ti hūX phaṭa/ oX ra ga rā ti huX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra rā ti hūX phaṭa/ ces pa bzla/dbyangs can ma'am rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma gang rung zhig bsgoms na/ dbyangs can ma'i sngags oX pu tsu sogs dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sngags/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki ni hūX phaṭa/ ces pa bzla'o/ /de nas rang nyid gtso bo dang dbyer med du gyur te/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na gtso bo'i tshul du gnas par mos la bzlas pa la 'jug par bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ rang nyid kyi thugs kar rgyu'i 'jam dpal/de'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūX gi mthar sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs la/ de las 'od zer sna tshogs dpag tu med pa spros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod pas mnyes par byas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'od zer slar 'dus rang la thim par bsam mo/ /de ltar sgrub pa zla drug byed na/ zla ba lnga'i ring la dmigs pa de dag bya zhing / zla ba drug pa la dngos grub len pa'i dmigs pa bya ste de yang thun mjug la snying po la sogs pa'i mthar/ oṃ mahā badz+ra ste ra wa sogs gtso bo'i dngos grub len pa'i sngags dang / 'khor so so'i sngags kyi mthar oX hūX rtsa sogs 'khor gyi dngos grub len pa'i bzlas pa yang cung zad bya zhing / rang gi snying ga'i —333—

sngags 'phreng 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer kyi rnam par spyan drangs te/ rang nyid kyi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng dang / 'khor thams cad kyi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng la phog pas bkrag mdangs gzi brjid rgyas par bsam la/ sngags bzla'o/ /thun mtshams la 'jug pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pas dkyil 'khor nas thon te/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byen chen pos bdag la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/ ces gsol ba btab la/ gtor ma phul lo/ /bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma'i skabs 'dir bar chad 'jug pa'i sgo shin tu che bas/ snyo kho sno bsrung bzlog rang nyid kyis srod thun la bya zhing / sgrub grogs dam tshig gtsang ba dag gi thun bzhi la sogs par bsrung 'khor sgom du 'jug go /de yan chad kyi sgrub pa'am/ bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma'i zhal gdams rnams song nas/ /༈ da ni sgrub chen gyi zhal gdams rnams bstan par bya ste/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang / sgrub tshul sogs gong bzhin las/ gtso bo'i mtshan ma ral gri'i mdun du thod snod la sogs par mar khu'am/ chang la sogs pa la dam rdzas btab pa'am yang na thod pa la sogs pa'i snod kyi nang du bdud rtsi ril bu lta bu zhig dngos grub kyi rdzas su bzhag /bdag bskyed grub mtshams su thod pa dang / de'i nang gi rdzas gnyis car la bgegs bskrad pa dang / a mṛ ta dang ya mun+ta ka la sogs pas mang du bsngags shing / mdun bskyed sgrub pa la 'jug —334—

cing thod pa'i nang gi rdzas dang bcas pa mdun bskyed kyi lte ba'i nang du gnas pa la bsangs sbyangs/ de yang dbus su huX dang / de'i mthar ya mun+ta kas bskor bar bsam/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ khu ba yin na bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i dbus su rdo rje 'jigs byed bskyed pa yin zhing / gong bu'i rdzas yin na de shin tu che bar gyur pa'i gtso bo'i phyogs su sa bon huX las rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa chung ngu zhig bskyed do/ /de nas gtor ma 'bul ba'i bar gong bzhin byas la/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnam pas dkyil 'khor gyi sgo nas zhugs te gtso bo dang rang gnyis su med par gyur pa'i lte bar thod nang gi rdzas kyi nang gi 'jigs byed dang bcas pa gnas par bsam la/ sngags gsum po gang rung gi mthar/ dngos grub len pa'i sngags btags la bzla/dmigs pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs rnams sngags dang / de yang 'od zer 'bar zhing bdud rtsi 'dzag pa'i rnam pa can dpag tu med pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ rang gi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng la thim bkrag mdangs rgyas par bsam zhing / de las sngags dang 'od zer bdud rtsi 'dzag pa'i rnam pa can gyi byin rlabs kyi cha shas zhig /lte ba'i rdzas nang gi 'jigs byed la thim pas bkrag mdangs rgyas par bsam mo/ /thun mtshams la 'jug pa'i skabs su rang nyid phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pas phyir phyung ste/ gtor ma 'phul ba sogs bya'o/ /de yang sgrub chen gyi skabs 'dir grub na zhag bdun la sogs pa byed pa'i tshe/ mtshan mo gnyid mi log par —335—

bzlas pa bya ba yin kyang / ci ste ma 'grub na zhag drug gi ring la mtshan phyed kyi bar du bzlas pa bya zhing / de nas dkyil 'khor gyi nang nas thon te/ yi dam gyi gtor ma 'bul ba dang / phyogs skyong la yang drug cu rtsa bzhi phul la/ de nas rang nyid 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis lag pa g.yas su ral gri dang / g.yon du thod pa chang gis gang ba thogs la sgrub khang gi phyi rol tu phyin te/sha khrag dang bcas pa'i gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi la/ thod pa'i nang gi chang nas blug la gtor ma rgyas par btang la/ tshams rngams dang bcas pas/hiXgyiXdang / hūX hūX ha ha ho ho he hai zhes pa 'don bzhin pas/ dkyil 'khor la bskor ba byas la/ de nas badz+ra ud gha ṭa ya sa mā ya pra be sha ya hūX/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi sgo nas zhugs te/ gtso bo'i sku'i mdun du 'dug par mos la/bdag la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu btab bo/ /de nas gnyid la sogs pa log na dkyil 'khor nas phyir thon te/ sgrub khang nyid du nyal lo/ /zhag bdun pa la/ nam gong gi spyin sreg dang / gtor ma 'bul ba dang /phyi rol tu drug cu rtsa bzhi gtong ba/ dkyil 'khor la bskor ba byed cing / nang du zhugs la dngos grub stsol bar gsol ba btab la/ rang nyid gtso bo dang dbyer med du gyur par bsam la bzlas pa bya/ de nas slar yang nam langs du nye ba na phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pas phyir thon te/ 'grub na spyin sreg dang / gtor ma gtong ba sogs bya/ ma 'grub na mchod pa gsar ba bshams la byin gyis brlabs la/ mchod pa rnams phul la/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs te/—336—

dngos grub stsol bar gsol ba drag la yun ring bar btab pas/ mdun bskyed rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis dngos grub kyi rdzas rang la gnang bar brtsams pa na/rang nyid kyis kyang / na maXte huX/ na maXme huX/ na mo na maXhūX/ zhes/ phyag 'tshal zhing hiXgyiXbazlas pas rang la dngos grub kyi rdzas te stsal ba la lag pa gnyis kyis blangs la/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thams cad du mos pas rdzas te bza' ba'am/ btung bas dngos grub thams cad thob par mos/ de nas dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol bya ba yin pa las/ nyer sgrub dang / sgrub pa'i skabs su ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba yin la/ sgrub chen gyi skabs 'dir mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs thams cad rang la oṃ āXhūX dang yo ga shudha sogs bzla bzhin pas rang la bsdu'o/ /de la sgrub pa po dngos grub 'grub pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa dag gis ril bu mig sman ro langs sogs kyi dngos grub rnams kyang tshul 'di kho nas cho gas sgrub pa yin la/ da lta las dang po pa rnams kyis mos pa lam byed kyi tshul gyis sgrub pa yin no/ /gzhan dag rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor gyis ril bu mig sman la sogs pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa yang dgra nag nas 'byung ba'i cho gas sgrub dgos so/ /zhes smra ba ni rtogs bdun nas bshad pa'i man ngag zab mo 'di lta bu dang mi ldan zhing ma rtogs par zad do/ /de dag gis ni thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa rnams zugad zin to/ /༈ /'dir smras pa/ zab yang chos kyi gting mtha' mi mngon pa/ /thamasacad mkhyen cing gzigs pa'i ye shes yul/ /gang la gang dga' de de'i gdul —337—

bya la/ /bskal ba'i rim par ston 'di rgyal ba'i srol/ /de phyir snying la zhe sdang me 'bar ba'i/ /gdug can gang de 'dul ba'i thabs kyis 'phrul/ /brjod bya rab zab rjod byed rdo rje'i tshig /rtog bdun 'jam pa'i rdo rjes nye bar bstan/ /gang de'i dgongs don bla med pa/ /mthu stobs dpa' bo rwa lo yis/ /man ngag snyan nas snyan brgyud pa/ /mkhas rlo me phal gyi ming tsam yang / /rna ba'i lam du ma grags pa/ /u dum ba ra'i me tog ltar/ khren tu rnyed dka'i lam bzang 'di/ /bla ma'i drin las legs rnyed pa/ /brjed pa 'jigs nas yi ger bris/ /byis pa'i blo ni don la rmongs/ /de phyir nor dang 'khrul ba'i cha/ /'di la gang byung de dang de/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bshags/ /'dir 'bad dge ba thob de yis/ /'gro rnams 'jam pa'i rdo rje yi/ /go 'phang bla med thob par shog /ces pa'ang rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' snying po'i gsung rgyud las byung ba/ shākya'i dge slong ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su byas pa'o/ /dge'o// // bkra shis//de nas nang mchod ni/ dmigs pa byin rlabs rnams rtogs bdun las ma gsungs kyang / gdong drug gi rgyud las dngos su gsungs pas/ thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga dbus dang phyogs bzhir na ga ku da ha sha lnga'i ngo bo yin par bsam/ ya kle ma me da lnga gshin rje rigs lnga'i ngo bor mos/mtshams bzhir dbus dang lngar/ byang sems dri chen/ dri chu/ klad pa/ rak+ta rnams rim bzhin/ dza sa ma rus huX mtshan pa yum tsar tsi ka /phag mo/ dbyangs can ma/ go ri bzhi'i ngo bor mos/ rang gi thugs kar 'od 'phros/ de dag la —338—

phog pas de thams cad zhi zhing 'dres pa'i nang du sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i steng mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la 'phyud pa/ shar rwa'i steng du rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ spyan ma la/lhor rin 'byung ser po/ mā ma ki/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po/ dbyangs can ma byang rwa'i steng du don yod grub pa ljang gu ral gri 'dzin pa/ yum sgrol ma la 'khyud pa/ thams cad g.yas rang rang gi phyag mtshan/ g.yon pa thams cad dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /yab yum snyoms 'jug byas pa'i sgras sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsir zhu/ yum gyi pad+ma ra babs/ yab yum rnams rjes chags kyi rol pas bdud rtsi zhu/ rdzas rnams la thim pas/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam/ thams cad la dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig /—339—

nyin gcig rdzogs pa'i dbu bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/ dpal gzhan rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang rgyu 'bras gshin rje kun/ /'joms byed bde stong dbyer med gshed/ /dngos po kun kyis gus btud nas/ /de yi gtor ma'i rnam dbye bshad/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor ma bsdus pa gtong bar 'dod pas/ 4zhams bkod rnams tshar ba dang / 'di'i bshams bkod ni/ bris sku la sogs rten gyi mdun du/ yi dam gyi gtor ma zlum gtor zhig stegs mtho ba la ba theg /de'i mdun nam/ g.yon du stegs dma' ba la/gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i gtor ma zur gsum pa dang / snod cung zad yangs pa zhig tu/ phyogs skyong spyi'i gtor ma zlum po'i grub gsum gang 'os bshams/ de rnams kyi mdun du 'theb skyu yang zlum po'am/ gru gsum sogs las gang byed dang bstun/ snod bzhir 'theb skyu bcu drug bcu drug gi snod brgyad du brgyad dam/ bcu drug tu bzhi bzhi bshams pa'am/ yang na snod che ba gcig tu tshan pa so sor bcad de bshams kyang drang / de dag gi mdun du 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mchod pa dang bstun/ de'i mdun du las gshin gyi mchod pa thams cad kyang phyi rol tu spyi'i mchod pa bshams/drag po'i las cung zad 'brel na/ rak+ta'i ar+ghaX yang bshams/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang gtor ma byin rlabs thams cad lhan cig tu byas/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma dang gnas yo byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par bya/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum gang rung gi bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus lung skabs dang sbyar/ bzlas pa cung zad bya/ mdun bskyed nyen yod na de la dmigs shing / med na mdun gyi nam mkha' bskyed pa yin la/ 'jigs byed lta bu la dper mtsho ni na/ ya mun+ta kas bsangs/ swa bhā —340—

was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gru gsum zhes pa nas/ mdun bskyed rgyas bsdus dmar nag 'jigs gsum rang rang gi lugs ltar bya/ spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol dbang bskur rgyas gdab rang rang gi lugs ltar bya/ mdun bskyed mchod bstod rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa bya/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer gyis rtse mo nas khro bo lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ phyogs skyong ba bcu srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa bkug par gyur/ oX khyiXsgyi bi kri ta nan hūX phaṭa/ in+t+ra ya sa pa ri wa ra ṇa a kar+ṣa ya dzaX sogs nas phur gdab dbang bskur rgyas gdab bya/ de nas las gshin gyi gtor ma rgyas bsdus gang rung 'bul/ thugs rgyud bskul ba'i ched du bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ de nas chos skyong gang mos kyi gtor ma bsngo ba mkha' 'gro sbyi gtor gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs skabs 'dir bya/ drug cu rtsa bzhi btab pa'i tshul ni/snod so sor na chu dang chang phal pa thog ma nas blug /gtor ma byin rlabs kyi gong du nang mchod re blug oṃ aXhuX ha ho hiXs lan gsum byin gyis rlabs/ yi dam gyi snying po tshar re dang phyogs skyong kyi sngags kyi phul/ in+t+ra ya: sogs/ phre phre phre phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ bdag dang che ge mo'i sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad shin+taX ku ru swāhā/ oX sha dig lī ka pa la sa pa ri wa ra khyuX zhes mgo bor sbyar la/ ar+ghaXje nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyi nang mchod/ bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'joms/ /go pas bstod/ 'dod don gsol gdab bsdus pa'i skabs/ 'di zhes bya ba'i 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod 'phel/ /thams cad dbang du bsdu bar mdzod/ /log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ /mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las kyis/ /don dam dbyings su tshar chod la/ /zhi ba chen por mdzad du —341—

gsol/ /bde legs thams cad 'gyung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub ye rdzog /ces pa yan chod zhi ba'i lugs la 'theb skyu zlum po/ rgyas pa la gru bzhi/ dbang la zla gam/bsad bskrad la gru gsum gong bzhin du sngags dang 'dod don gsol gdab 'dra ba la/ mjug tu rgyas la/ tshe dang bsod nams pyuXni ku ru ye swāhā/ dbang la/ che ge mo wa shaX ku ru ho/dgug pa la/ che ge mo a kar+ṣa ya dza hri/ bskrad pa la/ che ge mo u tsi ṭa ya phaṭa/ bzlog pa la/ byad ma dgra bgegs thams cad ni bā ra ya phaṭa/ bsad pa la/ mā ra ya phaṭa/ rengs pa la/ 'a ya laX/ dbye ba la/ che ge mo dang che ge mo bi de sha ya phaṭa/bsrung ba la/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā/ zhes spel tshig dang 'don pa sbyar ba bya/ bzhi tshar bcug pa la 'byung po thams cad pa dang lhan cig tu byin pa la/ phyogs skyong gi tshang bzhi dang / oṃ kha kha ji hi ji hi/ sogs lan gnyis kyis gtor ma byin nas 'phrin las bcol ba la sogs sngar bzhin du bya/ de nas gtor ma rnams la dpal 'bar btsug la/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ /sogs phyogs skyong gi bstod pa sogs/ tshogs la bstod/ gang 'dul tshul gyi/ zhes pa nas/ lha'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /zhes sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pas bar gyi 'phrin las bcol/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pa'i 'dod/〈mjug ma rnyed lags/〉—342—

dge spyan ba/ rgyal smre 'brug pa/ ri — byāri dpe sgrig 'gan —'khur pa/ tshangs po/ mdun shog ma rjes 'ego de pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/ ri —༷ — dro —ri — rdo dzo — — skyi ci ༷ri —tsho— bye56snyes she/su~X/rdosherdo la5 / co snye deb —gya ga ji/ma ga— ༄nam/rderde /jo mang ca ra ma tha'i gsang 'bam/—ri justo rderderde/ / / tshon / /rnyog rgyu rnyog bye /— ( 41745) rīco — smra —dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying— zheb 'jug kheng gis bsgrigs/ :krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gi se bskrun/rderde te bkram/pe cin ma'o rin tshon khra par 'deb so kung sis dpar btab/ji lo 20༷8lo'i snga /ra par gzhi dang ca bsgrig /sgo lo 2008lo'i rder ra meng dang go btab/dpar grangs/ 1—spro— nye34mya rde —1bya2smo978—7—8ji263—013—3(2 51gsung 'bum cho tshang (deb 1—45yod ) la rin sgor/ 9 10 00

nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gi las sgrub mi snar lo bstud mar 'tsho ba'i yon spyor gnang mkhan mchog sprul pad+ma dbang rgyal rin po che la snying thag pa nas thugs rje zhu ba dang /krung rga'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma par skrun thad la rgyab skyor dang mnyam las gnang bar snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba yin/dpar phro zhal 'debs gnang mkhan/rang re'i spun zla rnams kyi mtshan tho/ ka mad kyi go rim ltar lags/gdung sras phrin las nor bu rin po che/ bla ma mthar phyin rin po che/ bla ma yon tan/sman pa rig 'dzin lags/ las rab gling pa rin po che/ bsod nams bde skyid/
